d: n 字母A；第一流的；学业成绩达最高标准的评价符号 used to show that you are referring to a general type of person or thing and not a specific person or thing；abbr [物]安（ampere）

es.e: Would you like a sandwich?
es.c: 来块三明治好吗？

es.e: I want to train to be an engineer.
es.c: 我想经过培训成为一名工程师。

es.e: He’s a really nice man.
es.c: 他真是个好人。

d: n 放任；狂热 if someone does something with abandon, they behave in a careless or uncontrolled way, without thinking or caring about what they are doing；v 遗弃；放弃 to leave someone, especially someone you are responsible for

es.e: He approached life with reckless abandon–I don't think he himself knew what he was going to do next.
es.c: 他以不计后果的放纵态度对待生活–我想他自己都不知道他接下来要做什么。

d: n 能力，能耐；才能 the state of being able to do something

es.e: The test measures your mathematical ability.
es.c: 这种测试考查的是数学能力。

d: adj 能；[经管] 有能力的；能干的 clever or good at doing something；n (Able)人名；(伊朗)阿布勒；(英)埃布尔

es.e: one of my more able students
es.c: 我班上能力比较强的学生之一

d: adj 反常的，不规则的；变态的 very different from usual in a way that seems strange, worrying, wrong, or dangerous

es.e: abnormal behaviour
es.c: 反常行为

es.e: an abnormal level of cholesterol
es.c: 胆固醇水平异常

es.e: My parents thought it was abnormal for a boy to be interested in ballet.
es.c: 我父母认为一个男孩子对芭蕾舞感兴趣并不正常。

d: adv 在飞机上；[船] 在船上；在火车上 on or onto a ship, plane, or train；prep 在…上 on or onto a ship, plane, or train

es.e: The plane crashed, killing all 200 people aboard.
es.c: 飞机失事，机上200人全部遇难。

es.e: The boat swayed as he stepped aboard.
es.c: 他上船时，船晃了起来。

d: v 废除，废止；取消，革除 to officially end a law, system etc, especially one that has existed for a long time

es.e: Slavery was abolished in the US in the 19th century.
es.c: 美国于19世纪废除了奴隶制。

d: n 流产，堕胎，小产；流产的胎儿；（计划等）失败，夭折 a medical operation to end a  pregnancy  so that the baby is not born alive

es.e: She decided to have an abortion .
es.c: 她决定做人工流产。

es.e: anti-abortion campaigners
es.c: 参与反堕胎运动的人

d: prep 关于；大约 concerning or relating to a particular subject；adj 在附近的；四处走动的；在起作用的；adv 大约；周围；到处 a little more or less than a particular number, amount, or size；n 大致；粗枝大叶；不拘小节的人

es.e: a book about politics
es.c: 一本有关政治的书

es.e: She said something about leaving town.
es.c: 她说了些要离开镇子的话。

es.e: He lied about his age.
es.c: 他谎报年龄。

d: prep 超过；在……上面；在……之上；adv 在上面；在上文 in a higher position than something else；adj 上文的 used in a piece of writing to refer to something mentioned in an earlier part of the same piece of writing；n 上文 Above is also a noun

es.e: Our office is above the hairdresser’s.
es.c: 我们的办公室在理发店上面。

es.e: He had a bruise just above his left eye.
es.c: 就在他左眼上方有块瘀伤。

es.e: I heard a strange noise coming from the room above.
es.c: 我听见楼上房间传来奇怪的响声。

d: adv 在国外；到海外 in or to a foreign country；adj 往国外的；n 海外；异国

es.e: I’ve never lived abroad before.
es.c: 我以前从未在国外生活过。

es.e: She often goes abroad on business.
es.c: 她经常出国公干。

es.e: We never travelled abroad when we were kids.
es.c: 我们小时候从来没有去国外旅行过。

d: adj 生硬的；突然的；唐突的；陡峭的 sudden and unexpected

es.e: an abrupt change of plan
es.c: 计划的突然改变

d: n 没有；缺乏；缺席；不注意 when you are not in the place where people expect you to be, or the time that you are away

es.e: In the absence of any evidence, the police had to let Myers go.
es.c: 警察没有证据，只好把迈尔斯放了。

d: adj 缺席的；缺少的；心不在焉的；茫然的 not at work, school, a meeting etc, because you are sick or decide not to go；v 使缺席 to not go to a place or take part in an event where people expect you to be

es.e: The dull, absent look on her face implied boredom.
es.c: 她脸上呆滞、茫然的神情说明她觉得无聊了。

d: adj 绝对的；完全的；专制的 complete or total；n 绝对；绝对事物 something that is considered to be true or right in all situations

es.e: I have absolute confidence in her.
es.c: 我对她充满信心。

es.e: We don’t know with absolute certainty that the project will succeed.
es.c: 我们没有绝对的把握这个项目一定会成功。

d: v 吸收；吸引；承受；理解；使…全神贯注 to take in liquid, gas, or another substance from the surface or space around something

es.e: Plants absorb nutrients from the soil.
es.c: 植物从土壤中吸收养分。

d: n 摘要；抽象；抽象的概念 a painting, design etc which contains shapes or images that do not look like real things or people；adj 抽象的；深奥的 based on general ideas or principles rather than specific examples or real events；v 摘要；提取；使……抽象

es.e: Talking about crime in the abstract just isn’t enough.
es.c: 抽象地谈论犯罪根本不足以说明问题。

d: adj 荒谬的；可笑的 completely stupid or unreasonable；n 荒诞；荒诞作品

es.e: It seems an absurd idea.
es.c: 这似乎是个荒唐的想法。

d: adj 丰富的；充裕的；盛产 something that is abundant exists or is available in large quantities so that there is more than enough

es.e: an abundant supply of fresh water
es.c: 充足的淡水供应

es.e: abundant opportunities for well qualified staff
es.c: 提供给高素质的员工的大量机会

d: n 滥用；虐待；辱骂；弊端；恶习，陋习 cruel or violent treatment of someone；v 滥用；虐待；辱骂 to treat someone in a cruel and violent way, often sexually

es.e: several cases of child abuse
es.c: 数宗虐待儿童案

es.e: An independent committee will look into alleged human rights abuses.
es.c: 一个独立委员会将对涉嫌践踏人权的行为进行调查。

d: adj 学术的；理论的；学院的 relating to education, especially at college or university level；n 大学生，大学教师；学者 a teacher in a college or university

es.e: He possessed no academic qualifications.
es.c: 他没有学历。

es.e: a program to raise academic standards
es.c: 旨在提高学术水平的计划

d: n 学院；研究院；学会；专科院校 an official organization which encourages the development of literature, art, science etc

es.e: the American Academy of Arts and Letters
es.c: 美国艺术和文学学会

d: v 使……加快；使……增速 if a process accelerates or if something accelerates it, it happens faster than usual or sooner than you expect

es.e: measures to accelerate the rate of economic growth
es.c: 加快经济增长速度的措施

d: n 口音；重音；强调；特点；重音符号 the way someone pronounces the words of a language, showing which country or which part of a country they come from；v 强调；重读；带…口音讲话 to make something more noticeable so that people will pay attention to

es.e: He had a strong Irish accent
es.c: 他有浓重的爱尔兰口音。

d: v 接受；承认；承担；承兑；容纳 to take something that someone offers you, or to agree to do something that someone asks you to do

es.e: Rick accepted her offer of coffee.
es.c: 她请里克喝咖啡，他接受了。

es.e: He accepted the invitation to stay with us.
es.c: 他接受了邀请来我们家住。

es.e: His school reports said that he is always ready to accept a challenge (=  agree to do something difficult  ) .
es.c: 他的学业报告上说他乐于接受挑战。

d: v 使用；存取；接近 to find information, especially on a computer；n 进入；使用权；通路 the right to enter a place, use something, see someone etc

es.e: Users can access their voice mail remotely.
es.c: 用户可以远程获取语音邮件。

d: adj 易接近的；可进入的；可理解的 a place, building, or object that is accessible is easy to reach or get into

es.e: The island is only accessible by boat.
es.c: 这个岛只有坐船才能到。

es.e: There is a church which is easily accessible from my home.
es.c: 有座教堂离我家很近。

d: n 锚；抛锚停泊；靠山；新闻节目主播 a piece of heavy metal that is lowered to the bottom of the sea, a lake etc to prevent a ship or boat moving；v 抛锚；使固定；主持节目 to fasten something firmly so that it cannot move；adj 末棒的；最后一棒的

es.e: We dropped anchor a few yards offshore.
es.c: 我们在离岸几码远的地方抛锚停航。

es.e: The next morning, they weighed anchor (=  lifted the anchor  ) and began to move south again.
es.c: 第二天早上他们起锚，又开始向南航行。

d: n 事故；意外；[法] 意外事件；机遇 in a way that is not planned or intended

es.e: I met her quite by accident (=  completely by accident  ) .
es.c: 我遇见她完全是偶然。

es.e: The discovery was made almost by accident.
es.c: 这项发现几乎纯属意外。

es.e: The pilot, whether by accident or design (=  whether it was planned or not planned  ) , made the plane do a sharp turn.
es.c: 不知是有意还是无意，那名飞行员让飞机来了个急转弯。

d: n 住处，膳宿；调节；和解；预订铺位 a place for someone to stay, live, or work

es.e: The price for the holiday includes flights and accommodation.
es.c: 度假的价格包括机票和住宿。

es.e: living accommodations for the crews
es.c: 船员的起居舱

es.e: travel and hotel accommodations
es.c: 旅行及酒店住宿

d: v 陪伴，伴随；伴奏 to go somewhere with someone

es.e: Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult.
es.c: 14岁以下儿童必须有成人陪同。

es.e: Wherever her husband went, she would accompany him.
es.c: 不论丈夫去哪里，她都陪伴左右。

d: v 完成；实现；达到 to succeed in doing something, especially after trying very hard

es.e: We have accomplished all we set out to do.
es.c: 所有计划要做的事情，我们都已完成。

es.e: (=  we have done what we intended to do  ) .
es.c: 大功告成。

d: n 账户；解释；账目，账单；理由；描述 an arrangement in which a bank keeps your money safe so that you can pay more in or take money out；v 解释；导致；报账

es.e: My salary is paid into my bank account.
es.c: 我的工资直接存入我的银行账户。

es.e: I’ve opened an account with Barclay’s Bank.
es.c: 我在巴克莱银行开了一个账户。

es.e: My husband and I have a joint account (=  one that is shared between two people  ) .
es.c: 我和丈夫有个联名账户。

d: n 会计师；会计人员 someone whose job is to keep and check financial accounts, calculate taxes etc

es.e: The boss dropped an accountant from the payroll.
es.c: 老板把一名会计师从在职人员名单中除了名。

d: v 累积；积聚 to gradually get more and more money, possessions, knowledge etc over a period of time

es.e: It is unjust that a privileged few should continue to accumulate wealth.
es.c: 少数特权阶级继续积聚财富，这是不公平的。

d: n [数] 精确度，准确性 the ability to do something in an exact way without making a mistake

es.e: He passes the ball with unerring accuracy.
es.c: 他传球准确无误。

d: v 控告，指控；谴责；归咎于 to say that you believe someone is guilty of a crime or of doing something bad

es.e: The professor stands accused of (=  has been accused of  ) stealing his student’s ideas and publishing them.
es.c: 那位教授被指控剽窃学生的观点拿去发表。

d: adj 习惯的；通常的；独有的 usual；v 使习惯于（accustom的过去分词）

es.e: The pans were in their accustomed places.
es.c: 那些锅在老地方。

d: v 疼痛；渴望 if part of your body aches, you feel a continuous, but not very sharp pain there；n 疼痛 a continuous pain that is not sharp or very strong

es.e: His feet were aching from standing so long.
es.c: 他站了那么久，双脚隐隐作痛。

d: v 取得；获得；实现；成功 to successfully complete something or get a good result, especially by working hard

es.e: Frances achieved very good exam results.
es.c: 弗朗西丝考试取得了优异成绩。

es.e: Wilson has achieved considerable success as an artist.
es.c: 威尔逊作为一名艺术家成就斐然。

es.e: She eventually achieved her goal of becoming a professor.
es.c: 她终于实现目标，当上了教授。

d: n 成就；完成；达到；成绩 something important that you succeed in doing by your own efforts

es.e: His great achievement is to make all the players into a united team.
es.c: 他的伟大成就在于把所有选手组织成一支团结的队伍。

d: n 酸；<俚>迷幻药 a chemical substance that has a  pH  of less than 7. Strong acids can burn holes in material or damage your skin；adj 酸的；讽刺的；刻薄的 having a sharp sour taste

es.e: sulphuric acid
es.c: 硫酸

d: v 承认；答谢；报偿；告知已收到 to admit or accept that something is true or that a situation exists

es.e: The family acknowledge the need for change.
es.c: 全家人都承认需要改变一下。

es.e: Claire acknowledged that she was guilty.
es.c: 克莱尔承认有罪。

es.e: The government must acknowledge what is happening and do something about it.
es.c: 对于目前的情况，政府必须承认其存在并对此采取措施。

d: n 熟人；相识；了解；知道 someone you know, but who is not a close friend

es.e: She was a casual acquaintance of my family in Vienna.
es.c: 她是我们家在维也纳的一个交情不深的朋友。

es.e: He heard about the job through a mutual acquaintance (=  someone you and another person both know  ) .
es.c: 他是通过一个双方都认识的人知道有这份工作的。

d: v 获得；取得；学到；捕获 to obtain something by buying it or being given it

es.e: Manning hoped to acquire valuable works of art as cheaply as possible.
es.c: 曼宁希望以尽可能低的价格买到有价值的艺术品。

es.e: She has acquired an email address and a site on the World Wide Web.
es.c: 她获得了一个电子邮件地址和万维网网址。

d: n 获得物，获得；收购 the process by which you gain knowledge or learn a skill

es.e: the acquisition of language
es.c: 语言的习得

d: n 土地，地产；英亩 a unit for measuring area, equal to 4,840 square yards or 4,047 square metres

es.e: They own 200 acres of farmland.
es.c: 他们拥有200英亩农田。

es.e: a 200-acre wood
es.c: 一片200英亩的林地

d: prep 穿过；横穿；adv 横过；在对面 on the opposite side of something

es.e: We can gain some time if we cut across this field.
es.c: 我们如果抄近路穿过这片田野可以省下一些时间。

d: v 扮演；装作，举动像 to perform in a play or film；n 行为，行动；法令，法案；（戏剧，歌剧的）一幕，段；装腔作势 one thing that you do

es.e: I first started acting when I was 12 years old.
es.c: 我12岁开始演戏。

es.e: The movie is very well acted.
es.c: 这部影片演得非常好。

d: n 行动；活动；功能；战斗；情节 the process of doing something, especially in order to achieve a particular thing

es.e: The government must take action (=  do something  ) now to stop the rise in violent crime.
es.c: 政府现在必须采取行动遏止暴力犯罪的上升。

es.e: She was looking forward to putting her ideas into action (=  doing the things she had planned  ) .
es.c: 她盼望着将自己的想法付诸实施。

es.e: Ambulance crews are ready to spring into action (=  suddenly start doing something  ) if anything goes wrong during the race.
es.c: 救护车急救人员随时准备出动，以应对比赛期间发生的意外。

d: adj 积极的；活跃的；主动的；有效的；现役的 always busy doing things, especially physical or mental activities；n 主动语态；积极分子 the active form of a verb, for example ‘destroyed’ in the sentence ‘Enemy planes destroyed the village.’

es.e: games for active youngsters
es.c: 活跃好动的年轻人玩的游戏

es.e: She’s over 80, but is still very active.
es.c: 她80多岁了，但仍旧很活跃。

d: n 活动；行动；活跃 things that people do, especially in order to achieve a particular aim

es.e: Everyone is free to engage in peaceful political activity.
es.c: 每个人都可以自由参加和平的政治活动。

es.e: fund-raising activities
es.c: 筹款活动

es.e: Regular physical activity helps to control your weight.
es.c: 定期参加体育活动有助于控制体重。

d: n 男演员；行动者；作用物 someone who performs in a play or film

es.e: His father was an actor in the Cantonese Opera Company.
es.c: 他父亲曾是粤剧团的一名演员。

d: n 女演员 a woman who performs in a play or film

es.e: She's not only a great dramatic actress but she's also very funny.
es.c: 她不仅是一位伟大的女戏剧演员，而且也很幽默。

d: adj 真实的，实际的；现行的，目前的 used to emphasize that something is real or exact

es.e: I’m not joking. Those were his actual words.
es.c: 我没开玩笑，那都是他的原话。

es.e: I know Germany won, but I can’t tell you the actual score.
es.c: 我知道德国队胜了，但我不知道确切的比分。

es.e: Interest is only charged on the actual amount borrowed.
es.c: 利息只按实际借款额收取。

d: adj 严重的，[医] 急性的；敏锐的；激烈的；尖声的 an acute problem is very serious

es.e: The housing shortage is more acute than first thought.
es.c: 住房短缺情况比一开始想的要严重。

d: n 公元；广告（ad）
v 使适应；改编 to gradually change your behaviour and attitudes in order to be successful in a new situation

es.e: The ability to adapt is a definite asset in this job.
es.c: 适应能力是做这份工作的绝对有利条件。

d: n 适应；改编；改编本，改写本 a film or television programme that is based on a book or play

es.e: Branagh won two awards for his screen adaptation of Shakespeare's Henry the Fifth.
es.c: 布拉纳因他对莎士比亚的《亨利五世》的荧幕改编而获了两次奖。

d: v 加；增加；加起来；做加法 to put something with something else or with a group of other things；n 加法，加法运算

es.e: If the mixture seems dry, add water.
es.c: 如果混合物看上去干，加点水。

d: adj 沉溺于某种（尤其是不良的）嗜好的；入了迷的，上了瘾的 unable to stop taking a harmful substance, especially a drug；v 使…上瘾（addict的过去分词）

es.e: Many of the women are addicted to heroin and cocaine.
es.c: 这些妇女中的很多吸食海洛因和可卡因成瘾。

d: n 添加；[数] 加法；增加物 the act of adding something to something else

es.e: This is a fine book; a worthy addition to the series.
es.c: 这是一本好书——是对这套丛书有价值的增补。

d: v 演说；从事；忙于；写姓名地址；向…致辞；与…说话；提出；处理 if you address an envelope, package etc, you write on it the name and address of the person you are sending it to；n 地址；演讲；致辞；说话的技巧；称呼 a formal speech that someone makes to a group of peop

es.e: Send a stamped, self-addressed envelope (=  with your address on it so it can be sent back to you  ) .
es.c: 寄上一个贴好邮票的、写有回邮地址的信封。

d: adj 充足的；适当的；胜任的 enough in quantity or of a good enough quality for a particular purpose

es.e: Farmers have been slow to make adequate provision for their retirement.
es.c: 农民们迟迟没有为退休做好适当安排。

es.e: Some creams we tested failed to give adequate protection against UV light.
es.c: 我们检测的有些防晒霜不能提供足够的防紫外线保护。

es.e: The standard of his work is barely adequate .
es.c: 他的工作水准勉强合格。

d: v 调整，使…适合；校准 to change or move something slightly to improve it or make it more suitable for a particular purpose

es.e: Check and adjust the brakes regularly.
es.c: 经常检查并调节刹车装置。

es.e: Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning.
es.c: 尝尝汤的味道，然后调整佐料用量。

es.e: If your employment status changes, your tax code will be adjusted accordingly.
es.c: 如果就业状况改变，你的免税代码也会作相应调整。

d: n 调整，调节；调节器 a small change made to a machine, system, or calculation

es.e: a period of adjustment
es.c: 一段调整期

d: n 管理；行政；实施；行政机构 the activities that are involved in managing the work of a company or organization

es.e: We’re looking for someone with experience in administration.
es.c: 我们正在寻找一个有管理经验的人。

es.e: The health service spends too much on administration.
es.c: 医疗服务部门在行政方面花费太多。

d: adj 令人钦佩的；极好的；值得赞扬的 having many good qualities that you respect and admire

es.e: an admirable achievement
es.c: 令人钦佩的成就

d: v 钦佩；赞美 to respect and like someone because they have done something that you think is good

es.e: I really admire the way she brings up those kids all on her own.
es.c: 我十分佩服她独力把那些孩子抚养大。

d: n 承认；入场费；进入许可；坦白；录用 a statement in which you admit that something is true or that you have done something wrong

es.e: Reese, by his own admission , lacks the necessary experience.
es.c: 里斯自己也承认缺乏必要的经验。

d: v 承认；准许进入；可容纳 to agree unwillingly that something is true or that someone else is right

es.e: ‘Okay, so maybe I was a little bit scared,’ Jenny admitted.
es.c: “行了，也许我是有点害怕。”珍妮承认道。

es.e: I must admit , I didn’t actually do anything to help her.
es.c: 我必须承认，实际上我并没有帮她什么忙。

es.e: Admit it! I’m right, aren’t I?
es.c: 承认吧！我对了，是不是？

d: n 青春期 the time, usually between the ages of 12 and 18, when a young person is developing into an adult

es.e: Some young people suddenly become self-conscious and tongue-tied in early adolescence.
es.c: 一些年青人在青春期早期突然变得害羞结舌。

d: adj 青春期的；未成熟的 Adolescent is used to describe young people who are no longer children but who have not yet become adults. It also refers to their behaviour.；n 青少年 a young person, usually between the ages of 12 and 18, who

es.e: It is important that an adolescent boy should have an adult in whom he can confide.
es.c: 一个青春期男孩应该有一个他能倾吐心声的成年人，这是很重要的。

d: v 采取；接受；收养；正式通过 to take someone else’s child into your home and legally become its parent

es.e: Sally was adopted when she was four.
es.c: 莎莉四岁时被人收养。

es.e: The couple are unable to have children of their own, but hope to adopt.
es.c: 那对夫妇自己无法生育，但希望领养孩子。

d: v 崇拜；爱慕；喜爱；极喜欢 to love someone very much and feel very proud of them；n (Adore)人名；(法)阿多尔

es.e: Betty adores her grandchildren.
es.c: 贝蒂非常宠爱孙辈。

d: adj 成年的；成熟的 fully grown or developed；n 成年人 a fully-grown person, or one who is considered to be legally responsible for their actions

es.e: an adult lion
es.c: 一头成年的狮子

es.e: the adult population
es.c: 成年人口

es.e: He lived most of his adult life in Scotland.
es.c: 他成年后大部分时间住在苏格兰。

d: n 发展；前进；增长；预付款 a change, discovery, or  invention  that brings progress；v 提出；预付；使……前进；将……提前 to move towards someone or something, especially in a slow and determined way – used especially to talk about soldiers；adj 预先的；先

es.e: a major advance
es.c: 一项重大进展

es.e: the advances made in the understanding of mental handicap
es.c: 在了解智障方面取得的进步

es.e: They don't normally give any advance notice about which building they're going to inspect.
es.c: 他们对要视察哪座大楼通常不作事先通知。

d: n 优势；利益；有利条件 something that helps you to be more successful than others, or the state of having this；v 获利

es.e: Younger workers tend to be at an advantage (=  have an advantage  ) when applying for jobs.
es.c: 年轻点的工人申请工作时往往处于优势地位。

es.e: It might be to your advantage (=  it might help you  ) to take a computer course of some kind.
es.c: 上一门计算机课程可能对你有利。

d: n 冒险；冒险精神；投机活动 willingness to try new things, take risks etc；v 冒险；大胆说出

es.e: Come on – where’s your sense of adventure?
es.c: 来吧——你的冒险精神哪里去了？

d: v 通知；为…做广告；使突出 to tell the public about a product or service in order to persuade them to buy it

es.e: They no longer advertise alcohol or cigarettes at sporting events.
es.c: 他们不再在体育赛事上做烟酒广告了。

es.e: Colleges and universities have found that it pays to advertise (=  advertising brings good results  ) .
es.c: 大专院校发现做广告效果很好。

d: n 广告，宣传 a picture, set of words, or a short film, which is intended to persuade people to buy a product or use a service, or that gives information about a job that is available, an event that is going to happen etc

es.e: They put an advertisement in ‘The Morning News’, offering a high salary for the right person.
es.c: 他们在《晨报》上刊登了一则启事，出高薪寻找合适的人选。

es.e: The organizers of the concert had taken out a full page advertisement in ‘The New York Times’.
es.c: 音乐会筹办者在《纽约时报》上刊登了整版广告。

es.e: Only a handful of people answered the advertisement .
es.c: 只有寥寥数人对该广告作出了回应。

d: n 建议；忠告；劝告；通知 an opinion you give someone about what they should do

es.e: You should have followed my advice.
es.c: 你真该听我的建议。

d: v 建议；劝告，忠告；通知；警告 to tell someone what you think they should do, especially when you know more than they do about something

es.e: She needed someone to advise her.
es.c: 她需要有个人给她出主意。

es.e: ‘Make sure that you keep the documents in a safe place,’ Otley advised him.
es.c: “一定要把文件放在安全的地方。”奥特利向他建议道。

d: v 提倡，主张，拥护 to publicly support a particular way of doing something；n 提倡者；支持者；律师 someone who publicly supports someone or something

es.e: Extremists were openly advocating violence.
es.c: 极端主义者公开鼓吹使用暴力。

d: n 飞机（等于airplane） a flying vehicle with wings and at least one engine

es.e: The aeroplane landed us at the airport in Barcelona.
es.c: 飞机把我们降落在巴塞罗那机场。

d: n 事情；事务；私事；（尤指关系不长久的）风流韵事 public or political events and activities

es.e: Are you interested in world affairs?
es.c: 你对世界大事感兴趣吗？

es.e: the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
es.c: 外交部

es.e: Women had little role in public affairs.
es.c: 女性过去几乎不参与公共事务。

d: v 影响；感染；感动；假装 to do something that produces an effect or change in something or in someone’s situation；n 情感；引起感情的因素

es.e: the areas affected by the hurricane
es.c: 受飓风影响的地区

es.e: a disease that affects the central nervous system
es.c: 影响中枢神经系统的疾病

es.e: decisions which affect our lives
es.c: 影响我们生活的决定

d: n 喜爱，感情；影响；感染 a feeling of liking or love and caring

es.e: She looked back on those days with affection .
es.c: 她深情地回顾那些日子。

es.e: Their father never showed them much affection .
es.c: 他们的父亲对他们从来没有表现出多少慈爱。

es.e: The church was held in great affection (=  loved and cared about a lot  ) by the local residents.
es.c: 教会深受当地民众爱戴。

d: v 给予，提供；买得起 to provide something or allow something to happen；n (Afford)人名；(英)阿福德

es.e: The room affords a beautiful view over the city.
es.c: 这房间可以俯瞰城市美景。

es.e: The new law will afford protection to employees.
es.c: 新法律将为雇员提供保障。

d: adj 害怕的；恐怕；担心的 frightened because you think that you may get hurt or that something bad may happen

es.e: There’s no need to be afraid.
es.c: 没有必要害怕。

d: n 非洲

es.e: The giraffe ranges in Africa.
es.c: 长颈鹿生长在非洲。

es.e: The practice still prevails in some parts of Africa.
es.c: 这种做法在非洲某些地区仍然很盛行。

es.e: He traversed alone the whole continent of Africa from east to west.
es.c: 他只身长途跋涉， 从东向西横穿整个非洲大陆。

d: adj 非洲的，非洲人的 relating to Africa or its people；n 非洲人 someone from Africa

es.e: ...the African continent.
es.c: …非洲大陆。

d: adv 后来，以后 After is also an adverb；prep 在……之后 when a particular event or time has happened, or when someone has done something；conj 在……之后；adj 以后的 in the years after the time that has been mentioned

es.e: Tomorrow. Or the day after.
es.c: 明天。或者后天。

d: n 午后，下午 the part of the day after the morning and before the evening

es.e: There’s a meeting on Thursday afternoon .
es.c: 星期四下午有个会议。

es.e: It was very hot in the afternoon .
es.c: 下午很热。

es.e: See you tomorrow afternoon .
es.c: 明天下午见。

d: adv 以后，后来 If you do something or if something happens afterward, you do it or it happens after a particular event or time that has already been mentioned

es.e: Shortly afterward, police arrested four suspects.
es.c: 之后不久，警方逮捕了４名嫌疑犯。

d: adv 又，此外；再一次；再说；增加 one more time – used when something has happened or been done before；n （英、保）阿盖恩

es.e: Can you say that again? I didn’t hear.
es.c: 你能再说一遍吗？ 我没听见。

es.e: I’ll never go there again.
es.c: 我再也不会去那儿了。

es.e: Mr Khan’s busy. Can you try again later?
es.c: 卡恩先生正忙着。 你能不能过一会儿再打来？

d: prep 反对，违反；靠；倚；防备 next to and touching an upright surface, especially for support；adj 不利的；对立的

es.e: There was a ladder propped up against the wall.
es.c: 有一把梯子靠在墙边。

es.e: The younger policeman was leaning against the bureau with his arms folded.
es.c: 那位较年轻的警官两臂交叉，倚靠在办公桌旁。

d: n 年龄；时代；寿命，使用年限；阶段 the number of years someone has lived or something has existed；v 成熟；变老 to start looking older or to make someone or something look older

es.e: Francis is the same age as me.
es.c: 弗朗西斯和我同年岁。

es.e: Experts disagree over the age of the drawings.
es.c: 专家对这些画作的年代意见不统一。

es.e: Dad retired at the age of 56.
es.c: 爸爸是在56岁时退休的。

d: n 代理，中介；代理处，经销处 a business that provides a particular service for people or organizations

es.e: a UN agency responsible for helping refugees
es.c: 负责为难民提供帮助的联合国机构

d: n 议程；日常工作事项；日程表 a list of problems or subjects that a government, organization etc is planning to deal with

es.e: The Republicans have stuck to their conservative agenda.
es.c: 共和党人坚持自己的保守议题。

d: n 代理人，代理商；药剂；特工 a person or company that represents another person or company, especially in business；vt 由…作中介；由…代理；adj 代理的

es.e: Our agent in Rio deals with all our Brazilian business.
es.c: 我们在里约热内卢的业务代表处理我们在巴西的全部业务。

d: n 侵略；进攻；侵犯；侵害 the act of attacking a country, especially when that country has not attacked first

es.e: an unprovoked act of aggression
es.c: 无端的侵犯

d: adj 侵略性的；好斗的；有进取心的；有闯劲的 behaving in an angry threatening way, as if you want to fight or attack someone

es.e: Jim’s voice became aggressive.
es.c: 吉姆的声音凶了起来。

es.e: Teachers apparently expect a certain amount of aggressive behaviour from boys.
es.c: 老师显然料到男孩子多少会有些好勇斗狠的行为。

d: adv 以前，以往 used to show how far back in the past something happened；adj 以前的；过去的；n (Ago)人名；(英、西、意、塞、瑞典)阿戈

es.e: They moved to a new house some time ago (=  a fairly long time ago  ) .
es.c: 他们搬进新居已有些日子了。

es.e: We had our bicentenary celebrations not that long ago.
es.c: 不久前，我们举行了200周年庆典活动。

d: v 同意，赞成；承认；约定，商定 to have or express the same opinion about something as someone else

es.e: Teenagers and their parents rarely agree.
es.c: 十几岁的孩子跟父母意见很少一致。

d: n 协议；同意，一致 an arrangement or promise to do something, made by two or more people, companies, organizations etc

es.e: It is easier for two parties to reach agreement than for three.
es.c: 两方达成一致比三方达成一致容易。

d: adj 农业的；农艺的 Agricultural means involving or relating to agriculture

es.e: Farmers struggling for survival strip the forests for agricultural land.
es.c: 为生存而挣扎的农民们把森林伐光来作农业用地。

d: n 农业；农耕；农业生产；农艺，农学 the practice or science of farming

es.e: More than 75% of the land is used for agriculture.
es.c: 75%以上的土地用于农耕。

d: adj 向前；在前的；领先；adv 向前地；领先地；在（某人或某事物的）前面；预先；在将来，为未来 a short distance in front of someone or something

es.e: He kept his gaze fixed on the car ahead.
es.c: 他的目光一直盯着前面的那辆汽车。

es.e: We could see the lights of Las Vegas up ahead .
es.c: 我们能看到前方拉斯维加斯的灯光。

es.e: Henry hurried on ahead (=  went in front of the others  ) .
es.c: 亨利赶紧跑到前面。

d: n 援助；帮助；助手；帮助者 help, such as money or food, given by an organization or government to a country or to people who are in a difficult situation；v 援助；帮助；有助于 to help someone do something

es.e: Foreign aid from many countries poured into the famine area.
es.c: 来自许多国家的救援物资纷纷送到饥荒地区。

es.e: convoys delivering humanitarian aid
es.c: 运载人道主义援助的车队

es.e: a substantial aid programme
es.c: 大规模的援助计划

d: abbr 获得性免疫缺乏综合征；爱滋病（Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome）
v 目的在于；引导；把…对准 to choose the place, person etc that you want to hit or reach and point a weapon or another object towards them；n 目的；目标；对准 something you hope to achieve by doing something

es.e: Denver aimed his gun but did not shoot.
es.c: 丹佛举枪瞄准，但是没有射击。

d: n 空气，大气；天空；样子；曲调 the mixture of gases around the Earth, that we breathe；v 使通风，晾干；夸耀 to let fresh air into a room, especially one that has been closed for a long time

es.e: Let’s go outside and get some fresh air.
es.c: 我们出去呼吸些新鲜空气吧。

es.e: You need to put some air in the tyres.
es.c: 你得给轮胎充气了。

d: n 飞机，航空器 a plane or other vehicle that can fly

es.e: The return flight of the aircraft was delayed.
es.c: 飞机的返回航程被推迟了。

d: n 航空公司；航线 a company that takes passengers and goods to different places by plane；adj 航线的

es.e: an airline pilot
es.c: 航空公司飞行员

d: n 航空邮件 letters and packages that are sent somewhere using a plane, or the system of doing this

es.e: Send the letter by airmail.
es.c: 这封信用航空邮寄。

d: n 飞机 a vehicle that flies through the air and has one or more engines

es.e: The airplane cracked up in landing.
es.c: 这架飞机在着陆时坠毁。

es.e: The new airplane flies at twice the speed of sound.
es.c: 这架新式飞机以两倍于音速的速度飞行。

es.e: We beamed the airplane down safely.
es.c: 我们给飞机导航使它安全降落。

d: n 机场；航空站 a place where planes take off and land, with buildings for passengers to wait in

es.e: The plane landed at Heathrow Airport.
es.c: 飞机降落在希思罗机场。

es.e: Her family went to see her off at the airport.
es.c: 她的家人去机场送她。

d: n 空域；领空；空间 the sky above a particular country, that is legally controlled by that country

es.e: Canadian airspace
es.c: 加拿大领空

d: n 闹钟；警报，警告器；惊慌 a piece of equipment that makes a loud noise to warn you of danger；v 警告；使惊恐 If something alarms you, it makes you afraid or anxious that something unpleasant or dangerous might happen

es.e: I forgot to set the burglar alarm.
es.c: 我忘记打开防盗警报器了。

es.e: Car alarms are always going off in the street.
es.c: 街上总有汽车警报器在响。

es.e: a sophisticated alarm system
es.c: 精密的警报系统

d: n 相簿；唱片集；集邮簿；签名纪念册 a book that you put photographs, stamps etc in

es.e: a photograph album
es.c: 相册

d: n 酒精，乙醇 drinks such as beer or wine that contain a substance which can make you drunk

es.e: I don’t drink alcohol anymore.
es.c: 我不再喝酒了。

es.e: {"GLOSS":["when someone drinks too much"],"COLLOINEXA":["alcohol abuse"]}
es.c: 酗酒

es.e: people with alcohol problems
es.c: 有酗酒问题的人

d: adj 酒精的，含酒精的 relating to alcohol or containing alcohol；n 酒鬼，酗酒者 someone who regularly drinks too much alcohol and has difficulty stopping

es.e: alcoholic drinks
es.c: 酒精饮料

d: n 代数学 a type of mathematics that uses letters and other signs to represent numbers and values

es.e: My behavior is on behalf of half zebras," the algebra teacher said.
es.c: "我的行为代表了一半斑马的利益,"代数老师说.

es.e: I barely passed algebra and geometry， but here she's head of her class in both.
es.c: 我的几何和代数只是勉强及格。 可是，她这两门课在班里都是第一。

d: adj 相似的；相同的 very similar；adv 以同样的方式；类似于 used to emphasize that you mean both the people, groups, or things that you have just mentioned

es.e: My mother and I are alike in many ways.
es.c: 我和母亲在许多方面很相似。

d: adj 活着的；活泼的；有生气的 still living and not dead

es.e: It was a bad accident – they’re lucky to be alive.
es.c: 这是一宗严重事故——他们能活着实属幸运。

es.e: My grandparents are still alive .
es.c: 我的祖父母和外祖父母都还健在。

es.e: We stayed alive by eating berries.
es.c: 我们靠吃浆果活命。

d: adj 全部的；adv 全然地；越发 completely；n 全部 the whole of an amount, thing, or type of thing；pron 全部

es.e: You shouldn’t be sitting here by yourself, all alone.
es.c: 你不应该一个人孤零零地坐在这儿。

es.e: a strange woman, dressed all in black
es.c: 一袭黑衣的奇怪女子

es.e: If people want more freedom of choice, then I’m all for it (=  I strongly support it  ) .
es.c: 如果民众想要更多选择的自由，我完全支持。

d: adj 对…过敏的；对…极讨厌的 having an allergy

es.e: an allergic reaction to nuts
es.c: 对坚果的过敏性反应

d: n 小巷；小路；小径 a narrow street between or behind buildings, not usually used by cars

es.e: The alley led to the railway bridge.
es.c: 这条小巷通往铁路桥。

es.e: She found the side alley where the stage door was located.
es.c: 她找到了剧场后门所在的小巷。

d: v 分配；拨出；使坐落于 to use something for a particular purpose, give something to a particular person etc, especially after an official decision has been made

es.e: Tickets are limited and will be allocated to those who apply first.
es.c: 票数有限，将分配给那些先申请的人。

d: v 允许；给予；认可 to let someone do or have something, or let something happen

es.e: We don’t allow diving in the pool.
es.c: 泳池内禁止跳水。

d: n 津贴，零用钱；允许；限额 an amount of money that you are given regularly or for a special purpose；v 定量供应

es.e: Sales staff get a generous mileage allowance or a company car.
es.c: 销售人员有优厚的里程补贴或者公司提供的专用汽车。

es.e: If you are entitled to sickness allowance, you must claim it from your employer.
es.c: 你如果有资格领取疾病津贴，必须向雇主申请索要。

d: adv 差不多，几乎 nearly, but not completely or not quite

es.e: Have you almost finished?
es.c: 你差不多完成了吗？

es.e: Supper’s almost ready.
es.c: 晚饭就要做好了。

es.e: It was almost midnight.
es.c: 午夜将至。

d: adj 独自的；单独的；孤独的 if you are alone in a place, there is no one with you；adv 独自地；单独地 Alone is also an adverb

es.e: She lives alone .
es.c: 她一个人生活。

es.e: You shouldn’t leave a child alone in the house.
es.c: 你不应该把小孩独自留在家里。

es.e: My wife and I like to spend time alone together away from the kids.
es.c: 我和妻子喜欢没有孩子打扰，过二人世界。

d: adv 一起；向前；来到 going forward；prep 沿着；顺着 from one place on something such as a line, road, or edge towards the other end of it

es.e: I was driving along, thinking about Chris.
es.c: 我一边开车，一边想着克里斯。

es.e: a group of children walking along in a line
es.c: 排着队向前走的一群孩子

d: adv 在旁边 next to the side of something；prep 在……旁边

es.e: A car drew up alongside .
es.c: 一辆车在旁边停了下来。

es.e: Children’s prices are shown alongside adult prices.
es.c: 儿童票价标在成人票价旁边。

d: adv 大声地；出声地 if you read, laugh, say something etc aloud, you read etc so that people can hear you

es.e: When we were children, our father read aloud to us.
es.c: 当我们是孩子时，我们的父亲大声地朗读给我们听。

d: n 字母表，字母系统；入门，初步 a set of letters, arranged in a particular order, and used in writing

es.e: The modern Russian alphabet has 31 letters.
es.c: 现代俄语字母表有31个字母。

d: adv 已经，早已；先前 before now, or before a particular time

es.e: The design of the new house is similar to those that have already been built.
es.c: 新房的设计与那些已建好的房子相似。

es.e: The performance had already started when we arrived.
es.c: 我们到达时表演已经开始了。

d: adv 也；而且；同样 in addition to something else that you have mentioned；conj 并且；另外；n (Also)人名；(罗)阿尔索

es.e: Information is also available on women’s health care.
es.c: 还可以获得有关女性保健方面的资料。

es.e: She sings beautifully and also plays the flute and piano.
es.c: 她歌唱得好，而且还会吹长笛和弹钢琴。

es.e: The system was not only complicated but also ineffective.
es.c: 这套系统不仅复杂而且效率低。

d: adj 供选择的；选择性的；交替的 Alternative medicine uses traditional ways of curing people, such as medicines made from plants, massage, and acupuncture；n 二中择一；供替代的选择 something you can choose to do or use instead of something else

es.e: ...alternative health care.
es.c: …替代性保健。

d: conj 尽管；虽然；但是；然而 used to introduce a statement that makes your main statement seem surprising or unlikely

es.e: Although in poor health, she continued to carry out her duties.
es.c: 尽管身体不好，她仍继续执行任务。

es.e: We decided to take rooms in Longwood House, although we knew we could not really afford the rent.
es.c: 虽然我们知道自己其实付不起租金，但还是决定住朗伍德庄园的房间。

es.e: Although I can’t help admiring the man’s courage, I do not approve of his methods.
es.c: 尽管我不得不佩服那个男子的勇气，却并不赞成他的方法。

d: n 高地；高度；[数] 顶垂线；（等级和地位等的）高级；海拔 the height of an object or place above the sea

es.e: The aircraft had reached its cruising altitude of about 39,000 feet.
es.c: 那架飞机已经达到了大约三万九千英尺的巡航高度。

d: adv 完全地；总共；总而言之 used to emphasize that something has been done completely or has finished completely；n 整个；裸体 not wearing any clothes – used humorously

es.e: an old custom that has vanished altogether
es.c: 一个彻底消亡的古老习俗

es.e: Congress could ban the procession altogether.
es.c: 国会可以完全禁止这次游行。

d: adj 铝的；n 铝 a silver-white metal that is very light and is used to make cans, cooking pans, window frames etc. It is a chemical  element  : symbol Al

es.e: If necessary, we can use aluminium instead of steel.
es.c: 如果必要，我们可用铝代钢。

d: adv 永远，一直；总是；常常 all the time, at all times, or every time

es.e: Always lock your bicycle to something secure.
es.c: 每次都要把自行车锁在牢固的物体上。

es.e: She’d always assumed that Gabriel was a girl’s name.
es.c: 她一直认为加布里埃尔是个女孩名字。

es.e: He hadn’t always been a butler.
es.c: 他并不是一直当管家。

d: abbr 调频，调谐，调幅（ amplitude modulation）；v （用于第一人称单数现在时） the first person singular of the present tense of the verb  be；aux （与v-ing连用构成现在进行时，与v-ed连用构成被动语态）；n （柬）安（人名）

es.e: You have made me what I am.
es.c: 你使我成了我现在这个样子。

es.e: I cannot express to you how grateful I am.
es.c: 我无法向你表达我是多么感激。

es.e: I fear I am late.
es.c: 我恐怕要迟到了。

d: n 爱好者；业余爱好者；外行 someone who does an activity just for pleasure, not as their job；adj 业余的；外行的 Amateur sports or activities are done by people as a hobby and not as a job

es.e: a gifted amateur
es.c: 有天赋的业余爱好者

es.e: Mickelson won his first major golf tournament while still an amateur.
es.c: 米克尔森还是业余选手时就赢得了他第一个高尔夫球锦标赛大奖。

es.e: ...professional athletes and amateur runners.
es.c: …专业运动员和业余赛跑运动员。

d: v 使吃惊 to surprise someone very much

es.e: Dave amazed his friends by suddenly getting married.
es.c: 戴夫突然结婚，令朋友们非常吃惊。

d: adj 令人惊异的 very good, especially in an unexpected way；v 使吃惊（amaze的ing形式）

es.e: He’s an amazing player to watch.
es.c: 看他比赛那才叫精彩呢。

es.e: an amazing bargain
es.c: 令人惊喜的便宜货

d: n 大使；代表；使节 an important official who represents his or her government in a foreign country

es.e: ...the German ambassador to Poland.
es.c: …德国驻波兰大使。

d: adj 模糊不清的；引起歧义的

es.e: The language in the Minister’s statement is highly ambiguous.
es.c: 部长的声明措辞很含糊。

d: n 野心，雄心；抱负，志向 determination to be successful, rich, powerful etc；v 追求；有…野心

es.e: He was young and full of ambition.
es.c: 他年轻，而且雄心勃勃。

d: n [车辆][医] 救护车；战时流动医院 a special vehicle that is used to take people who are ill or injured to hospital

es.e: the ambulance service
es.c: 救护车服务

es.e: the ambulance service
es.c: 你觉得我们需要叫救护车吗？

d: n 美洲（包括北美和南美洲）；美国

es.e: I may go to America or I may not,it all depends.
es.c: 我也许去美国，也许不去，要视情况而定。

es.e: She scampered in London then went back to America.
es.c: 她在伦敦匆忙地游览了一番，然后回到了美国。

es.e: Some of the mountains in America have not yet been mapped out.
es.c: 美洲有些山脉还没有在地图上标出来。

d: n 美国人，美洲人；美国英语 someone from the US；adj 美国的，美洲的；地道美国式的 relating to the US or its people

es.e: The 1990 Nobel Prize for medicine was won by two Americans.
es.c: 两名美国人获得了1990年度诺贝尔医学奖。

d: prep 在…中间；在…之中 in or through the middle of a group of people or things

es.e: The girl quickly disappeared among the crowd.
es.c: 女孩转眼消失在人群中。

es.e: I could hear voices coming from somewhere among the bushes.
es.c: 我能听到灌木丛中某个地方传来说话的声音。

es.e: We walked among the chestnut woods on the mountain slopes.
es.c: 我们走在山坡上的栗树林中。

d: v 总计，合计；相当于；共计；产生…结果 If something amounts to a particular total, all the parts of it add up to that total；n 数量；总额，总数 a quantity of something such as time, money, or a substance

es.e: Consumer spending on sports-related items amounted to $9.75 billion.
es.c: 消费者在体育相关用品上的消费总共达到了97.5亿美元。

d: adj 丰富的；足够的；宽敞的 more than enough；n (Ample)人名；(西)安普尔

es.e: an ample bosom
es.c: 丰满的胸部

d: v 娱乐；消遣；使发笑；使愉快 to make time pass in an enjoyable way, so that you do not get bored

es.e: Doing jigsaws would amuse Amy for hours on end.
es.c: 拼图能让埃米连续玩上几个小时。

es.e: The kids amused themselves playing hide-and-seek.
es.c: 孩子们玩捉迷藏玩。

d: n 消遣，娱乐；乐趣 the feeling you have when you think something is funny

es.e: Steve couldn’t hide his amusement.
es.c: 史蒂夫忍俊不禁。

es.e: The cats are a constant source of amusement to us.
es.c: 那些猫给我们带来无穷的乐趣。

d: n 分析；分解；验定 a process in which a doctor makes someone talk about their past experiences, relationships etc in order to help them with mental or emotional problems

es.e: She’s been in analysis for three years.
es.c: 她接受精神分析治疗已经三年了。

d: v 对…进行分析，分解（等于analyse）
n 始祖，祖先；被继承人 a member of your family who lived a long time ago

es.e: My ancestors were French.
es.c: 我的祖先是法国人。

d: adj 古代的；古老的，过时的；年老的 belonging to a time long ago in history, especially thousands of years ago；n 古代人；老人 people who lived long ago, especially the Greeks and Romans

es.e: the ancient civilizations of Asia
es.c: 亚洲的古代文明

d: conj 和，与；就；而且；但是；然后 used to join two words, phrases etc referring to things that are related in some way；n (And)人名；(土、瑞典)安德 used before saying the part of a large number which is less than 100

es.e: He’s gone to get some fish and chips.
es.c: 他去买炸鱼薯条了。

es.e: The film starred Jack Lemmon and Shirley Maclaine.
es.c: 这部电影由杰克·莱蒙和雪莉·麦克莱恩主演。

es.e: We’ve dealt with items one, two, and eleven.
es.c: 我们已经处理了第一项、第二项和第十一项。

d: n 轶事；奇闻；秘史 a short story based on your personal experience

es.e: The book is full of amusing anecdotes about his life in Japan.
es.c: 这本书里全是他在日本生活的趣闻轶事。

d: n 怒，愤怒；忿怒 a strong feeling of wanting to hurt or criticize someone because they have done something bad to you or been unkind to you；v 使发怒，激怒；恼火 to make someone angry

es.e: There is growing anger among the people against the government.
es.c: 民众对政府越来越不满。

d: v 钓鱼；谋取；n 角度，角，方面 the space between two straight lines or surfaces that join each other, measured in degrees

es.e: You didn’t measure the angle accurately.
es.c: 你没有量准角度。

d: adj 生气的；愤怒的；狂暴的；（伤口等）发炎的 feeling strong emotions which make you want to shout at someone or hurt them because they have behaved in an unfair, cruel, offensive etc way, or because you think that a situation is unfair, una

es.e: I was angry because he hadn’t told me his plans.
es.c: 我很生气，因为他没有告诉我他的计划。

es.e: He was beginning to get angry .
es.c: 他开始发脾气了。

es.e: His comments brought an angry response from opposition politicians.
es.c: 他的话激起反对派政客愤怒的回应。

d: n 动物 a living creature such as a dog or cat, that is not an insect, plant, bird, fish, or person

es.e: furry little animals
es.c: 毛茸茸的小动物

es.e: The cosmetics have not been tested on animals.
es.c: 这些化妆品没有进行过动物试验。

es.e: Beth is an animal lover (=  someone who likes animals  ) .
es.c: 贝丝是个喜欢动物的人。

d: n 踝关节，踝 the joint between your foot and your leg

es.e: slender ankles
es.c: 纤细的脚踝

d: n 周年纪念日 a date on which something special or important happened in a previous year

es.e: Jack and Kim celebrated their twentieth wedding anniversary in January.
es.c: 1月，杰克和金庆祝了他们的结婚20周年纪念日。

d: v 宣布；述说；预示；播报 to officially tell people about something, especially about a plan or a decision

es.e: They announced their engagement in ‘The Times’.
es.c: 他们在《泰晤士报》上宣布了订婚的消息。

es.e: At the end of their meeting, it was announced that an agreement had been reached.
es.c: 会议最后宣布已达成一项协议。

d: n 公告；宣告；发表；通告 an important or official statement

es.e: The minister made the announcement at a news conference.
es.c: 部长在记者招待会上发表了这项声明。

d: v 骚扰；惹恼；打搅；n 烦恼（等于annoyance）

es.e: He is not doing this to annoy you.
es.c: 他做这件事并非是要惹你烦恼。

es.e: I am convinced that some people complain just to annoy me, for something to do, or they simply enjoy complaining.
es.c: 我以为身边的人抱怨是为了令我烦恼、是为了解决某些事、又或者他们就是喜欢抱怨。

d: adj 年度的；每年的 happening once a year；n 年刊，年鉴；一年生植物 a plant that lives for one year or season

es.e: The school trip has become an annual event.
es.c: 学校组织的旅行成了一年一度的活动。

d: adj 又一，另一；另外的；不同的；pron 另一个；又一个；prep 另一个；另一个人

es.e: Can you cite another case like this one?
es.c: 你能举出另一个像这样的例子吗?

es.e: The conversation drifted from one subject to another.
es.c: 谈话从一个话题转到另一个话题。

es.e: She buddied up with a student from another university.
es.c: 她与来自另一大学的一名学生交朋友。

d: v 回答；符合 to say something to someone as a reply when they have asked you a question, made a suggestion etc；n 回答；答案；答辩 something you say when you reply to a question that someone has asked you

es.e: She thought for a moment before answering.
es.c: 她想了一会儿才回答。

es.e: He still hadn’t answered my question .
es.c: 他仍然没有回答我的问题。

es.e: ‘Why don’t you just leave?’ ‘I’d like to,’ she answered, ‘but I have nowhere else to go.’
es.c: “你为什么不一走了之？”“我倒是想走，”她回答说，“但是我没有其他地方可去。”

d: n 蚂蚁 a small insect that lives in large groups

es.e: Ants swarmed up out of the ground and covered her shoes and legs.
es.c: 蚂蚁从地里成群地爬出来，爬满了她的鞋和腿。

d: adj 古老的，年代久远的；过时的，古董的；古风的，古式的 antique furniture, jewellery etc is old and often valuable；n 古董，古玩；古风，古希腊和古罗马艺术风格 a piece of furniture, jewellery etc that was made a very long time ago and is therefore valuable；v 觅购古玩

es.e: an antique rosewood desk
es.c: 古董红木书桌

d: n 焦虑；渴望；挂念；令人焦虑的事 the feeling of being very worried about something

es.e: his feelings of anxiety
es.c: 他焦虑的心情

es.e: A high level of anxiety was created by the introduction of cameras into the factory.
es.c: 工厂安装了摄像头，这引起了工人的高度不安。

es.e: It can help if you discuss your anxieties with someone.
es.c: 与别人谈谈自己的忧虑会有帮助的。

d: adj 焦虑的；担忧的；渴望的；急切的 worried about something

es.e: She gave me an anxious look.
es.c: 她焦急地看了我一眼。

d: adj 任何的；所有的；丝毫；pron 任何；任何一个；若干；adv 稍微；少许；n (Any)人名；(法、罗)阿尼

es.e: We should be prepared for any contingency.
es.c: 我们应该对任何应急情况有所准备。

es.e: We could not reason out which way the robbers escaped, because we were unable to find any trace of them.
es.c: 我们推断不出这些强盗是从哪个方向逃走的，因为我们找不到他们的任何踪迹。

d: adv 总之；无论如何；不管怎样

es.e: The scandal could damage her reputation but the press reported it anyhow.
es.c: 这宗丑闻可能损害她的名声，不过报纸还是给登了出来。

d: pron 任何人；任何一个 used to refer to any person, when it is not important to say exactly who

es.e: Anyone could win tonight.
es.c: 今晚任何人都可能赢。

es.e: They offer help and advice to anyone interested in becoming a teacher.
es.c: 他们为任何有兴趣当老师的人提供帮助和咨询。

es.e: If anyone sees Lisa, ask her to call me.
es.c: 如果有谁看见莉萨，叫她打电话给我。

d: pron 任何事 any thing, event, situation etc, when it is not important to say exactly which

es.e: You can buy anything you want.
es.c: 你想要什么都可以买。

es.e: He was prepared to do anything to make a bit of money.
es.c: 只要能赚一点钱，他什么都愿意做。

es.e: Anything would be better than staying at home!
es.c: 做什么都比待在家里好！

d: adv 无论如何，不管怎样；总之 in spite of the fact that you have just mentioned

es.e: Catherine wasn’t sure the book was the right one, but she bought it anyway.
es.c: 凯瑟琳不能确定就是这本书，但她还是买了。

es.e: This idea probably won’t work, but let’s try it anyway.
es.c: 这个办法可能行不通，不过我们还是试试吧。

d: adv 在任何地方；无论何处 in or to any place；n 任何地方

es.e: Sit anywhere you like.
es.c: 你随便坐吧。

es.e: You can buy clothes like these anywhere.
es.c: 这样的衣服到处都可以买到。

es.e: I don’t want to live in London, but I’d be happy living anywhere else .
es.c: 我不想住在伦敦，但是住在其他什么地方我都很乐意。

d: adv 相距；与众不同地；分离着 if things are apart, they are not close to each other or touching each other；adj 分离的；与众不同的 If people or groups are a long way apart on a particular topic or issue, they have completely different views an

es.e: They have offices in countries as far apart as India and Peru.
es.c: 他们的办事处远至印度、秘鲁等国。

es.e: The police try to keep rival supporters apart at all matches.
es.c: 警方在所有的比赛中都设法将双方的支持者分开。

es.e: A couple of men started fighting and we had to pull them apart .
es.c: 几名男子打起架来，我们不得不将他们拉开。

d: n 公寓；房间 a set of rooms on one floor of a large building, where someone lives

es.e: She lives in a small apartment.
es.c: 她住在一套小公寓里。

d: v 道歉；辩解；赔不是 to tell someone that you are sorry that you have done something wrong

es.e: I’m so sorry, I do apologize.
es.c: 非常对不起，我真心道歉。

d: n 道歉；谢罪；辩护；勉强的替代物 something that you say or write to show that you are sorry for doing something wrong

es.e: Edward can’t be here today, but he sends his apologies .
es.c: 爱德华今天来不了，他向大家表示歉意。

d: adj 显然的；表面上的 seeming to have a particular feeling or attitude, although this may not be true

es.e: He did well in his exams, despite his apparent lack of interest in his work.
es.c: 他考得很好，尽管表面上他对功课不感兴趣。

d: v 呼吁，恳求；上诉；诉诸，求助；有吸引力，迎合爱好；（体育比赛中）诉诸裁判 to make a serious public request for help, money, information etc；n 呼吁，请求；吸引力，感染力；上诉；诉诸裁判 an urgent request for something important

es.e: She is not happy with the decision and plans to appeal.
es.c: 她不服判决，打算上诉。

d: v 出现；显得；似乎；出庭；登场 used to say how something seems, especially from what you know about it or from what you can see

es.e: Police have found what appear to be human remains.
es.c: 警方发现了疑似人体遗骸的东西。

es.e: He tried to make it appear that she had committed suicide.
es.c: 他试图制造她自杀的假象。

es.e: It may be less useful than it appears at first.
es.c: 这可能没有一开始显得那么有用。

d: n 外貌，外观；出现，露面 the way someone or something looks to other people

es.e: He was always criticising his wife’s appearance.
es.c: 他老是批评妻子的外表。

es.e: We are often attracted to somebody first by their physical appearance .
es.c: 我们经常先被一个人的外貌吸引。

es.e: Women, in general, tend to be more concerned than men about their personal appearance .
es.c: 总的来说，女性比男性更注重自己的仪容。

d: n 附录；阑尾；附加物 a small organ near your  bowel  , which has little or no use

es.e: Christine had to go into hospital to have her appendix out (=  have it removed  ) .
es.c: 克里丝蒂娜不得不去医院切除阑尾。

d: n 食欲；嗜好 a desire for food

es.e: Her husband always had a huge appetite.
es.c: 她丈夫向来胃口极大。

es.e: Symptoms include tiredness and loss of appetite.
es.c: 症状包括疲倦和食欲不振。

d: v 赞同；称赞；向…喝彩 to express strong approval of an idea, plan etc

es.e: I applaud the decision to install more security cameras.
es.c: 我极力赞成安装更多监控摄像机的决定。

es.c: 我早在2005年就曾在《大西洋月刊》上撰文写过此事。

d: n 气氛；大气；空气 the feeling that an event or place gives you

es.e: The hotel had a lovely relaxed atmosphere .
es.c: 那家宾馆的气氛轻松愉快。

es.e: The atmosphere at home was rather tense.
es.c: 家里的气氛很紧张。

d: n 原子 the smallest part of an  element  that can exist alone or can combine with other substances to form a  molecule

es.e: carbon atoms
es.c: 碳原子

d: v 使依附；贴上；系上；使依恋 If you attach something to an object, you join it or fasten it to the object

es.e: We attach labels to things before we file them away.
es.c: 我们在把东西归档前先给它们贴上标签。

es.e: For further information, please contact us on the attached form.
es.c: 如需更多信息，请凭附表联系我们。

d: v 达到，实现；获得；到达 to succeed in achieving something after trying for a long time；n 成就

es.e: More women are attaining positions of power.
es.c: 越来越多的女性获得要职。

d: n 企图，试图；攻击 an act of trying to do something, especially something difficult；v 企图，试图；尝试 to try to do something, especially something difficult

es.e: He made no attempt to hide his anger.
es.c: 他毫不掩饰自己的愤怒。

d: v 出席；上（大学等）；照料；招待；陪伴 to go to an event such as a meeting or a class

es.e: Only 12 people attended the meeting.
es.c: 只有12个人出席了会议。

es.e: Please let us know if you are unable to attend.
es.c: 如果不能出席，请通知我们。

d: n 注意力；关心；立正！（口令） when you carefully listen to, look at, or think about someone or something

es.e: My attention wasn’t really on the game.
es.c: 我的注意力其实不在比赛上。

es.e: She tried to pay attention to what he was saying.
es.c: 她尽量注意听他说话。

es.e: If you paid more attention in class, you might actually learn something!
es.c: 要是你上课更认真些，也许能实实在在地学到些东西！

d: adv 注意地；聚精会神地；周到地
n 态度；看法；意见；姿势 the opinions and feelings that you usually have about something, especially when this is shown in your behaviour

es.e: As soon as they found out I was a doctor, their whole attitude changed.
es.c: 他们一听说我是医生，态度就完全改变了。

d: v 吸引；引起 to make someone interested in something, or make them want to take part in something

es.e: I’m not usually attracted to blondes.
es.c: 我一般不喜欢金发女子。

d: n 吸引，吸引力；引力；吸引人的事物 something interesting or enjoyable to see or do

es.e: The beautiful beaches are the island’s main attraction (=  most popular place, activity etc  ) .
es.c: 美丽的海滩是这个岛上的主要魅力所在。

d: adj 吸引人的；有魅力的；引人注目的 someone who is attractive is good looking, especially in a way that makes you sexually interested in them

es.e: an attractive young woman
es.c: 妩媚动人的年轻女子

es.e: Women seem to find him attractive .
es.c: 女性似乎觉得他很有吸引力。

d: n 观众；听众；读者；接见；正式会见；拜会 a group of people who come to watch and listen to someone speaking or performing in public

es.e: The audience began clapping and cheering.
es.c: 观众开始鼓掌欢呼。

es.e: One member of the audience described the opera as ‘boring’.
es.c: 有一名观众说这出歌剧“乏味”。

d: adj 威严的；令人敬畏的；n 八月（简写为Aug） the eighth month of the year, between July and September

es.e: The world premiere took place in August 1956.
es.c: 全球首映是在1956年8月。

d: n 阿姨；姑妈；伯母；舅妈 the sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your father’s or mother’s brother

es.e: Aunt Mary
es.c: 玛丽姑妈

d: n 澳大利亚，澳洲

es.e: He transplanted his family to Australia.
es.c: 他把家迁到澳大利亚。

es.e: He went out to Australia about five years ago.
es.c: 他大约在五年前移居澳大利亚。

es.e: Australia won the toss and put England in to bat.
es.c: 澳大利亚队掷币获胜，要求英格兰队首先击球。

d: adj 澳大利亚的，澳大利亚人的 relating to Australia or its people；n 澳大利亚人 someone from Australia

es.e: She went solo backpacking for eight months in the Australian outback.
es.c: 她在澳大利亚内陆独自背包旅行了八个月。

d: adj 真正的，真实的；可信的 based on facts

es.e: an authentic account
es.c: 真实可信的说法

d: n 作者；作家；创始人 someone who has written a book；v 创作出版 to be the writer of a book, report etc

es.e: Nothomb is a Belgian author.
es.c: 诺东是位比利时作家。

es.e: It’s clear that the author is a woman.
es.c: 显然，这位作者是女性。

d: n 权威；权力；当局 the power you have because of your official position

es.e: an agreement between the US and Colombian authorities
es.c: 美国和哥伦比亚当局的一份协议

d: adj 自动的；无意识的；必然的 an automatic machine is designed to work without needing someone to operate it for each part of a process；n 自动机械；自动手枪 a weapon that can fire bullets continuously

es.e: an automatic weapon
es.c: 自动武器

es.e: an automatic gearbox
es.c: 自动变速箱

es.e: My camera is fully automatic .
es.c: 我的照相机是全自动的。

d: adj 自治的；自主的；自发的 an autonomous place or organization is free to govern or control itself

es.e: They proudly declared themselves part of a new autonomous province.
es.c: 他们自豪地宣布自己是新自治省的一部分。

d: n 秋天；成熟期；渐衰期，凋落期 the season between summer and winter, when leaves change colour and the weather becomes cooler；adj 秋天的，秋季的

es.e: autumn mists
es.c: 秋天的雾霭

d: adj 可获得的；可购得的；可找到的；有空的 something that is available is able to be used or can easily be bought or found

es.e: Tickets are available from the box office.
es.c: 售票处有票出售。

es.e: Meetings were held to update employees as soon as new information became available .
es.c: 一有新的信息就开会告诉员工。

es.e: Further building can continue when money is made available .
es.c: 有了资金就可以继续进一步的施工。

d: n 大街；林荫大道；[比喻](达到某物的)途径，手段，方法，渠道 used in the names of streets in a town or city

es.e: Fifth Avenue
es.c: 第五大街

es.e: Shaftesbury Avenue
es.c: 沙夫茨伯里街

d: n 平均；平均数；海损 the amount calculated by adding together several quantities, and then dividing this amount by the total number of quantities；adj 平均的；普通的；通常的 the average amount is the amount you get when you add together seve

es.e: The December figures brought the annual average for 2001 up to 10.6 per cent.
es.c: 12月的数据将2001年的年平均水平提升到10.6%。

d: v 避免；避开，躲避；消除 to prevent something bad from happening

es.e: Road safety is taught to young children to avoid road accidents.
es.c: 小孩子受到道路安全知识的教育，以避免交通事故。

es.e: It is important to take measures to avoid the risk of fire.
es.c: 采取措施避免火灾风险很重要。

es.e: Alan narrowly avoided an accident.
es.c: 艾伦险出事故。

d: v 觉醒，意识到；醒来；被唤起 to wake up, or to make someone wake up；adj 醒着的 not sleeping

es.e: It was midday when she awoke.
es.c: 她醒来时已是中午。

es.e: We awoke to a day of brilliant sunshine.
es.c: 我们醒来时阳光明媚。

d: v 授予；判定 to officially give someone something such as a prize or money to reward them for something they have done；n 奖品；判决 something such as a prize or money given to someone to reward them for something they have done

es.e: Moodie has been awarded a golf scholarship at the University of Hawaii.
es.c: 穆迪获授夏威夷大学高尔夫奖学金。

d: adj 意识到的；知道的；有…方面知识的；懂世故的 if you are aware that a situation exists, you realize or know that it exists；n (Aware)人名；(阿拉伯、索)阿瓦雷

es.e: Mr Braley has been made aware of the need for absolute secrecy.
es.c: 布雷利先生被告知需要绝对保密。

es.e: As you are aware, a fee will be charged annually.
es.c: 正如你所知道的那样，每年都要收取一笔费用。

d: adv 离去，离开；在远处 used to say that someone leaves a place or person, or stays some distance from a place or person

es.e: Go away!
es.c: 走开！

es.e: Dinah was crying as she drove slowly away.
es.c: 黛娜一边哭一边慢慢地开车走了。

d: adj 令人敬畏的；使人畏惧的；可怕的；极好的 extremely impressive, serious, or difficult so that you feel great respect, worry, or fear

es.e: an awesome responsibility
es.c: 一项令人惊惧的责任

es.e: the awesome sweep of the scenery
es.c: 连绵的壮丽景色

d: adj 可怕的；极坏的；使人敬畏的 making you feel great respect or fear

es.e: The weather was awful.
es.c: 天气很糟糕。

d: adj 尴尬的；笨拙的；棘手的；不合适的 making you feel embarrassed so that you are not sure what to do or say

es.e: I hoped he would stop asking awkward questions .
es.c: 我希望他不要再问令人难堪的问题。

es.e: There was an awkward moment when she didn’t know whether to shake his hand or kiss his cheek.
es.c: 她不知道是该跟他握手还是亲他的脸颊，一时很尴尬。

es.e: an awkward silence
es.c: 令人尴尬的沉默

d: n 婴儿，婴孩；孩子气的人 A baby is a very young child, especially one that cannot yet walk or talk；v 纵容，娇纵；把……当婴儿般对待；adj 婴儿的；幼小的 Baby vegetables are vegetables picked when they are very small

es.e: She used to take care of me when I was a baby.
es.c: 她曾在我还是婴儿的时候照看过我。

es.e: My wife has just had a baby.
es.c: 我妻子刚生小孩。

es.e: Cook the baby potatoes in their skins.
es.c: 把这些小土豆连皮煮。

d: n 学士；单身汉；（尚未交配的）小雄兽 a man who has never been married

es.e: Gerald was 38, and a confirmed bachelor (=  a man who has decided that he will never marry  ) .
es.c: 杰拉德38岁，抱定主意独身。

es.e: The Crown Prince was Japan’s most eligible bachelor (=  a rich young man who has not yet married  ) .
es.c: 皇太子是日本最理想的适婚男子。

d: n 后面；背部；靠背；足球等的后卫；书报等的末尾 the part of something that is furthest from the front；v 支持；后退；背书；下赌注 If you move back, you move in the opposite direction to the one in which you are facing or in which you were moving before；adv

es.e: a T-shirt with a picture of a snake on the back
es.c: 后背印了一条蛇的T恤衫

es.e: She stepped back from the door expectantly.
es.c: 她充满期待地从门口往后退。

es.e: He pushed her away and she fell back on the wooden bench.
es.c: 他把她推开，然后她向后跌坐在长木椅上。

d: n 背痛；腰痛 a pain in your back

es.e: Many workers go home from their first day on the job with either a bad headache or a backache—undoubtedly the result of nervous tension.
es.c: 许多员工在第一天上班的时候会带着头痛或背痛回家，这无疑就是紧张情绪造成的结果。

es.e: This may cause stomach upset, ulcers, headache, backache, high blood pressure and in severe cases can lead to panic attacks or a panic disorder.
es.c: 这可能会引起胃部不适，溃疡，头痛，背痛，高血压，甚至在严重的情况下可能导致惊恐发作或惊恐障碍等疾病。

d: n 背景；隐蔽的位置 someone’s family, education, previous work etc；v 作…的背景；adj 背景的；发布背景材料的

es.e: Students with a background in chemistry will probably find the course easier.
es.c: 学过化学的学生可能会觉得这门课程容易些。

es.e: It’s important to understand other people, people from different backgrounds .
es.c: 要理解别人，理解那些来自不同背景的人，这是很重要的。

es.e: Do you know anything about his background?
es.c: 关于他的背景，你知道什么吗？

d: adj 向后的；反向的；发展迟缓的 looking or facing in the direction that is behind you；adv 向后地；相反地 If you move or look backward, you move or look in the direction that your back is facing

es.e: She went without a backward glance.
es.c: 她头也不回地走了。

es.e: The diver flipped over backward into the water.
es.c: 跳水运动员向后翻转跳入水中。

es.e: He took two steps backward.
es.c: 他往后退了两步。

d: n 咸肉；腌肉；熏猪肉 salted or smoked meat from the back or sides of a pig, often served in narrow thin pieces

es.e: bacon and eggs
es.c: 咸猪肉煎蛋

d: n [微] 细菌；杆菌属
adj 坏的；严重的；劣质的 unpleasant or likely to cause problems；n 坏事；坏人；adv 很，非常；坏地；邪恶地 a word used to mean ‘badly’ that many people think is incorrect

es.e: I have some bad news for you.
es.c: 我有坏消息要告诉你。

es.e: I thought things couldn’t possibly get any worse.
es.c: 我想事情最坏也不过如此了。

es.e: The plane was delayed for several hours by bad weather.
es.c: 天气不好，飞机延误了好几个小时。

d: adv 非常，很；严重地，厉害地；恶劣地 in an unsatisfactory or unsuccessful way

es.e: The company has been very badly managed.
es.c: 这家公司的管理非常差。

es.e: The novel was translated badly into English.
es.c: 这部小说被拙劣地翻成了英语。

es.e: badly made furniture
es.c: 做工粗糙的家具

d: n 羽毛球 a game that is similar to tennis but played with a  shuttlecock (=  small feathered object  )  instead of a ball

es.e: Can I try you new badminton racket?
es.c: 我可以试用你的羽毛球拍吗？

es.e: I like playing basketball and  badminton.
es.c: 我喜欢的篮球和羽毛球。

es.e: My friend and I take part in sports like tennis,badminton and swimming.
es.c: 我和我的朋友参加体育运动如打网球,羽毛球和游泳.

d: n 袋；猎获物；（俚）一瓶啤酒 the amount that a bag will hold；v 猎获；把…装入袋中；占据，私吞；使膨大 to put things into bags

es.e: ...a bag of sweets.
es.c: …一袋糖果。

d: n 行李；[交] 辎重（军队的） the cases, bags, boxes etc carried by someone who is travelling

es.e: Check your baggage in at the desk.
es.c: 在服务台托运行李。

d: v 烤，烘焙 to cook something using dry heat, in an  oven；n 烤；烘烤食品

es.e: I’m baking some bread.
es.c: 我在烤一些面包。

es.e: baked potatoes
es.c: 烤马铃薯

es.e: Bake at 250 degrees for 20 minutes.
es.c: 用250度的温度烤20分钟。

d: n 面包店 a place where bread and cakes are baked, or a shop where they are sold

es.e: A smell of bread drifted from some distant bakery.
es.c: 一股面包的味道从远处的某个面包店飘来。

d: n 平衡；余额；匀称 a state in which all your weight is evenly spread so that you do not fall；v 使平衡；结算；使相称 if a government balances the budget, they make the amount of money that they spend equal to the amount of money available

es.e: I lost my balance and fell on my face.
es.c: 我失去平衡，脸着地摔倒了。

d: n 阳台；包厢；戏院楼厅 a structure that you can stand on, that is attached to the outside wall of a building, above ground level

es.e: Has your flat got a balcony?
es.c: 你的公寓有阳台吗？

d: n 球；舞会 a round object that is thrown, kicked, or hit in a game or sport；v 成团块

es.e: ...a golf ball.
es.c: …一个高尔夫球。

d: n 芭蕾舞剧；芭蕾舞乐曲 a performance in which dancing and music tell a story without any speaking

es.e: We’re going to the ballet tomorrow evening.
es.c: 我们明天晚上要去看芭蕾舞演出。

d: v 激增；膨胀如气球 to suddenly become larger in amount；n 气球 an object made of brightly coloured thin rubber, that is filled with air and used as a toy or decoration for parties；adj 像气球般鼓起的

es.e: The company’s debt has ballooned in the past year.
es.c: 在过去一年里，公司的债务激增。

d: n 圆珠笔 a pen with a ball at the end that rolls ink onto the paper

es.e: To mouse proof your house, check all small openings with a ballpoint pen - if it fits the hole, it will let mice in.
es.c: 要使你的房子里没有小老鼠，用圆珠笔来检查下所有的小洞，如果圆珠笔能放进去的话，那小老鼠就可能钻进去。

es.e: If you twist the shaft in one way it becomes a ballpoint pen.
es.c: 如果你以某种方式转动笔杆，它就变成了一支圆珠笔。

es.e: Laptop, flash disk, a ballpoint pen, a pencil, a notebook, a pair of glasses, cell phone, charger, moisture lotion, … Oh, that is too much.
es.c: 笔记本电脑，闪存，一致圆珠笔，一支钢笔，一本笔记本，一副眼镜，手机，保湿液，… 噢，太多了。

d: n 竹，竹子 a tall tropical plant with hollow stems that is used for making furniture；vt 为…装上篾条；adj 竹制的；土著居民的

es.e: Everything there is made of bamboo.
es.c: 那里什么都是竹子做的。

es.e: Do you like bamboo?
es.c: 你喜欢竹子吗?

d: v 禁止，取缔 to say that something must not be done, seen, used etc；n 禁令，禁忌 an official order that prevents something from being used or done

es.e: Smoking is banned in the building.
es.c: 大楼内禁止吸烟。

d: n 香蕉；喜剧演员；大鹰钩鼻 a long curved tropical fruit with a yellow skin

es.e: ...a bunch of bananas.
es.c: …一串香蕉。

d: n 带，环；[物] 波段；(演奏流行音乐的) 乐队 a group of musicians, especially a group that plays popular music；v 用带绑扎；给镶边

es.e: The band was playing old Beatles songs.
es.c: 乐队正在演奏披头士的老歌。

es.e: I grew up playing in rock bands.
es.c: 我是在摇滚乐队里玩音乐长大的。

es.e: Smith joined the band in 1989.
es.c: 史密斯在1989年加入这个乐队。

d: n 绷带 a narrow piece of cloth that you tie around a wound or around a part of the body that has been injured；v 用绷带包扎 to tie or cover a part of the body with a bandage

es.e: We put some ointment and a bandage on his knee.
es.c: 我们在他的膝盖上涂了些药膏，还缠了一条绷带。

d: n 刘海；重击；突然巨响 hair cut straight across your forehead；adv 直接地；砰然地；突然巨响地 to close something violently, making a loud noise, or to be closed in this way；v 重击；发巨响 to hit something hard, making a loud noise

es.e: a bang on the head
es.c: 头上一记猛烈的撞击

d: n 银行；岸；浅滩；储库 land along the side of a river or lake；v 将…存入银行；倾斜转弯 if a plane banks, it slopes to one side when turning

es.e: the river bank
es.c: 河岸

d: n 条，棒；酒吧；障碍；法庭 a place where a particular kind of food or drink is served；v 禁止；阻拦 to officially prevent someone from entering a place or from doing something；prep 除……外 except

es.e: ...Devil's Herd, the city's most popular country and western bar.
es.c: …“魔鬼群”，全城最受欢迎的西部乡村酒吧。

d: n 烤肉；吃烤肉的野宴 a meal or party during which food is cooked on a metal frame over a fire and eaten outdoors；v 烧烤；烤肉 to cook food on a metal frame over a fire outdoors

es.e: We had a barbecue on the beach.
es.c: 我们在海滩上烧烤。

d: v 为…理发；修整；n 理发师 a man whose job is to cut men’s hair and sometimes to  shave  them

es.e: My father marched me over to Otto, the local barber, to have my hair cut short.
es.c: 爸爸把我拽到当地理发师奥托跟前，让他把我的头发剪短。

d: n 理发店 a style of singing popular songs with parts for four men, usually without music；adj 有男声合唱之和声的

es.e: a barbershop quartet
es.c: 男声四重唱

d: adj 空的；赤裸的，无遮蔽的 not covered by clothes；v 露出，使赤裸 to remove something that was covering or hiding something；n (Bare)人名；(英)贝尔

es.e: a ragged child with bare feet
es.c: 一个衣衫褴褛、光着脚的小孩

es.c: …一只棒球棒。

d: n 沐浴；浴室；浴盆 if you take a bath, you wash your body in a bath；v 洗澡 to wash someone in a bath

es.c: 豌豆山的山顶沐浴在灿烂的阳光中。

es.e: Without bothering to dry off, I pulled on my bathrobe.
es.c: 还没来得及擦干身子，我就穿上了浴衣。

es.c: 一位女士只穿着一件睡衣，其他人只围着一条毯子。

es.c: 但坏消息是你的朋友拉尔夫用浴衣的腰带把自己挂在了浴室，很不幸，他去世了。

d: n 浴室；厕所；盥洗室 a room where there is a bath or  shower  , a  basin  , and sometimes a toilet

es.c: 洗手间在哪里？

es.c: 洗完澡后请把浴缸洗干净。

es.e: His students are generally much better at bathtub dynamics by the end of his course, which gives him hope.
es.c: 在完成他的课程之后，他的学生对浴缸动力学的理解普遍好多了，这给了他希望。

es.e: And the neighbor down the street found in the bathtub… And the kid who ran his motorcycle into a tree an accident but for the note left behind saying that's exactly what he intended to do… And so on.

es.c: 汽车的蓄电池没电了。

es.c: 特拉法尔加战役

es.e: a pitched battle (=  a long and serious battle  ) between police and drug gangs
es.c: 警方和贩毒团伙之间的一场激战

es.e: But all too often, a relationship becomes a battleground where each partner becomes well schooled in the art of inflicting pain on the other.
es.c: 不过一切太频繁，一段关系成为一个战场，在每一方在对别人造成伤害的艺术中成为好的学校。

es.e: Well, one can debate what these data show. But this much is clear: that little strip of plastic is a mini-battleground.
es.c: 你可以质疑这些数据显示的结果，但是有一点是不容质疑的：小小的塑料扶手已成为了一个争夺战场。

d: n 海湾；狗吠声 a part of the sea that is partly enclosed by a curve in the land；v 向…吠叫 If a dog or wolf bays, it makes loud, long cries

es.c: 能看到海湾全景的一幢房子

es.c: 蒙特哥湾

es.c: 一只狗忽然嚎叫起来，对月长嗥。

d: v 是； 有，存在； 做，成为； 发生 used with a present participle to form the  continuous 4  tenses of verbs；n (Be)人名；(缅)拜；(日)部(姓)；(朝)培；(中非)贝

es.c: 烘豆

es.c: 芸豆

es.e: Beijing is a city of gastronomic contradictions. The traditional everyday diet of local people is a simple affair: noodles, breads and dumplings, with pork and mutton, beancurd and vegetables.
es.c: 北京是一个美食矛盾体。当地人的日常传统饮食是一件简单的事：面条、面包和饺子，饺子馅有猪肉、羊肉、豆腐和蔬菜。

es.c: 请允许我代表在座的各位祝你退休后生活愉快。

es.c: 有益于免疫系统的一种药物
