es.c: 在这种情况下，我真诚地相信佛教徒的思维方式。

es.e: On the extreme northwestern outskirts of the city stands the Buddhist temple.
es.c: 那所佛教寺院位于市郊的最西北角。

es.e: These were all qualities he recognized in himself, but which all could be improved upon, and so he became a Buddhist.
es.c: 这些特质他都可以在自己的身上找到，但也都还有着可提高的空间，于是他成了一名佛教徒。

d: n 预算，预算费 the money that is available to an organization or person, or a plan of how it will be spent；v 安排，预定；把…编入预算 to carefully plan and control how much money you spend and what you will buy with it；adj 廉价的 very low in

es.e: We had a really tight budget .
es.c: 我们的预算很紧。

d: n 自助餐；小卖部；打击；猛烈冲击 a meal at a party or other occasion, in which people serve themselves at a table and then move away to eat；v 与…搏斗；连续猛击 if something, especially wind, rain, or the sea, buffets something, it hits it with

es.e: a cold buffet
es.c: 冷餐会

d: v 建立；建筑 to make something, especially a building or something large；n 构造；体形；体格 the shape and size of someone’s body

es.e: The purpose is to build new houses for local people.
es.c: 目的是要为当地居民建造新的住宅。

es.e: The road took many years to build.
es.c: 这条路修了好几年。

es.e: They needed $3 million to build the bridge.
es.c: 他们需要300万美元来修建这座桥。

d: n 建筑；建筑物 a structure such as a house, church, or factory, that has a roof and walls；v 建筑；建立；增加（build的ing形式）

es.e: The offices are on the top two floors of the building.
es.c: 办公室在大楼最高的两层。

es.e: a farmhouse and other farm buildings
es.c: 农舍以及其他的农场建筑

d: n 小圆面包 a small round sweet cake

es.e: a sticky bun
es.c: 一个黏糊糊的小圆甜点心

d: n 群；串；突出物 a group of things that are fastened, held, or growing together；v 隆起；打褶；形成一串 to pull material together tightly in folds

es.e: Lili had fallen asleep clutching a fat bunch of grapes.
es.c: 莉莉手里抓着一大串葡萄睡着了。

d: n 平房；小屋 a house that is all on ground level

es.e: I remember changing cars twice when visiting her bungalow in New Delhi in 1998.
es.c: 我记得1998年去她在新德里的小平房拜访时，中途两次换车。

es.e: Belinda and Clive, who worked on the railways, moved to a bungalow not far from Barry Island.
es.c: 贝琳达和克里夫在铁路工作，并且搬到离巴厘岛不远的一处平房居住。

es.e: It would never have happened if he had stayed in Australia, for Australia is still the land of the bungalow.
es.c: 要是他居住在澳大利亚的话这种情况绝对不可能发生，因为现在澳大利亚土地上所座落的依然是平房。

d: n 负担；责任；船的载货量 something difficult or worrying that you are responsible for；v 使负担；烦扰；装货于 If someone burdens you with something that is likely to worry you, for example, a problem or a difficult decision, they tell you abo

es.e: His family responsibilities had started to become a burden.
es.c: 家庭责任已开始成为他的负担。

es.e: We decided not to burden him with the news.
es.c: 我们决定不拿这个消息去烦他。

d: adj 官僚的；官僚政治的 involving a lot of complicated official rules and processes

es.e: Bureaucratic delays are inevitable.
es.c: 官僚主义所致的延误是不可避免的。

d: n 夜贼，窃贼 someone who goes into houses, shops etc to steal things

es.e: Burglars broke into their home.
es.c: 窃贼闯进了他们家。

d: n 埋葬；葬礼；弃绝 the act or ceremony of putting a dead body into a  grave；adj 埋葬的

es.e: The priest prepared the body for burial.
es.c: 牧师为尸体做好了下葬的准备。

d: v 燃烧；烧毁，灼伤；激起…的愤怒 to destroy or damage something with fire；n 灼伤，烧伤；烙印 an injury caused by fire, heat, the light of the sun, or acid

es.e: I burnt all his old letters.
es.c: 我把他以前的信全烧了。

es.e: Cars were burned and shops were looted during the rioting.
es.c: 暴乱期间，汽车被焚，商店遭抢劫。

es.e: The Grand Hotel had burnt to the ground .
es.c: 格兰德大酒店被大火夷为平地。

d: v 爆发，突发；爆炸 if something bursts, or if you burst it, it breaks open or apart suddenly and violently so that its contents come out；n 爆发，突发；爆炸 the act of something bursting or the place where it has burst

es.e: The pipes had burst and the house was under two feet of water.
es.c: 水管爆裂，房子被水淹了两英尺。

d: v 埋葬；隐藏 to put someone who has died in a  grave；n (Bury)人名；(法)比里；(英、西)伯里；(德、意、罗、波、捷、匈)布里；(俄)布雷

es.e: Electric cables are buried beneath the streets.
es.c: 电缆埋在街道的下面。

d: n 公共汽车 a large vehicle that people pay to travel on

es.e: I took a bus to San Francisco.
es.c: 我乘公共汽车去旧金山。

es.e: Buses run at 15 and 30 minutes past the hour.
es.c: 公共汽车在每小时的15分和30分时发车。

d: n 灌木；矮树丛 a plant with many thin branches growing up from the ground；v 以灌木装饰；使…精疲力竭；adj 如灌木般长得低矮的；粗野的

es.e: a rose bush
es.c: 玫瑰丛

es.e: The child was hiding in the bushes.
es.c: 那孩子躲在灌木丛里。

d: n 商业；[贸易] 生意；[贸易] 交易；事情 the activity of making money by producing or buying and selling goods, or providing services

es.e: Students on the course learn about all aspects of business.
es.c: 这门课程的学生要学习商业活动的各个方面。

es.e: Carl began in the music business by running a recording studio.
es.c: 卡尔是从经营录音棚开始干音乐这一行的。

es.e: We do business with a number of Italian companies.
es.c: 我们和一些意大利公司做生意。

d: n 商人 a man who works in business

es.e: ...a wealthy businessman who owns a printing business in Orlando.
es.c: …一个在奥兰多拥有印刷企业的富有商人。

d: n 女商人 a woman who works in business

es.e: ...a successful businesswoman who runs her own international cosmetics company.
es.c: …一个经营着自己的国际化妆品公司的成功的女商人。

d: adj 忙碌的；热闹的；正被占用的 if you are busy, you are working hard and have a lot of things to do；v 使忙于 to use your time dealing with something；n (Busy)人名；(匈)布希；(法)比西

es.e: She’s busy now – can you phone later?
es.c: 她现在正忙，你稍后打来好吗？

es.e: a busy mother of four
es.c: 一个忙忙碌碌、育有四个孩子的妈妈

es.e: There were lots of activities to keep the kids busy .
es.c: 有很多活动可以让孩子们不闲着。

d: conj 但是；而是；然而 used to connect two statements or phrases when the second one adds something different or seems surprising after the first one；adv 仅仅，只 only；prep 除…以外 apart from；n (But)人名；(俄、罗)布特；(越)笔 used to emphasize a w

es.e: It’s an old car, but it’s very reliable.
es.c: 这是一辆旧车，但是性能非常可靠。

es.e: They rushed to the hospital, but they were too late.
es.c: 他们急忙赶到医院，但是已经太迟了。

es.e: We’ve invited the boss, but she may decide not to come.
es.c: 我们邀请过老板，但她有可能决定不来。

d: v 屠杀 to kill animals and prepare them to be used as meat；n 屠夫 A butcher is a shopkeeper who cuts up and sells meat. Some butchers also kill animals for meat and make foods such as sausages and meat pies.

es.e: Pigs were butchered, hams were hung to dry from the ceiling.
es.c: 猪被宰杀了，火腿吊在屋顶下风干。

d: v 涂黄油于；讨好 to spread butter on something；n 黄油；奶油；奉承话 a solid yellow food made from milk or cream that you spread on bread or use in cooking

es.e: buttered toast
es.c: 涂了黄油的烤面包片

d: n 蝴蝶；蝶泳；举止轻浮的人；追求享乐的人 a type of insect that has large wings, often with beautiful colours

es.e: Gwen’s a real social butterfly .
es.c: 格温是个十足的交际花。

d: n 按钮；纽扣 a small round flat object on your shirt, coat etc that you pass through a hole to fasten it；v 扣住；扣紧；在…上装纽扣 to fasten clothes with buttons, or to be fastened with buttons

es.e: small pearl buttons
es.c: 小的珍珠纽扣

es.e: A button was missing from his shirt.
es.c: 他的衬衫上掉了一颗纽扣。

es.e: She undid (=  unfastened  ) the buttons of her blouse.
es.c: 她解开衬衫的纽扣。

d: v 购买；获得；贿赂 to pay money to someone, especially someone in a position of authority, in order to persuade them to do something dishonest；n 购买，买卖；所购的物品 an act of buying something, especially something illegal

es.e: People say the judge had been bought by the Mafia.
es.c: 人们都说法官被黑手党收买了。

d: prep 通过；被；依据；经由；在附近；在……之前 used especially with a  passive  verb to say who or what does something or makes something happen；adv 通过；经过；附近；[互联网] 白俄罗斯的国家代码顶级域名 past someone or something

es.e: I was attacked by a dog.
es.c: 我被一条狗袭击。

es.e: a church designed by the famous architect, Sir Christopher Wren
es.c: 著名建筑师克里斯托弗·雷恩爵士设计的一座教堂

es.e: We are all alarmed by the rise in violent crime.
es.c: 我们都对暴力罪案的增加感到忧虑。

d: int 再见 goodbye；n 轮空；次要的东西；adj 次要的

es.e: Bye, Dave.
es.c: 再见，戴夫。

d: n 驾驶室；出租汽车；出租马车 a taxi；v 乘出租马车（或汽车）

es.e: New York’s yellow cabs
es.c: 纽约的黄色出租车

es.e: Ralph tried to hail a cab (= wave to get a cab to stop for you ) .
es.c: 拉尔夫招手想叫一辆出租车。

d: n 卷心菜，甘蓝菜，洋白菜；（俚)脑袋；（非正式、侮辱）植物人（常用于英式英语）；（俚）钱，尤指纸币（常用于美式俚语） a large round vegetable with thick green or purple leaves
n 自助餐厅 a restaurant, often in a factory, college etc, where you choose from foods that have already been cooked and carry your own food to a table

es.e: the school cafeteria
es.c: 学校餐厅

d: n 笼，兽笼；牢房，监狱 a structure made of wires or bars in which birds or animals can be kept；v 把…关进笼子；把…囚禁起来 to put or keep an animal or bird in a cage

es.e: I hate to see birds in cages.
es.c: 我不喜欢看到鸟在笼子里。

d: n 蛋糕；块状物；利益总额 a soft sweet food made by baking a mixture of flour, butter, sugar, and eggs；v 使结块 if a substance cakes, it forms a thick hard layer when it dries

es.e: We had cake and ice cream.
es.c: 我们吃了蛋糕和冰激凌。

es.e: a chocolate cake
es.c: 巧克力蛋糕

d: v 计算；以为；作打算 to find out how much something will cost, how long something will take etc, by using numbers

es.e: These instruments calculate distances precisely.
es.c: 这些仪器计算距离非常精确。

d: v 呼叫；拜访；叫牌 to say or shout something loudly so that someone can hear you；n 电话；呼叫；要求；访问 when you speak to someone on the telephone

es.e: I heard someone calling in the distance.
es.c: 我听到远处有人在叫。

es.e: ‘I’m coming!’ she called down the stairs.
es.c: “来啦！”她朝楼下喊道。

es.e: Sheila was just sneaking out when her mother called her.
es.c: 希拉正要溜出去，这时她妈妈叫她了。

d: adj 静的，平静的；沉着的 relaxed and quiet, not angry, nervous, or upset；v 使平静；使镇定 to become quiet and relaxed after you have been angry, excited, nervous, or upset, or to make someone become quiet and relaxed；n 风平浪静 a situation o

es.e: Glen was calm and composed at the funeral.
es.c: 格伦在葬礼上表现得平静而镇定。

d: n [畜牧][脊椎] 骆驼；打捞浮筒；工作作风官僚 a large desert animal with a long neck and either one or two  hump s (= large raised parts )  on its back；adj 驼色的；暗棕色的；vi 工作刻板平庸
n 照相机；摄影机 a piece of equipment used to take photographs or make films or television programmes

es.e: Her grandmother lent her a camera for a school trip to Venice and Egypt.
es.c: 她的祖母借给她一部相机，让她在学校组织的到威尼斯和埃及的旅行中使用。

d: v 露营；扎营 to set up a tent or shelter and stay there for a short time；n 露营 a place where people stay in tents, shelters etc for a short time, usually in the mountains, a forest etc

es.e: We’ll camp by the river for the night, and move on tomorrow.
es.c: 我们今晚在河边露营，明天继续前进。

d: v 作战；参加竞选；参加活动 to lead or take part in a series of actions intended to achieve a particular social or political result；n 运动；活动；战役 a series of actions intended to achieve a particular result relating to politics or busine

es.e: Jones ran a good campaign.
es.c: 琼斯的活动搞得很成功。

es.e: Police have launched a campaign to crack down on drug dealers.
es.c: 警方发起了一场严厉打击毒贩的运动。

d: n 加拿大（北美洲国家）

es.e: She was domiciliated in Canada.
es.c: 她在加拿大定居。

es.e: Canada produces high-guality wheat.
es.c: 加拿大出产优质小麦。

es.e: He has lived in Canada for more than twenty years and is completely Canadianized now.
es.c: 他在加拿大已经住了二十多年了，现在完全加拿大化了。

d: adj 加拿大（人）的 relating to Canada or its people；n 加拿大人 someone from Canada

es.e: What about the Canadian policy?
es.c: 那么加拿大的政策呢？

es.e: The fugitive is believed to be headed for the Canadian border.
es.c: 据信，逃亡者正向加拿大边界方向逃窜。

es.e: Most English people bracket American and Canadian accents together.
es.c: 大多数英国人都把美国音和加拿大音相提并论。

d: n 运河；[地理] 水道；[建] 管道；灌溉水渠 a long passage dug into the ground and filled with water, either for boats to travel along, or to take water to a place；v 在…开凿运河

es.e: We walked along by the side of the canal.
es.c: 我们沿着运河边往前走。

es.e: the Panama Canal
es.c: 巴拿马运河

d: v 取消；删去 to decide that something that was officially planned will not happen；n 取消，撤销

es.e: Our flight was cancelled.
es.c: 我们的航班取消了。

es.e: I’m afraid I’ll have to cancel our meeting tomorrow.
es.c: 恐怕我得取消我们明天的会议。

es.e: You’ll just have to ring John and cancel.
es.c: 你只能打电话给约翰取消了。

d: n 癌症；恶性肿瘤 a very serious disease in which cells in one part of the body start to grow in a way that is not normal

es.e: A lot of cancers can now be treated successfully.
es.c: 现在许多癌症可以治愈。

es.e: She was told last year that she had cancer .
es.c: 去年她得知自己患了癌症。

es.e: He died of cancer last month.
es.c: 上个月他死于癌症。

d: n 候选人，候补者；应试者 someone who is being considered for a job or is competing in an election

es.e: a presidential candidate
es.c: 总统候选人

d: n 蜡烛；烛光；烛形物 a stick of  wax  with a string through the middle, which you burn to give light；v 对着光检查

es.e: When the candle was only half an inch high it flickered out and the room became dark.
es.c: 蜡烛只有半英寸长时，烛光忽闪忽闪地熄灭了，于是房间一片漆黑。

d: v 用糖煮；使结晶为砂糖；美化；n 糖果（等于sweets）；冰糖（等于sugar candy，rock candy）；毒品 Candy is sweet foods such as chocolate or toffees；adj 新潮的（服饰）；甜言蜜语的

es.e: ...a piece of candy.
es.c: …一块糖果。

d: n 食堂，小卖部；水壶 a place in a factory, school etc where meals are provided, usually quite cheaply

es.e: Rennie had eaten his supper in the canteen.
es.c: 伦尼已在食堂吃过晚饭。

d: n 盖；帽子 a protective covering that you put on the end or top of an object；v 脱帽致意

es.e: Make sure you put the cap back on the pen.
es.c: 一定要把笔帽套上。

es.e: a bottle cap
es.c: 瓶盖

d: n 首都，省会；资金；大写字母；资本家 an important city where the main government of a country, state etc is；adj 首都的；重要的；大写的 a capital letter is one that is written or printed in its large form

es.e: Washington D.C., the capital of the United States
es.c: 美国首都华盛顿特区

d: n 胶囊；[植] 蒴果；太空舱；小容器 a plastic container shaped like a very small tube with medicine inside that you swallow whole；adj 压缩的；概要的；v 压缩；简述

es.e: a space capsule orbiting the Earth
es.c: 沿地球轨道飞行的太空舱

d: n 队长，首领；船长；上尉；海军上校 the sailor in charge of a ship, or the pilot in charge of an aircraft；v 指挥；率领 to lead a group or team of people and be their captain

es.e: The captain and crew welcome you aboard.
es.c: 机长和全体机组人员欢迎各位乘坐本次航班。

d: n 标题；字幕；说明；逮捕 words printed above or below a picture in a book or newspaper or on a television screen to explain what the picture is showing；v 加上说明；加上标题

es.e: The local paper featured me standing on a stepladder with a caption, "Wendy climbs the ladder to success."
es.c: 当地的报纸刊登了一幅我站在活梯上的特写，下面写着：“温迪登上了成功之梯。”

d: n 汽车；车厢 a vehicle with four wheels and an engine, that can carry a small number of passengers

es.e: Dan got out of the car and locked the door.
es.c: 丹下了车，锁上车门。

es.e: He isn’t old enough to drive a car.
es.c: 他还未到可以开车的年龄。

es.e: Coughlan was killed in a car accident.
es.c: 科赫兰死于一场车祸。

d: n [化学] 碳；碳棒；复写纸 a chemical substance that exists in a pure form as diamonds,  graphite  etc, or in an impure form as coal, petrol etc. It is a chemical  element  : symbol C；adj 碳的；碳处理的

es.e: Across the world, forests and the soil beneath them absorb about a quarter of all carbon emissions.
es.c: 纵观全球，森林与它们脚下的土壤能吸收大约碳排放总量的四分之一。

d: n 卡片；纸牌；明信片 a small piece of plastic or paper containing information about a person or showing, for example, that they belong to a particular organization, club etc；v 记于卡片上

es.e: Employees must show their identity cards at the gate.
es.c: 雇员在大门口必须出示自己的身份卡。

es.e: I haven’t got my membership card yet.
es.c: 我还没拿到会员卡。

d: n 关怀；照料；谨慎；忧虑 the process of looking after someone, especially because they are ill, old, or very young；v 照顾；关心；喜爱；顾虑 to be concerned about what happens to someone, because you like or love them

es.e: high standards of medical care
es.c: 高水平的医疗护理

es.e: They shared the care of the children.
es.c: 他们共同照顾孩子。

es.e: Care facilities for the elderly are inadequate.
es.c: 老年人的护理设施很缺乏。

d: adj 仔细的，小心的 used to tell someone to think about what they are doing so that something bad does not happen

es.e: Be careful - the floor’s slippery.
es.c: 小心——地板很滑。

d: adj 粗心的；无忧无虑的；淡漠的 not paying enough attention to what you are doing, so that you make mistakes, damage things etc；n (Careless)人名；(英)凯尔利斯

es.e: It was careless of him to leave the door unlocked.
es.c: 他忘了锁门，真是粗心大意。

es.e: a careless mistake
es.c: 粗心造成的错误

es.e: careless driving
es.c: 粗心驾驶

d: n 木匠，木工 someone whose job is making and repairing wooden objects；v 当木匠，做木匠工作

es.e: He is a carpenter by profession.
es.c: 他以木工为业。

es.c: 仔细填写现金账簿，每次都要检查计算结果。

d: n 面颊，脸颊；臀部 the soft round part of your face below each of your eyes；v 无礼地向…讲话，对…大胆无礼 to speak rudely or with disrespect to someone, especially to someone older such as your teacher or parents

es.c: 露西伸长了脖子去亲吻他的脸颊。

es.e: Billy had rosy cheeks and blue eyes.
es.c: 比利脸颊红润，长着一双蓝眼睛。

es.e: her tear-stained cheeks
es.c: 她泪痕斑斑的脸颊

d: v 欢呼；使高兴；为…加油 to shout as a way of showing happiness, praise, approval, or support of someone or something；n 欢呼；愉快；心情；令人愉快的事 a shout of happiness, praise, approval, or encouragement

es.e: Everybody cheered when the firemen arrived.
es.c: 消防员到达时，大家都欢呼起来。

es.e: The audience was shouting and cheering.
es.c: 观众在呐喊欢呼。

es.e: The spectators cheered him wildly.
es.c: 观众拼命为他加油。

d: adj 快乐的；愉快的；高兴的 happy, or behaving in a way that shows you are happy

es.e: She’s feeling more cheerful today.
es.c: 今天她高兴些了。

es.e: I’m making a real effort to be cheerful despite everything.
es.c: 尽管发生了这些事，我还是非常努力让自己保持愉快。

d: v 感谢；谢谢；再见

es.c: 半公斤干酪

es.c: 干酪三明治

es.c: 撒上磨碎的干酪。

es.c: 手艺高超的厨师长

es.c: 糕饼师傅

d: n 化学制品，化学药品 a substance used in chemistry or produced by a chemical process；adj 化学的 relating to substances, the study of substances, or processes involving changes in substances

es.c: 有机化学工业

d: n 化学家；化学工作者；药剂师；炼金术士 a scientist who has special knowledge and training in chemistry

es.c: 她是一名化学研究员。

d: n 化学；化学过程 the science that is concerned with studying the structure of substances and the way that they change or combine with each other

es.c: 人体的化学组成

d: n 支票 a printed piece of paper that you write an amount of money on, sign, and use instead of money to pay for things

es.c: 你可以给她开张支票。

d: n 国际象棋，西洋棋 a game for two players, who move their playing pieces according to particular rules across a special board to try to trap their opponent’s  king (= most important piece )

es.e: They meet fairly often to play chess .
es.c: 他们经常在一起下国际象棋。

d: n 胸，胸部；衣柜；箱子；金库 the front part of your body between your neck and your stomach

es.e: Her heart was pounding in her chest.
es.c: 她的心在胸口怦怦直跳。

es.e: a hairy chest
es.c: 毛茸茸的胸部

d: n 咀嚼；咀嚼物 the act of biting something many times with your teeth；v 嚼碎，咀嚼 to bite food several times before swallowing it

es.c: 这肉太老了，我几乎嚼不动！

d: n 小鸡；小鸟；少妇 a baby bird；adj 胆小的；懦弱的

es.e: a mother hen with her chicks
es.c: 和小鸡在一起的鸡妈妈

d: n 鸡肉；小鸡；胆小鬼，懦夫 a common farm bird that is kept for its meat and eggs；adj 鸡肉的；胆怯的；幼小的 not brave enough to do something

es.e: roast chicken
es.c: 烤鸡

d: n 首领；酋长；主要部分 the most important person, or one of the most important people, in a company or organization – used especially in job titles and in news reports；adj 首席的；主要的；主任的 highest in rank；adv 主要地；首要地

es.e: Most health chiefs believe the reforms have gone too far.
es.c: 大多数卫生部领导人都觉得改革搞得过火了。

es.e: industry chiefs
es.c: 工业界领袖

d: n 儿童，小孩，孩子；产物；子孙；幼稚的人；弟子 someone who is not yet an adult

es.c: 这家宾馆对带小孩的家庭再合适不过。

es.c: 这部影片不适合12岁以下的儿童观看。

es.e: I was very happy as a child (= when I was a child ) .
es.c: 我小时候很幸福。

d: n 童年时期；幼年时代 the period of time when you are a child

es.e: I had a very happy childhood.
es.c: 我的童年很快乐。

d: n 烟囱 a vertical pipe that allows smoke from a fire to pass out of a building up into the air, or the part of this pipe that is above the roof

es.e: We can’t light a fire because the chimney hasn’t been swept.
es.c: 烟囱管没有清扫过，我们生不了火。

d: n 中国；adj 中国的；中国制造的
n 中文，汉语；中国人 the language used in China；adj 中国的，中国人的；中国话的 relating to China, its people, or its language

es.e: Do you fancy going out for a Chinese?
es.c: 你想不想出去吃顿中餐？

d: n [食品] 炸土豆条；小木片；（作赌注用的）圆形筹码；缺口（chip的复数形式） Chips are long, thin pieces of potato fried in oil or fat and eaten hot, usually with a meal

es.c: …一张带有芯片的电子卡。

d: n 巧克力，巧克力糖；巧克力色 a sweet brown food that you can eat as a sweet or use in cooking to give foods such as cakes a special sweet taste；adj 巧克力色的；巧克力口味的

es.c: 巧克力条

es.c: 巧克力蛋糕

es.e: a packet of chocolate biscuits
es.c: 一包巧克力饼干

d: n 选择；选择权；精选品 if you have a choice, you can choose between several things；adj 精选的；仔细推敲的 choice food is of very good quality

es.c: 他得作出一些重要的抉择。

es.c: 在这件事情上他们没给我们选择的余地。

d: n 唱诗班；合唱队；舞蹈队 a group of people who sing together for other people to listen to；v 合唱

es.c: 他八岁时加入了一个教堂唱诗班。

es.c: 我感觉好像有重物压在胸口，让我喘不过气来。

es.e: The smoke was choking me.
es.c: 烟呛得我呼吸困难。

d: v 选择，决定 to decide which one of a number of things or people you want

es.e: It took us ages to choose a new carpet.
es.c: 我们挑选新地毯花了很长时间。

es.e: A panel of judges will choose the winner.
es.c: 会由一个评判小组选出冠军。

es.e: He chose his words carefully as he spoke.
es.c: 他说话时字斟句酌。

d: n 筷子

es.c: 还少一双筷子。

es.c: 午饭前他教那个外国人怎样使筷子。

es.e: If you want your friend to try something they should pick it up from your plate with their own chopsticks.
es.c: 如果你想让你的朋友尝尝某道菜时，应该让他们用他们自己的筷子从你的盘中夹。

d: n 合唱队；齐声；歌舞队 a large group of people who sing together；v 合唱；异口同声地说 if people chorus something, they say it at the same time

es.e: I sing with the university chorus.
es.c: 我在大学合唱队里唱歌。

d: n 基督徒，信徒 a person who believes in the ideas taught by Jesus Christ；adj 基督教的；信基督教的 related to Christianity

es.e: a Christmas present
es.c: 圣诞礼物

es.c: 简短的教堂礼拜仪式

es.e: church bells
es.c: 教堂的钟

d: n 雪茄 a thick tube-shaped thing that people smoke, and which is made from tobacco leaves that have been rolled up

es.e: He was smoking a big cigar.
es.c: 他在抽一只大雪茄。

d: n 香烟；纸烟 a thin tube of paper filled with finely cut tobacco that people smoke

es.e: a packet of cigarettes
es.c: 一包香烟

d: n 电影；电影院；电影业，电影制作术 a building in which films are shown

d: n 循环，周期；圆；圈子；圆形物 a completely round shape, like the letter O；v 盘旋，旋转；环行 to move in the shape of a circle around something, especially in the air

es.e: Draw a circle 10cm in diameter.
es.c: 画一个直径10厘米的圆形。

es.e: Cut the pastry into circles.
es.c: 将油酥面团切成圆形。

es.e: We did a circuit of the old city.
es.c: 我们绕着老城走了一圈。

d: v 传播，流传；循环；流通 to move around within a system, or to make something do this

es.e: Swimming helps to get the blood circulating through the muscles.
es.c: 游泳有助于肌肉的血液循环。

es.e: Ceiling fans circulated warm air around the room.
es.c: 吊扇使暖空气在房间里循环。

es.c: 苏联为形势所迫同纳粹德国签订了一项条约。

es.e: I can’t imagine a circumstance in which I would be willing to steal.
es.c: 我无法想象我在什么情况下会愿意去偷东西。

es.c: 一场特大暴风雨即将到来，市长敦促市民做好准备。

es.c: 最近的大城市是圣路易斯。

es.c: 他们在五月份举行了世俗婚礼。

es.c: …这个国家的平民人口。

es.c: 观众礼貌地鼓了掌，但并不热烈。

es.c: 记者们要求他阐明他在福利改革问题上的立场。

es.c: 他不得不在一个比他小的学生的班上呆了大约六个月。

es.c: 各个家庭按父亲的职业分类。

es.c: 他把我妹妹介绍给他的同班同学。

es.c: 他把我的弟弟介绍给他的同班同学。

es.c: 我是你的同班同学,能了解你。

es.c: 那男孩突然从教室里奔出去。

es.c: 学生们蜂拥着跑出了教室。

es.e: She fainted in the classroom and was carried out.
es.c: 她在教室中昏过去了，并被抬了出来。

es.e: The cat dug his claws into my leg.
es.c: 猫的爪子抓进了我的腿中。

es.e: lobster claws
es.c: 龙虾的螯

es.e: Bricks are made from clay.
es.c: 砖是用黏土制成的。

es.e: Are your hands clean?
es.c: 你的手干净吗？

es.e: clean towels
es.c: 干净的毛巾

es.e: Make sure you keep the wound clean .
es.c: 一定要保持伤口清洁。

es.c: 真空吸尘器

es.c: 明确的指示

es.c: 我从没用过这么清晰易懂的指南。

es.c: 忽视他显然是个错误。

es.c: 一家商行的文员

d: adj 聪明的；机灵的；熟练的 able to learn and understand things quickly

es.e: a clever man
es.c: 聪明的人

es.c: 门在我身后咔嗒一声关上了。

es.c: 妈妈咂咂嘴，叹了口气。

es.e: Edmund clicked his fingers (= made a short sound to get someone’s attention ) for John to follow him.
es.c: 埃德蒙弹了个响指示意约翰跟着他。

d: n 气候；风气；思潮；风土 the typical weather conditions in a particular area

es.c: 洛杉矶温暖干燥的气候

es.c: 哈里爬上楼梯。

es.e: Boys were climbing trees along the river bank.
es.c: 男孩们在河边爬树。

d: n 临床；诊所 a place, often in a hospital, where medical treatment is given to people who do not need to stay in the hospital

es.c: 门诊预约

es.c: 我听到钟敲了六下。

es.c: 车站的钟慢了十分钟。

es.c: 几次有人报告说有海豚与人类比邻而居。

es.c: 用一块湿布清洗表面。

es.c: 他穿着什么样的衣服？

es.c: 我淋浴后穿上干净的衣服。

es.c: 笨拙的接球动作

d: n 教练；旅客车厢；长途公车；四轮大马车 someone who trains a person or team in a sport；v 训练；指导 to teach a person or team the skills they need for a sport

es.c: 挪威国家队教练

d: v 上煤；加煤；n 煤；煤块；木炭 a hard black mineral which is dug out of the ground and burnt to produce heat

es.c: 往火里加点煤。

es.c: 他踩下离合器，滑行了一会儿便停下来了。

d: n 外套 a piece of clothing with long sleeves that is worn over your clothes to protect them or to keep you warm；v 覆盖…的表面

es.c: 比利！穿上外套，外面很冷！

es.c: 孩子们脱下外套扔在地板上。

es.c: 我需要一件新的冬衣。

d: n 公鸡；龙头；雄鸟；头目 an adult male chicken；v 使竖起；使耸立；使朝上

es.c: 远处有只公鸡在打鸣。

d: n 可可粉；可可豆；可可饮料；深褐色 a brown powder made from cocoa beans, used to make chocolate and to give a chocolate taste to foods

es.c: 一杯可可

es.c: 你要来杯咖啡吗？

es.c: 你的咖啡要加奶还是不加奶？

d: v 铸造（货币）；杜撰，创造 to invent a new word or expression, especially one that many people start to use；n 硬币，钱币 a piece of metal, usually flat and round, that is used as money

es.e: The word ‘aromatherapy’ was coined in the 1920s. aromatherapy
es.c: （芳香疗法）这个词是在20世纪20年代创造出来的。

d: n 巧合；一致；同时发生 when two things happen at the same time, in the same place, or to the same people in a way that seems surprising or unusual

es.e: ‘I’m going to Appleby tomorrow.’ ‘ What a coincidence ! I’m going there too.’
es.c: “明天我要去阿普尔比。”“太巧了！我也要去那里。”

d: n 焦炭；可卡因；可口可乐（Coca-Cola） the drink Coca-Cola, or a bottle, can, or glass of this drink；v 焦化

es.e: ...a coke-burning stove.
es.c: …一个烧焦炭的炉子。

d: adj 寒冷的；冷淡的，不热情的；失去知觉的 something that is cold has a low temperature；n 寒冷；感冒 a common illness that makes it difficult to breathe through your nose and often makes your throat hurt；adv 完全地 suddenly and completely

es.c: 她往脸上泼冷水。

es.e: a blast of cold air
es.c: 一股冷空气

es.e: We slept on the cold ground.
es.c: 我们睡在冰冷的地上。

d: n 衣领；颈圈 the part of a shirt, coat etc that fits around your neck, and is usually folded over；v 抓住；给…上领子；给…套上颈圈 to catch someone and hold them so that they cannot escape

es.c: 他抓住我的衣领。

es.e: He loosened his collar and tie .
es.c: 他松开了领子和领带。

d: n 同事，同僚 someone you work with – used especially by professional people

es.e: a colleague of mine from the bank
es.c: 我在银行的一位同事

es.e: She discussed the idea with some of her colleagues.
es.c: 她和几位同事讨论了这个想法。

d: v 收集；募捐 to get things of the same type from different places and bring them together；adv 由收件人付款地 to get and keep objects of the same type, because you think they are attractive or interesting；adj 由收件人付款的；n (Collect)人名；(英

es.e: After 25 years of collecting recipes, she has compiled them into a cookbook.
es.c: 她搜集了25年食谱，把它们编成一本烹饪书。

es.e: The company collects information about consumer trends.
es.c: 这家公司搜集有关消费者趋向的信息。

es.e: We’ve been out collecting signatures for our petition.
es.c: 我们出去为我们的请愿征集签名。

d: n 采集，聚集；[税收] 征收；收藏品；募捐 the act of asking people to give you money for an organization that helps people, or during a church service, or the money collected in this way

es.e: We’ll be taking up a collection at the end of tonight’s service.
es.c: 我们在今晚的仪式之后将举行募捐活动。

d: n 大学；学院；学会 a school for advanced education, especially in a particular profession or skill

es.c: 师范学院

es.c: 唐娜中学毕业后进了艺术学院。

d: n 碰撞；冲突；（意见，看法）的抵触；（政党等的）倾轧 an accident in which two or more people or vehicles hit each other while moving in different directions

es.c: 218号公路上有两辆汽车迎面相撞，两人死亡。

d: v 把…涂颜色，粉饰；歪曲；使脸红 when someone colours, their face becomes redder because they are embarrassed；n 颜色；风格；气色，面色；外貌 red, blue, yellow, green, brown, purple etc

es.e: Her eyes suddenly met his and she coloured slightly.
es.c: 她的目光突然和他相遇，她微微有点脸红了。

d: n 梳子；蜂巢；鸡冠 a flat piece of plastic, metal etc with a row of thin teeth on one side, used for making your hair tidy；v 梳头发；梳毛 to make hair look tidy using a comb

es.e: Your hair needs a good comb.
es.c: 你的头发需要好好梳理一下。

d: v 使化合；使联合，使结合 if you combine two or more different things, or if they combine, they begin to exist or work together；n 联合收割机；联合企业 a machine used by farmers to cut grain, separate the seeds from it, and clean it

es.e: Diets are most effective when combined with exercise.
es.c: 节食和锻炼相结合是最有效的。

es.e: Ruth hesitated, uncertain of how to combine honesty and diplomacy in her answer.
es.c: 露丝犹豫了，她不知道怎样回答才能既诚实又婉转。

d: v 来；开始；出现；发生；变成；到达 to move towards you or arrive at the place where you are；int 嗨！；n (Come)人名；(英)科姆；(阿尔巴)乔梅

es.c: 他们来了就告诉我。

es.c: 你到这里来一会儿好吗？

es.e: Come a bit closer and you’ll be able to see better.

d: n 喜剧；喜剧性；有趣的事情 entertainment that is intended to make people laugh

es.c: 单口喜剧表演职业

es.c: 我穿衣服只讲舒服，不追求时髦。

es.c: 艾伦很不情愿离开暖和舒适的火堆。

es.e: Now you can watch your favorite movies in the comfort of your own home.
es.c: 现在你可以舒舒服服地在自己家里看你最喜欢的电影了。

es.c: 床上又舒服又暖和，我都不想起来。

es.c: 你需在此加一个逗号，否则意思不清楚。

es.c: 所以我滚动到右边，我应当看到一个逗号,在右引号的右边，然后这两个值是多少？

d: v 命令，指挥；控制 to tell someone officially to do something, especially if you are a military leader, a king etc；n 指挥，控制；命令；司令部 the control of a group of people or a situation

es.e: He commands the 4th Battalion.
es.c: 他指挥第四营。

d: n 评论；意见；批评 an opinion that you express about someone or something；v 发表评论；发表意见 to express an opinion about someone or something

es.c: 他因谩骂裁判而被罚款。

d: adj 商业的；营利的；靠广告收入的 related to business and the buying and selling of goods and services；n 商业广告 an advertisement on television or radio

es.c: 复杂的公路网

es.c: 光合作用是一个非常复杂的过程。

es.c: 再复杂的问题彼得似乎也是一看就明白。

es.c: 戈尔巴乔夫没能使苏联各组成部分保持在一起。

es.c: 她承认自己无法作出妥协。

es.c: 强制性裁员的威胁

es.c: 汽车保险是强制性的。

es.c: 最新的计算机软件

es.c: 我们对得体的人类行为的基本观念

es.c: 食品添加剂这类事情确实使我很担心。

es.c: 摇滚音乐会

es.c: 法国合唱音乐会

es.e: We were going to a concert in Bath Abbey.
es.c: 我们要去听一场在巴斯修道院内举行的音乐会。

d: v 推断；决定，作结论；结束 to decide that something is true after considering all the information you have

es.c: 等到调查结束后，结果会被送到联邦检察官办公室。

es.c: 这些就是这篇报告的主要结论。

es.c: 在这一点上作出结论还为时过早。

es.e: There are perhaps two main conclusions to be drawn from the above discussion.
es.c: 从以上的讨论也许可以得出两个主要的结论。

d: adj 混凝土的；实在的，具体的；有形的 made of concrete；v 凝结 to cover something such as a path, wall etc with concrete；n 具体物；凝结物

es.c: 混凝土地面

d: v 谴责；判刑，定罪；声讨 to say very strongly that you do not approve of something or someone, especially because you think it is morally wrong

es.e: Politicians were quick to condemn the bombing.
es.c: 政治家们立即对爆炸事件进行了谴责。

d: n 条件；情况；环境；身份 the situation in which people live or work, especially the physical things that affect the quality of their lives；v 决定；使适应；使健康；以…为条件 to make a person or an animal think or behave in a certain way by influen

es.e: Conditions in the prison were atrocious.
es.c: 这座监狱的条件糟透了。

es.e: In May, staff went on strike, demanding better pay and conditions .
es.c: 五月份员工举行了罢工，要求提高工资和改善工作条件。

d: v 导电；带领 if something conducts electricity or heat, it allows electricity or heat to travel along or through it；n 进行；行为；实施 the way someone behaves, especially in public, in their job etc

es.e: Aluminium, being a metal, readily conducts heat .
es.c: 铝这种金属导热性能很好。

d: n 导体；售票员；领导者；管理人 someone whose job is to collect payments from passengers on a bus

es.e: Wood is a poor conductor of heat.
es.c: 木头导热性能差。

d: n 会议；讨论；协商；联盟；（正式）讨论会；[工会、工党用语]（每年的）大会 a large formal meeting where a lot of people discuss important matters such as business, politics, or science, especially for several days；vi 举行或参加（系列）会议

es.e: Representatives from over 100 countries attended the International Peace Conference in Geneva.
es.c: 来自一百多个国家的代表出席了在日内瓦举行的国际和平大会。

d: adj 自信的；确信的 sure that something will happen in the way that you want or expect

es.e: Despite her disability, Philippa is very confident.
es.c: 菲莉帕虽然有残疾，却很自信。

d: adj 机密的；表示信任的；获信任的 spoken or written in secret and intended to be kept secret

es.e: a confidential government report
es.c: 一份机密的政府报告

es.e: Doctors are required to keep patients’ records completely confidential .
es.c: 医生必须对病人的病历完全保密。

es.e: The information will be regarded as strictly confidential (= completely confidential ) .
es.c: 这一信息将被视为绝对机密。

d: v 确认；确定；证实；批准；使巩固 to show that something is definitely true, especially by providing more proof

es.e: New evidence has confirmed the first witness’s story.
es.c: 新的证据证实了第一个证人的说法。

es.e: To confirm my diagnosis I need to do some tests.
es.c: 为了证实我的诊断，我要做一些化验。

d: n 冲突，矛盾；斗争；争执 a state of disagreement or argument between people, groups, countries etc；v 冲突，抵触；争执；战斗 if two ideas, beliefs, opinions etc conflict, they cannot exist together or both be true

es.e: the threat of industrial conflict in the coalfields
es.c: 煤田发生劳资纠纷的风险

es.e: Marx points out the potential conflicts below the surface of society.
es.c: 马克思指出了隐藏在社会表层之下的潜在矛盾。

es.e: His views on the literal truth of the Bible brought him into conflict with other Christian leaders.
es.c: 他坚持《圣经》字面真理的观点使他与其他的基督教领袖发生了冲突。

d: v 使混乱；使困惑 to make someone feel that they cannot think clearly or do not understand

es.e: I understand the text but the diagrams are confusing me.
es.c: 文字我理解，但是图表把我弄糊涂了。

d: v 祝贺；恭喜；庆贺 to tell someone that you are happy because they have achieved something or because something nice has happened to them

es.e: He never even stopped to congratulate me.
es.c: 他甚至没有过来向我祝贺。

d: n 祝贺；贺辞 when you tell someone that you are happy because they have achieved something or because something nice has happened to them

es.e: letters of congratulation
es.c: 祝贺信

d: v 连接；联合；关连 to join two or more things together

es.e: We’d like two rooms with connecting doors (= doors that join the rooms ) .
es.c: 我们想要两个有门相通的房间。

d: n 连接；关系；人脉；连接件 the way in which two facts, ideas, events etc are related to each other, and one is affected or caused by the other

es.e: Police have so far failed to establish a connection between the two murders.
es.c: 到目前为止警方尚未确定两宗凶杀案之间有关联。

es.e: The evidence was there in the file but no one made the connection .
es.c: 证据就在档案里，但没有人把它们联系起来。

es.e: Students often see little connection between school and the rest of their lives.
es.c: 学生往往看不到上学和今后生活的联系。

d: n 道德心，良心 the part of your mind that tells you whether what you are doing is morally right or wrong

es.e: Well, at least I can face them all with a clear conscience (= the knowledge that you have done nothing wrong ) .
es.c: 好吧，至少我可以问心无愧地面对他们所有人。

es.e: I can’t tell you what to do – it’s a matter of conscience (= something that you must make a moral judgment about ) .
es.c: 我不能告诉你怎么办——这是良心问题。

es.e: a crisis of conscience among medical staff (= a situation in which it is very difficult to decide what is the right thing to do )
es.c: 医务人员中的良心危机

d: n 一致；舆论；合意 an opinion that everyone in a group agrees with or accepts

es.e: The EU Council of Finance Ministers failed to reach a consensus on the pace of integration.
es.c: 欧盟财政部长会议未能就一体化的进度达成共识。

es.e: the current consensus of opinion
es.c: 目前观点上的一致

es.e: The general consensus was that technology was a good thing.
es.c: 大家都认为科技是好东西。

d: n 结果；重要性；推论 something that happens as a result of a particular action or set of conditions

es.e: I don’t suppose it is of any consequence now.
es.c: 现在我觉得这事一点都无所谓了。

d: n 保存，保持；保护 the protection of natural things such as animals, plants, forests etc, to prevent them from being spoiled or destroyed

es.e: wildlife conservation
es.c: 野生生物保护

es.e: a local conservation group
es.c: 当地的一个环境保护团体

d: adj 保守的 not liking changes or new ideas；n 保守派，守旧者 someone who supports or is a member of the Conservative Party in Britain

es.e: a very conservative attitude to education
es.c: 对待教育非常守旧的态度

es.e: conservative views
es.c: 保守的观点

d: v 考虑；认为；考虑到；细想 to think about something carefully, especially before making a choice or decision

es.e: We will have to consider your offer carefully .
es.c: 我们得仔细考虑你的提议。

d: adj 体贴的；体谅的；考虑周到的 always thinking of what other people need or want and being careful not to upset them

es.e: He was always kind and considerate.
es.c: 他总是很善良，为别人着想。

d: n 考虑；原因；关心；报酬 careful thought and attention, especially before making an official or important decision

es.e: proposals put forward for consideration
es.c: 提请考虑的建议

d: v 由…组成；在于；符合

es.e: My diet consisted almost exclusively of chocolate-covered cookies and glasses of milk.
es.c: 我的饮食几乎只包含裹上巧克力的曲奇饼和一杯杯牛奶。

d: adj 始终如一的，一致的；坚持的 a consistent argument or idea does not have any parts that do not match other parts

es.e: The evidence is not consistent.
es.c: 证词前后不一致。

d: adj 不变的；恒定的；经常的 happening regularly or all the time；n [数] 常数；恒量 a number or quantity that never changes

es.e: There was a constant stream of visitors to the house.
es.c: 参观这幢房子的游客川流不息。

es.e: Amy lived in constant fear of being attacked.
es.c: 埃米一直生活在害怕遭到袭击的恐惧之中。

es.e: He kept in constant contact with his family while he was in Australia.
es.c: 他在澳大利亚时一直和家人保持着联系。

d: n 宪法；体制；章程；构造；建立，组成；体格 a set of basic laws and principles that a country or organization is governed by

es.e: The right to speak freely is written into the Constitution of the United States.
es.c: 言论自由的权利被写入美国宪法。

d: v 建造，构造；创立 to build something such as a house, bridge, road etc；n 构想，概念 an idea formed by combining several pieces of information or knowledge

es.e: There are plans to construct a new road bridge across the river.
es.c: 有计划要建造一条新的跨河公路桥。

d: n 建设；建筑物；解释；造句 the process of building things such as houses, bridges, roads etc

es.e: a road construction project
es.c: 道路修建计划

es.e: construction workers
es.c: 建筑工人

d: v 查阅；商量；向…请教 to ask for information or advice from someone because it is their job to know something

es.e: If symptoms persist, consult a doctor without delay.
es.c: 如果症状持续的话，马上咨询医生。

d: n 顾问；咨询者；会诊医生 someone whose job is to give advice on a particular subject

es.e: a management consultant
es.c: 管理顾问

d: v 消耗，消费；使…著迷；挥霍 to use time, energy, goods etc

es.e: Only 27% of the paper we consume is recycled.
es.c: 我们消耗的纸张只有 27% 得到回收利用。

es.e: A smaller vehicle will consume less fuel.
es.c: 汽车小耗费燃料也少。

d: v 包含；控制；容纳；牵制（敌军） if something such as a bag, box, or place contains something, that thing is inside it

es.e: The thieves stole a purse containing bank-notes.
es.c: 小偷们偷到了一个里面有钞票的钱包。

es.e: The museum contains a number of original artworks.
es.c: 这家博物馆藏有一些原创艺术品。

d: n 集装箱；容器 something such as a box or bowl that you use to keep things in

es.e: ice cream in plastic containers
es.c: 塑料容器里的冰激凌

d: n 同时代的人；同时期的东西 someone who lived or was in a particular place at the same time as someone else；adj 当代的；同时代的；属于同一时期的 belonging to the present time

es.e: Like most of my contemporaries, I grew up in a vastly different world.
es.c: 像我同时代的大多数人一样，我在一个非常不同的世界里长大。

d: n 内容，目录；满足；容量 the amount of a substance that is contained in something, especially food or drink；adj 满意的 happy and satisfied；v 使满足 to do or have something that is not what you really wanted, but is still satisfactory

es.e: water with a low salt content
es.c: 含盐量低的水

d: n 大陆，洲，陆地 a large mass of land surrounded by sea；adj 自制的，克制的 able to control your sexual desires

es.e: the continents of Asia and Africa
es.c: 亚洲及非洲大陆

d: v 继续，延续；仍旧，连续 to not stop happening, existing, or doing something

es.e: He will be continuing his education in the US.
es.c: 他将在美国继续求学。

es.e: I felt too sick to continue.
es.c: 我感觉很难受，无法继续下去了。

d: v 反驳；否定；与…矛盾；与…抵触 to disagree with something, especially by saying that the opposite is true

es.e: Deborah opened her mouth to contradict, but closed it again.
es.c: 黛博拉张口想要反驳，但又把嘴闭上了。

es.e: Dad just can’t bear to be contradicted.
es.c: 爸爸就是受不了有人反驳他。

es.e: The article flatly contradicts their claims.
es.c: 这篇文章断然驳斥他们的说法。

d: adj 矛盾的；反对的；反驳的；抗辩的 two statements, beliefs etc that are contradictory are different and therefore cannot both be true or correct；n 对立物；矛盾因素

es.e: Customs officials have made a series of contradictory statements about the equipment.
es.c: 海关官员们对于这种设备做出了一系列相互矛盾的陈述。

d: adj 相反的；对立的 contrary ideas, opinions, or actions are completely different and opposed to each other；adv 相反地；n 相反；反面 used to add to a negative statement, to disagree with a negative statement by someone else, or to answer

es.e: Two contrary views emerged.
es.c: 出现了两种相反的观点。

es.e: The men shouted contrary orders.
es.c: 这些人大声喊叫的命令互相矛盾。

d: v 贡献，出力；投稿；捐献 to give money, help, ideas etc to something that a lot of other people are also involved in

es.e: The three sons also contribute to the family business.
es.c: 3个儿子也为家族企业做贡献。

d: n 贡献；捐献；投稿 something that you give or do in order to help something be successful

es.e: a campaign contribution
es.c: 竞选捐款

d: n 控制；管理；抑制；操纵装置 the ability or power to make someone or something do what you want or make something happen in the way you want；v 控制；管理；抑制 to have the power to make the decisions about how a country, place, company etc i

es.e: The disease robs you of muscle control.
es.c: 这种疾病会让你丧失肌肉控制力。

es.e: ‘Do you need any help?’ ‘No. It’s under control , thanks.’
es.c: “你需要帮忙吗？”“不用，已经搞定了。谢谢。”

es.e: Dogs are allowed on the trails if they are kept under control .
es.c: 狗在受到看管的情况下可以在小径上走。

d: adj 有争议的；有争论的 causing a lot of disagreement, because many people have strong opinions about the subject being discussed

es.e: the controversial issue of welfare reform
es.c: 福利改革这一有争议的话题

es.e: a highly controversial (= very controversial ) plan to flood the valley in order to build a dam
es.c: 一个把山谷淹掉来建造水坝的极具争议的计划

es.e: He is a controversial figure (= person who does controversial things ) in the art world.
es.c: 他是艺术界极具争议的人物。

d: n 便利；厕所；便利的事物 the quality of being suitable or useful for a particular purpose, especially by making something easier or saving you time

es.e: Ready meals sell well because of their convenience.
es.c: 即食餐因为方便销路好。

d: adj 方便的；[废语]适当的；[口语]近便的；实用的 useful to you because it saves you time, or does not spoil your plans or cause you problems

es.e: Mail-order catalogs are a convenient way to shop.
es.c: 使用邮购目录是一种方便的购物方式。

es.e: My secretary will call you to arrange a convenient time to meet.
es.c: 我的秘书会打电话给你安排一个方便的时间见面。

d: adj 符合习俗的，传统的；常见的；惯例的 a conventional method, product, practice etc has been used for a long time and is considered the usual type

es.e: Internet connections through conventional phone lines are fairly slow.
es.c: 通过传统的电话线来连接因特网速度很慢。

es.e: Bake for 20 minutes in a conventional oven; 8 in a microwave.
es.c: 在传统的烤炉中烘烤20分钟，在微波炉里则烤8分钟。

d: n 交谈，会话；社交；交往，交际；会谈；（人与计算机的）人机对话 an informal talk in which people exchange news, feelings, and thoughts

es.e: a telephone conversation
es.c: 电话交谈

es.e: Children quickly get bored by adult conversation.
es.c: 儿童对成年人的谈话很快就会厌倦。

es.e: They had a short conversation in German and seemed to be disagreeing about something.
es.c: 他们用德语说了一会儿，好像对什么事有分歧。

d: v 传达；运输；让与 to communicate or express something, with or without using words

es.e: All this information can be conveyed in a simple diagram.
es.c: 所有这些信息可以通过一张简单的图表来表示。

es.e: Ads convey the message that thin is beautiful.
es.c: 广告传递的信息是: 瘦就是美。

es.e: He was sent to convey a message to the UN Secretary General.
es.c: 他被派去向联合国秘书长传达一条信息。

d: v 说服；使确信，使信服 to make someone feel certain that something is true

es.e: Her arguments didn’t convince everyone, but changes were made.
es.c: 她的论点不能说服每个人，但还是引起了一些变化。

d: v 烹调，煮 to prepare food for eating by using heat；n 厨师，厨子 someone who prepares and cooks food as their job

es.e: Where did you learn to cook?
es.c: 你在哪里学烹调的？

es.e: Cook the sauce over a low heat for ten minutes.
es.c: 把这调味汁用低火烧十分钟。

es.e: slices of cooked ham
es.c: 熟的火腿片

d: n 炊具；烹饪用水果；窜改者

es.e: a gas cooker
es.c: 煤气炉灶

d: n 饼干；小甜点 a small flat sweet cake

es.e: a glass of milk and a cookie
es.c: 一杯牛奶和一块小甜饼

es.e: a chocolate chip cookie
es.c: 带巧克力碎粒的小甜饼

d: adj 凉爽的；冷静的；出色的 low in temperature, but not cold, often in a way that feels pleasant；v 使…冷却；使…平静下来 to make something slightly colder, or to become slightly colder；n 凉爽；凉爽的空气 a temperature that is pleasantly cold；adv 冷静地

es.e: She swam out into the cool water.
es.c: 她往外游向清凉的水里。

es.e: The evening air was cool.
es.c: 夜晚的空气很凉爽。

es.e: Relax in the sun with a cool drink.
es.c: 在阳光下喝杯清凉饮料放松一下。

d: v 复制；复印；抄袭 to deliberately make or produce something that is exactly like another thing；n 副本；一册；摹仿 something that is made to be exactly like another thing

es.e: Could you copy this letter and send it out, please?
es.c: 你能把这封信复印一份发出去吗？

es.e: To copy a file, press F3.
es.c: 拷贝文件按F3键。

d: n 珊瑚；珊瑚虫 a hard red, white, or pink substance formed from the bones of very small sea creatures, which is often used to make jewellery；adj 珊瑚的；珊瑚色的 pink or reddish-orange in colour

es.e: The seas around Bermuda are full of colourful corals and fantastic fish.
es.c: 百慕大周围的海域中到处都是五彩的珊瑚虫和奇异的鱼类。

d: n 不用电线的；adj 无线的（副词cordlessly） a piece of equipment that is cordless is not connected to its power supply by wires

es.e: a cordless phone
es.c: 无线电话

es.e: a cordless drill
es.c: 无线电钻

d: n （美）玉米；（英）谷物；[皮肤] 鸡眼 plants such as wheat,  barley  , and  oats  or their seeds；v 腌；使成颗粒

es.e: fields of corn
es.c: 一片片麦田

es.e: an ear of corn
es.c: 谷穗

d: n 角落，拐角处；地区，偏僻处；困境，窘境 the point at which two lines or edges meet；v 囤积；相交成角

es.e: He pulled a dirty handkerchief out by its corner and waved it at me.
es.c: 他拽出一块脏手帕，捏着一角向我挥动。

d: n 公司；法人（团体）；社团；大腹便便；市政当局 a big company, or a group of companies acting together as a single organization

es.e: He works for a large American corporation.
es.c: 他在一家美国大公司工作。

es.e: multinational corporations
es.c: 跨国公司

es.e: the Siemens Corporation
es.c: 西门子公司

d: v 改正；告诫 to show someone that something is wrong, and make it right；adj 正确的；恰当的；端正的 having no mistakes

es.e: Correct my pronunciation if it’s wrong.
es.c: 如果我的发音错了，请给我纠正。

es.e: ‘She’s in Ireland now.’ ‘She was,’ Farrell corrected him.
es.c: “她现在在爱尔兰。”“她之前在爱尔兰。”法雷尔纠正他道。

d: n 改正，修正 a change made in something in order to make it right or better

es.e: I just need to make a few corrections , and then we can send it to the printer.
es.c: 我只要修改几个地方，然后就可以把它发送到打印机。

d: v 符合，一致；相应；通信 if two things or ideas correspond, the parts or information in one relate to the parts or information in the other

es.e: The two halves of the document did not correspond.
es.c: 这份文件的前后两部分不相符。

d: adj 腐败的，贪污的；堕落的 using your power in a dishonest or illegal way in order to get an advantage for yourself；v 使腐烂；使堕落，使恶化 to encourage someone to start behaving in an immoral or dishonest way

es.e: Corrupt judges have taken millions of dollars in bribes.
es.c: 腐败的法官接受了几百万美元的贿赂。

d: v 花费；使付出；使花许多钱 to calculate the total price of something or decide how much the price of something should be；n 费用，代价，成本；损失 the amount of money that you have to pay in order to buy, do, or produce something

es.e: We’ll get the plan costed before presenting it to the board.
es.c: 在把计划提交董事会以前，我们会核算成本。

d: adj 舒适的；惬意的 a place that is cosy is small, comfortable, and warm；n 保温罩 a covering for a  teapot  that keeps the tea inside from getting cold too quickly

es.e: The living room was warm and cosy .
es.c: 客厅暖和又舒适。

d: n 小屋；村舍；（农舍式的）小别墅 a small house in the country

es.e: a country cottage
es.c: 乡间小屋

es.e: We’re staying in a holiday cottage in Dorset.
es.c: 我们住在多塞特的一个度假小别墅里。

d: n 棉花；棉布；棉线 cloth or thread made from the white hair of the cotton plant；v 一致；理解；和谐；亲近；adj 棉的；棉制的

es.e: a white cotton shirt
es.c: 白色棉布衬衫
