d: adj 黑暗的，深色的；模糊的；无知的；忧郁的 if it is dark, there is little or no light；n 黑暗；夜；黄昏；模糊 when there is no light, especially because the sun has gone down

es.e: The church was dark and quiet.
es.c: 教堂里黑魆魆的，寂静无声。

es.e: the dark winter days
es.c: 阴暗的冬日

es.e: Suddenly, the room went dark (= became dark ) .
es.c: 房间突然变暗了。

d: n 黑暗；模糊；无知；阴郁 when there is no light

es.e: the long hours of darkness during winter
es.c: 冬季漫长的黑夜

es.e: We lit our campfire as darkness fell (= it became night ) .
es.c: 夜幕降临，我们点起了篝火。

es.e: He stared out the window at the gathering darkness (= the night slowly coming ) .
es.c: 他凝视着窗外渐浓的夜色。

d: n 破折号；冲撞 a line [-] used in writing to separate two closely related parts of a sentence, as for example, in the sentence ‘Go home-they’re waiting for you.’；v 使…破灭；猛撞；泼溅 If you dash somewhere, you run or go there quickly

es.e: ...a 160-mile dash to the hospital.
es.c: …飞奔160英里赶向医院。

es.e: Suddenly she dashed down to the cellar.
es.c: 她猛地朝地窖冲过去。

d: n 数据（datum的复数）；资料 information or facts

es.e: The research involves collecting data from two random samples.
es.c: 该项研究需要从两个随机样本里收集资料。

d: n 数据库，资料库 a large amount of data stored in a computer system so that you can find and use it easily

es.e: customer details held on a database
es.c: 存储在数据库内的客户详细信息

d: n 日期；约会；年代；枣椰子 a particular day of the month or year, especially shown by a number；v 过时；注明日期；始于（某一历史时期） if clothing, art etc dates, it begins to look old-fashioned

es.e: The date on the letter was 30th August 1962.
es.c: 信上的日期是1962年8月30日。

es.e: What’s today’s date?
es.c: 今天几号？

d: n 女儿；[遗][农学] 子代 someone’s female child；adj 女儿的；子代的

es.e: She’s got two daughters and one son.
es.c: 她有两个女儿和一个儿子。

es.e: our eldest daughter
es.c: 我们的长女

d: n 黎明；开端 the time at the beginning of the day when light first appears；v 破晓；出现；被领悟 if day or morning dawns, it begins

es.e: When dawn broke (= the first light of the day appeared ) , we were still 50 miles from Calcutta.
es.c: 破晓的时候，我们离加尔各答还有50英里。

es.e: I was up at the crack of dawn (= very early in the morning ) to get the plane.
es.c: 我一大早就起来赶飞机。

es.e: We worked from dawn to dusk (= through the whole day while it is light ) .
es.c: 我们从早干到晚。

d: n 一天；时期；白昼 a period of 24 hours；adv 每天；经常在白天地；adj 日间的；逐日的

es.e: We spent three days in Paris.
es.c: 我们在巴黎度过了三天。

es.e: ‘What day is it today?’ ‘Friday.’
es.c: “今天星期几？” “星期五。”

es.e: He left two days ago.
es.c: 他两天前离开的。

d: n 白天；日光；黎明；公开 the light produced by the sun during the day

es.e: The park is open to the public during daylight hours .
es.c: 公园白天对公众开放。

es.e: If possible, it’s better to work in natural daylight.
es.c: 如果条件允许的话，最好在自然日光下工作。

d: adj 无生命的；呆板的；废弃了的 a dead  planet  has no life on it；adv 完全地 completely；n 死者 people who have died

es.e: Her mother had been dead for ten years.
es.c: 她母亲去世十年了。

d: n 截止期限，最后期限 a date or time by which you have to do or complete something

es.e: I’m always working under pressure to meet deadlines (= finish something on time ) .
es.c: 我总是在赶工期的压力下工作。

d: adj 聋的 physically unable to hear anything or unable to hear well

es.e: communication between deaf and hearing people
es.c: 失聪者和听力正常者之间的交流

es.e: I think Mum’s going a bit deaf .
es.c: 我觉得妈妈有点耳聋了。

es.e: She’s deaf and dumb (= unable to hear or speak ) and communicates using sign language.
es.c: 她又聋又哑，用手语交流。

d: v 处理；给予；分配；发牌 to give playing cards to each of the players in a game；n 交易；（美）政策；待遇；份量 treatment of a particular type that is given or received

es.e: Whose turn is it to deal?
es.c: 轮到谁发牌了？

d: adj 亲爱的；尊敬的；昂贵的 used before someone’s name or title to begin a letter；adv 高价地；疼爱地；int 哎呀；n 亲爱的人 You can call someone dear as a sign of affection

es.e: Dear Sir or Madam, ...
es.c: 尊敬的先生或女士，…

es.e: Dear Mrs. Wilson, ...
es.c: 尊敬的威尔逊夫人，…

es.e: Dear Meg, ...
es.c: 亲爱的梅格，…

d: n 死；死亡；死神；毁灭 the permanent end of something

es.e: The latest bombing is the death of all our hopes.
es.c: 最近的炸弹爆炸事件使我们所有的希望都化为乌有。

es.e: These regulations could spell the death (= lead to the end ) of the American car industry.
es.c: 这些规定可能会毁掉美国的汽车工业。

d: v 辩论，争论，讨论 to discuss a subject formally when you are trying to make a decision or find a solution；n 辩论；辩论会 discussion of a particular subject that often continues for a long time and in which people express different op

es.e: The issue will be debated on Tuesday.
es.c: 这个问题将在星期二讨论。

es.e: His conclusions are hotly debated (= argued about strongly ) .
es.c: 他的结论引发了热烈的讨论。

d: n 债务；借款；罪过 a sum of money that a person or organization owes

es.e: He had enough money to pay off his outstanding debts.
es.c: 他有足够的钱偿还亏欠的债务。

es.e: students who run up huge debts
es.c: 欠下巨额债务的学生

d: n 十年，十年期；十 a period of 10 years

es.e: ...the last decade of the nineteenth century.
es.c: …19世纪的最后10年。

d: n 十二月 the 12th month of the year, between November and January

es.e: In the dark of December.
es.c: 在十二月的黑夜里。

es.e: Our summers are short and our winters long.In December, when it is darkest, we only have a few hours of very weak sunlight per day.
es.c: 我们的夏天很短但是冬天很长，在十二月，也就是最黑的时候，我们的一天中只有很短的时间可以看到微弱的阳光。

es.e: I send out Valentine’s cards with the girls’ photo, instead of trying to mail cards in December.
es.c: ——我寄出有女孩子照片的情人节贺卡，以代替试图在十二月寄出的贺卡。

d: v 决定；解决；判决 to make a choice or judgment about something, especially after considering all the possibilities or arguments

es.e: Has anything been decided yet?
es.c: 已经作出什么决定了吗？

es.e: The trainees decide among themselves what programs to take.
es.c: 受训者自行选择课程。

es.e: After a long discussion, they decided in favour of (= chose ) the older applicant.
es.c: 经过长时间的讨论，他们决定选那位较年长的求职者。

d: n 决定，决心；决议 a choice or judgment that you make after a period of discussion or thought

es.e: Do you ever wonder if you made the right decision?
es.c: 你怀疑过自己所作的决定是否正确吗？

es.e: The judges’ decision is final (= it will not be changed ) .
es.c: 法官的裁决是最终判决。

d: v 宣布，声明；断言，宣称 to state officially and publicly that a particular situation exists or that something is true

es.e: A state of emergency has been declared.
es.c: 已宣布进入紧急状态。

es.e: Mr Steel has been declared bankrupt
es.c: 斯蒂尔先生被宣布破产了。

es.e: We celebrate September 16, the day when Mexico declared independence from Spain (= officially stated that it was no longer ruled by Spain ) .
es.c: 我们在9月16日举行庆祝活动，这一天是墨西哥摆脱西班牙统治宣布独立的日子。

d: n 下降；衰退；斜面 If there is a decline in something, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or quality；v 下降；衰落；谢绝 to say no politely when someone invites you somewhere, offers you something, or wants you to do something

es.e: Official figures show a sharp decline in the number of foreign tourists.
es.c: 官方数字显示外国游客数量骤降。

d: v 装饰；布置；授勋给 to make something look more attractive by putting something pretty on it

es.e: Children’s pictures decorated the walls of the classroom.
es.c: 教室的墙上装点着儿童画。

d: n 装饰，装潢；装饰品；奖章 something pretty that you put in a place or on top of something to make it look attractive

es.e: Christmas decorations
es.c: 圣诞节装饰物

es.e: cake decorations
es.c: 蛋糕上的裱花

d: n 减少，减小；减少量 the process of becoming less, or the amount by which something becomes less；v 减少，减小 to become less or go down to a lower level, or to make something do this

es.e: In Spain and Portugal there has been a decrease in the number of young people out of work.
es.c: 在西班牙和葡萄牙，失业青年人数已经有所下降。

d: n 行动；功绩；证书；[法] 契据 something someone does, especially something that is very good or very bad；vt 立契转让

es.e: After the morning’s good deeds he deserved a rest.
es.c: 上午做了好事之后，他理应休息一下。

es.e: She tried to strangle her baby and her lover helped her finish the evil deed .
es.c: 她试图掐死自己的宝宝，她的情人帮着完成了这个罪恶的勾当。

d: n 深处；深渊；adj 深的；低沉的；深奥的 going far in from the outside or from the front edge of something；adv 深入地；深深地；迟 a long way into or below the surface of something

es.e: a deep wound
es.c: 很深的伤口

es.e: She was sitting in a deep leather chair.
es.c: 她坐在一张很深的皮椅子里。

d: adv 深刻地；浓浓地；在深处 a long way into something

es.e: Her lies hurt my father deeply.
es.c: 她的谎言深深地伤害了我父亲。

d: n 鹿 a large wild animal that can run very fast, eats grass, and has horns

es.e: The hunter wounded the deer.
es.c: 猎人打伤了鹿。

es.e: The hound found the place where the deer lodged.
es.c: 猎狗找到了那头鹿躲藏过的地方。

es.e: The lions in this area prey on deer and other wild animals.
es.c: 这个地方的狮子捕食鹿和其他野生动物。

d: v 击败，战胜；挫败；使…失败 to win a victory over someone in a war, competition, game etc；n 失败的事实；击败的行为 failure to win or succeed

es.e: They hoped to defeat the enemy at sea.
es.c: 他们希望在海上击败敌人。

d: v 辩护；防护 to use arguments to protect something or someone from criticism, or to prove that something is right

es.e: She was always defending her husband in front of their daughter.
es.c: 她在女儿面前总是为丈夫辩解。

es.e: Students should be ready to explain and defend their views.
es.c: 学生应该勇于为自己的观点进行解释和辩护。

d: n 防卫，防护；防御措施；防守；vt 谋划抵御
v 延期；耽搁 to wait until a later time to do something；n 延期；耽搁；被耽搁或推迟的时间 when someone or something has to wait, or the length of the waiting time

es.e: Don’t delay – send off for the information now.
es.c: 别犹豫——即刻去函索取信息。

es.e: He delayed his decision on whether to call an election.
es.c: 在是否宣布举行选举一事上，他推迟作出决定。

d: v 删除 to remove something that has been written down or stored in a computer

es.e: His name was deleted from the list.
es.c: 他的名字从名单上删掉了。

es.e: I deleted the file by mistake.
es.c: 我误删了这个文件。

d: adv 故意地；谨慎地；慎重地 done in a way that is intended or planned

es.e: He deliberately upset her.
es.c: 他故意惹她不开心。

d: adj 微妙的；精美的，雅致的；柔和的；易碎的；纤弱的；清淡可口的 needing to be dealt with carefully or sensitively in order to avoid problems or failure

es.e: There’s something I have to speak to you about – it’s a delicate matter .
es.c: 我有件事要跟你讲——是一件需要谨慎处理的事。

es.e: delicate negotiations
es.c: 微妙的谈判

d: adj 美味的；可口的 very pleasant to taste or smell

es.e: ‘The meal was absolutely delicious,’ she said politely.
es.c: “这顿饭味道好极了。” 她礼貌地说道。

es.e: the delicious smell of new-mown grass
es.c: 新修剪的草坪的芳香

d: n 高兴 a feeling of great pleasure and satisfaction；v 高兴 to give someone great satisfaction and enjoyment

es.e: Throughout the house, the views are a constant source of surprise and delight.
es.c: 整个房子，目之所及不停带来惊奇和欣喜。

d: adj 高兴的；欣喜的 very pleased and happy；v 使…兴高采烈；感到快乐（delight的过去分词）

es.e: Her screams of delighted laughter filled the air.
es.c: 她喜悦的尖叫声在空中荡漾。

d: v 交付；发表；递送；释放；给予（打击）；给…接生 to take goods, letters, packages etc to a particular place or person；n 投球

es.e: The morning mail has just been delivered.
es.c: 早晨的邮件刚送到。

es.e: Do you deliver on Saturdays?
es.c: 星期六你们送货吗？

es.e: I’m having some flowers delivered for her birthday.
es.c: 我在安排人给她送花祝贺生日。

d: v 要求；需要；查询 to ask for something very firmly, especially because you think you have a right to do this；n [经] 需求；要求；需要 the need or desire that people have for particular goods and services

es.e: Angry demonstrators demanded the resignation of two senior officials.
es.c: 愤怒的示威者要求两名高级官员辞职。

es.e: ‘Where are you going?’ she demanded angrily.
es.c: “你要去哪里？” 她气愤地质问道。

d: n 牙科医生 someone whose job is to treat people’s teeth

es.e: Visit your dentist twice a year for a checkup.
es.c: 每年看两次牙医做检查。

d: n 部；部门；系；科；局 one of the groups of people who work together in a particular part of a large organization such as a hospital, university, company, or government

es.e: the personnel department
es.c: 人事部

es.e: the English department
es.c: 英语系

d: n 离开；出发；违背 an act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey

es.e: There are several departures for New York every day.
es.c: 每天有好几个班次去纽约。

d: v 依赖，依靠；取决于；相信，信赖 If you depend on someone or something, you need them in order to be able to survive physically, financially, or emotionally

es.e: He depended on his writing for his income.
es.c: 他靠写作谋生。

d: n 存款；押金；订金；保证金；沉淀物 a part of the cost of something you are buying that you pay some time before you pay the rest of it；v 使沉积；存放 to put something down in a particular place

es.e: fatty deposits on the heart
es.c: 心脏上沉积的脂肪层

d: n [海洋] 深度；深奥 the part that is furthest away from people, and most difficult to reach

es.e: Astronomers may one day travel to the depths of space.
es.c: 天文学家也许有一天可以到太空深处去。

d: v 描述，形容；描绘 to say what something or someone is like by giving details about them

es.e: The police asked her to describe the man.
es.c: 警察叫她描述一下那名男子。

es.e: Another approach to the problem is described in Chapter 3.
es.c: 这个问题的另一种解决方法在第三章有所阐述。

d: n 描述，描写；类型；说明书 a piece of writing or speech that gives details about what someone or something is like

es.e: The booklet gives a brief description of each place.
es.c: 这本小册子对每一个地方都作了简短的介绍。

es.e: Berlin sounds fascinating from your description.
es.c: 从你的描述来看，柏林是个迷人的城市。

d: v 遗弃；放弃；逃跑 to leave someone or something and no longer help or support them；n 沙漠；荒原；应得的赏罚 a large area of land where it is always very dry, and there is a lot of sand；adj 沙漠的；荒凉的；不毛的

es.e: Helen was deserted by her husband.
es.c: 海伦被丈夫遗弃了。

es.e: Many of the party’s traditional voters deserted it at the last election.
es.c: 许多长期支持该党的选民在上一次选举中抛弃了它。

es.e: The price rise caused many readers to desert the magazine.
es.c: 价格上涨导致许多读者放弃了这本杂志。

d: v 应受，应得 to have earned something by good or bad actions or behaviour

es.e: What have I done to deserve this?
es.c: 我做了什么事，要得到这样的报应？

es.e: I’m sorry for the kids. They deserve better (= deserve to be treated in a better way ) .
es.c: 我为这些孩子感到难过，他们应该过得更好。

es.e: Ledley deserves a place in the team.
es.c: 莱德利应该在队里占有一席之地。

d: v 设计；计划；构思 to make a drawing or plan of something that will be made or built；n 设计；图案 the art or process of making a drawing of something to show how you will make it or what it will look like

es.e: The tower was designed by Gilbert Scott.
es.c: 这座塔楼是吉尔伯特·斯科特设计的。

d: n 欲望；要求，心愿；性欲 a strong hope or wish；v 想要；要求；希望得到… If you desire something, you want it

es.e: female sexual desire
es.c: 女性的性欲

es.e: She had remarried and desired a child with her new husband.
es.c: 她再婚了，想跟新任丈夫生一个孩子。

d: adj 不顾一切的；令人绝望的；极度渴望的 willing to do anything to change a very bad situation, and not caring about danger

es.e: I had no money left and was desperate.
es.c: 我身无分文，已经走投无路了。

es.e: Time was running out and we were getting desperate .
es.c: 时间越来越少，我们越来越感到绝望。

es.e: the missing teenager’s desperate parents
es.c: 失踪少年绝望的父母

d: n 餐后甜点；甜点心 sweet food served after the main part of a meal

es.e: She had homemade ice cream for dessert.
es.c: 她吃了些自制冰淇淋当餐后甜点。

d: n 目的地，终点 the place that someone or something is going to

es.e: Ellis Island has become one of America's most popular tourist destinations.
es.c: 埃利斯岛已经成为美国最受欢迎的游览地之一。

d: v 破坏；消灭；毁坏 to damage something so badly that it no longer exists or cannot be used or repaired

es.e: companies that are polluting and destroying the environment
es.c: 污染和破坏环境的公司

d: adj 侦探的 A detective novel or story is one in which a detective tries to solve a crime；n 侦探 a police officer whose job is to discover information about crimes and catch criminals

es.e: ...Arthur Conan Doyle's classic detective novel.
es.c: …阿瑟·柯南·道尔的经典侦探小说。

d: n 决心；果断；测定 the quality of trying to do something even when it is difficult

es.e: his dogged determination (= very strong determination ) to succeed
es.c: 他想要成功的坚定决心

d: v （使）下决心，（使）做出决定 to officially decide something

es.e: The date of the court case has not yet been determined.
es.c: 庭审日期尚未确定。

d: v 开发；进步；使成长；使显影 to grow or change into something bigger, stronger, or more advanced, or to make someone or something do this

es.e: Knowledge in the field of genetics has been developing very rapidly.
es.c: 遗传学领域的知识发展非常迅速。

es.e: Corsica has developed its economy around the tourist industry.
es.c: 科西嘉岛的经济是围绕旅游业发展起来的。

es.e: exercises to develop muscle strength
es.c: 锻炼肌肉力量的运动

d: n 发展；开发；发育；住宅小区（专指由同一开发商开发的）；[摄] 显影 the process of gradually becoming bigger, better, stronger, or more advanced

es.e: child development
es.c: 儿童发育

d: v 致力于；奉献 to use all or most of your time, effort etc in order to do something or help someone

es.e: He decided to devote the rest of his life to scientific investigation.
es.c: 他决定把余生奉献给科学研究。

d: n 献身，奉献；忠诚；热爱 the loyalty that you show towards a person, job etc, especially by working hard

es.e: At first she was flattered by his devotion.
es.c: 最初他的挚爱使她感到受宠若惊。

d: n 图表；图解 a simple drawing or plan that shows exactly where something is, what something looks like, or how something works；v 用图解法表示 to show or represent something in a diagram

es.e: On our project, we gradually decomposed each of the areas within the context diagram.
es.c: 在我们的项目中，我们逐渐地分解环境图中的每个区域。

d: n 转盘；刻度盘；钟面 the round part of a clock, watch, machine etc that has numbers that show you the time or a measurement；v 拨号 to press the buttons or turn the dial on a telephone in order to make a telephone call

es.e: The lighted dial of her watch said 1.20.
es.c: 她手表上的夜光表面显示时间为1点20分。

es.e: She looked at the dial to check her speed.
es.c: 她看了看仪表盘，以确认自己的速度。

d: n 对话；意见交换 a conversation in a book, play, or film；vi 对话；vt 用对话表达

es.e: a boring movie full of bad dialog
es.c: 充满差劲对白的乏味电影

es.e: Students were asked to read simple dialogues out loud.
es.c: 学生被要求大声朗读简单的对话。

d: n 钻石，金刚石；菱形；方块牌 a clear, very hard valuable stone, used in jewellery and in industry；adj 菱形的；金刚钻的

es.e: a diamond engagement ring
es.c: 订婚钻戒

d: n 日志，日记；日记簿 a book in which you write down the things that happen to you each day

es.e: Inge kept a diary (= wrote in a diary ) during the war years.
es.c: 英奇在战争年代里一直写日记。

d: n 听写；口述；命令 when you say words for someone to write down

es.e: There were no secretaries available to take dictation (= write down what someone is saying ) .
es.c: 身边没有秘书记录口授内容。

d: n 字典；词典 a book that gives a list of words in alphabetical order and explains their meanings in the same language, or another language

es.e: a German-English dictionary
es.c: 一本德英词典

d: v 死亡；凋零；熄灭 to stop living and become dead；n 冲模，钢模；骰子 a  dice

es.e: He died in 1985 at the age of 76.
es.c: 他1985年去世，终年76岁。

es.e: Her father died suddenly in an accident when she was only ten.
es.c: 她年仅10岁时父亲突然死于一场意外事故。

es.e: She died peacefully in her sleep at the age of 98.
es.c: 她在睡眠中安然辞世，享年98岁。

d: n 饮食；食物；规定饮食 a way of eating in which you only eat certain foods, in order to lose weight, or to improve your health；v 节食 to limit the amount and type of food that you eat, in order to become thinner

es.e: Lyn always seems to be on a diet.
es.c: 琳恩似乎一直在节食。

es.e: a salt-free diet
es.c: 无盐饮食

es.e: Not all diets are good for you.
es.c: 不是所有的节食方法都适合你。

d: v 使…相异；使…不同 If two or more things differ, they are unlike each other in some way；n (Differ)人名；(法)迪费

es.e: The story he told police differed from the one he told his mother.
es.c: 他告诉警察的话和告诉他母亲的不同。

d: n 差异；不同；争执 a way in which two or more people or things are not like each other

es.e: (= there’s a very big difference ) between us.
es.c: 我们之间有着天壤之别。

d: adj 不同的；个别的，与众不同的 not like something or someone else, or not like before

es.e: The place looks completely different now.
es.c: 这地方现在完全变了。

es.e: They decided to try a radically different approach.
es.c: 他们决定尝试一种全然不同的办法。

es.e: We found women had significantly different political views from men.
es.c: 我们发现女性的政治观点与男性大不相同。

d: adj 困难的；不随和的；执拗的 hard to do, understand, or deal with

es.e: a difficult question
es.c: 难解的问题

es.e: an immensely difficult task
es.c: 极为艰巨的任务

es.e: Was the exam very difficult?
es.c: 这次考试很难吗？

d: n 困难，困境 if you have difficulty doing something, it is difficult for you to do

es.e: If you have any difficulties, give me a call.
es.c: 如果你遇到困难，就给我打电话。

d: v 挖，掘；探究 to move earth, snow etc, or to make a hole in the ground, using a  spade  or your hands；n 戳，刺；挖苦 a joke or remark that you make to annoy or criticize someone

es.e: freshly dug carrots
es.c: 刚挖出来的胡萝卜

d: v 消化；吸收；融会贯通 to change food that you have just eaten into substances that your body can use；n 文摘；摘要 a short piece of writing that gives the most important facts from a book, report etc

es.e: Most babies can digest a wide range of food easily.
es.c: 大多数婴儿能轻易地消化很多种食物。

d: adj 数字的；手指的 using a system in which information is recorded or sent out electronically in the form of numbers, usually ones and zeros；n 数字；键

es.e: digital TV
es.c: 数字电视

es.e: a digital signal
es.c: 数字信号

es.e: a digital camera
es.c: 数码照相机

d: n 尊严；高贵 the ability to behave in a calm controlled way even in a difficult situation

es.e: an appearance of quiet dignity
es.c: 肃穆的神态

d: n 困境；进退两难；两刀论法 a situation in which it is very difficult to decide what to do, because all the choices seem equally good or equally bad

es.e: a moral dilemma
es.c: 道德上进退两难的窘境

es.e: This placed Robert Kennedy in a dilemma.
es.c: 这让罗伯特·肯尼迪陷入了两难的境地。

es.e: Many women are faced with the dilemma of choosing between work and family commitments.
es.c: 许多女性面临着出去工作还是照顾家庭的两难境地。

d: n 方面;[数] 维；尺寸；次元；容积 vt标出尺寸 a part of a situation or a quality involved in it；adj 规格的

es.e: You can have a spiritual dimension to your life without being religious.
es.c: 即使你不信宗教，也可以在生命中拥有精神层面的内容。

d: v 进餐，用餐 to eat dinner；n (Dine)人名；(意、葡)迪内；(英)戴恩；(法)迪纳

es.e: He was dining with friends at the Ritz.
es.c: 他和朋友在里茨饭店一起进餐。

d: n 晚餐，晚宴；宴会；正餐 the main meal of the day, eaten in the middle of the day or the evening

es.e: What time do you usually have dinner?
es.c: 你通常什么时候吃饭？

es.e: We’re having fish for dinner tonight.
es.c: 我们今天晚饭吃鱼。

es.e: What’s for dinner?
es.c: 晚饭吃什么？

d: n 恐龙；过时、落伍的人或事物 one of a group of  reptile s  that lived millions of years ago

es.e: lengthy speeches by some of the party’s dinosaurs
es.c: 该政党那些老古董冗长的发言

d: n 二氧化物 a chemical  compound  that contains two atoms of oxygen and one atom of another chemical  element

es.e: How much carbon dioxide you save, if any, depends on how far you live from work and how you get there, among other things.
es.c: 如果真有的话，你可以节约多少二氧化碳？ 它取决于你住得有多远还是你如何完成目标抑或其他因素？

es.e: Studying the light in each image could also reveal physical characteristics, such as the presence of water or carbon dioxide.
es.c: 研究每个行星图像中的光线同样可以揭示物理特性，如是否存在水或二氧化碳。

es.e: And then we have gas cooled reactors which can use supercritical carbon dioxide or helium.
es.c: 然后我们有气体冷却反应堆,那能使用超临界二氧化碳或者氦。

d: v 浸，泡，蘸；舀取；把伸入 to put something into a liquid and lift it out again；n 下沉，下降；倾斜；浸渍，蘸湿 a slight decrease in the amount of something

es.e: Dip each apple in the syrup until thickly coated.
es.c: 把每个苹果在糖浆里蘸一下，直到被厚厚地裹上糖浆。

d: n 毕业证书，学位证书；公文，文书；奖状 a document showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study or passed an examination；vt 发给…毕业文凭

es.e: I’m hoping to get my teaching diploma this year.
es.c: 我希望今年能拿到教师证书。

d: adj 直接的；直系的；亲身的；恰好的 done without any other people, actions, processes etc coming between；v 管理；指挥；导演；指向 to be in charge of something or control it；adv 直接地；正好；按直系关系 Direct is also an adverb

es.e: Experienced users have direct access to the main data files.
es.c: 高级用户可直接浏览主数据文档。

es.e: I’m not in direct contact with them.
es.c: 我和他们没有直接的联系。

es.e: Few policy-makers have had direct experience of business.
es.c: 决策者几乎都没有直接的从商经历。

d: n 主任，主管；导演；人事助理 someone who is in charge of a particular activity or organization

es.e: The company is run by a board of directors (= a group of directors ) .
es.c: 这家公司由董事会管理。

d: n [计] 目录；工商名录；姓名地址录 a book or list of names, facts etc, usually arranged in alphabetical order；adj 指导的；咨询的

es.e: I couldn’t find your number in the telephone directory.
es.c: 我在电话簿上找不到你的电话号码。

es.e: a new business directory
es.c: 新的商业名录

d: n 污垢，泥土；灰尘，尘土；下流话 any substance that makes things dirty, such as mud or dust

es.e: You should have seen the dirt on that car!
es.c: 你没看见那车上沾了多少泥！

es.e: His face and hands were black with dirt.
es.c: 他的脸和手黑乎乎的，全是泥。

es.e: a patch of grass, covered in dog dirt
es.c: 满是狗屎的一小片草地

d: adj 下流的，卑鄙的；肮脏的；恶劣的；暗淡的 covered in or marked by an unwanted substance；v 弄脏 To dirty something means to cause it to become dirty

es.e: a stack of dirty dishes in the sink
es.c: 洗涤槽里的一堆脏碟子

es.e: How did you get so dirty?
es.c: 你怎么会弄得这么脏？

es.e: He was afraid the dog's hairs might dirty the seats.
es.c: 他担心狗毛会把座椅弄脏。

d: n 残疾；无能；无资格；不利条件 A disability is a permanent injury, illness, or physical or mental condition that tends to restrict the way that someone can live their life

es.e: Facilities for people with disabilities are still insufficient.
es.c: 供残疾人使用的设施仍然不足。

d: adj 残废的，有缺陷的 someone who is disabled cannot use a part of their body properly, or cannot learn easily；v 使…失去能力（disable的过去分词）

es.e: a support group for parents of disabled children
es.c: 帮助残障儿童父母的援助团

es.e: a severely disabled polio patient
es.c: 严重残疾的小儿麻痺症病人

es.e: teachers who work with learning disabled children (= children who have problems learning )
es.c: 教有学习障碍的儿童的教师

d: n 缺点；不利条件；损失 something that causes problems, or that makes someone or something less likely to be successful or effective

es.e: Criminal behaviour can be linked to economic disadvantage.
es.c: 犯罪行为可能会与经济困难有关。

d: v 不同意；不一致；争执；不适宜 to have or express a different opinion from someone else

es.e: Barr strongly disagreed with Kronfeld’s statement.
es.c: 巴尔强烈反对克龙费尔德的说法。

d: n 不一致；争论；意见不同 a situation in which people express different opinions about something and sometimes argue

es.e: We’ve had a few disagreements , but we’re still good friends.
es.c: 虽然有过一些分歧，但我们仍是好朋友。

d: v 消失；失踪；不复存在 to become impossible to see any longer

es.e: At this point the path seemed to disappear altogether (= disappear completely ) .
es.c: 小路到这里好像完全消失了。

d: v 使失望 to make someone feel unhappy because something they hoped for did not happen or was not as good as they expected

es.e: I hated to disappoint her.
es.c: 我不愿意让她失望。

es.e: Great things were expected of this band, and they didn’t disappoint.
es.c: 大家对这支乐队的期望很高，而他们也不负众望。

d: n 失望；沮丧 a feeling of unhappiness because something is not as good as you expected, or has not happened in the way you hoped

es.e: He could see the disappointment in her eyes.
es.c: 他看到了她眼中的失望。

es.e: Several people expressed disappointment at the delay.
es.c: 有好几个人对这次延误表示失望。

es.e: She hid her bitter disappointment .
es.c: 她把深深的沮丧掩饰起来。

d: n 灾难，灾祸；不幸 a sudden event such as a flood, storm, or accident which causes great damage or suffering

es.e: One hundred and twenty people died in China’s worst air disaster .
es.c: 有120人在中国这起最惨烈的空难事故中丧生。

es.e: the economic consequences of the Chernobyl nuclear disaster
es.c: 切尔诺贝利核灾难给经济带来的后果

es.e: The 1987 hurricane was the worst natural disaster to hit England for decades.
es.c: 1987年的飓风是英格兰数十年来遭遇的最为严重的自然灾害。

d: n 折扣；贴现率 a reduction in the usual price of something；v 贴现；打折扣出售商品 to reduce the price of something

es.e: They are often available at a discount.
es.c: 它们经常可以以折扣价买到。

d: v 阻止；使气馁 to make something less likely to happen

es.e: Aspirin may discourage tumour growth in some types of cancer.
es.c: 阿司匹林可能遏制某些恶性肿瘤的生长。

d: v 发现；发觉 to find someone or something, either by accident or because you were looking for them

es.e: The body was discovered in a field.
es.c: 尸体是在一块田地里找到的。

es.e: Forest Service crews often discover campfires that have not been put out completely.
es.c: 林务局工作人员常常发现未完全熄灭的营火。

d: n 发现，发觉；被发现的事物 a fact or thing that someone finds out about, when it was not known about before

es.e: I felt I'd made an incredible discovery.
es.c: 我感到自己有了一个惊人的发现。

d: n 歧视；区别，辨别；识别力 the practice of treating one person or group differently from another in an unfair way

es.e: laws to prevent discrimination
es.c: 防止歧视的法律

d: v 讨论；论述，辩论 to talk about something with another person or a group in order to exchange ideas or decide something

es.e: Littman refused to discuss the case publicly.
es.c: 利特曼拒绝公开讨论此案。

es.e: If you would like to discuss the matter further, please call me.
es.c: 如果你想进一步讨论此事，请打电话给我。

d: n 讨论，议论 when you discuss something

es.e: class discussions
es.c: 课堂讨论

es.e: the topics suggested for discussion
es.c: 建议讨论的话题

es.e: We have had discussions about her legal situation.
es.c: 我们就她的法律状况已进行了讨论。

d: n 病，[医] 疾病；弊病 an illness which affects a person, animal, or plant；vt 传染；使…有病

es.e: His father died of heart disease.
es.c: 他父亲死于心脏病。

es.e: She contracted the disease while she was abroad on holiday.
es.c: 她在国外度假时染上了这种疾病。

d: adj 令人厌恶的 extremely unpleasant and making you feel sick

es.e: Rubbish was piled everywhere – it was disgusting.
es.c: 垃圾堆得到处都是，很恶心。

es.e: Smoking is a really disgusting habit.
es.c: 吸烟是一种十分令人讨厌的习惯。

d: n 盘；餐具；一盘食物；外貌有吸引力的人 a flat container with low sides, for serving food from or cooking food in；v 盛于碟盘中；分发；使某人的希望破灭；说（某人）的闲话 to give a lot of information about something or someone, especially something that would usually

es.e: a serving dish
es.c: 上菜用的盘子

es.e: an ovenproof dish
es.c: 耐热盘

d: n [计] 磁盘，磁碟片；圆盘，盘状物；唱片 a small flat piece of plastic or metal which is used for storing computer or electronic information

es.e: The food processor has thin, medium, and thick slicing discs.
es.c: 这个食品加工机有薄、中、厚的切片盘。

d: v 不喜欢，厌恶 to think someone or something is unpleasant and not like them；n 嫌恶，反感，不喜爱 Dislike is the feeling that you do not like someone or something

es.e: Why do you dislike her so much?
es.c: 你为什么那么讨厌她？

es.e: My dislike of thunder and even small earthquakes was due to Mother.
es.c: 我对雷声甚至于轻微地震的厌恶都归因于我的母亲。

d: v 解散；解雇；开除；让离开；不予理会、不予考虑 to remove someone from their job

es.e: The government has dismissed criticisms that the country’s health policy is a mess.
es.c: 有人认为国家医疗政策一塌糊涂，政府对这种批评持否认态度。

d: v 违反；不服从 to refuse to do what someone with authority tells you to do, or refuse to obey a rule or law

es.e: You disobeyed my orders.
es.c: 你违抗我的命令。

d: n 距离；远方；疏远；间隔 the amount of space between two places or things；v 疏远；把…远远甩在后面 If you distance yourself from a person or thing, or if something distances you from them, you feel less friendly or positive toward them, or be

es.e: Measure the distance between the two points.
es.c: 量出两点之间的距离。

es.e: The cottage is some distance (= quite a long distance ) from the road.
es.c: 小屋离开大路有些距离。

es.e: The author distanced himself from some of the comments in his book.
es.c: 作者在他的书里对某些评论淡然处之。

d: adj 遥远的；冷漠的；远隔的；不友好的，冷淡的 far away in space or time

es.e: the sound of distant gunfire
es.c: 远处的炮火声

es.e: Her honeymoon seemed a distant memory .
es.c: 她的蜜月似乎成了遥远的记忆。

es.e: That affair was in the dim and distant past (= a long time ago ) .
es.c: 那件事已成为遥远的过去了。

d: n 区别；差别；特性；荣誉、勋章 a clear difference or separation between two similar things

es.e: There are obvious distinctions between the two wine-making areas.
es.c: 这两个酿酒区之间有明显的不同。

d: v 区分；辨别；使杰出，使表现突出 to recognize and understand the difference between two or more things or people

es.e: The light was too dim for me to distinguish anything clearly.
es.c: 光线太暗，我什么也看不清。

d: v 分配；散布；分开；把…分类 to share things among a group of people, especially in a planned way

es.e: a man distributing leaflets to passers-by
es.c: 一个向路人派发传单的男子

d: n 区域；地方；行政区 an area of a town or the countryside, especially one with particular features

es.e: a postal district
es.c: 邮政区

d: v 打扰；妨碍；使不安；弄乱；使恼怒 to interrupt someone so that they cannot continue what they are doing

es.e: Sorry to disturb you, but I have an urgent message.
es.c: 对不起打扰一下，我有个紧急消息。

es.e: The thieves fled when they were disturbed by a neighbour.
es.c: 窃贼们被一名邻居惊动后逃跑了。

es.e: (= a sign you put on a door so that people will not interrupt you ) .
es.c: 请勿打扰。

d: adj 令人不安的；烦扰的 worrying or upsetting；v 干扰；打断（disturb的ing形式）

es.e: a disturbing increase in the crime rate
es.c: 令人不安的犯罪率增幅

d: v 潜水；跳水；俯冲；急剧下降 to jump into deep water with your head and arms going in first；n 潜水；跳水；俯冲；扑 a sudden movement in a particular direction or into a particular place

es.e: Diving off the cliffs is dangerous.
es.c: 从悬崖上跳水是很危险的。

d: adj 不同的；多种多样的；变化多的 If a group of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things

es.e: The building houses a wide and diverse variety of antiques.
es.c: 这栋楼里摆放着大量各式各样的古董。

d: v 划分；除；分开；使产生分歧 if something divides, or if you divide it, it separates into two or more parts；n [地理] 分水岭，分水线 a line of high ground between two river systems

es.e: The physical benefits of exercise can be divided into three factors.
es.c: 锻炼对身体的好处可以分成3个方面。

d: n [数] 除法；部门；分配；分割；师（军队）；赛区 the act of separating something into two or more different parts, or the way these parts are separated or shared

es.e: the traditional division of labour (= the way that particular tasks are shared ) between husband and wife
es.c: 夫妻之间传统的分工

d: adj 晕眩的；使人头晕的；昏乱的；心不在焉的；愚蠢的 feeling unable to stand steadily, for example because you are looking down from a high place or because you are ill；v 使头晕眼花；使混乱；使茫然；n (Dizzy)人名；(英)迪齐

es.e: The heat and the champagne made him feel dizzy .
es.c: 高温和香槟酒使他感到眩晕。

es.e: She started to suffer from dizzy spells (= a short period when you feel dizzy ) .
es.c: 她开始感到一阵阵的眩晕。

d: v 修理；篡改，伪造；为…治病；授以博士学位 to dishonestly change something in order to gain an advantage；n 医生；博士 someone who is trained to treat people who are ill

es.e: He had doctored his passport to pass her off as his daughter.
es.c: 他窜改了护照，谎称她是他的女儿。

es.e: There are concerns that some players have been doctoring the ball.
es.c: 有人担心说一些选手在球上做手脚。

d: n 文件，公文；[计] 文档；证件 a piece of paper that has official information on it；v 用文件证明

es.e: She produces legal documents for a downtown Seattle law firm.
es.c: 她为西雅图市区的一家法律事务所撰写法律文件。

d: n 狗；丑女人；卑鄙的人；(俚)朋友 a common animal with four legs, fur, and a tail. Dogs are kept as pets or trained to guard places, find drugs etc.；v 跟踪；尾随 to follow close behind someone

es.e: I could hear a dog barking .
es.c: 我听到了狗吠声。

es.e: He’s taken the dog for a walk .
es.c: 他去遛狗了。

es.e: We used to have a dog when I was young.
es.c: 我小时候我们养过狗。

d: n 洋娃娃；玩偶；无头脑的美丽女人 a child’s toy that looks like a small person or baby；v 把…打扮得花枝招展

es.e: a small wooden doll
es.c: 一个小木玩偶

d: n 美元 the standard unit of money in the US, Canada, Australia, and some other countries, divided into 100  cent s  : symbol $

es.e: It cost three dollars.
es.c: 它要三美元。

es.e: a ten-dollar bill
es.c: 一张十元钞票

es.e: You can pay in dollars or euros at the airport.
es.c: 在机场你可以使用美元或欧元。

d: n 门；家，户；门口；通道 the large flat piece of wood, glass etc that you move when you go into or out of a building, room, vehicle etc, or when you open a cupboard

es.e: Could you open the door for me?
es.c: 请你帮我开门好吗？

es.e: The door flew open and Ruth stormed in.
es.c: 门一下子打开了，露丝气冲冲地跑了进来。

es.e: Don’t forget to lock the garage door.
es.c: 别忘了把车库的门锁上。

d: n 宿舍，学生宿舍 a large building at a college or university where students live；adj 住宅区的

es.e: She lived in a college dormitory.
es.c: 她住在一幢大学宿舍楼里。

d: n 点，圆点；嫁妆 a small round mark or spot；v 打上点

es.e: a pattern of dots
es.c: 圆点图案

d: n 两倍；双精度型 something that is twice as big, as much etc as usual or as something else；adj 双重的；两倍的 consisting of two parts that are similar or exactly the same；v 加倍，加倍努力；快步走 to become twice as big or twice as much, or to ma

es.e: Scotch and water, please – make it a double.
es.c: 请来苏格兰威士忌加水——要双份的。

es.e: ‘They offered me £10,000.’ ‘I’ll give you double.’
es.c: “他们向我开价1万英镑。” “我给你加倍。”

d: n 怀疑；疑问；疑惑 a feeling of being not sure whether something is true or right；v 怀疑；不信；恐怕；拿不准 to think that something may not be true or that it is unlikely

es.e: There was still one little nagging doubt at the back of his mind.
es.c: 他的心头仍有一丝挥之不去的疑虑。

d: adv 向下，下去；在下面 to or towards a lower place or position；adj 向下的；n 软毛，绒毛；[地质] 开阔的高地 soft hair like a baby’s；prep 沿着，往下

es.e: David bent down to tie his shoelace.
es.c: 戴维弯腰系鞋带。

es.e: Get down off the table.
es.c: 从桌子上下来。

es.e: Tears were streaming down my face.
es.c: 我泪流满面。

d: v [计] 下载 to move information or programs from a computer network to a small computer

es.e: games that can be downloaded free from the Internet
es.c: 可以从因特网上免费下载的游戏

d: adv 在楼下 towards or on a lower floor of a building, especially a house；adj 楼下的 Downstairs means situated on the ground floor of a building or on a lower floor than you are；n 楼下 the rooms on the ground floor in a house

es.e: Rosie ran downstairs to answer the door.
es.c: 罗茜跑下楼去开门。

es.e: Charles was downstairs in the kitchen.
es.c: 查尔斯在楼下厨房里。

es.e: She repainted the downstairs rooms and closed off the second floor.
es.c: 她重新粉刷了楼下的房间，并把二楼封上了。

d: adv 往闹市区；在市区 Downtown is also an adverb；adj 市中心的 Downtown places are in or toward the centre of a large town or city, where the stores and places of business are；n 市中心区；三分线以外 Downtown is also a noun

es.e: By day he worked downtown for American Standard.
es.c: 白天，他在市中心为美国标准公司工作。

es.e: ...an office in downtown Chicago.
es.c: …芝加哥市中心的一间办公室。

es.e: ...in a large vacant area of the downtown.
es.c: …在市中心的一大块空地上。

d: adj 向下的，下降的 moving or pointing towards a lower position；adv 向下 If you move or look downward, you move or look toward the ground or a lower level

es.e: a gentle downward slope
es.c: 缓坡

es.e: Benedict pointed downward again with his stick.
es.c: 贝内迪克特又用他的拐杖向下指了指。

d: n 十二个，一打 twelve；adj 一打的

es.e: a dozen eggs
es.c: 一打鸡蛋

es.e: Chris, Helen, and half a dozen others went on holiday together.
es.c: 克里斯、海伦和其他六个人一起去度假了。

es.e: (= about 12 ) cars were parked near the entrance.
es.c: 入口附近停了大约十二辆汽车。

d: abbr 速度三角形定位法（dead reckoning）；数据记录器（Data Recorder）

n 汇票；草稿；选派；（尤指房间、烟囱、炉子等供暖系统中的）（小股）气流 a piece of writing or a plan that is not yet in its finished form；v 起草；制定；征募 to write a plan, letter, report etc that will need to be changed before it is in its finished form；adj 初步画

es.e: the rough draft of his new novel
es.c: 他的新小说的草稿

es.e: I read the first draft and thought it was very good.
es.c: 我读了第一稿，觉得非常好。

es.e: All parties eventually approved the final draft (= finished form ) of the peace treaty.
es.c: 各方最后都同意了和平条约的终稿。

d: v 拖累；拖拉；缓慢而吃力地行进 to pull something along the ground, often because it is too heavy to carry；n 拖；拖累

es.e: He grabbed her arm and dragged her into the room.
es.c: 他抓住她的手臂把她拖进房间。

d: v 画；拉；吸引 to produce a picture of something using a pencil, pen etc；n 平局；抽签 the final result of a game or competition in which both teams or players have the same number of points

es.e: Katie had drawn a cottage with a little stream running next to it.
es.c: 凯蒂画了一间小茅舍，旁边流淌着一条小溪。

es.e: She asked the little girl to draw a picture of the man she’d spoken to.
es.c: 她让小女孩把刚才和她说话的那个男人画出来。

es.e: Keith was drawing a complicated-looking graph.
es.c: 基思在画一张看上去很复杂的图表。

d: n 缺点，不利条件；退税 a disadvantage of a situation, plan, product etc

es.e: It’s a great city – the only drawback is the weather.
es.c: 这是座很不错的城市，唯一的不足就是天气。

d: n 抽屉；开票人；出票人；起草者；酒馆侍 part of a piece of furniture, such as a desk, that you pull out and push in and use to keep things in

es.e: She took a file from her desk drawer .
es.c: 她从书桌的抽屉里拿出了一个文件夹。

es.e: The scissors are in the kitchen drawer (= drawer in a piece of kitchen furniture ) .
es.c: 剪刀在厨房的抽屉里。

d: n 图画；牵引；素描术 a picture that you draw with a pencil, pen etc；v 绘画；吸引（draw的ing形式）；拖曳

es.e: I’ve never been very good at drawing.
es.c: 我向来不擅长画图。

d: v 梦想；做梦，梦见；想到 to think about something that you would like to happen or have；n 梦想，愿望；梦 a series of thoughts, images, and feelings that you experience when you are asleep；adj 梦的；理想的；不切实际的 You can use dream to describe som

es.e: She had been dreaming and had not followed the conversation.
es.c: 她一直在走神，没注意听谈话。

es.e: ...a dream holiday to Jamaica.
es.c: …一个去牙买加的理想假期。

d: v 给…穿衣 to put clothes on yourself or someone else；n 连衣裙；女装 a piece of clothing worn by a woman or girl that covers the top of her body and part or all of her legs

es.e: Can you wait a minute? I’m just getting dressed .
es.c: 稍等一会儿，我穿下衣服就好。

es.e: She dressed quickly and went out of the house.
es.c: 她很快穿好衣服，走到房子外面。

es.e: I usually have to dress the kids in the mornings.
es.c: 早上我通常得给孩子们穿衣服。

d: n 干燥机；干燥剂；吹风机
n 训练；钻孔机；钻子；播种机 a tool or machine used for making holes in something；v 钻孔；训练 to train soldiers to march or perform other military actions

es.e: an electric drill
es.c: 电钻

es.e: a whine like a dentist’s drill
es.c: 像牙钻发出的那种呜呜声

d: v 喝，饮；吸收；举杯庆贺 to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it；n 酒，饮料；喝酒 an amount of liquid that you drink, or the act of drinking something

es.e: You should drink plenty of water.
es.c: 你应该大量喝水。

es.e: What would you like to drink?
es.c: 你想喝点什么？

es.e: Take a seat while I get you something to drink .
es.c: 请坐，我去给你倒杯喝的。

d: v 开车；猛击；飞跑 to make a car, truck, bus etc move along；n 驱动器；驾车；[心理] 内驱力，推进力；快车道 a journey in a car

es.e: the man driving the car
es.c: 开车的男子

es.e: Can you drive?
es.c: 你会开车吗？

es.e: So when did you learn to drive ?
es.c: 那么你是什么时候学会开车的？

d: n 驾驶员；驱动程序；起子；传动器 someone who drives a car, bus etc

es.e: a taxi driver
es.c: 出租车司机

es.e: Do you think you’re a good driver?
es.c: 你认为自己是个好司机吗？

d: v 滴；使降低；使终止；随口漏出；n 滴；落下；空投；微量；滴剂 a very small amount of liquid that falls in a round shape

es.e: Temperatures can drop to freezing at night.
es.c: 晚上气温能陡降到零度以下。

d: v 淹没；把…淹死 to die from being under water for too long, or to kill someone in this way；n (Drown)人名；(英)德朗

es.e: Many people drowned when the boat overturned.
es.c: 船翻后许多人淹死了。

es.e: Jane was drowned in the river.
es.c: 简在那条河里溺水身亡。

d: n 药；毒品；麻醉药；滞销货 an illegal substance such as  marijuana  or  cocaine  , which some people take in order to feel happy, relaxed, or excited；v 使服麻醉药；使服毒品；掺麻醉药于 to give a person or animal a drug, especially in order to make

es.e: A lot of young people start taking drugs at school.
es.c: 许多年轻人上学时开始吸毒。

es.e: She always looks as though she’s on drugs (= taking drugs ) .
es.c: 她总是看上去一副吸过毒的样子。

es.e: Jimi Hendrix died of a drug overdose.
es.c: 吉米·亨德里克斯死于吸毒过量。

d: v 击鼓；大力争取 to play a drum；n 鼓；鼓声 a musical instrument made of skin stretched over a circular frame, played by hitting it with your hand or a stick

es.e: I could hear the rain drumming against the windows.
es.c: 我听到雨滴有节奏地打在窗上的声音。

d: v 喝酒（drink的过去分词）；adj 喝醉了的 unable to control your behaviour, speech etc because you have drunk too much alcohol

es.e: He must be either mad or drunk.
es.c: 他要么是疯了，要么是喝醉了。

es.e: Last night I got drunk and rolfed my dinner.
es.c: 昨天晚上我喝醉了，把晚饭全吐出来了。

d: adj 干的；口渴的；枯燥无味的；禁酒的 without water or liquid inside or on the surface；v 把…弄干 to make something dry, or to become dry；n 干涸

es.e: I need to change into some dry clothes .
es.c: 我要换上干衣服。

es.e: Make sure that the surface is clean and dry before you start to paint.
es.c: 油漆之前一定先要确保表面清洁干燥。

es.e: You should store disks in a cool, dry place.
es.c: 你应该把磁盘存放在阴凉干燥的地方。

d: n 鸭子；鸭肉；（英）宝贝儿；零分 a very common water bird with short legs and a wide beak, used for its meat, eggs, and soft feathers；v 闪避；没入水中 to push someone under water for a short time as a joke

es.e: roast duck with orange sauce
es.c: 烤鸭配橘子酱

d: adj 到期的；预期的；应付的；应得的 expected to happen or arrive at a particular time；n 应付款；应得之物；adv 正（置于方位词前） directly to the north, south, east, or west

es.e: Any money due you will be sent by cheque through the post.
es.c: 应该支付给你的款项将会以支票邮寄给你。

d: adj 钝的；迟钝的；无趣的；呆滞的；阴暗的 not interesting or exciting；v 使迟钝；使阴暗；缓和 to make something become less sharp or clear；n (Dull)人名；(罗、匈)杜尔；(柬)杜；(英)达尔

es.e: Life is never dull when Elizabeth is here.
es.c: 有伊丽莎白在这里生活绝不会无聊。

es.e: a dull movie
es.c: 一部沉闷的电影

es.e: It sounded pretty dull to me.
es.c: 在我听来，这很无聊。

d: n 饺子，汤团；面团布丁 a round lump of flour and fat mixed with water, cooked in boiling liquid and served with meat

es.e: chicken and dumplings
es.c: 鸡肉和汤团

d: prep 在…的时候，在…的期间 from the beginning to the end of a period of time；n (During)人名；(法)迪兰；(瑞典、利比)杜林

es.e: During the summer she worked as a lifeguard.
es.c: 夏天她当过救生员。

es.e: He slept calmly during the early part of the night.
es.c: 他上半夜睡得很安稳。

es.e: Foxes remain hidden during the day.
es.c: 狐狸白天一直躲藏着。

d: n 黄昏，薄暮；幽暗，昏暗 the time before it gets dark when the sky is becoming less bright；adj 微暗的；v 使变微暗

es.e: The street lights go on at dusk.
es.c: 街灯在黄昏时亮起来。

d: n 灰尘；尘埃；尘土 dry powder consisting of extremely small bits of dirt that is in buildings on furniture, floors etc if they are not kept clean；v 撒；拂去灰尘 to clean the dust from a surface by moving something such as a soft cloth

es.e: All the furniture was covered in dust .
es.c: 所有的家具都蒙上了灰尘。

es.e: a thick layer of dust
es.c: 厚厚的一层灰尘

es.e: There’s not a speck of dust in the kitchen.
es.c: 厨房里一尘不染。

d: n 垃圾箱；吃货 a large container outside your house, used for holding waste until it is taken away

es.e: A bomb planted in a dustbin exploded early today.
es.c: 一枚安置在一个垃圾桶内的炸弹今天清早爆炸了。

d: adj 落满灰尘的 covered with dust

es.e: Adrian cycled along the dusty road.
es.c: 阿德里安沿着满是尘土的路骑自行车。

es.e: Everything’s really dusty.
es.c: 所有东西都布满灰尘。

d: n 责任；[税收] 关税；职务 something that you have to do because it is morally or legally right

es.e: I promise I will do my duty .
es.c: 我保证会尽到我的责任。

es.e: We feel it is our duty to help her.
es.c: 我们感到帮助她是我们的责任。

es.e: Local authorities have a duty to keep the streets clean.
es.c: 地方当局有责任保持街道整洁。

d: abbr 数字化视频光盘（Digital Video Disk）

adj 动态的；动力的；动力学的；有活力的 If you describe someone as dynamic, you approve of them because they are full of energy or full of new and exciting ideas；n 动态；动力 The dynamic of a system or process is the force that causes it to ch

es.e: He seemed a dynamic and energetic leader.
es.c: 他看来是个富有创新力与活力的领导。

es.e: The dynamic of the market demands constant change and adjustment.
es.c: 市场的动力要求有不断的变化和调整。

d: n 王朝，朝代 A dynasty is a series of rulers of a country who all belong to the same family

es.e: The Seljuk dynasty of Syria was founded in 1094.
es.c: 叙利亚的塞尔柱王朝建立于1094年。

d: adj 每；各自的；adv 每个；各自 Each is also an adverb；pron 每个；各自

es.e: They reviewed each aspect of the plan bit by bit.
es.c: 他们对计划的各个方面逐一地进行了审核。

es.e: The children were given one each, handed to them or placed on their plates.
es.c: 孩子们每人给一个，递给他们或者放在他们的盘子里。

d: adj 渴望的；热切的；热心的 very keen and excited about something that is going to happen or about something you want to do；n (Eager)人名；(英)伊格

es.e: He’s a bright kid and eager to learn.
es.c: 他是个聪明的孩子，热爱学习。

es.e: She’s a very hard worker and very eager to please.
es.c: 她工作很卖力，而且很希望别人满意。

es.e: A crowd of eager young students were already waiting outside.
es.c: 一群急不可待的青年学生已经在外面等着。

d: n 鹰；鹰状标饰 a very large strong bird with a beak like a hook that eats small animals, birds etc
n 耳朵；穗；听觉；倾听 one of the organs on either side of your head that you hear with；vi （美俚）听见；抽穗

es.e: She tucked her hair behind her ears.
es.c: 她把头发拢到耳朵背后。

d: adj 早期的；早熟的 in the first part of a period of time, event, or process；adv 提早；在初期 before the usual, arranged, or expected time；n (Early)人名；(英)厄尔利

es.e: the early morning sunshine
es.c: 清晨的阳光

es.e: an afternoon in early spring
es.c: 一个早春的午后

es.e: In the early days, the railways mainly carried goods.
es.c: 最初，铁路主要用于运输货物。

d: v 赚，赚得；获得，挣得；使得到；博得 to receive a particular amount of money for the work that you do；n (Earn)人名；(泰)炎

es.e: He earns nearly £20,000 a year.
es.c: 他每年挣近20,000英镑。

es.e: You don’t earn much money being a nurse.
es.c: 当护士挣钱并不多。

es.e: He did all sorts of jobs to earn a living.
es.c: 他为谋生什么活都干。

d: n 地球；地表，陆地；土地，土壤；尘事，俗事；兽穴 the planet that we live on；v 把（电线）[电] 接地；盖（土）；追赶入洞穴 to make electrical equipment safe by connecting it to the ground with a wire

es.e: the planet Earth
es.c: 地球

d: n 地震；大动荡 a sudden shaking of the earth’s surface that often causes a lot of damage

es.e: An earthquake measuring 6.1 on the Richter scale struck southern California on June 28.
es.c: 6月28日加州南部地区发生了里氏6.1级地震。

es.e: The city is in an earthquake zone.
es.c: 该市位于地震带。

d: v 减轻，缓和；使安心 if something unpleasant eases, or if you ease it, it gradually improves or becomes less；n 轻松，舒适；安逸，悠闲 Ease is the state of being very comfortable and able to live as you want, without any worries or problems

es.e: measures to ease congestion in the city
es.c: 改善城市拥堵状况的措施

es.e: Her breathing had eased.
es.c: 她的呼吸平缓下来。

es.e: She lived a life of ease.
es.c: 她过着悠闲自在的生活。

d: adv 容易地；无疑地 without problems or difficulties

es.e: They won quite easily.
es.c: 他们赢得相当轻松。

es.e: We found the house easily enough.
es.c: 我们轻轻松松就找到了房子。

d: n 东方；东风；东方国家 the direction from which the sun rises, and which is on the right if you are facing north；adj 东方的；向东的；从东方来的 in the east or facing the east；adv 向东方，在东方 towards the east

es.e: Which way is east?
es.c: 哪边是东？

d: n 复活节 a Christian holy day in March or April when Christians remember the death of Christ and his return to life

es.e: on Easter Sunday
es.c: 在复活节星期日

d: adj 东方的；朝东的；东洋的 in or from the countries in Asia, especially China and Japan；n 东方人；（美国）东部地区的人

d: n 平等；相等；[数] 等式 a situation in which people have the same rights, advantages etc

es.e: ...equality of the sexes.
es.c: …性别平等。

d: v 装备，配备 to provide a person or place with the things that are needed for a particular kind of activity or work

es.e: They try to equip their vehicles with gadgets to deal with every possible contingency.
es.c: 他们尽量给他们的车辆配备各种小装置以应付任何可能的突发状况。

d: n 设备，装备；器材 the tools, machines etc that you need to do a particular job or activity

es.e: a shop selling camping equipment
es.c: 出售露营装备的商店

es.e: some brand new computer equipment
es.c: 一些全新的计算机设备

es.e: a very useful piece of equipment
es.c: 一件非常有用的设备

d: n 橡皮；擦除器；[计] 清除器 a small piece of rubber that you use to remove pencil or pen marks from paper
n 误差；错误；过失 a mistake

es.e: an error message
es.c: 出错信息

d: v 爆发；喷出；发疹；长牙 if fighting, violence, noise etc erupts, it starts suddenly

es.e: Violence erupted after police shot a student during the demonstration.
es.c: 警察向示威人群中的一名学生开枪，暴乱随之发生。

es.e: A political row erupted over the MP’s comments.
es.c: 这名下院议员的评论引发了一场政治论战。

d: v 逃避，避开，避免；被忘掉；被忽视 to get away from a dangerous or bad situation；n 逃跑；逃亡；逃走；逃跑工具或方法；野生种；泄漏 the act of getting away from a place, or a dangerous or bad situation

es.e: They went to the hills to escape the summer heat.
es.c: 他们去山中避暑了。

es.e: The youth was trying to escape the clutches of two drunken female companions.
es.c: 那个小伙子试图摆脱两名醉酒女伴的纠缠。

d: adv 特别；尤其；格外 used to emphasize that something is more important or happens more with one particular thing than with others

es.e: I never liked long walks, especially in winter.
es.c: 我向来不喜欢长距离散步，尤其在冬天。

es.e: Art books are expensive to produce, especially if they contain colour illustrations.
es.c: 美术类书籍制作成本很高，尤其是那些带彩色插图的。

d: n 散文；试图；随笔 a short piece of writing giving someone’s ideas about politics, society etc；v 尝试；对…做试验

es.e: We asked Jason to write an essay about his hometown.
es.c: 我们让杰森写一篇关于他家乡的短文。

d: n 欧洲 the continent that is north of the Mediterranean and goes as far east as the Ural Mountains in Russia

es.e: eastern Europe
es.c: 东欧

d: adj 欧洲的；欧洲人的 relating to Europe or its people；n 欧洲人 someone from Europe

es.e: European languages
es.c: 欧洲的语言

es.e: our European partners
es.c: 我们的欧洲伙伴

d: v 评价；估价；求…的值 to judge how good, useful, or successful something is

es.e: You should be able to evaluate your own work.
es.c: 你应该能够评估自己的工作。

es.e: We need to evaluate the success of the campaign.
es.c: 我们要评估一下这次运动是否成功。

es.e: It can be difficult to evaluate the effectiveness of different treatments.
es.c: 要对各种治疗方法的效果作出评估会很难。

d: adj [数] 偶数的；平坦的；相等的 flat and level, with no parts that are higher than other parts；adv 甚至；即使；还；实际上 used to emphasize something that is unexpected or surprising in what you are saying；v 使平坦；使相等；n (Even)人名；(法)埃旺；(德)埃文；(英)埃

es.e: The floor must be completely even before we lay the tiles.
es.c: 地面必须完全平整后才能铺地砖。

es.e: You need a flat, even surface to work on.
es.c: 你需要在一个平整的台面上干活。

es.e: He had lovely white, even teeth.
es.c: 他有一副洁白整齐的牙齿。

d: n 晚上；傍晚；（联欢性的）晚会；后期 the early part of the night between the end of the day and the time you go to bed；adj 在晚上的；为晚上的；晚上用的；int 晚上好（等于good evening） the early part of the night between the end of the day and the time you go

es.e: I do most of my studying in the evening.
es.c: 我学习大都在晚上。

es.e: I’m usually out on Friday evenings.
es.c: 周五晚上我通常都不在家。

es.e: What are you doing tomorrow evening?
es.c: 明天晚上你打算做什么？

d: n 事件，大事；项目；结果 something that happens, especially something important, interesting or unusual

es.e: one of the most important events in the history of mankind
es.c: 人类历史上最重大的事件之一

d: adv 最后，终于 after a long time, or after a lot of things have happened

es.e: He eventually escaped and made his way back to England.
es.c: 他终于逃脱并返回英格兰。

es.e: Eventually, she got a job and moved to London.
es.c: 最终，她找到了工作并移居伦敦。

d: adv 永远；曾经；究竟 for all time；n (Ever)人名；(英)埃弗；(俄)叶韦尔；(西、法)埃韦尔

es.e: Nothing lasts for ever.
es.c: 没有什么是永恒的。

d: adj 每一的，每个的；每隔…的 Every is also an adjective；n (Every)人名；(英)埃夫里

es.e: His every utterance will be scrutinized.
es.c: 他说的每句话都会被细查。

d: pron 每个人；人人 everyone
adj 每天的，日常的 ordinary, usual, or happening every day；n 平时；寻常日子

es.e: the problems of everyday life
es.c: 日常生活中的问题

es.e: wearing everyday clothes
es.c: 穿平常衣服

es.e: a simple, everyday object
es.c: 简单的日常物品

d: pron 每个人；人人 every person；n 每个人 every person

es.e: If everyone is ready, I’ll begin.
es.c: 如果大家都准备好了，我就开始。

es.e: Send my best wishes to everyone in the family.
es.c: 请向全家人致以最美好的祝愿。

es.e: Of course everyone else thought it was hilarious!
es.c: 当然其他所有人都觉得好笑极了！

d: pron 每件事物；最重要的东西；（有关的）一切；万事 each thing or all things

es.e: Everything was covered in a thick layer of dust.
es.c: 所有东西上面都蒙着厚厚一层灰。

es.e: I decided to tell her everything.
es.c: 我决定把一切都告诉她。

es.e: Apart from the bus arriving late, everything else seemed to be going according to plan.
es.c: 除了公共汽车晚点之外，其他一切似乎都在按计划进行。

d: adv 到处 in or to every place；n 每个地方

es.e: I’ve looked everywhere but I can’t find the map.
es.c: 我到处都找过了，但就是找不到地图。

es.e: He’s travelled everywhere in Europe.
es.c: 他走遍了欧洲各地。

es.e: The south should remain dry, but everywhere else will have heavy rain.
es.c: 南部持续干旱，但其他地区会下暴雨。

d: n 证据，证明；迹象；明显 facts or signs that show clearly that something exists or is true；v 证明 to show that something exists or is true

es.e: Murrow’s evidence was enough to convict Hayes of murder.
es.c: 默罗的证词足以证明海斯犯了谋杀罪。

d: adj 明显的；明白的 easy to see, notice, or understand

es.e: Bob ate his lunch with evident enjoyment.
es.c: 显然鲍勃吃午饭吃得津津有味。

d: n 演变；进化论；进展 the scientific idea that plants and animals develop and change gradually over a long period of time

es.e: the theory of evolution
es.c: 进化论

d: adj 准确的，精密的；精确的 completely correct in every detail；v 要求；强求；急需 to demand and get something from someone by using threats, force etc

es.e: Police are still investigating the exact cause of the accident.
es.c: 警方还在调查这起事故的确切原因。

es.e: What were his exact words?
es.c: 他的原话是什么？

es.e: The timing had to be exact.
es.c: 对时机的把握必须精确。

d: adv 恰好地；正是；精确地；正确地 used when emphasizing that something is no more and no less than a number or amount, or is completely correct in every detail

es.e: It’s exactly half past five.
es.c: 一分不差，正好5点半。

es.e: The figures may not be exactly right, but they’re close enough.
es.c: 那些数字可能不是非常精确，但也相当接近。

d: n 考试；测验 a spoken or written test of knowledge, especially an important one

es.e: At the end of each level, there’s an exam.
es.c: 在每一级别结束时都有一次考试。

es.e: How did you do in your exams?
es.c: 你考试考得怎么样？

d: v 检查；调查； 检测；考试 to look at something carefully and thoroughly because you want to find out more about it

es.e: A team of divers was sent down to examine the wreck.
es.c: 一组潜水员被送到水下检查沉船。

es.e: Hegel’s philosophy will be examined in detail in Chapter 4.
es.c: 黑格尔的哲学将在第4章作详细探讨。

d: n 例子；榜样 a specific fact, idea, person, or thing that is used to explain or support a general idea, or to show what is typical of a larger group；vt 作为…的例子；为…做出榜样；vi 举例

es.e: Parents should set an example for their children.
es.c: 父母应该为孩子树立榜样。

d: adj 卓越的；极好的；杰出的 extremely good or of very high quality

es.e: an excellent suggestion
es.c: 极好的建议

es.e: His car is in excellent condition.
es.c: 他的汽车状况极佳。

es.e: Second-hand computers can be excellent value.
es.c: 二手计算机买得好会非常合算。

d: v 不计；把…除外 to not include something；prep 除…之外；conj 除了；要不是 used to give the reason why something was not done or did not happen

es.e: They were all there except me.
es.c: 除了我以外他们都在那里。

es.e: We all went except him.
es.c: 除他以外， 我们都去了。

es.e: They all howled with laughter except me.
es.c: 除了我以外，他们全都哈哈大笑起来。

d: n 交换；交流；交易所；兑换 the act of giving someone something and receiving something else from them；v 交换；交易；兑换 to replace one thing with another

es.e: Four of my cassettes for your Madonna CD is a fair exchange.
es.c: 我用四盒磁带换你的麦当娜激光唱片很公平。

d: v 激起；刺激…，使…兴奋 to make someone feel happy, interested, or eager

es.e: His playing is technically brilliant, but it doesn’t excite me.
es.c: 他的演奏技巧娴熟，但并不让我激动。

d: n 借口；理由 a reason that you give to explain careless or offensive behaviour；v 原谅；为…申辩；给…免去 to forgive someone for doing something that is not seriously wrong, such as being rude or careless

es.e: I’m tired of listening to his excuses.
es.c: 我听厌了他的种种理由。

d: n 运动；练习；运用；操练；礼拜；典礼 physical activities that you do in order to stay healthy and become stronger；v 锻炼；练习；使用；使忙碌；使惊恐 to use a power, right, or quality that you have

es.e: Try to fit some regular exercise into your daily routine.
es.c: 尽量在日常生活中安排一些经常性的锻炼。

es.e: Working in an office, I don’t get much exercise.
es.c: 由于在办公室工作，我很少运动。

d: n 展览，显示；展览会；展览品 a show of paintings, photographs, or other objects that people can go to see

es.e: I’ve never seen such an exhibition of jealousy.
es.c: 我从未见过如此嫉妒的表现。

d: v 存在；生存；生活；继续存在 to happen or be present in a particular situation or place

es.e: The custom of arranged marriages still exists in many countries.
es.c: 许多国家仍存在包办婚姻的习俗。

es.e: Opportunities exist for students to gain sponsorship.
es.c: 学生有机会获得资助。

es.e: Stop pretending that the problem doesn’t exist.
es.c: 别再假装这个问题不存在了。

d: n 存在，实在；生存，生活；存在物，实在物 the state of existing

es.e: Scientists have many theories about how the universe first came into existence (= started to exist ).
es.c: 关于宇宙的起源，科学家有多种理论。

d: n 出口，通道；退场 a door or space through which you can leave a public room, building etc；v 退出；离去 to leave a place

es.e: We made for the nearest exit.
es.c: 我们走向最近的出口。

es.e: an exit door
es.c: 出口门

es.e: Two men were blocking her exit.
es.c: 两个男人挡住了她出去的路。

d: v 扩张；使膨胀；详述 if a company, business etc expands, or if someone expands it, they open new shops, factories etc

es.e: The computer industry has expanded greatly over the last decade.
es.c: 计算机行业在过去十年间大大地发展起来。

es.e: The hotel wants to expand its business by adding a swimming pool.
es.c: 该酒店想添个游泳池来扩展业务。

es.e: the rapidly expanding field of information technology
es.c: 迅速发展的信息技术领域

d: v 期望；指望；认为；预料 to think that something will happen because it seems likely or has been planned

es.e: He will be hard to beat. I fully expect (= am completely sure about ) that and I’m ready.
es.c: 他很难击败。我确信这一点，不过我准备好了。

es.e: ‘Who are you?’ he murmured, only half expecting (= thinking it was possible, but not likely ) her to answer.
es.c: “你是谁？”他低声问道，预计她可能不会回答。

es.e: He didn’t get his expected pay rise.
es.c: 他没有得到他预想的加薪。

d: n 期待；预期；指望 what you think or hope will happen

es.e: Having raised expectations (= made people more hopeful ), he went on to help only a few people.
es.c: 他唤起了大家的希望，但接着只是帮助了几个人。

es.e: The show exceeded all expectations (= was much better than expected ).
es.c: 这场演出比人们预期的要好得多。

es.e: The number of people who attended fell short of expectations (= was lower than expected ).
es.c: 出席的人数比预期的要少。

d: n 损失，代价；消费；开支 Expense is the money that something costs you or that you need to spend in order to do something；vt 向…收取费用；vi 被花掉

es.e: He's bought a big TV at vast expense so that everyone can see properly.
es.c: 他花了很多钱买了台大电视，这样人人都可以看清楚了。

d: adj 昂贵的；花钱的 costing a lot of money

es.e: the most expensive restaurant in town
es.c: 城里最贵的餐馆

es.e: Petrol is becoming more and more expensive.
es.c: 汽油越来越贵了。

es.e: Photography is an expensive hobby.
es.c: 摄影是一项很花钱的业余爱好。

d: n 经验；经历；体验 knowledge or skill that you gain from doing a job or activity, or the process of doing this；v 经验；经历；体验 if you experience a problem, event, or situation, it happens to you or affects you

es.e: The advice in the booklet reflects the practical experience we have gained (= experience gained by actually doing something, rather than knowledge from books etc ).
es.c: 小册子中的建议反映了我们所获得的实践经验。

es.e: I had some experience in fashion design.
es.c: 我有一些时装设计方面的经验。

es.e: She was turned down on the grounds of lack of experience.
es.c: 她因缺乏经验而被拒绝。

d: v 尝试；进行实验 to try using various ideas, methods etc to find out how good or effective they are；n 实验，试验；尝试 a scientific test done to find out how something reacts under certain conditions, or to find out if a particular ide

es.e: The teacher provided some different materials and left the children to experiment.
es.c: 老师提供了几种不同的材料让孩子们试验。

d: adj 熟练的；内行的；老练的 having a special skill or special knowledge of a subject；n 专家；行家；能手 someone who has a special skill or special knowledge of a subject, gained as a result of training or experience；vt 当专家；在…中当行家

es.e: He cast his expert eye on the gardener’s work.
es.c: 他用内行的眼光看了看园丁干的活。

d: v 说明；解释 to tell someone about something in a way that is clear or easy to understand

es.e: He carefully explained the procedure.
es.c: 他仔细解释了程序。

d: n 说明，解释；辩解 the reasons you give for why something happened or why you did something

es.e: She told the court she would give a full explanation of the prosecution's decision on Monday.
es.c: 她告诉法庭她将在星期一就控方的决定做出详尽的解释。

d: adj 明确的；清楚的；直率的；详述的 expressed in a way that is very clear and direct

es.e: The contrast could not have been made more explicit.
es.c: 这个对比再清楚不过了。

es.e: explicit knowledge of grammar
es.c: 清楚易懂的语法知识

es.e: The kidnappers gave us explicit instructions not to involve the police.
es.c: 绑匪明确告诉我们不许报警。

d: v 爆炸，爆发；激增 to burst, or to make something burst, into small pieces, usually with a loud noise and in a way that causes damage

es.e: The device was thrown at an army patrol but failed to explode.
es.c: 炸弹投向了陆军巡逻队，但没有爆炸。

es.e: Far sooner than anyone thought possible, the Russians exploded an atomic bomb.
es.c: 苏联引爆了一颗原子弹，大大早于任何人的预期。

d: v 开发，开拓；剥削；开采 to treat someone unfairly by asking them to do things for you, but giving them very little in return – used to show disapproval；n 勋绩；功绩

es.e: Homeworkers can easily be exploited by employers.
es.c: 在家工作的人容易被雇主剥削。

d: v 探索；探测；探险 to discuss or think about something carefully

es.e: Management need to explore ways of improving office security.
es.c: 管理层需要探讨如何加强办事处的安全措施。

es.e: I’m going to explore the possibility of a part-time job.
es.c: 我要好好想想兼职工作的可能性。

d: n 探险家；勘探者；探测器；[医]探针 someone who travels through an unknown area to find out about it

es.e: ...the travels of Columbus, Magellan, and many other explorers.
es.c: …哥伦布、麦哲伦和许多其他探险家的旅行。

d: n 输出，出口；出口商品 the business of selling and sending goods to other countries；v 输出物资 to sell goods to another country

es.e: Wheat is one of the country’s main exports.
es.c: 小麦是该国的主要出口商品之一。

d: v 揭露，揭发；使曝光；显示 to show something that is usually covered or hidden

es.e: He lifted his T-shirt to expose a jagged scar across his chest.
es.c: 他撩起T恤衫，露出横贯胸部的锯齿状伤疤。

d: v 表达；快递 to tell or show what you are feeling or thinking by using words, looks, or actions；adj 明确的；迅速的；专门的 clear and definite；n 快车，快递，专使；捷运公司 a train or bus that does not stop in many places and therefore travels quickly

es.e: Parents have expressed their concerns about their children’s safety.
es.c: 父母对自己孩子的安全表示忧虑。

es.e: She expressed an interest in seeing York.
es.c: 她表示有兴趣见见约克。

es.e: Many people have expressed their opposition to the proposals.
es.c: 许多人反对这些提议。

d: n 表现，表示，表达；表情，脸色，态度，腔调，声调；式，符号；词句，语句，措辞，说法 something you say, write, or do that shows what you think or feel

es.e: Student leaders are demanding greater freedom of expression (= the right to say what you think without being punished ).
es.c: 学生领袖要求得到更多的言论自由。

d: n 延长；延期；扩大；伸展；电话分机 the process of making a road, building etc bigger or longer, or the part that is added

es.e: a loft extension
es.c: 增建的阁楼

d: adv 特别地，非常；另外 in addition to the usual things or the usual amount；n 临时演员；号外；额外的事物；上等产品 an amount of something, especially money, in addition to the usual, basic, or necessary amount；adj 额外的，另外收费的；特大的 more of something, i

es.e: They need to offer something extra to attract customers.
es.c: 他们需要提供额外的东西以吸引顾客。

d: adj 非凡的；特别的；离奇的；临时的；特派的 very much greater or more impressive than usual

es.e: a woman of extraordinary beauty
es.c: 容貌出众的女子

es.e: an extraordinary talent
es.c: 非凡的才华

d: adj 极端的；极度的；偏激的；尽头的 very great in degree；n 极端；末端；最大程度；极端的事物 a situation, quality etc which is as great as it can possibly be – used especially when talking about two opposites

es.e: Extreme poverty still exists in many rural areas.
es.c: 许多农村地区仍处于赤贫状态。

es.e: extreme cold
es.c: 严寒

es.e: He had extreme difficulty getting hold of the ingredients.
es.c: 他费了极大的劲找配料。

d: adv 非常，极其；极端地 to a very great degree

es.e: Earthquakes are extremely difficult to predict.
es.c: 地震非常难以预测。

es.e: I’m extremely sorry to have troubled you.
es.c: 给你添了麻烦，我十分抱歉。

d: n 眼睛；视力；眼光；见解，观点 one of the two parts of the body that you use to see with；v 注视，看 to look at someone or something carefully, especially because you do not trust them or because you want something

es.e: He’s got beautiful eyes.
es.c: 他有一双漂亮的眼睛。

es.e: There were tears in her eyes as she listened to the story.
es.c: 她听故事时眼里噙着泪水。

es.e: Ow! I’ve got something in my eye!
es.c: 哎呀！我眼睛里进了什么东西！

d: n 视力；目力 your ability to see

es.e: He had a problem with his eyesight.
es.c: 他的视力有问题。

d: n 目击者；见证人 someone who has seen something such as a crime happen, and is able to describe it afterwards

es.e: One eyewitness said he saw her talking to a man in a blue car.
es.c: 一名目击者说他看见她在跟一个坐在蓝色汽车里的男子说话。

d: n 脸；表面；面子；面容；外观；威信 the front part of your head, where your eyes, nose, and mouth are；v 向；朝 to be opposite someone or something, or to be looking or pointing in a particular direction

es.e: She had a beautiful face.
es.c: 她面容秀美。

es.e: Her face was white with fear.
es.c: 她吓得脸煞白。

es.e: A big smile spread across his face.
es.c: 他的脸上绽开了灿烂笑容。

d: adj 面部的，表面的；脸的，面部用的 on your face or relating to your face；n 美容，美颜；脸部按摩 if you have a facial, you have a beauty treatment in which your face is cleaned and creams are rubbed into it

es.e: Victor’s facial expression didn’t change.
es.c: 维克托脸上的表情没有变化。

es.e: facial hair
es.c: 脸部的汗毛

d: n 事实；实际；真相 a piece of information that is known to be true

es.e: Our decision to build the museum in Hartlepool was influenced by the fact that there were no national museums in the North East.
es.c: 我们之所以决定在哈特尔浦建造博物馆，是因为东北地区没有国家级的博物馆。

d: n 工厂；制造厂；代理店 a building or group of buildings in which goods are produced in large quantities, using machines

es.e: a car factory
es.c: 汽车制造厂

es.e: factory workers
es.c: 工厂工人

d: v 褪色；凋谢；逐渐消失 to gradually disappear；adj 平淡的；乏味的；n [电影][电视] 淡出；[电影][电视] 淡入

es.e: Hopes of a peace settlement are beginning to fade.
es.c: 达成和平协议的希望日渐渺茫。

es.e: Over the years her beauty had faded a little.
es.c: 岁月流逝，她的美貌已略逊当年。

d: v 失败，不及格；破产；缺乏；衰退 to not succeed in achieving something；n 不及格 an unsuccessful result in a test or examination

es.e: It looks likely that the peace talks will fail.
es.c: 看来和平谈判可能会失败。

es.e: Millions of people have tried to quit smoking and failed miserably (= been completely unsuccessful ).
es.c: 数百万人戒过烟，都以惨败告终。

es.e: his efforts to save his failing marriage
es.c: 他挽救自己濒危婚姻的努力

d: n 失败；故障；失败者；破产 a lack of success in achieving or doing something

es.e: Successful people often aren’t very good at dealing with failure.
es.c: 一帆风顺的人往往不太擅长应对失败。

d: adj 公平的；美丽的，白皙的；[气象] 晴朗的 treating everyone in a way that is right or equal；adv 公平地；直接地；清楚地 absolutely or squarely; quite；v 转晴；n 展览会；市集；美人 an outdoor event, at which there are large machines to ride on, games to play, and

es.e: Why does Eric get to go and I don’t? It’s not fair!
es.c: 为什么埃里克能去我不能？这不公平！

es.e: Life isn’t always fair.
es.c: 生活并非总是公平的。

es.e: My boss expects a lot – but he’s very fair.
es.c: 我的老板要求很高——但是他很公平。

d: adv 相当地；公平地；简直 more than a little, but much less than very；n (Fairly)人名；(英)费尔利

es.e: The house had a fairly large garden.
es.c: 那幢房子有个不小的花园。

es.e: She speaks English fairly well.
es.c: 她英语讲得还不错。

es.e: The instructions seem fairly straightforward.
es.c: 操作指南似乎很简明。

d: n 公平；美好；清晰；顺利性 the quality of being fair

es.e: the basic fairness of the judicial system
es.c: 司法制度的基本公正性

d: n 信仰；信念；信任；忠实 a strong feeling of trust or confidence in someone or something

es.e: People have lost faith in the government.
es.c: 人们已失去了对政府的信心。

d: v 落下；变成；来临；减弱 to move or drop down from a higher position to a lower position；n 下降；秋天；瀑布 a reduction in the amount, level, price etc of something；adj 秋天的

es.e: The tree was about to fall.
es.c: 那棵树快要倒下了。

es.e: The book fell from his hands.
es.c: 书从他手上跌落。

es.e: Enough rain had fallen to flood the grounds.
es.c: 雨量很大，淹没了地面。

d: adj 错误的；虚伪的；伪造的 If something is false, it is incorrect, untrue, or mistaken；adv 欺诈地

es.e: It was quite clear the president was being given false information by those around him.
es.c: 很明显，总统身边的那些人正给总统提供着错误信息。

es.e: You do not know whether what you're told is true or false.
es.c: 你不知道别人告诉你的是真的还是假的。

d: adj 熟悉的；常见的；亲近的 someone or something that is familiar is well-known to you and easy to recognize；n 常客；密友

es.e: a familiar tune
es.c: 熟悉的曲调

es.e: It was a relief to be back in familiar surroundings .
es.c: 回到熟悉的环境里让人松了一口气。

es.e: Beggars on the street are becoming a familiar sight .
es.c: 街上出现乞丐的情况逐渐变得屡见不鲜。

d: n 家庭；亲属；家族；子女；[生]科；语族；[化]族 a group of people who are related to each other, especially a mother, a father, and their children；adj 家庭的；家族的；适合于全家的 You can use family to describe things that belong to a particular family

es.e: Do you know the family next door?
es.c: 你认识隔壁那家人吗？

es.e: The Webb family still has its farm over there.
es.c: 韦伯家依然保留着那里的农场。

es.e: The family now live in London.
es.c: 那家人现居伦敦。

d: adj 著名的；极好的，非常令人满意的 known about by many people in many places

es.e: a famous actor
es.c: 著名演员

es.e: Many famous people have stayed in the hotel.
es.c: 许多名人都曾下榻这家酒店。

es.e: The Eiffel Tower is a famous landmark (= a famous place or building that is easy to recognize ) .
es.c: 埃菲尔铁塔是著名的地标。

d: v 煽动；刺激；吹拂 to make someone feel an emotion more strongly；n 迷；风扇；爱好者 someone who likes a particular sport or performing art very much, or who admires a famous person

es.e: Her resistance only fanned his desire.
es.c: 她的反抗反而激起了他的欲望。

d: n 幻想；想象力；爱好 an idea or opinion that is not based on fact；adj 想象的；奇特的；昂贵的；精选的 fancy hotels, restaurants, cars etc are expensive and fashionable；v 想象；喜爱；设想；自负 to like or want something, or want to do something

es.e: Oh, that was just a fancy of his.
es.c: 啊，那只是他的异想天开。

d: adj 奇异的；空想的；异想天开的；古怪的；极好的，极出色的；不可思议的；不切实际的 extremely good, attractive, enjoyable etc；n 古怪的人

es.e: You look fantastic!
es.c: 你看上去棒极了！

es.e: It’s a fantastic place, really beautiful!
es.c: 这真是个好地方，漂亮极了！

d: n 幻想；白日梦；幻觉 an exciting and unusual experience or situation you imagine happening to you, but which will probably never happen；adj 虚幻的 Fantasy football, baseball, or another sport is a game in which players choose an ima

es.e: I used to have fantasies about living in Paris with an artist.
es.c: 我过去常幻想着在巴黎与一位艺术家同住。

es.e: sexual fantasies
es.c: 性幻想

es.e: Young children sometimes can’t distinguish between fantasy and reality.
es.c: 小孩子有时不能区分幻想与现实。

d: adv 很；遥远地；久远地；到很远的距离；到很深的程度 very much, or to a great degree；adj 远的；久远的 a long distance away；n 远方

es.e: We’ve kept the original features of the house as far as possible (= as much as possible ) .
es.c: 我们尽量保留了房子的原貌。

es.e: How far do those old, outdated laws affect today’s legislation?
es.c: 那些陈旧过时的法律对今天的立法有多少影响？

es.e: His style was far removed (= very different ) from that of Picasso.
es.c: 他的风格与毕加索有天壤之别。

d: v 经营；进展；遭遇；过活 If you say that someone or something fares well or badly, you are referring to the degree of success they achieve in a particular situation or activity；n 票价；费用；旅客；食物 the price you pay to travel somewhere by

es.e: It is unlikely that the marine industry will fare any better in September.
es.c: 海运业不大可能在9月份有所好转。

d: v 种田，务农；经营农场；n 农场；农家；畜牧场 an area of land used for growing crops or keeping animals

es.c: 这家人世代在此务农。

d: n 农夫，农民

es.e: She dickered with the farmer for the best fruit.
es.c: 她要买最好的水果而跟农民讨价还价。

es.e: The farmer peddled his fruit from house to house.
es.c: 那个农民挨家挨户兜售他的水果。

es.e: As a farmer, you should learn how to yoke the oxen together.
es.c: 作为农民，你应该学会怎样把一对牛用轭连起来。

d: adj 快速的，迅速的；紧的，稳固的 moving or able to move quickly；adv 迅速地；紧紧地；彻底地 moving quickly；v 禁食，斋戒 If you fast, you eat no food for a period of time, usually for either religious or medical reasons, or as a protest；n 斋戒；绝食 a perio

es.e: a fast car
es.c: 速度很快的汽车

es.e: He’s one of the fastest runners in the world.
es.c: 他是世界上跑得最快的人之一。

es.e: I fasted for a day and a half and asked God to help me.
es.c: 我禁食了一天半，请求上帝帮助我。

d: v 使固定；集中于；扎牢；强加于 to attach something firmly to another object or surface；n (Fasten)人名；(英)法森

es.e: Are you suggesting I’m too fat?
es.c: 你是不是在说我太胖了？

es.e: a short fat man in his early fifties
es.c: 一个五十岁出头的矮胖男人

es.e: You’ll get fat if you eat all that chocolate.
es.c: 如果你把那些巧克力都吃了，就会变胖的。

es.c: 叫你父亲帮你。

es.e: Andrew was very excited about becoming a father.
es.c: 安德鲁初为人父，非常激动。

es.e: He’s been like a father to me.
es.c: 对我来说，他就像父亲一样。

d: n 故障；[地质] 断层；错误；缺点；毛病；（网球等）发球失误 a bad or weak part of someone’s character；v 弄错；产生断层

es.e: His worst fault is his arrogance.
es.c: 他最大的缺点是傲慢。

es.e: I may have my faults , but ingratitude is not one of them.
es.c: 我可能有我的缺点，但我决不会忘恩负义。

es.e: For all his faults (= in spite of his faults ) he was a good father.
es.c: 尽管他有缺点，但还是个好父亲。

d: n 偏爱；赞同；善行 support, approval, or agreement for something such as a plan, idea, or system；v 赞成；喜爱；有助于 to provide suitable conditions for something to happen

es.c: 在瑞典等国家，核能已不受欢迎。

es.e: (= used when asking people to vote on something by raising a hand )?
es.c: 都同意吗？〔用于要求人们对某事举手表决时〕

es.c: 孩子最喜欢的玩具

es.e: What’s your favourite colour?
es.c: 你最喜欢什么颜色？

es.e: a favorite spot for picnickers
es.c: 野餐者最喜欢的地方

es.e: I faxed a copy of the agreement to each of the investors.
es.c: 我给每位投资者都传真了一份协议副本。

d: n 害怕；恐惧；敬畏；担心 the feeling you get when you are afraid or worried that something bad is going to happen；v 害怕；敬畏；为…担心 to feel afraid or worried that something bad may happen

es.e: She finally ran away for fear that he would kill her.
es.c: 她最后逃走了，唯恐他会杀她。

d: v 享受；款待，宴请 If you feast, you take part in a feast；n 筵席，宴会；节日 a large meal where a lot of people celebrate a special occasion

es.e: Only a few feet away, their captors feasted in the castle's banqueting hall.
es.c: 仅仅几英尺外，俘获他们的人在城堡的宴会厅里大吃大喝。

d: n 羽毛 one of the light soft things that cover a bird’s body；v 用羽毛装饰

es.e: an ostrich feather
es.c: 一根鸵鸟羽毛

d: n 二月 the second month of the year, between January and March

es.e: He joined the Army in February 1943.
es.c: 他1943年2月参军。

d: adj 联邦的；同盟的；联邦政府的； 联邦制的 a federal country or system of government consists of a group of states which control their own affairs, but which are also controlled by a single national government which makes decisions on fore

es.e: Switzerland is a federal republic.
es.c: 瑞士是一个联邦共和国。

d: n 费用；酬金；小费 an amount of money that you pay to do something or that you pay to a professional person for their work；v 付费给……

es.e: You can use the gym and pool for a fee of £35 a month.
es.c: 月付35英镑，即可使用健身房和游泳池。

d: v 喂养；供给；放牧；抚养（家庭等）；靠…为生 to give a special substance to a plant, which helps it grow；n 饲料；饲养；（动物或婴儿的）一餐 food for animals

es.e: Feed the tomatoes once a week.
es.c: 每周给番茄施一次肥。

d: v 感觉；认为；触摸；试探 to give you a particular physical feeling, especially when you touch or hold something；n 感觉；触摸 a quality that something has that makes you feel or think a particular way about it

es.e: It’s nice fabric - it feels like velvet.
es.c: 面料不错——摸上去像丝绒。

d: n 感觉，触觉；感情，情绪；同情 an emotion that you feel, such as anger, sadness, or happiness；adj 有感觉的；有同情心的；富于感情的；v 感觉；认为（feel的现在分词）；触摸

es.e: Knowing we’d won was a wonderful feeling.
es.c: 得知我们赢了，感觉真好。

d: n 家伙；朋友；同事；会员 a man；adj 同伴的，同事的；同道的 You use fellow to describe people who are in the same situation as you, or people you feel you have something in common with；vt 使…与另一个对等；使…与另一个匹敌

es.e: Paul’s an easy-going sort of fellow.
es.c: 保罗人很随和。

es.c: 她高兴地发现一个把她同来的客人逗笑的本事。

es.c: 女性选民

es.c: 半数以上的员工是女性。

es.c: 村民们说栅栏将限制公众进入山区。

es.e: They had recrossed the River Gambia by ferry.
es.c: 他们乘船又一次渡过了冈比亚河。

d: n 节日；庆祝，纪念活动；欢乐 a special occasion when people celebrate something such as a religious event, and there is often a public holiday；adj 节日的，喜庆的；快乐的

es.e: Christmas is one of the main festivals in the Christian Calendar.
es.c: 圣诞节是基督教历的重大节日之一。

d: v 取来；接来；到达；吸引 to make people react in a particular way；n 取得；诡计

es.c: 这一宣告博得听众极其热烈的欢呼声。

es.c: 安迪发烧了，今天不来上班。

es.c: 今天早上醒来时我发烧了，胃也不舒服。

es.e: She’s running a fever (= has a fever ) .
es.c: 她在发烧。

d: adj 很少的；几乎没有的 Few is also an adjective；pron 很少 The few means a small set of people considered as separate from the majority, especially because they share a particular opportunity or quality that the others do not have；n

es.e: ...spending her few waking hours in front of the TV.
es.c: …把她清醒的个把钟头花在电视机前。

es.e: This should not be an experience for the few.
es.c: 这应该不只是少数人的经历。

d: n 纤维；纤维制品 the parts of plants that you eat but cannot  digest  . Fibre helps to keep you healthy by moving food quickly through your body.

es.c: 水果和蔬菜的纤维素含量很高。

es.e: food that is high in dietary fibre
es.c: 富含膳食纤维的食物

d: n 小说；虚构，编造；谎言 books and stories about imaginary people and events

es.c: 爱情小说

es.e: historical fiction
es.c: 历史小说

d: n 领域；牧场；旷野；战场；运动场 a subject that people study or an area of activity that they are involved in as part of their work；v 担任场外队员 the team that is fielding in a game of  cricket  or baseball is the one that is throwing and c

es.c: 他是政治领域之外最出名的美国人。

es.c: 我也在男生中进行了一项有关他们对人际关系态度的实地调查。

es.c: 城里的激烈战斗

es.c: 土伦以南15英里的一个滨海村落

es.e: They met when she was fifteen (= 15 years old ) .
es.c: 他们相遇那年她15岁。
