es.e: in the fifth century
es.c: 在五世纪

es.e: her fifth birthday
es.c: 她的五岁生日

d: n 五十；五十个；编号为50的东西 the number 50；adj 五十的；五十个的；众多的

es.e: Standards of living rose in the fifties.
es.c: 50年代生活水平提高了。

d: v 打架；与…打仗，与…斗争；反对…提案 to take part in a war or battle；n 打架；战斗，斗志 a situation in which two people or groups hit, push etc each other

es.e: Neither country is capable of fighting a long war .
es.c: 两个国家都没有能力打持久战。

es.e: Later the Indians fought the Anglo settlers.
es.c: 后来，印第安人跟英国殖民者打起了仗。

d: n 数字；人物；图形；价格；（人的）体形；画像 a  geometric  shape；v 计算；出现；扮演角色 to be an important part of a process, event, or situation, or to be included in something

es.e: A hexagon is a six-sided figure.
es.c: 六边形是一种有六条边的几何图形。

d: n 文件；档案；文件夹；锉刀 a set of papers, records etc that contain information about a particular person or subject；v 提出；锉；琢磨；把…归档 to keep papers, documents etc in a particular place so that you can find them easily

es.e: We will keep your details on file (= store them for later use ) .
es.c: 我们将把你的详细资料存档。

d: v 装满，使充满；满足；堵塞；任职 if a container or place fills, or if you fill it, enough of something goes into it to make it full；n 满足；填满的量；装填物

es.e: He poured her a drink, then filled his own glass.
es.c: 他给她倒了一杯，然后将自己的杯子斟满。

es.e: My job was filling the flour sacks.
es.c: 我的工作是装面粉袋。

es.e: Take a deep breath and allow your lungs to fill.
es.c: 深吸一口气，让肺部涨满。

d: n 电影；薄膜；胶卷；轻烟 a story that is told using sound and moving pictures, shown at a cinema or on television；v 在…上覆以薄膜；把…拍成电影 to use a camera to record a story or real events so that it can be shown in the cinema or on televis

es.e: Have you seen any good films recently?
es.c: 你最近看过什么好的影片吗？

d: adj 最终的；决定性的；不可更改的 last in a series of actions, events, parts of a story etc；n 决赛；期末考试；当日报纸的末版 the last and most important game, race, or set of games in a competition

es.e: The final episode will be shown tonight.
es.c: 最后一集将于今晚播出。

es.e: students preparing for their final examinations
es.c: 正在准备期末考试的学生

es.e: Stone is filming the final instalment of his Vietnam trilogy.
es.c: 斯通正在拍摄越战三部曲的最后一部。

d: n 财政，财政学；金融 the management of money by governments, large organizations etc；v 负担经费，供给…经费

es.e: leasing and other forms of business finance
es.c: 租赁及其他商业金融形式

es.e: Russia’s finance minister
es.c: 俄罗斯财政部长

es.e: the world of high finance
es.c: 高级金融界

d: v 查找，找到；发现；认为；感到；获得 to discover, see, or get something that you have been searching for；n 发现 something very good or useful that you discover by chance

es.e: I can’t find the car keys.
es.c: 我找不到汽车钥匙。

es.e: Hold on while I find a pen.
es.c: 别挂电话，我找支笔。

es.e: Her body was later found hidden in the bushes.
es.c: 后来有人发现她的尸体被藏在了灌木丛里。

d: adj 好的；优良的；细小的，精美的；健康的；晴朗的 in good health；n 罚款 money that you have to pay as a punishment；v 罚款；澄清；adv 很好地；精巧地 in a way that is satisfactory or acceptable

es.e: ‘How are you?’ ‘Fine, thanks, how are you?’
es.c: “你好吗？”“很好，谢谢，你呢？”

es.e: I feel fine , really.
es.c: 我感觉很好，真的。

d: n 手指；指针，指状物 one of the four long thin parts on your hand, not including your thumb；v 伸出；用手指拨弄 to touch or handle something with your fingers

es.e: The woman had a ring on her finger, so I assumed she was married.
es.c: 那女人手指上戴着戒指，因此我猜想她已经结婚了。

es.e: We ate with our fingers.
es.c: 我们用手抓着吃。

d: n 手指甲 the hard flat part that covers the top end of your finger

es.e: It takes about 150 days to grow out a full length fingernail.
es.c: 大约150天的时间就可以长一个完整的指甲出来。

es.e: As I turned on my side I noticed pieces of fingernail, bits of skin and hair on the lift carpet.
es.c: 当我转身侧卧时，注意到电梯的地毯上有零星的指甲、皮肤碎屑和头发。

es.e: The top of the box was sealed with wide brown parcel tape, Jacob managed to get his fingernail under the end and peeled off the tape in one go.
es.c: 箱子的顶端是用褐色的包裹胶带封起来的，雅各布用指甲把胶带的一头抠起来，一下子把胶带整个扯开。

d: v 完成；结束；用完 to complete the last part of something that you are doing；n 结束；完美；回味（葡萄酒）

es.e: You can’t go anywhere until you’ve finished your homework.
es.c: 没完成家庭作业前你哪儿也不能去。

es.e: Have you finished that book yet?
es.c: 那本书你看完了吗？

es.e: ‘How’s the decorating going?’ ‘We’ve nearly finished.’
es.c: “装修进行得怎么样了？”“差不多快完成了。”

d: n 火；火灾；炮火；炉火；热情；激情；磨难 uncontrolled flames, light, and heat that destroy and damage things；v 点燃；解雇；开除；使发光；烧制；激动；放枪 to force someone to leave their job

es.e: The warehouse was completely destroyed by fire.
es.c: 仓库全给烧毁了。

es.e: Thirty people died in a fire in downtown Chicago.
es.c: 30人死于芝加哥市中心的一场火灾。

es.e: Police think that the fire was started deliberately.
es.c: 警方认为有人故意纵火。

d: n 消防队员 someone whose job is to stop fires burning

es.e: When every molecule in your body tells you to run away from the burning building, as a firefighter you have to resist the urge, override it and plunge in.
es.c: 当你身体内每个细胞都告诉逃离失火的建筑物时，作为一名消防员，你必须克制这种冲动，超越它，投入火场进行战斗。

es.e: He mows lawns and gardens for half a dozen clients in Grafton, some of them family friends. And he is an active volunteer firefighter.
es.c: 他为格拉夫顿六户人家修剪草坪和花园，他们中一些是父母的朋友，此外他还是个积极的义务消防员。

es.e: Locally and from the state standpoint, we had some firefighter jobs that were in jeopardy, up in the hundreds.
es.c: 站在州政府的立场，我们有一些消防员在危险岗位工作，最多时有数百人。

d: n 壁炉 a special place in the wall of a room, where you can make a fire

es.e: In the evenings, we gathered around the fireplace and talked in hushed whispers.
es.c: 晚上，我们聚集在壁炉周围轻声交谈。

d: n 柴火；木柴 wood that has been cut or collected in order to be burned in a fire

es.e: Young Geoffrey made money by chopping and selling firewood.
es.c: 年轻的杰弗里靠砍柴卖柴挣钱。

d: n 烟火；激烈情绪 a small container filled with powder that burns or explodes to produce coloured lights and noise in the sky

es.e: a New Year’s Eve fireworks display
es.c: 除夕夜的烟火表演

es.e: Jeff and David were in the back yard setting off fireworks .
es.c: 杰夫和戴维在后院放烟花。

d: adj 坚定的；牢固的；严格的；结实的 not completely hard, but not soft, and not easy to bend into a different shape；v 使坚定；使牢固 to make or become firm；adv 稳固地；n 公司；商号 a business or company, especially a small one

es.e: The sofa cushions are fairly firm.
es.c: 沙发的坐垫很硬。

es.e: a firm green apple
es.c: 硬的青苹果

es.e: Most doctors recommend sleeping on a firm mattress.
es.c: 大多数医生建议睡硬床垫。

d: adv 坚定地，坚决地；坚固地，稳固地

adv 第一；首先；优先；宁愿 before doing anything else, or before anything else happens；n 第一；开始；冠军 something that has never happened or been done before；adj 第一的；基本的；最早的 coming before all the other things or people in a series；num 第一

es.e: I’ll join you in a minute but I need to make a phone call first.
es.c: 我一会儿就来，但是我得先打个电话。

d: v 捕鱼，钓鱼；用钩捞取 to try to catch fish；n 鱼，鱼类 an animal that lives in water, and uses its  fins  and tail to swim

es.e: Dad really loves to fish.
es.c: 爸爸很喜欢钓鱼。

d: n 渔夫；渔人 someone who catches fish as a sport or as a job

es.e: But there was a price below which they dared not go, for it had happened that a fisherman in despair had given his pearls to the church.
es.c: 但是有一个价格底线，他们不敢低于这个价格了，因为曾有渔夫因为价格太低而绝望得宁愿把珍珠募捐给教堂。

d: n 拳，拳头；〈口〉笔迹；掌握；[印]指标参见号 the hand when it is tightly closed, so that the fingers are curled in towards the  palm  . People close their hand in a fist when they are angry or are going to hit someone.；vt 紧握；握成拳；用拳打

es.e: She held the money tightly in her fist.
es.c: 她把钱紧紧地攥在手中。

es.e: Malcolm clenched his fist (= held his fist very tightly closed ) angrily.
es.c: 马尔科姆愤怒地握紧拳头。

es.e: Dooley stood up and shook his fist in her face.
es.c: 杜利站起身，在她眼前挥舞着拳头。

d: v 安装；使……适应；使……合身；与……相符 to put a piece of equipment into a place, or a new part onto a machine, so that it is ready to be used；adj 健康的；合适的；恰当的；准备好的 someone who is fit is strong and healthy, especially because they exercis

es.e: The sash, kimono, and other garments were made to fit a child.
es.c: 这些腰带、和服和其他衣服都做得适合孩子穿。

d: n 五，五个；五美元钞票 the number 5；num 五，五个 the number 5；adj 五的；五个的

es.e: There is also a golf course five miles away.
es.c: 五英里外还有个高尔夫球场。

es.e: I’ll be back by five (= five o’clock ) .
es.c: 我五点前回来。

es.e: The family moved to Canada when he was five (= five years old ) .
es.c: 他五岁时全家移居加拿大。

d: v 使固定；修理；安装；准备 to repair something that is broken or not working properly；n 困境；方位；贿赂 to have a problem that is difficult to solve

es.e: He’s outside fixing the brakes on the car.
es.c: 他在外面修理汽车的刹车。

es.e: Ellis was able to quickly find and fix the problem.
es.c: 埃利斯马上就找到并解决了问题。

d: v 标记；衰退；枯萎 If you flag or if your spirits flag, you begin to lose enthusiasm or energy；n 标志；旗子 an expression meaning a country or organization and its beliefs, values, and people

es.e: His enthusiasm was in no way flagging.
es.c: 他的热情丝毫没有减退。

d: n 火焰；热情；光辉 hot bright burning gas that you see when something is on fire；v 焚烧；泛红 to burn brightly

es.e: Flames poured out of the windows of the building.
es.c: 火焰从大楼窗口冒出来。

es.e: They rushed past us with buckets of water and tried to douse the flames .
es.c: 他们提着一桶桶水跑过我们身边去灭火。

es.e: They sat around the campfire, watching the flickering flames .
es.c: 他们围坐在篝火旁，看着跳动的火焰。

d: adj 燃烧的；火红的；激昂的 covered with flames；v 燃烧；变亮；发光（flame的ing形式）；n (Flaming)人名；(法)弗拉曼

es.e: Residents panicked as flaming petrol poured down the street.
es.c: 燃烧的汽油沿街流淌，居民惊慌失措。

d: v 使闪光；反射 to shine suddenly and brightly for a short time, or to make something shine in this way；n 闪光，闪现；一瞬间 a bright light that shines for a short time and then stops shining；adj 闪光的，火速的

es.e: Lightning flashed overhead.
es.c: 头顶上电光闪闪。

es.e: Red warning lights flashed on and off (= shone for a short time and then stopped shining ) .
es.c: 红色警告灯一闪一闪。

d: n 手电筒；闪光灯 a small electric light that you can carry in your hand

es.e: Wicky peeked at John's flashlight.
es.c: 威奇向约翰的手电筒瞥了一眼。

es.e: Do you have a flashlight?
es.c: 你有没有手电筒？

d: adj 平的；单调的；不景气的；干脆的；平坦的；扁平的；浅的 smooth and level, without raised or hollow areas, and not sloping or curving；adv （尤指贴着另一表面）平直地；断然地；水平地；直接地，完全地 in a position in which the surface of something is against another surface wit

es.e: houses with flat roofs
es.c: 平顶房

es.e: a perfectly flat sandy beach
es.c: 十分平坦的沙滩

es.e: The countryside near there is flat as a pancake (= very flat ) .
es.c: 那儿附近的乡间地势非常平坦。

d: v 逃走；消失，消散 to leave somewhere very quickly, in order to escape from danger

es.e: His attackers turned and fled.
es.c: 袭击他的人转身逃走了。

es.e: Masaari spent six months in prison before fleeing the country .
es.c: 正有蹲了六个月监狱，然后逃出了该国。

d: n 肉；肉体 the soft part of the body of a person or animal that is between the skin and the bones；v 喂肉给…；使发胖

es.e: a freshwater fish with firm white flesh
es.c: 一种肉色雪白、肉质紧实的淡水鱼

d: adj 灵活的；柔韧的；易弯曲的 a person, plan etc that is flexible can change or be changed easily to suit any new situation

es.e: We can be flexible about your starting date.
es.c: 你具体从哪天开始，我们可以灵活一点。

es.e: The government needs a more flexible approach to education.
es.c: 政府在处理教育问题上需要更加灵活。

d: n 飞行；班机；逃走 a journey in a plane or space vehicle, or the plane or vehicle that is making the journey；v 射击；使惊飞

es.e: He immediately booked a flight to Toulouse.
es.c: 他当即就订了去图卢兹的航班。

es.e: There are only three flights a day to Logan Airport from Heathrow.
es.c: 希思罗机场每天只有三趟飞往洛根机场的航班。

d: v 使漂浮；实行 if something floats, it moves slowly through the air or stays up in the air；n 彩车，花车；漂流物；浮舟；浮萍 a large vehicle that is decorated to drive through the streets as part of a special event

es.e: I looked up at the clouds floating in the sky.
es.c: 我仰望着天上的浮云。

es.e: Leaves floated gently down from the trees.
es.c: 叶子从树上轻轻飘落。

d: v 淹没；充满；溢出 to cover a place with water, or to become covered with water；n 洪水；泛滥；一大批 a very large amount of water that covers an area that is usually dry

es.e: Towns and cities all over the country have been flooded.
es.c: 全国各地的城镇都被淹没了。

es.e: The houses down by the river flood quite regularly.
es.c: 沿河的房屋常遭水淹。

d: n 地板，地面；楼层；基底；议员席 the flat surface that you stand on inside a building；v 铺地板；打倒，击倒；（被困难）难倒 to hit someone so hard that they fall down

es.e: a polished wooden floor
es.c: 上过蜡的木地板

es.e: a puddle of water on the kitchen floor
es.c: 厨房地面上的一摊水

es.e: a warehouse that has 410,000 square feet of floor space
es.c: 楼面面积为41万平方英尺的仓库

d: n 面粉；粉状物质 a powder that is made by crushing wheat or other grain and is used for making bread, cakes etc；v 撒粉于；把…磨成粉 to cover a surface with flour when you are cooking

es.e: Roll the pastry out on a lightly floured board.
es.c: 把面团放在撒有少许面粉的案板上擀平。

d: v 流动，涌流；川流不息；飘扬 when a liquid, gas, or electricity flows, it moves in a steady continuous stream；n 流动；流量；涨潮，泛滥 a smooth steady movement of liquid, gas, or electricity

es.e: Money has been flowing into the country from Western aid agencies.
es.c: 资金源源不断地从西方援助机构流入该国。

d: n 花；精华；开花植物 a coloured or white part that a plant or tree produces before fruit or seeds；v 成熟，发育；开花；繁荣；旺盛 to produce flowers

es.e: a lovely rose bush with delicate pink flowers
es.c: 一簇开着娇嫩的粉红色花朵的美丽蔷薇

es.e: fields full of beautiful wild flowers
es.c: 开满美丽野花的田野

d: n 流感 a common illness that makes you feel very tired and weak, gives you a sore throat, and makes you cough and have to clear your nose a lot

es.e: Steven’s still in bed with flu .
es.c: 史蒂文患了流感，仍卧病在床。

es.e: She’s got the flu .
es.c: 她得了流感。

es.e: I couldn’t go because I had flu .
es.c: 我得了流感，去不了。

d: n （语言、文章）流利；（技能）娴熟

es.e: So, how to balance accuracy and fluency in spoken English?
es.c: 所以，英语口语的准确与流利，如何才能平衡起来呢？

d: adj 流畅的，流利的；液态的；畅流的 able to speak a language very well

es.e: He spoke in fluent Italian.
es.c: 他用流利的意大利语讲话。

d: v 飞；驾驶飞机；飘扬 to travel by plane；n 飞行；苍蝇；两翼昆虫 a small flying insect with two wings；adj 敏捷的 knowing and sharp; smart

es.e: She’s flying back to the States tomorrow.
es.c: 她明天乘飞机回美国。

es.e: Will you take the train there or fly?
es.c: 你去那里是坐火车还是坐飞机？

es.e: Maurice is nervous about flying, so he usually travels overland.
es.c: 莫里斯害怕乘坐飞机，因此他一般走陆路。

d: n 焦点；中心；清晰；焦距 the thing, person, situation etc that people pay special attention to；v 使集中；使聚焦 to give special attention to one particular person or thing, or to make people do this

es.e: The focus of recent research has been on environmental issues.
es.c: 近期的研究重点是环境问题。

es.e: Eggs became the focus for the food poisoning scare.
es.c: 鸡蛋成了食物中毒恐慌的焦点。

d: n 雾；烟雾，尘雾；迷惑 cloudy air near the ground which is difficult to see through；v 使模糊；使困惑；以雾笼罩 if something made of glass fogs or becomes fogged, it becomes covered in small drops of water that make it difficult to see through

es.e: It will be a cold night, and there may be fog patches .
es.c: 今夜天气寒冷，部分地区可能有雾。

es.e: A blanket of fog covered the fields.
es.c: 大雾笼罩了田野。

es.e: The fog lifted (= disappeared ) in the afternoon.
es.c: 下午，雾散了。

d: adj 有雾的；模糊的，朦胧的 if the weather is foggy, there is fog

es.e: a foggy day in November
es.c: 11月的一个雾天

es.e: driving in foggy conditions
es.c: 雾天驾驶

d: v 折叠；合拢；抱住；笼罩 to bend a piece of paper, cloth etc by laying or pressing one part over another；n 折痕；信徒；羊栏 a line made in paper or material when you fold one part of it over another

es.e: Fold the paper along the dotted line.
es.c: 沿虚线将纸折起来。

es.e: It’ll fit in if you fold it in half .
es.c: 对折的话就能放下了。

d: n 民族；人们；亲属（复数） people；adj 民间的 folk art, stories, customs etc are traditional and typical of the ordinary people who live in a particular area

es.e: I’m sure there are some folk who would rather they weren’t here.
es.c: 我敢肯定有些人宁愿自己不在这里。

es.e: Thanks to the folks at NBC.
es.c: 感谢全国广播公司的工作人员。

es.e: Wait till the folks back home hear about this!
es.c: 等到家乡的人听说这事吧！

d: v 跟随；遵循；追求；密切注意，注视；注意；倾听 to go, walk, drive etc behind or after someone else；n 跟随；追随

es.e: Are those men following us?
es.c: 那些人在跟着我们吗？

es.e: The patrol car followed the BMW for a few miles and then lost it.
es.c: 巡逻车跟了那辆宝马几英里，后来就跟丢了。

es.e: Tom’s already gone out to Rome and his wife and children will follow shortly.

es.c: 我们最好在下个小镇加油。

es.e: The van was fuelled and waiting in the basement car park.
es.c: 小货车加好了油，在地下停车场等着。

d: adj 完全的，完整的；满的，充满的；丰富的；完美的；丰满的；详尽的 containing as much or as many things or people as possible, so there is no space left；adv 十分，非常；完全地；整整；v 把衣服缝得宽大；n 全部；完整 including the whole of something

es.e: The train was completely full.
es.c: 火车坐得满满的。

es.e: Don’t talk with your mouth full.
es.c: 嘴里塞满东西时不要说话。

es.e: The class is full, but you can register for next term.
es.c: 这个班已经满了，不过你可以注册下学期的。

d: n 乐趣；玩笑；有趣的人或事 an experience or activity that is very enjoyable and exciting；adj 供娱乐用的；vi 开玩笑

es.e: There’s plenty of fun for all the family.
es.c: 可以让全家人玩得很开心。

es.e: The children were having so much fun, I hated to call them inside.
es.c: 小孩子玩得很开心，我不忍心把他们叫进来。

d: n 功能；[数] 函数；职责；盛大的集会 the purpose that something has, or the job that someone or something does；v 运行；活动；行使职责 If a machine or system is functioning, it is working or operating

es.e: The nervous system regulates our bodily functions (= eating, breathing, going to the toilet etc ) .
es.c: 神经系统控制着我们身体的功能。

es.e: Bauhaus architects thought that function was more important than form.
es.c: 包豪斯学派的建筑师认为功能重于形式。

es.e: The authorities say the prison is now functioning normally.
es.c: 当局称该监狱现在在正常运转。

d: adj 基本的，根本的 relating to the most basic and important parts of something；n 基本原理；基本原则

es.e: We have to tackle the fundamental cause of the problem.
es.c: 我们必须解决问题的根本原因。

es.e: the fundamental principles of liberty and equality
es.c: 自由和平等这两个基本原则

d: n 葬礼；麻烦事 a religious ceremony for burying or  cremating (= burning )  someone who has died；adj 丧葬的，出殡的

es.e: The funeral will be held at St. Martin’s Church.
es.c: 葬礼将在圣马丁教堂举行。

es.e: Hundreds of mourners attended the funeral of the two boys.
es.c: 数百名哀悼者参加了那两个男孩的葬礼。

es.e: the minister who conducted the funeral service
es.c: 主持葬礼的牧师

d: adj 有趣的，好笑的，滑稽的；（口）稀奇的，古怪的，奇异的；有病的，不舒服的；狡猾的，欺骗（性）的，可疑的，不光明 making you laugh；n 滑稽人物；笑话，有趣的故事；滑稽连环漫画栏；（英）（比赛用）单人双桨小艇

es.e: the funniest man in Britain
es.c: 英国最滑稽的男人

es.e: If this is your idea of a joke, I don’t find it at all funny .
es.c: 如果你觉得这是个玩笑，那我认为它一点也不好笑。

es.e: Luckily, when I explained the situation, he saw the funny side (= recognized that it was partly funny ) .
es.c: 好在我把情况解释了以后，他看到了好笑的一面。

d: n 皮，皮子；毛皮；软毛 the thick soft hair that covers the bodies of some animals, such as cats, dogs, and rabbits；v 用毛皮覆盖；使穿毛皮服装

es.e: a fur coat
es.c: 裘皮大衣

d: adj 家具，有家具的 A furnished room or house is available to be rented together with the furniture in it；v 供应；装备（furnish的过去分词）

es.e: We drank tea by lamplight in his sparsely furnished house.
es.c: 我们在他这间没什么家具的房子里，我们在灯下喝茶。

d: n 未来；前途；期货；将来时 what someone or something will do or what will happen to them in the future；adj 将来的，未来的 likely to happen or exist at a time after the present

es.e: The islands should have the right to decide their own future.
es.c: 这些岛屿应当有权决定自己的未来。

es.e: a leader who will shape the organization’s future
es.c: 将决定该组织未来的一位领导者

d: n 增加；利润；收获 an increase in the amount or level of something；v 获得；增加；赚到 to obtain or achieve something you want or need

es.e: The Democratic Party needed a net gain of only 20 votes.
es.c: 民主党只需要增20张选票。

es.e: Eating too many fatty foods could cause weight gain.
es.c: 过多食用高脂食物会导致体重增加。

d: n [气象] 大风，狂风；（突发的）一阵 a very strong wind

es.e: a severe gale
es.c: 一阵狂风

d: n 画廊；走廊；旁听席；地道 a small privately owned shop or studio where you can see and buy pieces of art；vt 在…修建走廊；在…挖地道；vi 挖地道
n 加仑（容量单位） a unit for measuring liquids, equal to eight pints. In Britain this is 4.55 litres, and in the US it is 3.79 litres.

es.e: a 20 gallon fish tank
es.c: 一个20加仑的鱼缸

es.e: The car does about 50 miles per gallon.
es.c: 这辆车每加仑油能开50英里左右。

d: n 游戏；比赛 a children’s activity in which they play with toys, pretend to be someone else etc；adj 勇敢的 If you are game for something, you are willing to do something new, unusual, or risky；v 赌博 to play games of chance for mo

es.e: The boys were playing a game in the backyard.
es.c: 男孩们在后院里玩游戏。

es.e: He said he's game for a similar challenge next year.
es.c: 他说明年他敢尝试一次类似的挑战。

d: n 车库；汽车修理厂；飞机库 a building for keeping a car in, usually next to or attached to a house；v 把……送入车库；把（汽车）开进车库 to put or keep a vehicle in a garage

es.e: I’ll just go and put the car in the garage.
es.c: 我把车停到车库去。

es.e: an automatic garage door
es.c: 车库自动门

d: n 垃圾；废物 waste material, such as paper, empty containers, and food thrown away

es.e: Can you take out the garbage when you go?
es.c: 你走的时候把垃圾带出去好吗？

d: n 花园；菜园 the area of land next to a house, where there are flowers, grass, and other plants, and often a place for people to sit；v 栽培花木

es.e: He’s outside in the garden.
es.c: 他在外面花园里。

es.e: Grace brought us some flowers from her garden.
es.c: 格雷丝给我们送来一些她花园里的花。

d: n 园艺；园林工人的工作 the activity of working in a garden, growing plants, cutting a lawn etc

es.e: I might do a bit of gardening this afternoon.
es.c: 今天下午我可能会干些园艺活。

d: n 大蒜；蒜头 a plant like a small onion, used in cooking to give a strong taste

es.e: Add a crushed clove of garlic (= single section of it ).
es.c: 加一瓣压碎的大蒜。

d: n 衣服，服装；外表，外观 a piece of clothing；v 给…穿衣服

es.e: She pulled the garment on and zipped it up.
es.c: 她穿上衣服并拉好拉链。

d: n 气体；[矿业] 瓦斯；汽油；毒气 a substance such as air, which is not solid or liquid, and usually cannot be seen；v 加油；毒（死）

es.e: hydrogen gas
es.c: 氢气

d: n 大门；出入口；门道 the part of a fence or outside wall that you can open and close so that you can enter or leave a place；v 给…装大门 to provide with a gate or gates

es.e: We went through the gate into the orchard.
es.c: 我们穿过大门进了果园。

es.e: the wrought-iron gates of the palace
es.c: 宫殿的锻铁大门

d: v 收集；收割；使…聚集；使…皱起 to come together and form a group, or to make people do this；n 聚集；衣褶；收获量 a small fold produced by pulling cloth together

es.e: A crowd gathered to watch the fight.
es.c: 一群人聚拢来围观打架。

es.e: Thousands of people gathered outside the embassy.
es.c: 大使馆外面聚集了数千人。

es.e: During the air raids, we gathered the children around us and sang songs.
es.c: 空袭期间，我们把孩子们聚集在身边唱歌。

d: adj 快乐的；放荡的；艳丽的 cheerful and excited；n 同性恋者 someone who is homosexual, especially a man

es.e: She felt excited and quite gay.
es.c: 她感到兴奋而快活。

d: adj 一般的，普通的；综合的；大体的 describing or relating to only the main features or parts of something, not the details；n 一般；将军，上将；常规 an officer of very high rank in the army or air force

es.e: a general introduction to computing
es.c: 计算机应用概论

es.e: I skimmed through it to get a general impression of the text.
es.c: 我把文章浏览了一下，让自己有个大致的了解。

es.e: I have a general idea of what I want to express.
es.c: 我对自己想要表达什么有个大致的想法。

d: n 一代；产生；一代人；生殖 all people of about the same age

es.e: Like most of my generation, I had never known a war.
es.c: 和我们这一代的大多数人一样，我并没有经历过战争。

es.e: In my generation the divorce rate is very high.
es.c: 我们这一代人离婚率很高。

es.e: the need to preserve the planet for future generations
es.c: 为子孙后代保护地球的必要性

d: adj 慷慨的，大方的；宽宏大量的；有雅量的 someone who is generous is willing to give money, spend time etc, in order to help people or give them pleasure

es.e: a generous glass of wine
es.c: 一大杯葡萄酒

d: adj 温和的；文雅的 kind and careful in the way you behave or do things, so that you do not hurt or damage anyone or anything；v 使温和，使驯服；n 蛆，饵

es.e: Arthur was a very gentle, caring person.
es.c: 阿瑟是一个非常温柔体贴的人。

d: n 先生；绅士；有身份的人 a polite word for a man, used especially when talking to or about a man you do not know

es.e: Could you serve this gentleman please, Miss Bath?
es.c: 巴思小姐，请你接待一下这位先生好吗？

es.e: Good morning, ladies and gentlemen .
es.c: 早上好，女士们，先生们。

es.e: An elderly gentleman was asleep next to the fire.
es.c: 一位老先生在火炉旁边睡着了。

d: n 地理；地形 the study of the countries, oceans, rivers, mountains, cities etc of the world

es.e: a geography lesson
es.c: 地理课

d: n 几何学 the study in  mathematics  of the angles and shapes formed by the relationships of lines, surfaces, and solid objects in space

es.e: ...the very ordered way in which mathematics and geometry describe nature.
es.c: …数学和几何学描述自然的条理性。

d: adj 德国的；德语的，德国人的 relating to Germany, its people, or its language；n 德语；德国人 someone from Germany

es.e: German history
es.c: 德国历史

d: n 德国

es.e: Germany borders on France.
es.c: 德国与法国接壤。

es.e: Bismarck ruled Germany by a strong hand.
es.c: 俾斯麦用铁腕手段统治德国。

es.e: The new Nazism is resurging in some places in Germany.
es.c: 新纳粹主义正在德国的一些地方复活。

d: n 姿态；手势 a movement of part of your body, especially your hands or head, to show what you mean or how you feel；v 作手势；用动作示意 to move your hand, arm, or head to tell someone something, or show them what you mean

es.e: Luke made an obscene gesture with his finger.
es.c: 卢克用手指做了一个下流的手势。

d: v 使得；获得；受到；变成 to obtain something by finding it, asking for it, or paying for it；n 生殖；幼兽

es.e: We need to get help quickly!
es.c: 我们需要马上得到帮助！

es.e: It would be a good idea to get professional advice.
es.c: 征求专业人士的意见，这个主意很好。

es.e: You may be able to get a grant from the local authority.
es.c: 你也许可以从当地政府获得拨款。

d: n 礼物；天赋；赠品 something that you give someone, for example to thank them or because you like them, especially on a special occasion；v 赋予；向…赠送

es.e: The earrings were a gift from my aunt.
es.c: 这副耳环是我姑姑送给我的礼物。

es.e: The clock was given as a retirement gift when he left the police.
es.c: 这个钟表是他退休离开警局时收到的礼物。

es.e: expensive wedding gifts
es.c: 昂贵的结婚礼物

d: adj 有天赋的；有才华的 having a natural ability to do one or more things extremely well；v 给予（gift的过去分词）

es.e: ...one of the most gifted players in the world.
es.c: …世界上最有天赋的运动员之一。

d: n 长颈鹿 a tall African animal with a very long neck and legs and dark spots on its yellow-brown fur

es.e: Can I get the mommy giraffe for Christmas?
es.c: 我在圣诞节能得到一个长颈鹿妈妈吗？

es.e: If so, find you a giraffe of some sort and put it out in the fall.
es.c: 如果是这样的话，拿出你的长颈鹿并把它在秋天里展示出来。

d: n 女孩；姑娘，未婚女子；女职员，女演员；（男人的）女朋友 a female child

es.e: Both boys and girls can apply to join the choir.
es.c: 男孩和女孩均可申请加入合唱团。

es.e: Girls! Please be quiet.
es.c: 姑娘们！请安静。

es.e: a teenage girl
es.c: 十几岁的女孩

d: v 给；产生；让步；举办；授予 to let someone have something as a present, or to provide something for someone；n 弹性；弯曲；伸展性 the ability of a material or substance to bend or stretch when put under pressure

es.e: Researchers were given a £10,000 grant to continue their work.
es.c: 研究人员得到一万英镑的经费以继续他们的研究。

es.e: I’ve got some old diaries that my grandmother gave me years ago.
es.c: 我有几本旧日记本，是多年前祖母给我的。

es.e: I didn’t steal it! Maria gave it to me!
es.c: 我不是偷的！是玛丽亚给我的！

d: adj 高兴的；乐意的；令人高兴的；灿烂美丽的 pleased and happy about something；vt 使高兴；n (Glad)人名；(塞、瑞典)格拉德；(英)格莱德；(法、挪)格拉

es.e: We’re so glad you came.
es.c: 你来了我们真高兴。

es.e: ‘I’ve decided to accept the job.’ ‘I’m glad.’
es.c: “我决定接受这份工作。”“我很高兴。”

d: n 一瞥；一滑；闪光 a quick look；v 扫视，匆匆一看；反光；瞥闪，瞥见 to quickly look at someone or something

es.e: He gave her a quick glance and smiled.
es.c: 他迅速地瞥了她一眼，笑了。

es.e: The brothers exchanged glances (= looked at each other quickly ) .
es.c: 兄弟俩互相瞥了一眼。

d: n 刺眼；耀眼的光；受公众注目 a bright unpleasant light which hurts your eyes；v 瞪眼表示

es.e: a special screen to reduce glare
es.c: 一种可以减弱刺眼强光的特殊屏幕

d: n 玻璃；玻璃制品；镜子 a transparent solid substance used for making windows, bottles etc；v 反映；给某物加玻璃

es.e: a glass bowl
es.c: 玻璃碗

es.e: a piece of broken glass
es.c: 一块碎玻璃片

es.e: the cathedral’s stained glass windows
es.c: 教堂的彩色玻璃窗

d: n 温室；暖房 a building made mainly of glass which is used for growing plants

es.e: BrightFarms, for example, together with a firm called Better Food Solutions, began constructing a large single-storey glasshouse on the roof of a big supermarket in October.
es.c: 比如，光明农场系统公司现在正在和一家名为“好上好食品”（BetterFood Solutions）的公司合作，自10月份开始在一家大超市的屋顶上建造一座单层的大温室。

es.e: The method is used commercially, especially for glasshouse crops, and also in experimental work in determining the effects of mineral deficiencies.
es.c: 此法经常在商业中使用，尤其是针对一些温室作物，或者用于验证矿质元素的缺乏对植物产生的影响的实验。

d: n 地球；地球仪；球体 a round object with a map of the Earth drawn on it；vt 使…成球形；vi 成球状

es.e: We export our goods all over the globe.
es.c: 我们的商品出口到世界各地。

d: n 光荣，荣誉；赞颂 the importance, honour, and praise that people give someone they admire a lot；v 自豪，骄傲；狂喜

es.e: She dreamt of future glory as an Olympic champion.
es.c: 她梦想着将来能得到奥运冠军的荣誉。

es.e: Goran’s moment of glory came when he defeated Rafter.
es.c: 戈兰击败拉夫特，迎来了荣耀的一刻。

es.e: He began the season in a blaze of glory , scoring seven goals in as many games.
es.c: 这个赛季一开始他便光芒四射，七场比赛进了七个球。

d: n 手套 a piece of clothing that you wear on your hand in order to protect it or keep it warm；vt 给…戴手套

es.e: a pair of gloves
es.c: 一副手套

es.e: boxing gloves
es.c: 拳击手套

d: v 粘合；似胶般固着于 to join two things together using glue；n 胶；各种胶合物 a sticky substance used for joining things together

es.e: Glue the fabric around the window.
es.c: 用胶把这布粘在窗户四周。

d: v 走；达到；运转；趋于 to move in a particular way, or to do something as you are moving；n 去；进行；尝试 an attempt to do something

es.e: The plate went crashing to the floor.
es.c: 盘子哗啦一声掉在地板上。

es.e: The bullet went flying over my head.
es.c: 子弹从我头顶飞过。

es.e: John went rushing off down the corridor.
es.c: 约翰沿走廊飞奔而去。

d: n 目标；球门，得分数；终点 something that you hope to achieve in the future；vi 攻门，射门得分

es.e: Your goal as a parent is to help your child become an independent adult.
es.c: 身为父母，你的目标就是要培养孩子成为独立的成年人。

d: n 山羊；替罪羊（美俚）；色鬼（美俚） an animal that has horns on top of its head and long hair under its chin, and can climb steep hills and rocks. Goats live wild in the mountains or are kept as farm animals.
n 神；（大写首字母时）上帝 the spirit or  being  who Christians, Jews, Muslims etc pray to, and who they believe created the universe；vt 膜拜，崇拜

es.e: Prayer is a way of talking to God.
es.c: 祈祷是同上帝交流的一种方式。

d: n 金，黄金；金色；金币 coins, jewellery etc made of gold；adj 金的，金制的；金色的 made of gold

es.e: She came to the party dripping with gold (= wearing a lot of gold ) .
es.c: 她披金戴银地来参加派对。

d: adj 金色的，黄金般的；珍贵的；金制的 having a bright yellow colour like gold；n (Golden)人名；(英、法、罗、德、瑞典)戈尔登

es.e: golden hair
es.c: 金发

es.e: golden sand
es.c: 金色的沙

d: n 高尔夫球；高尔夫球运动 a game in which the players hit a small white ball into holes in the ground with a set of golf clubs, using as few hits as possible；v 打高尔夫球

es.e: He plays golf on Sundays.
es.c: 他星期天都去打高尔夫球。

es.e: a round of golf
es.c: 一场高尔夫球赛

d: adj 好的；优良的；愉快的；虔诚的 of a high standard or quality；n 好处；善行；慷慨的行为 in order to help someone or improve a situation；adv 好 well. Many teachers think this is not correct English

es.e: a good hotel
es.c: 一家不错的宾馆

es.e: good quality cloth
es.c: 优质布料

es.e: The train service is not very good.
es.c: 火车服务不是很好。

d: int 天哪 said when you are surprised or sometimes angry；n 善良，优秀 ；精华，养分 the quality of being good

es.e: My goodness, you have spent a lot!
es.c: 啊呀，你花了这么多钱！

d: n 商品；动产；合意的人；真本领 things that are produced in order to be sold

es.e: the large market for consumer goods
es.c: 庞大的消费品市场

es.e: Britain’s leading exporter of manufactured goods
es.c: 英国主要的工业制成品出口商

es.e: There will be tax increases on a range of goods and services .
es.c: 有一些商品和服务将要增税。

d: n 鹅；鹅肉；傻瓜；雌鹅 the cooked meat of this bird；v 突然加大油门；嘘骂

es.e: ...roast goose.
es.c: …烤鹅。

d: v 管理；支配；统治；控制 to officially and legally control a country and make all the decisions about taxes, laws, public services etc；n (Govern)人名；(英)戈文

es.e: the leaders who govern the country
es.c: 治理这个国家的领导人

es.e: The party had been governing for seven months.
es.c: 该党执政已经有七个月了。

d: n 政府；政体；管辖 the group of people who govern a country or state

d: v 悬挂，垂下；装饰；绞死；使悬而未决 to kill someone by dropping them with a rope around their neck, or to die in this way, especially as a punishment for a serious crime；n 悬挂；暂停，中止

es.e: If he is found guilty, he will almost certainly hang.
es.c: 如果被判有罪，他几乎肯定会被处以绞刑。

d: v 发生；碰巧；偶然遇到 when something happens, there is an event, especially one that is not planned

es.e: When did the accident happen?
es.c: 事故什么时候发生的？

es.e: It’s impossible to predict what will happen next.
es.c: 不可能预测接下来会发生什么。

es.e: She carried on as if nothing had happened.
es.c: 她继续干，似乎什么都未曾发生。

d: adv 快乐地；幸福地；幸运地；恰当地 in a happy way

es.e: Michelle smiled happily.
es.c: 米歇尔高兴地笑了。

es.e: I’m a happily married man.
es.c: 我是个快乐的已婚男人。

es.e: So she married the prince, and they lived happily ever after (= used at the end of children’s stories to say that someone was happy for the rest of their life ).
es.c: 她嫁给了王子，他们从此过着幸福的生活。

d: n 幸福 the state of being happy

es.e: Juliet’s eyes shone with happiness.
es.c: 朱丽叶的双眼闪耀着幸福的光芒。

es.e: We want our children to have the best possible chance of happiness.
es.c: 我们希望自己的孩子得到追求幸福的最佳机会。

d: adj 幸福的；高兴的；巧妙的 having feelings of pleasure, for example because something good has happened to you or you are very satisfied with your life；n (Happy)人名；(英、瑞典、喀)哈皮

es.e: It’s a lovely house and we’ve been very happy here.
es.c: 房子很漂亮，我们住在这里非常开心。

es.e: I’ve never felt happier in my life.
es.c: 我一生从未感到如此快乐。

es.e: He was a happy child who rarely cried.
es.c: 他是一个快乐的孩子，很少哭鼻子。

d: v 藏匿；入港停泊；庇护 to protect and hide criminals that the police are searching for；n 海港（等于harbor）；避难所

es.e: Sinks and draining boards can harbour germs.
es.c: 洗涤槽和沥水板可能藏有病菌。

d: adj 努力的；硬的；困难的；辛苦的；确实的；严厉的；猛烈的；冷酷无情的 firm, stiff, and difficult to press down, break, or cut；adv 努力地；困难地；辛苦地；接近地；猛烈地；牢固地 using a lot of effort, energy, or attention；n (Hard)人名；(英、芬、瑞典)哈德

es.e: a hard wooden chair
es.c: 一把硬木椅

es.e: the hardest substance known to man
es.c: 已知的最硬物质

es.e: After months without rain, the ground was too hard to plough.
es.c: 数月无雨，土地坚硬难犁。

d: adv 几乎不，简直不；刚刚 almost not

es.e: My parents divorced when I was six, and I hardly knew my father.
es.c: 我六岁时父母离婚，我对父亲几乎一无所知。

es.e: The children were so excited they could hardly speak.
es.c: 孩子们兴奋得几乎连话都说不出来了。

es.e: I can hardly believe it.
es.c: 这简直让我难以置信。

d: n 困苦；苦难；艰难险阻 something that makes your life difficult or unpleasant, especially a lack of money, or the condition of having a difficult life

es.e: an economic policy that caused great hardship for many people
es.c: 造成许多人贫困的经济政策

es.e: Many students are suffering severe financial hardship.
es.c: 许多学生经济非常困难。

d: adj 努力工作的；不辞辛劳的，苦干的 If you describe someone as hardworking, you mean that they work very hard；v 努力工作（hardwork的ing形式）

es.e: He was hardworking and energetic.
es.c: 他很努力且精力充沛。

d: n 伤害；损害 damage, injury, or trouble caused by someone’s actions or by an event；v 伤害；危害；损害 to have a bad effect on something

es.e: The scandal did his career a lot of harm.
es.c: 丑闻对他的职业生涯造成很大损害。

es.e: Our children deserve protection from harm.
es.c: 我们的儿童理应得到保护免受伤害。

d: adj 有害的；能造成损害的 causing harm

es.e: the harmful effects of smoking
es.c: 吸烟的害处

d: adj 无害的；无恶意的 unable or unlikely to hurt anyone or cause damage

es.e: Her brother’s a bit simple, but he’s quite harmless.
es.c: 她的弟弟有点愚钝，不过他决不会伤害别人。

d: n 协调；和睦；融洽；调和 notes of music combined together in a pleasant way

es.e: the gorgeous vocal harmonies on ‘Mexicali Rose’
es.c: 《墨西哥玫瑰》的精彩和声演唱

es.e: three-part harmonies
es.c: 三部和声

d: n 收获；产量；结果 the time when crops are gathered from the fields, or the act of gathering them；v 收割；得到 to gather crops from the fields

es.e: The company is now reaping the harvest of careful planning.
es.c: 公司现在尝到了精心规划带来的甜头。

d: n 帽子 a piece of clothing that you wear on your head；v 给……戴上帽子

es.e: Maria was wearing a beautiful new hat.
es.c: 玛丽亚戴着一顶漂亮的新帽子。

d: n 孵化；舱口 a hole in a ship or aircraft, usually used for loading goods, or the door that covers it；v 孵；策划 if an egg hatches, or if it is hatched, it breaks, letting the young bird, insect etc come out

es.e: The problems do not end if crocodiles successfully hatch from the eggs.
es.c: 即使鳄鱼成功地从卵中孵化出来，这些问题也不会终止。

d: v 憎恨；厌恶；遗憾 to dislike someone very much and feel angry towards them；n 憎恨；反感 an angry unpleasant feeling that someone has when they hate someone and want to harm them

es.e: Why do you hate me so much?
es.c: 你为什么那么恨我？

d: v 有；让；拿；从事；允许 used with past participles to form perfect tenses；aux 已经 used with past participles to form perfect tenses；n (Have)人名；(芬)哈韦；(德)哈弗

es.e: Our guests have arrived.
es.c: 我们的客人到了。

es.e: Has anyone phoned?
es.c: 有人打过电话来吗？

es.e: We’ve been spending too much money.
es.c: 我们已经花掉太多钱了。

d: v 兜售，沿街叫卖；捕捉；咳出 to try to sell goods, usually by going from place to place and trying to persuade people to buy them；n 鹰；鹰派成员；掠夺他人的人 a large bird that hunts and eats small birds and animals
n 干草 long grass that has been cut and dried, used as food for cattle；v 把晒干 to cut, dry, and store (grass, clover, etc) as fodder

es.e: ...bales of hay.
es.c: …一捆捆的干草。

d: n 男孩，男人；它（雄性动物） used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is already known about；pron 他 used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is already known

es.e: ‘Where’s Paul?’ ‘He’s gone to the cinema.’
es.c: “保罗在哪儿？”“他去看电影了。”

es.e: It was he who first suggested the idea.
es.c: 是他先提出这个想法的。

d: n 头；头痛；上端；最前的部分；理解力 the top part of your body that has your face at the front and is supported by your neck；v 前进；用头顶；作为…的首领；站在…的前头；给…加标题 to go or travel towards a particular place, especially in a deliberate way；adj 头的；主

es.e: He kissed the top of her head.
es.c: 他吻了一下她的头顶。

es.e: Alan fell asleep as soon as he put his head on the pillow.
es.c: 艾伦头一挨枕头就睡着了。

es.e: They dived head first into the water.
es.c: 他们一头跳进水中。

d: n 头痛；麻烦；令人头痛之事 a pain in your head

es.e: If you have a headache, you should take some aspirin.
es.c: 要是头痛，你该吃点阿司匹林。

d: n 大标题；内容提要；栏外标题；头版头条新闻 the title of a newspaper report, which is printed in large letters above the report；v 给…加标题；使成为注意中心；大力宣传 to give a headline to an article or story

es.e: a paper carrying the front-page headline: ‘Space Aliens meet with President’
es.c: 头版报道题为“天外来客会见总统”的报纸

d: n 校长 a male teacher who is in charge of a school

es.e: This headmaster is very modest.
es.c: 这位校长很谦虚。

es.e: Our headmaster rattled on for at least two hours at the opening ceremony.
es.c: 我们的校长在开学典礼上唠唠叨叨地讲了至少两个小时。

d: n 女校长 a female teacher who is in charge of a school

es.e: "We've got life-size cutouts of William and Kate, " boasts one headmistress, claiming: "The children are really excited."
es.c: “我们制作了真人大小的威廉和凯特的人像，”一名女校长沾沾自喜地炫耀着：“孩子们可兴奋了。”

es.e: When I was growing up in the colony of Hong Kong, my British headmistress would glare when we asked to learn Chinese, and hiss: “If you want to learn Chinese, go onto the streets!”
es.c: 我成长在当时还是英国殖民地的香港，我的英籍女校长对我们要求学习中文的请求不屑一顾，并嘶声说道：“如果你想学习中文，就到街上去！”

es.e: In 1987 the school headmistress referred the case to the Institute of Child Health at University College London.
es.c: 1987年，学校校长将这些儿童的案例提交至伦敦大学学院儿童健康研究所。

d: n 中小学的校长

es.e: I know a number of parents have rung the headteacher about what has happened but I would appeal for everyone to be calm, particularly in relation to those people involved.
es.c: 我知道一些家长正围着校长问事情发生的经过，但我呼吁大家要保持冷静，特别是在那些跟这件事有直接关系的人。

d: n 健康；卫生；保健；兴旺 the general condition of your body and how healthy you are

es.e: I’m worried about my husband’s health.
es.c: 我担心我丈夫的健康状况。

d: adj 健康的，健全的；有益于健康的 physically strong and not likely to become ill or weak

es.e: a healthy baby boy
es.c: 健康的男婴

es.e: I’ve always been perfectly healthy until now.
es.c: 直到现在，我的身体一直非常健康。

d: n 堆；许多；累积 a large untidy pile of things；v 堆；堆积 to put a lot of things on top of each other in an untidy way

es.e: a rubbish heap
es.c: 垃圾堆

es.e: We piled the branches into heaps for burning.
es.c: 我们把树枝堆起来烧。

d: v 听到，听；听说；审理 to know that a sound is being made, using your ears

es.e: Blanche heard a crash as the back door was flung open.
es.c: 布兰奇听见后门哗啦一声被推开。

es.e: Did anyone see or hear anything last night?
es.c: 昨晚有没有人看见或听见什么？

es.e: Old Zeke doesn’t hear too well any more.
es.c: 老齐克的耳朵已不灵了。

d: n 听力；审讯，听讯 the sense which you use to hear sounds；v 听见（hear的ing形式）

es.e: a child with a hearing disability
es.c: 有听力障碍的儿童

d: n 心脏；感情；勇气；心形；要点 the organ in your chest which pumps blood through your body；vt 鼓励；铭记；vi 结心

es.e: Regular exercise is good for the heart.
es.c: 经常锻炼对心脏有好处。

es.e: Can you hear my heart beating?
es.c: 你能听见我的心跳吗？

es.e: Her cheeks were hot and her heart was pounding.
es.c: 她脸颊发烫，心怦怦直跳。

d: n 高温；压力；热度；热烈 warmth or the quality of being hot；v 使激动；把…加热 to make something become warm or hot

es.e: Ice needs heat to melt.
es.c: 冰需要热才能融化。

es.e: Insulating the attic is a good way to reduce heat loss.
es.c: 为阁楼安装隔热层是减少热量流失的好方法。

d: n 天堂；天空；极乐 the place where God is believed to live and where good people are believed to go when they die

es.e: He looked up towards the heavens.
es.c: 他仰望苍穹。

d: adv 沉重地；猛烈地；沉闷地 If someone says something heavily, they say it in a slow way which shows a feeling such as sadness, tiredness, or annoyance

es.e: "I didn't even think about her," he said heavily.
es.c: “我根本都没想到过她，”他沉重地说道。

d: adj 沉重的；繁重的，巨大的；拥挤的；阴沉的 weighing a lot；n 重物；严肃角色；adv 大量地；笨重地

es.e: The wardrobe was too heavy for me to move on my own.
es.c: 衣橱太重，我一个人移不动。

es.e: a heavy suitcase
es.c: 沉重的手提箱

es.e: The males are seven times heavier than the females.
es.c: 雄性的重量是雌性的七倍。

d: n 脚后跟；踵 the curved back part of your foot；v 倾侧 (of a vessel) to lean over; list

es.e: black boots with high heels
es.c: 有高跟的黑靴子

d: n 高地；高度；身高；顶点 how tall someone or something is

es.e: Sam’s about the same height as his sister now.
es.c: 萨姆现在身高和他姐姐差不多了。

es.e: State your age, height, and weight.
es.c: 说出你的年龄、身高和体重。

es.e: buildings of different heights
es.c: 高矮不一的建筑

d: n [航] 直升飞机 a type of aircraft with large metal blades on top which turn around very quickly to make it fly；vi [航] 乘直升飞机；vt 由直升机运送

es.e: You can helicopter to the island.
es.c: 你可以乘坐直升机去那个岛。

es.e: The helicopter is staying over our heads.
es.c: 那架直升机就在我们头顶的上方。

es.e: They were succoured from the fire by the rescue helicopter.
es.c: 他们被援救的直升机从大火中解救了出来。

d: int 喂；哈罗 used as a greeting when you see or meet someone；n 表示问候， 惊奇或唤起注意时的用语

es.e: Hello, John! How are you?
es.c: 喂，约翰！你好吗？

es.e: Stanley, come and say hello to your nephew.
es.c: 斯坦利，过来和你的侄子打声招呼。

es.e: Well, hello there ! I haven’t seen you for ages.
es.c: 嗨，你好！好久不见了。

d: n 钢盔，头盔 a strong hard hat that soldiers,  motorcycle  riders, the police etc wear to protect their heads

es.e: The Sword split the Knight's helmet and bit him fatally.
es.c: 剑劈开了骑士的头盔并致命地刺进他。

es.e: Instead, he was told the last time that she loved him, got a hug from her, put his helmet on her so that she can live, and die himself...
es.c: 相反，他叫女孩最后一次说她爱他，最后一次拥抱他，并让她戴上自己的头盔，因而，女孩可以幸免于难，而他自己却离开了人世……

es.e: Without Christ we are defenseless against the Devil, but with "the helmet of salvation" our minds are protected by God.
es.c: 没有基督，我们无力防御魔鬼的攻击；但有救恩的头盔，我们的心思便有神的保护。

d: v 帮助；促进；治疗；补救 to make it possible or easier for someone to do something by doing part of their work or by giving them something they need；n 帮助；补救办法；帮忙者；有益的东西 things you do to make it easier or possible for someone to do

es.e: If there’s anything I can do to help, just give me a call.
es.c: 如果需要我帮忙，就给我打个电话。

d: adj 有帮助的；有益的 providing useful help in making a situation better or easier

es.e: Thank you for your advice; it’s been very helpful.
es.c: 谢谢你的建议，它非常有用。

es.e: It is helpful if we address a few key questions here.
es.c: 如果我们在这里解决一些关键问题会很有用的。

d: n 母鸡；女人；雌禽 an adult female chicken

es.e: The hen sits in the hencoop [henroost].
es.c: 母鸡卧窝。

d: pron 她（she的宾格）；她的（she的所有格）；她（指某个国家；一艘船） used to refer to a woman, girl, or female animal that has already been mentioned or is already known about；n （法）埃尔（人名）

es.e: Jane? I don’t really know her.
es.c: 简？我不太认识她。

es.e: Margaret wants me to go with her.
es.c: 玛格丽特想让我和她一起去。

es.e: Give her the keys.
es.c: 把钥匙给她。

d: n 香草，药草 a small plant that is used to improve the taste of food, or to make medicine

es.e: Sprinkle the dish with chopped fresh herbs.
es.c: 在菜肴上撒些切碎的新鲜香草。

d: adv 在这里；此时 in this place；int 嘿！；喂！；n 这里

es.e: What are you doing here?
es.c: 你们在这里干什么？

es.e: Shall we eat here?
es.c: 我们在这里吃好吗？

es.e: Come here for a minute.
es.c: 到这里来一下。

d: n 英雄；男主角，男主人公 a man who is admired for doing something extremely brave

es.e: He had dared to speak out against injustice, and overnight he became a national hero .
es.c: 他敢于站出来抨击不公正的现象，一夜之间就成了国家英雄。

es.e: His father was a war hero , a former fighter pilot.
es.c: 他父亲是一位战争英雄，曾经是战斗机飞行员。

es.e: the unsung heroes who drove convoys of aid to Bosnia
es.c: 运载援助物品到波斯尼亚的那些无名英雄

d: n 女主角；女英雄；女杰出人物 a woman who is admired for doing something extremely brave

es.e: The heroine is a senior TV executive.
es.c: 女主人公是一位电视台高级主管。

d: pron 她的（所有格） used to refer to something that belongs to or is connected with a woman, girl, or female animal that has already been mentioned；n (Hers)人名；(法)埃尔

es.e: He bent and touched his mouth to hers.
es.c: 他俯身吻她的嘴唇。

es.e: These are my gloves. Hers are in the drawer.
es.c: 这是我的手套，她的在抽屉里。

es.e: The idea was hers.
es.c: 这个主意是她出的。

d: pron 她自己（she的反身代词）；她亲自 used to show that the woman or girl who does something is affected by her own action

es.e: She cut herself on some broken glass.
es.c: 碎玻璃把她割伤了。

es.e: She made herself a cup of coffee.
es.c: 她给自己煮了杯咖啡。

d: int 喂！（引起注意等）；你好！（表示问候） a shout used to get someone’s attention or to show surprise, interest, or annoyance；n 干草（等于hay）

es.e: Hey, wait a minute!
es.c: 喂，等一下！

d: int 嗨！（表示问候或用以唤起注意） hello；n (Hi)人名；(柬)希

es.e: Hi! How are you?
es.c: 嗨！你好吗？

es.e: Hi there! I haven’t seen you for ages.
es.c: 嘿！好久不见。

d: v 过冬；（动物）冬眠；（人等）避寒 if an animal hibernates, it sleeps for the whole winter

es.e: Dormice hibernate from October to May.
es.c: 睡鼠从10月到5月冬眠。

d: n 冬眠；过冬；避寒

es.e: Heart rate tracking for three of the Alaska bears showed a drop from 55 beats per minute on average before hibernation to 14 erratic ones per minute in winter.
es.c: 对三头阿拉斯加的黑熊的心率追踪显示出它们在冬眠前的平均每分钟 55 下降低到了冬天里每分钟飘忽不定的 14 下。

d: v 隐藏；隐瞒；鞭打 to deliberately put or keep something or someone in a place where they cannot easily be seen or found；n 躲藏；兽皮；躲藏处 an animal’s skin, especially when it has been removed to be used for leather

es.e: She keeps a bottle of gin hidden behind a stack of books.
es.c: 她在一堆书的后面藏了一瓶杜松子酒。

d: adj 高的；高级的；崇高的；高音调的 measuring a long distance from the bottom to the top；n 高水平；天空；由麻醉品引起的快感；高压地带 the highest price, number, temperature etc that has ever been recorded, or that has been recorded within a particular perio

es.e: This is the highest mountain in Japan.
es.c: 这是日本最高的山。

es.e: The camp was surrounded by a high fence.
es.c: 营地四周围着高高的栅栏。

es.e: a ten-foot high statue
es.c: 10英尺高的雕像

d: n 公路，大路；捷径 a wide main road that joins one town to another

es.e: Interstate Highway 75
es.c: 75号州际公路

d: n 小山；丘陵；斜坡；山冈 an area of land that is higher than the land around it, like a mountain but smaller

es.e: Their house is on a hill overlooking the sea.
es.c: 他们的房子建在可以俯视大海的小山上。

es.e: A cart was making its way up the hill.
es.c: 一辆马车正在爬上山丘。

d: n 山坡，山腹；山腰 the sloping side of a hill
adj 丘陵的；陡的；多小山的；多坡的 having a lot of hills；n (Hilly)人名；(阿拉伯)希利

es.e: The areas where the fighting is taking place are hilly and densely wooded.
es.c: 战斗发生的地区丘陵起伏，树木茂密。

d: pron 他（宾格） used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is already known about；n (Him)人名；(东南亚国家华语)欣；(柬)亨；(中)谦(广东话·威妥玛)

es.e: Are you in love with him?
es.c: 你爱上他了吗？

es.e: Why don’t you ask him yourself?
es.c: 你为什么不自己问他？

es.e: He repeated what she had told him.
es.c: 他把她告诉他的话重复了一遍。

d: pron 他自己；他亲自，他本人
n 雇用，租用；租金，工钱 an arrangement in which you pay a sum of money to borrow something for a short time；v 雇用；出租 to pay money to borrow something for a short period of time

es.e: a car hire company
es.c: 汽车租赁公司

d: pron 他的；n (His)人名；(法)伊斯

es.e: That should be his mother.
es.c: 那大概是他的母亲。

es.e: He stated his views to me.
es.c: 他向我说明了他的观点。

d: n 历史，历史学；历史记录；来历 all the things that happened in the past, especially the political, social, or economic development of a nation

es.e: Throughout history the achievements of women have been largely ignored.
es.c: 从古至今，妇女的成就都被大大地忽视了。

es.e: No man in recent history has done more to rebuild the Democratic Party.
es.c: 他对重建民主党的贡献在近代史上无人能及。

es.e: the early history of Scotland
es.c: 苏格兰的早期历史

d: v 打击；袭击；碰撞；偶然发现；伤…的感情 to touch someone or something quickly and hard with your hand, a stick etc；n 打；打击；（演出等）成功；讽刺 Hit is also a noun

es.e: He raised the hammer and hit the bell.
es.c: 他举起钟锤敲钟。

es.e: First a house took a direct hit and then the rocket exploded.
es.c: 首先一幢房子被直接击中，接着火箭弹爆炸了。

d: v 群居；入蜂房；生活在蜂房中；n 蜂房，蜂巢；热闹的场所；熙攘喧闹的人群 a place that is full of people who are very busy

es.e: This marketplace was once a hive of activity.
es.c: 这个市场曾经熙熙攘攘。

d: n 嗜好；业余爱好 an activity that you enjoy doing in your free time

es.e: What are your hobbies?
es.c: 你有些什么爱好？

es.e: Susan’s hobbies include reading, cooking, and drama.
es.c: 苏珊的业余爱好包括阅读、烹饪和戏剧。

es.e: Retirement gave him the time to pursue his hobbies.
es.c: 退休以后他有充裕的时间来做自己喜欢做的事。

d: v 持有；拥有；保存；拘留；约束或控制 to keep something to be used when it is needed；n 控制；保留 control, power, or influence over something or someone

es.e: Further copies of the book are held in the library.
es.c: 这本书在图书馆还存有一些。

es.e: Weapons were held at various sites.
es.c: 武器存放在不同地点。

d: n 洞，孔；洞穴，穴；突破口 an empty space in something solid；v 凿洞，穿孔；（高尔夫球等）进洞

es.e: I began digging a hole for the plant.
es.c: 我开始挖洞种那棵植物。

d: n 假日；节日；休息日 a time of rest from work, school etc；v 外出度假 to spend your holiday in a place - used especially in news reports

es.e: The school holidays start tomorrow.
es.c: 学校假期从明天开始。

d: adj 圣洁的，神圣的；至善的 connected with God and religion；n 神圣的东西

es.e: the holy city of Varanasi
es.c: 圣城瓦拉纳西

d: n 家，住宅；产地；家乡；避难所 the house, apartment, or place where you live；adv 在家，回家；深入地 to or at the place where you live；adj 国内的，家庭的；有效的 relating to or belonging to your home or family；v 归巢，回家 to or at the place where you live

es.e: They have a beautiful home in California.
es.c: 他们在加州有个美丽的家。

es.e: Good luck in your new home!
es.c: 祝你在新家一切顺利！

es.e: A family of birds made their home (= started living ) under the roof.
es.c: 一窝鸟在屋顶下安了家。

d: n 祖国；故乡 the country where someone was born

es.e: Many are planning to return to their homeland.
es.c: 很多人正计划回到自己的祖国去。

d: n 家乡；故乡 Someone's hometown is the town where they live or the town that they come from

es.e: Do you like your hometown?
es.c: 你喜欢你的家乡吗？

es.e: She expressed the wish to be interred in the graveyard of hometown.
es.c: 她表达了死后葬在故乡的墓地上的愿望。

d: n 家庭作业，课外作业 work that a student at school is asked to do at home

es.e: For homework, finish the exercise on page 14.
es.c: 家庭作业是完成第14页的练习。

d: adj 诚实的，实在的；可靠的；坦率的 someone who is honest always tells the truth and does not cheat or steal

es.e: He was a hard-working, honest man.
es.c: 他勤奋老实。

es.e: Ann had an honest face.
es.c: 安有一张诚实的面孔。

d: n 蜂蜜；宝贝；甜蜜 a sweet sticky substance produced by  bees  , used as food；adj 甘美的；蜂蜜似的；v 对…说甜言蜜语；加蜜使甜

es.e: Hi, honey.
es.c: 嗨，亲爱的。

d: n 荣誉；尊敬；勋章 the respect that you, your family, your country etc receive from other people, which makes you feel proud；v 尊敬；[金融] 承兑；承兑远期票据 to treat someone with special respect

es.e: He was showered with honours – among them an Oscar.
es.c: 他获得了很多荣誉–其中包括奥斯卡奖。

d: n 挂钩，吊钩 a curved piece of metal or plastic that you use for hanging things on；v 钩住；引上钩 to bend your finger, arm, or leg, especially so that you can pull or hold something else

es.e: Tom hung his coat on the hook behind the door.
es.c: 汤姆把外套挂在门后的衣钩上。

d: vi 呼万岁；vt 呼万岁；n 万岁；int 万岁

es.e: If that worked, hooray! If not, soldier on to the next step.
es.c: 如果这样行得通，万岁！如果还不行，那就迎着困难进行下一步吧

es.e: Some people have referred to documentaries like Blue Planet and Planet Earth as 'wildlife porn' – and I'd say hooray to that if it inspires viewers to get out into the natural world.
es.c: 有些人把《蓝色星球》和《行星地球》这样的纪录片称之为‘野生生命情色片’——如果它们能激发观众亲近自然，那我会为这样的情色高呼万岁。

d: n 希望；期望；信心 a feeling of wanting something to happen or be true and believing that it is possible or likely；v 希望；期望 to want something to happen or be true and to believe that it is possible or likely

es.e: When I first arrived in New York, I was full of hope for the future.
es.c: 我初到纽约时，对未来充满希望。

d: adj 有希望的；有前途的 believing that what you hope for is likely to happen；n 有希望成功的人 someone who is hoping to be successful, especially in acting, sports, politics etc

es.e: The vote is a hopeful sign that attitudes in the church are changing.
es.c: 投票结果是个好兆头，表明教会的态度正在转变。

d: adj 可怕的；极讨厌的 very bad - used, for example, about things you see, taste, or smell, or about the weather

es.e: The weather has been really horrible all week.
es.c: 整个星期天气都很糟。

es.e: a horrible smell
es.c: 极难闻的气味

es.e: The food looked horrible, but it tasted OK.
es.c: 那食物看上去很糟，可吃起来还不错。

d: n 马；骑兵；脚架；海洛因 a large strong animal that people ride and use for pulling heavy things；v 使骑马；系马于；捉弄

es.e: a horse and cart
es.c: 一辆马车

es.e: Lee had never ridden a horse before.
es.c: 李以前从未骑过马。

d: n 医院 a large building where sick or injured people receive medical treatment

es.e: They are building a new hospital.
es.c: 他们正在建一家新医院。

d: n [计] 主机；主人；主持人；许多 someone at a party, meal etc who has invited the guests and who provides the food, drink etc；v 主持；当主人招待 to introduce a radio or television programme

es.e: Our host greeted us at the door.
es.c: 主人在门口迎接我们。

d: n 女主人，女老板；女服务员；舞女；女房东 a woman at a party, meal etc who has invited all the guests and provides them with food, drink etc

es.e: The hostess introduced them.
es.c: 女主人介绍了他们。

d: adj 热的；辣的；热情的；激动的；紧迫的 food that tastes hot has a burning taste because it contains strong spices；adv 热；紧迫地；v 变热；n (Hot)人名；(塞)霍特；(法)奥特

es.e: a hot curry
es.c: 一种辛辣的咖喱

d: n 旅馆，饭店；客栈 a building where people pay to stay and eat meals；vt 使…在饭店下榻；vi 进行旅馆式办公

es.e: I’ve booked the flights and the hotel.
es.c: 我已订好机票和酒店。

es.e: We’ll be staying at the Hotel Ibis.
es.c: 我们将住在宜必思酒店。

d: n 小时；钟头；课时；…点钟 a unit for measuring time. There are 60 minutes in one hour, and 24 hours in one day.

es.e: The interview will last about two hours.
es.c: 面试大概要持续两小时。

es.e: I study for an hour every night.
es.c: 我每晚学习一小时。

es.e: I’ll be back in three hours .
es.c: 我三小时以后回来。

d: n 住宅；家庭；机构；议会；某种用途的建筑物 a group of people who make the laws of a country；v 覆盖；给…房子住；把…储藏在房内 to provide someone with a place to live

es.e: The president will address both houses of Congress.
es.c: 总统将向参众两院发表讲话。

es.e: the speaker of the house
es.c: 议会议长

d: n 家庭主妇 a married woman who works at home doing the cooking, cleaning etc, but does not have a job outside the house

es.e: Married at nineteen, she was a traditional housewife and mother of four children.
es.c: 她19岁就结婚了，是个传统的家庭主妇和4个孩子的母亲。

d: n 家务事 work that you do to take care of a house, for example washing, cleaning etc

es.e: Men are doing more housework nowadays.
es.c: 现今男人正在承担越来越多的家务。

d: adv 如何；多少；多么 used to ask or talk about the way in which something happens or is done；n 方法；方式 the way a thing is done；conj 如何

es.e: How do you spell your name?
es.c: 你的名字怎么拼写？

es.e: How can I help you?
es.c: 我怎么帮你？

es.e: I’d like to help in some way, but I’m not sure how.
es.c: 我想帮点忙，可不知道该怎么做。

d: adv 无论如何；不管怎样（接副词或形容词）；然而；可是 used when you are adding a fact or piece of information that seems surprising, or seems very different from what you have just said；conj 无论以何种方式; 不管怎样 in whatever way

es.e: This is a cheap and simple process. However, there are dangers.
es.c: 这是个花钱少而又简单的方法，不过有危险。

es.e: an extremely unpleasant disease that is, however, easy to treat
es.c: 一种让人极其难受却容易治疗的病

d: v 咆哮；怒吼；狂吠 to make a long loud cry because you are unhappy, angry, or in pain, or because you are amused or excited；n 嗥叫；怒号；嚎哭 a long loud sound made by a dog,  wolf  , or other animal

es.e: Upstairs, one of the twins began to howl (= cry ) .
es.c: 楼上，双胞胎中的一个开始大哭起来。

es.e: He makes audiences howl with laughter .
es.c: 他令观众哈哈大笑。

d: v 拥抱；紧抱；抱有，坚持 to put your arms around someone and hold them tightly to show love or friendship；n 拥抱；紧抱；固执 the action of putting your arms around someone and holding them tightly to show love or friendship

es.e: We stood there crying and hugging each other.
es.c: 我们站在那里哭着互相拥抱。

es.e: She went to her daughter and hugged her tightly .
es.c: 她走到女儿身边，紧紧地拥抱她。

d: adj 巨大的；庞大的；无限的 extremely large in size, amount, or degree；n (Huge)人名；(英)休奇

es.e: a huge dog
es.c: 一条大狗

es.e: huge crowds
es.c: 大群大群的人

es.e: Your room’s huge compared to mine.
es.c: 你的房间跟我的比很大。

d: adj 人的；人类的 belonging to or relating to people, especially as opposed to machines or animals；n 人；人类 a person

es.e: There are many different cell types in the human body .
es.c: 人体中有许多种不同的细胞类型。

es.e: the power of the human mind
es.c: 人脑的威力

es.e: The desire for joy lies deep within the human spirit .
es.c: 对快乐的渴求藏在人类心灵深处。

d: adj 诙谐的，幽默的；滑稽的，可笑的 funny and enjoyable

es.e: humorous stories
es.c: 诙谐的故事

es.e: The film has some mildly humorous moments.
es.c: 那部电影中有些略显幽默的片段。

d: n 幽默（等于humor）；诙谐 the ability or tendency to think that things are funny, or funny things you say that show you have this ability；v 迁就；使满足 to do what someone wants or to pretend to agree with them so that they do not beco

es.e: his humour and charm
es.c: 他的幽默感和魅力

es.e: Greg’s feeble attempt at humour
es.c: 格雷格干巴巴的幽默

es.e: English humour
es.c: 英国式幽默

d: n 一百；许多 a very large number of things or people；adj 一百的；许多的；num 百；百个 completely

es.e: Plank down your one hundred dollars.
es.c: 立即支付一百美元。

d: n 饿，饥饿；渴望 lack of food, especially for a long period of time, that can cause illness or death；v 渴望；挨饿 If you say that someone hungers for something or hungers after it, you are emphasizing that they want it very much

es.e: Try to satisfy your hunger by eating some fruit.
es.c: 吃些水果充充饥吧。

es.e: But Jules was not eager for classroom learning, he hungered for adventure.
es.c: 但是朱尔斯并不热衷于课堂学习，他渴望冒险。

d: adj 饥饿的；渴望的；荒年的；不毛的 wanting to eat something

es.e: I was cold, tired, and hungry.
es.c: 我又冷，又累，又饿。

es.e: If you get hungry , there’s some cold chicken in the fridge.
es.c: 你要是饿了，冰箱里有些冷鸡肉。

es.e: Do you still feel hungry?
es.c: 你还觉得饿吗？

d: v 打猎；搜索 to hunt  foxes  as a sport, riding on horses and using dogs；n 狩猎；搜寻 an occasion when people chase animals in order to kill or catch them

es.e: A forensic team was hunting for clues.
es.c: 法医小组正在搜寻线索。

d: n 猎人；猎犬；搜寻者 a person who hunts wild animals, or an animal that hunts other animals for food

es.e: The hunters stalked their prey.
es.c: 猎人们隐伏跟踪猎物。

d: abbr 飓风（hurricane）
n 飓风，暴风 a storm that has very strong fast winds and that moves over water

es.e: The hurricane devastated a large section of the coast.
es.c: 飓风毁坏了沿海地区的大部分。

es.e: The hurricane demage was assessed at three million dollars.
es.c: 飓风损害赔偿金的金额被确定为三百万美元。

es.e: The building can accommodate all of the offshore workers and protect them from hurricane damage.
es.c: 这个建筑能容纳所有的海上工人并且保护他们不受飓风的伤害。

d: n 匆忙，急忙 more quickly than usual；v 仓促（做某事）；催促；（朝某方向）迅速移动；迅速处理 to make someone do something more quickly

es.e: Sorry, I can’t stop, I’m in a hurry.
es.c: 对不起，我不能停下，我赶时间。

es.e: You’ll make mistakes if you do things in too much of a hurry.
es.c: 做事太仓促会出错。

d: v 节约地使用（或管理） to be very careful in the way you use your money, supplies etc and not waste any；n 丈夫 the man that a woman is married to

es.e: Have you met my husband Roy?
es.c: 你见过我的丈夫罗伊吗？

d: n [化学] 氢 Hydrogen is a colourless gas that is the lightest and commonest element in the universe

es.e: Water contains hydrogen and oxygen.
es.c: 水含有氢和氧。

es.e: Water can be reduced to oxygen and hydrogen by electrolysis.
es.c: 水通过电解可以分解为氧和氢。

es.e: The first bubbles to escape from the liquid are a mixture of air and hydrogen.
es.c: 从该液体中最先逸出的气泡是空气和氢的混合物。

d: pron 我 used by the person speaking or writing to refer to himself or herself；n 碘元素；英语字母I

es.e: I moved to this city six years ago.
es.c: 六年前我搬到了这个城市。

es.e: I’m not late again, am I?
es.c: 我没有又迟到吧？

es.e: My husband and I enjoy going to the theatre.
es.c: 我和丈夫喜欢去剧院看戏。

d: n 冰；冰淇淋；矜持；（俚）钻石 water that has frozen into a solid state；v 冰镇；结冰；adj 冰的

es.e: Would you like some ice in your drink?
es.c: 你饮料中要放点冰块吗？

es.e: Her hands were as cold as ice.
es.c: 她双手冰冷。

es.e: The city spent $7 million to remove snow and ice from the roads.
es.c: 市政府花费了700万美元用于清除路上的冰雪。

d: n 冰岛（欧洲岛名，在大西洋北部，近北极圈）

es.e: WHICH country will be the next Iceland?
es.c: 哪个国家会成为下一个冰岛？

es.e: Austria and Turkey beat out Iceland for the two seats allocated to this region.
es.c: 奥地利和土耳其击败冰岛赢得该地区分配到的两个席位。

d: n 想法；主意；概念 a plan or suggestion for a possible course of action, especially one that you think of suddenly

es.e: You should talk to Ken – he's always full of good ideas.
es.c: 你应该和肯谈谈，他总是满脑子好主意。

es.e: I knew it was a bad idea to leave him on his own.
es.c: 我知道把他独自留下不是个好主意。

es.e: It was my wife’s idea to move house.
es.c: 要搬家是我妻子的主意。

d: n 鉴定，识别；认同；身份证明 official papers or cards, such as your passport, that prove who you are

es.e: Do you have any identification?
es.c: 你有什么身份证明文件吗？

es.e: fingerprinting as a means of identification
es.c: 作为一种身份证明方式的指纹提取

d: n 身份；同一性，一致；特性；恒等式 someone’s identity is their name or who they are

es.e: The identity of the killer is still unknown.
es.c: 凶手的身份仍未查明。

d: n 成语，习语；土话 a group of words that has a special meaning that is different from the ordinary meaning of each separate word. For example, ‘under the weather’ is an idiom meaning ‘ill’.

es.e: the new musical idiom
es.c: 新的音乐风格

d: conj （表条件）如果；即使；是否；（表假设）假如 used when talking about something that might happen or be true, or might have happened；n 条件；设想 used when saying what someone’s feelings are about a possible situation

es.e: We’ll stay at home if it rains.
es.c: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里。

es.e: If you need money, I can lend you some.
es.c: 如果你需要钱，我能借给你一些。

es.e: If I didn’t apologize, I’d feel guilty.
es.c: 如果我不道歉，我会感到内疚。

d: v 驳回诉讼；忽视；不理睬 to deliberately pay no attention to something that you have been told or that you know about

es.e: You can’t ignore the fact that many criminals never go to prison.
es.c: 你不能无视很多罪犯从未获刑的事实。

es.e: problems which we can’t afford to ignore
es.c: 我们不能置之不理的问题

d: adj 生病的；坏的；邪恶的；不吉利的 suffering from a disease or not feeling well；adv 不利地；恶劣地；几乎不 Ill means the same as "badly."；n 疾病；不幸

es.e: Bridget can’t come – she’s ill.
es.c: 布里奇特不能来了，她生病了。

es.e: I was feeling ill that day and decided to stay at home.
es.c: 我那天不太舒服，决定留在家里。

es.e: a hospice for the terminally ill
es.c: 晚期病人的安养院

d: adj [法] 非法的；违法的；违反规则的 not allowed by the law；n 非法移民，非法劳工 an illegal immigrant

es.e: illegal drugs
es.c: 违禁药品

es.e: They were involved in illegal activities.
es.c: 他们参与了非法活动。

d: n 病；疾病 a disease of the body or mind, or the condition of being ill

es.e: She had all the normal childhood illnesses.
es.c: 儿童的常见病她小时候都得过。

es.e: Her mother was recovering from a serious illness.
es.c: 她母亲重病后正在逐渐康复。

es.e: I’ve never missed a day’s work through illness.
es.c: 我从未因病耽误过一天工作。

d: v 想像；猜想；臆断 to form a picture or idea in your mind about what something could be like

es.e: Perhaps she’d never really been there at all – perhaps she’d just imagined it.
es.c: 可能她从未到过那儿——也许这都是她的幻想。

d: adj 立即的；直接的；最接近的 happening or done at once and without delay

es.e: Our immediate response to the attack was sheer horror.
es.c: 我们对攻击的第一反应就是非常惊恐。

es.e: They promise immediate action to help the unemployed.
es.c: 他们承诺立即采取行动帮助失业者。

es.e: If the eyes are affected, seek immediate medical attention.
es.c: 如果眼睛感染了要立即就医。

d: adv 立即，立刻；直接地 without delay；conj 一…就 as soon as

es.e: Mix in the remaining ingredients and serve immediately.
es.c: 拌入余下的食材，立即上桌。

es.e: The telephone rang, and he answered it immediately.
es.c: 电话铃响了，他马上去接。

d: n 外来移民；移居 the process of entering another country in order to live there permanently

es.e: He called for a common European policy on immigration.
es.c: 他要求欧洲国家实施共同的移民政策。

d: n 进口，进口货；输入；意思，含义；重要性；v 输入，进口；含…的意思
n 价值；重要；重大；傲慢 the quality of being important

es.e: He was full of his own importance (= he behaved in an annoying way which showed that he thought he was very important ).
es.c: 他自以为很了不起。

d: adj 重要的，重大的；有地位的；有权力的 an important event, decision, problem etc has a big effect or influence on people’s lives or on events in the future

es.e: a very important meeting
es.c: 很重要的会议

es.e: The accident taught him an important lesson.
es.c: 那次事故给了他很大的教训。

es.e: Happiness is more important than money.
es.c: 快乐比金钱更重要。

d: adj 不可能的；不可能存在的；难以忍受的；不真实的 something that is impossible cannot happen or be done；n 不可能；不可能的事 something that cannot be done

es.e: ‘I want to speak to Mr Franks.’ ‘I’m afraid that’s impossible.’
es.c: “我想和弗兰克斯先生谈谈。”“恐怕不行。”

es.e: It’s impossible to be accurate about these things.
es.c: 这些事情不可能准确无误。

es.e: The noise made sleep impossible.
es.c: 噪音吵得人无法睡觉。

d: v 盖印；强征；传送；给予某人深刻印象 to commandeer or coerce (men or things) into government service; press-gang；n 印象，印记；特征，痕迹

es.e: Steve borrowed his dad’s sports car to impress his girlfriend.
es.c: 史蒂夫借来他爸爸的跑车向女友炫耀。

d: n 印象；效果，影响；压痕，印记；感想；曝光（衡量广告被显示的次数。打开一个带有该广告的网页，则该广告的impression 次数增加一次） the opinion or feeling you have about someone or something because of the way they seem

es.e: When we looked around the school we got a very good impression.
es.c: 我们参观了学校，对它的印象很好。

es.e: I got the impression that she wasn’t very happy with her job.
es.c: 我有这样的印象，她的工作干得并不愉快。

d: v 改善，增进；提高…的价值 to make something better, or to become better

es.e: a course for students wishing to improve their English
es.c: 为想提高英语水平的学生开设的一门课

es.e: The doctors say she is improving (= after being ill ).
es.c: 医生说她正在康复。

es.e: You could use the money for improving your home.
es.c: 你可以用这笔钱改善家居。

d: prep 按照（表示方式）；从事于；在…之内 used with the name of a container, place, or area to say where someone or something is；adv 进入；当选；（服装等）时髦；在屋里 inside or into a building, especially your home or the place where you work；adj 在里面的；时髦的

es.e: There’s some sugar in the cupboard.
es.c: 碗橱里有一些糖。

es.e: My mother was in the kitchen.
es.c: 我母亲在厨房里。

es.e: He took us for a drive in his new car.
es.c: 他开着他的新车载我们去兜风。

d: n 英寸；身高；少许 a unit for measuring length, equal to 2.54 centimetres. There are 12 inches in a foot.；v 使缓慢地移动 to move very slowly in a particular direction, or to make something do this

es.e: The curtains were an inch too short.
es.c: 窗帘短了一英寸。

es.e: Rainfall here is under 15 inches a year.
es.c: 本地的年降雨量不到15英寸。

d: n 事件，事变；插曲 an event, especially one that is unusual, important, or violent；adj [光] 入射的；附带的；易发生的，伴随而来的

es.e: Am I at risk because of some incident in my sexual past?
es.c: 我过去性生活中的某件事会使我处于危险境地吗？

es.e: Roads were sealed off because of a major incident.
es.c: 因为发生重大事故，道路被封锁了。

d: v 包含，包括 if one thing includes another, the second thing is part of the first

es.e: Does the price include postage?
es.c: 这个价格包含邮费吗？

es.e: His job includes looking after under-21 teams.
es.c: 他的职责包括照管21岁以下球队。

es.e: The curriculum includes courses in computing.
es.c: 课程内容包括计算机技术。

d: n 收入，收益；所得 the money that you earn from your work or that you receive from investments, the government etc

es.e: low-income families
es.c: 低收入家庭

d: adj 错误的，不正确的；不适当的；不真实的 not correct or true

es.e: The information you gave us was incorrect.
es.c: 你给我们的信息不准确。

d: n 增加，增长；提高 a rise in amount, number, or degree；v 增加，增大；繁殖 if you increase something, or if it increases, it becomes bigger in amount, number, or degree

es.e: Recent tax increases have affected the poor more than the rich.
es.c: 新近的增税对穷人的影响比对富人的大。

es.e: the dramatic increase in the population aged over 65
es.c: 65岁以上人口的急剧增加

es.e: There has been a marked increase in the use of firearms.
es.c: 使用枪支的人数显著增加了。

d: adv 的确；实在；真正地；甚至 used to emphasize a statement or answer；int 真的（表示惊讶、怀疑、讽刺等）

es.e: The blood tests prove that Vince is indeed the father.
es.c: 验血证明文斯确实是父亲。

es.e: ‘Would it help if you had an assistant?’ ‘It would indeed.’
es.c: “你要是有个助手，会有帮助吗？”“那是肯定的。

d: n 独立性，自立性；自主 political freedom from control by the government of another country

es.e: The country has made great advances since independence.
es.c: 该国自独立以来发展迅速。

d: adj 独立的；单独的；无党派的；不受约束的 an independent organization is not owned or controlled by, or does not receive money from, another organization or the government；n 独立自主者；无党派者 An independent is an independent politician

es.e: There are plans to split the corporation into a number of smaller independent companies.
es.c: 有计划要把这家大企业分割成一些独立的小公司。

es.e: an independent charity
es.c: 独立的慈善机构

es.e: small independent bookshops
es.c: 私营小书店

d: n 印度（南亚国家）

es.e: Burma borders on India.
es.c: 缅甸与印度毗邻。

es.e: This book treats of the caste system in India.
es.c: 这本书论述了印度的种姓制度。

es.e: If you come to India for just one thing, this should be it.
es.c: 如果你只为一件事来到印度，那就到这儿来吧。

d: adj 印度的；印第安人的；印第安语的 relating to India or its people；n 印度人；印第安人；印第安语 someone from India

es.e: ...the Indian government.
es.c: ...印度政府。

d: v 表明；指出；预示；象征 If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists

es.e: A survey of retired people has indicated that most are independent and enjoying life.
es.c: 一项对退休人员的调查表明，他们中的大部分人生活自立而愉快。

es.e: Our vote today indicates a change in United States policy.
es.c: 我们今天的投票表明了美国政策的变化。

d: n 产业；工业；勤勉 businesses that produce a particular type of thing or provide a particular service

es.e: I work in the oil industry.
es.c: 我在石油行业工作。

es.e: Italy’s thriving tourist industry
es.c: 意大利蓬勃发展的旅游业

d: n 影响；势力；感化；有影响的人或事 the power to affect the way someone or something develops, behaves, or thinks, without using direct force or orders；v 影响；改变 to affect the way someone or something develops, behaves, thinks etc without

es.e: As a scientist, his influence was immense.
es.c: 身为一名科学家，他的影响力极大。

d: v 通知；告诉；报告 to officially tell someone about something or give them information

es.e: They decided to inform the police.
es.c: 他们决定通知警察。

d: n 信息，资料；知识；情报；通知 facts or details that tell you something about a situation, person, event etc

es.e: I need more information.
es.c: 我需要更多信息。

d: adj 最初的；字首的 happening at the beginning；v 用姓名的首字母签名 to write your initials on a document to make it official or to show that you agree with something；n 词首大写字母 the first letter of someone’s first name

es.e: an initial investment of £5,000
es.c: 5,000英镑的初始投资

es.e: The initial response has been encouraging.
es.c: 最初的反应情况很乐观。

d: v 伤害，损害 to say unfair or unpleasant things that hurt someone’s pride, feelings etc

es.e: A number of bombs have exploded, seriously injuring at least five people.
es.c: 一些炸弹爆炸了，至少5人严重受伤。

d: v 签署；涂墨水于 to put ink on something；n 墨水，墨汁；油墨 a coloured liquid that you use for writing, printing or drawing

es.e: The two companies have inked a deal.
es.c: 这两家公司签署了一项协议。

d: n 内地；内陆；adj 内陆的；内地的；国内的 an inland area, city etc is not near the coast；adv 在内地；向内地；向内陆；在内陆 in a direction away from the coast and towards the centre of a country

es.e: The next day, we drove inland.
es.c: 第二天，我们乘车开往内陆。

es.e: We beached the boat and headed inland.
es.c: 我们想使船靠岸，朝内陆方向驶去。

es.e: In 1985 a glacier buried this shore; since then the ice has retreated a half mile inland.
es.c: 1985年，一座冰川在海滨融化，自那时起冰川已经向内陆退缩了半英里。

d: n 客栈；旅馆 a small hotel or pub, especially an old one in the countryside；vi 住旅馆

es.e: We’re staying at the Holiday Inn.
es.c: 我们住在假日酒店。

d: adj 无辜的；无罪的；无知的 not guilty of a crime；n 天真的人；笨蛋 An innocent is someone who is innocent

es.e: Nobody would believe that I was innocent.
es.c: 没人肯相信我是清白的。

es.e: The court found him innocent and he was released.
es.c: 法庭判他无罪，他被释放了。

es.e: She had always regarded Greg as a hopeless innocent where women were concerned.
es.c: 她过去一直认为格雷格在关于女人方面是一个不可救药的无知者。

d: n 昆虫；卑鄙的人 a small creature such as a fly or ant, that has six legs, and sometimes wings

es.e: an insect bite
es.c: 昆虫的叮咬

es.e: flying insects
es.c: 飞虫

es.e: Don’t forget to bring insect repellant (= a chemical to keep insects away ).
es.c: 不要忘记带上驱虫剂。

d: v 插入；嵌入 to put something inside or into something else；n 插入物；管芯；镶块；[机械]刀片 something that is designed to be put inside something else

es.e: He took a small key from his pocket and slowly inserted it into the lock.
es.c: 他从衣袋里掏出一把小钥匙，然后缓缓地将其插入锁孔里。

d: n 里面；内部；内情；内脏 the inner part of something, which is surrounded or hidden by the outer part；adj 里面的；内部的；秘密的 in or facing the inner part of something；adv 在里面 in or into a container or other closed space so as to be complet

es.e: The door had been locked from the inside.
es.c: 门从里面锁上了。

d: v 坚持，强调 to demand that something should happen

es.e: Stay for supper – I insist!
es.c: 留下来吃晚餐——一定的！

d: v 检查；视察；检阅 to examine something carefully in order to find out more about it or to find out what is wrong with it

es.e: I got out of the car to inspect the damage.
es.c: 我下车查看损坏情况。

es.e: Police inspected the scene and interviewed all the staff.
es.c: 警察仔细检查了现场并询问了所有员工。

d: v 激发；鼓舞；启示；产生；使生灵感 to encourage someone by making them feel confident and eager to do something

es.e: We need someone who can inspire the team.
es.c: 我们需要一个能鼓舞团队士气的人。

es.e: Inspired by the sunny weather, I decided to explore the woods.
es.c: 阳光明媚的天气令人振奋，我决定到森林里寻幽探胜。

d: adj 立即的；紧急的；紧迫的 happening or produced immediately；n 瞬间；立即；片刻 a moment

es.e: an instant success
es.c: 马到成功

es.e: a system that provides instant access to client information
es.c: 能立即查到客户信息的系统

es.e: The women took an instant dislike to one another.
es.c: 这些女人立刻就彼此厌恶起来。

d: adv 代替；反而；相反 used to say what is not used, does not happen etc, when something else is used, happens etc

es.e: You probably picked up my keys instead of yours.
es.c: 你可能没拿你的钥匙而错拿了我的。

es.e: Could I have tuna instead of ham?
es.c: 我可否要金枪鱼来代替火腿？

es.e: Instead of being annoyed, he seemed quite pleased.
es.c: 他没有生气，反而似乎很高兴。

d: v 开始（调查）；制定；创立；提起（诉讼） to introduce or start a system, rule, legal process etc；n 学会，协会；学院 an organization that has a particular purpose such as scientific or educational work, or the building where this organization is ba

es.e: We had no choice but to institute court proceedings against the airline.
es.c: 我们别无选择，只能对航空公司提起诉讼。

d: n 制度；建立；（社会或宗教等）公共机构；习俗 a large organization that has a particular kind of work or purpose

es.e: powerful institutions such as world banks
es.c: 诸如世界银行之类的强大机构

es.e: the Institution of Electrical Engineers
es.c: 电机工程师学会

d: v 指导；通知；命令；教授 to officially tell someone what to do

es.e: Eva went straight to the hotel, as instructed (= as she had been told ).
es.c: 伊娃按照指示径直去了宾馆。

d: n 指令，命令；指示；教导；用法说明 the written information that tells you how to do or use something

es.e: Press ‘Enter’ and follow the on-screen instructions.
es.c: 按回车键，然后按照电脑屏幕上的指示来操作。

d: n 仪器；工具；乐器；手段；器械 a small tool used in work such as science or medicine

es.e: surgical instruments
es.c: 外科(手术)器械

d: n 保险；保险费；保险契约；赔偿金 an arrangement with a company in which you pay them money, especially regularly, and they pay the costs if something bad happens, for example if you become ill or your car is damaged

es.e: Your father took out insurance to cover the mortgage.
es.c: 你父亲购买了抵押借款保险。

d: v 确保，保证；给…保险 to buy insurance so that you will receive money if something bad happens to you, your family, your possessions etc

es.e: Have you insured the contents of your home?
es.c: 你给家庭财产投保了吗？

d: n 智力；情报工作；情报机关；理解力；才智，智慧；天分 the ability to learn, understand, and think about things

es.e: To be good at the game, you need a reasonable level of intelligence.
es.c: 要想把这种游戏玩好，需要一定的智力水平。

d: n 意图；目的；意向；愈合 a plan or desire to do something

es.e: They went into town with the intention of visiting the library.
es.c: 他们进了城，打算参观图书馆。

d: n 兴趣，爱好；利息；趣味；同行 if you have an interest in something or someone, you want to know or learn more about them；v 使……感兴趣；引起……的关心；使……参与 to make someone want to pay attention to something and find out more about it

es.e: I watched the first few episodes, but soon lost interest.
es.c: 我看了前几集，但很快就失去了兴趣。

es.e: The last round of bidding aroused considerable interest.
es.c: 最后一轮竞价引起人们相当大的兴趣。

es.e: Our survey reveals a disturbing lack of interest in teacher training.
es.c: 我们的调查显示人们对教师培训失去了兴趣，这很令人不安。

d: adj 有趣的；引起兴趣的，令人关注的 if something is interesting, you give it your attention because it seems unusual or exciting or provides information that you did not know about

es.e: That’s an interesting question.
es.c: 那是一个有趣的问题。

es.e: a really interesting TV programme
es.c: 十分有趣的电视节目

es.e: Did you meet any interesting people?
es.c: 你见过什么有意思的人吗？

d: n 国际组织；国际体育比赛；外国居留者；国际股票 an international sports game；adj 国际的；两国（或以上）国家的；超越国界的；国际关系的；世界的 relating to or involving more than one nation

es.e: the response of the international community
es.c: 国际社会的反响

es.e: the UN and other international organizations
es.c: 联合国和其他国际组织

d: n 因特网
n 解释者；口译者；注释器 someone who changes spoken words from one language into an-other, especially as their job

es.e: Speaking through an interpreter (= using an interpreter ), Ahmed said, ‘I’m very worried about my wife and children.’
es.c: 艾哈迈德通过口译者说:“我很担心我的妻子和孩子们。”

d: v 中断；打断；插嘴；妨碍 to stop someone from continuing what they are saying or doing by suddenly speaking to them, making a noise etc；n 中断

es.e: Will you stop interrupting me!
es.c: 别打断我的话！

es.e: Sorry to interrupt, but I need to ask you to come downstairs.
es.c: 很抱歉打扰了，我得请你下楼来。

d: n 间隔；间距；幕间休息 the period of time between two events, activities etc

es.e: He left the room, returning after a short interval with a message.
es.c: 他离开房间，过了一会儿就带回来一条消息。

d: n 接见，采访；面试，面谈 a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out whether they are suitable for a job, course of study etc；v 采访；接见；对…进行面谈；对某人进行面试 to ask someone questions during an interview

es.e: a portfolio of work presented at interview
es.c: 在面试时呈递的工作成果样本

d: prep 到…里；深入…之中；成为…状况；进入到…之内 to the inside or inner part of a container, place, area etc；n (Into)人名；(芬、英)因托

es.e: Come into the office.
es.c: 到办公室里来。

es.e: He thrust his hand into his coat pocket.
es.c: 他把手插进大衣口袋里。

es.e: There must be another way into the cave.
es.c: 一定有其他的路可以进入洞穴。

d: v 介绍；引进；提出；采用 if you introduce someone to another person, you tell them each other’s names for the first time

es.e: Have you two been introduced? Tom, this is Greg.
es.c: 有人给你们俩互相介绍了吗？汤姆，这位是格雷格。

d: n 介绍；引进；采用；入门；传入 the act of bringing something into use for the first time

es.e: The book is a friendly, down-to-earth introduction to physics.
es.c: 这是一本简明、实用的物理学入门书。

d: v 发明；创造；虚构 to make, design, or think of a new type of thing

es.e: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone in 1876.
es.c: 亚历山大 · 格雷厄姆 · 贝尔于1876年发明了电话。

d: n 发明；发明物；虚构；发明才能 a useful machine, tool, instrument etc that has been invented

es.e: The dishwasher is a wonderful invention.
es.c: 洗碗机是一项奇妙的发明。
