d: n 主要部分，要点；体力；总管道 gas, water, or electricity supplied to a building through a pipe or wire；adj 主要的，最重要的；全力的 larger or more important than all other things, ideas etc of the same kind

es.e: The heater will run off mains gas or bottled gas.
es.c: 热水器使用管道煤气或罐装煤气均可。

d: n 大陆；本土 the main area of land that forms a country, as compared to islands near it that are also part of that country；adj 大陆的；本土的

es.e: flights between a Greek island and the mainland
es.c: 希腊一海岛和本土之间的航班

d: adj 主要的；重要的；主修的；较多的 having very serious or worrying results；n [人类] 成年人；主修科目；陆军少校 an officer of middle rank in the British or US army or  marine s  ,or in the US air force；v 主修

es.e: There is a major problem with parking in London.
es.c: 在伦敦，停车是个很大的问题。

es.e: The loss of their goalkeeper through injury was a major setback for the team.
es.c: 守门员因伤缺阵使该队的实力大打折扣。

es.e: He underwent major heart surgery recently.
es.c: 他最近做了心脏大手术。

d: n 多数；成年 most of the people or things in a group

es.e: The Labour Party won a huge majority at the last general election.
es.c: 工党在上次大选中以巨大的票数优势获胜。

d: v 使得；进行；布置，准备，整理；制造；认为；获得；形成；安排；引起；构成 to produce something, for example by putting the different parts of it together；n 制造；构造；性情

es.e: I’m going to show you how to make a box for your tools.
es.c: 我来教你怎么做一个箱子存放工具。

es.e: A family of mice had made their nest in the roof.
es.c: 一窝老鼠在屋顶上安了家。

es.e: She made her own wedding dress.
es.c: 她的婚纱是自己做的。

d: adj 男性的；雄性的；有力的 typical of or relating to men or boys；n 男人；雄性动物 a male animal

es.e: a deep male voice
es.c: 低沉的男声

es.e: traditional male values
es.c: 传统的男性价值观

es.e: Motor-racing has largely been a male preserve (= something that only men have been involved with ) .
es.c: 赛车基本上是男人的专利。

d: n 人；男人；人类；丈夫；雇工 an adult male human；v 操纵；给…配置人员；使增强勇气；在…就位 to work at, use, or ope-rate a system, piece of equipment etc

es.e: There were two men and a woman in the car.
es.c: 车上有两男一女。

es.e: He’s a very kind man.
es.c: 他是个非常和蔼的人。

es.e: a man’s watch
es.c: 男式手表

d: v 管理；经营；控制；设法 to direct or control a business or department and the people, equipment, and money involved in it

es.e: He was asked to manage a new department.
es.c: 他被要求去管理一个新的部门。

es.e: Managing a football team is harder than you think.
es.c: 管理一支足球队比你想象的要难。

es.e: The company had been very badly managed.
es.c: 公司管理非常糟糕。

d: n 经理；管理人员 someone whose job is to manage part or all of a company or other organization

es.e: one of our regional managers
es.c: 我们的一位地区经理

es.e: a middle manager in a computer company
es.c: 一家计算机公司的中层管理人员

d: n 人类；男性 all humans considered as a group

es.e: Since earliest times, mankind has been fascinated by fire.
es.c: 人类自远古以来就对火很感兴趣。

es.e: one of the most important events in the history of mankind
es.c: 人类历史上最重要的事件之一

d: n 方式；习惯；种类；规矩；风俗 the way in which something is done or happens

es.e: He felt some guilt over the manner of her death.
es.c: 她以这种方式死去，他心里有些内疚。

es.e: The issue will be resolved in a manner that is fair to both sides.
es.c: 这个问题将用对双方都公平的方式来解决。

es.e: criticism of the manner in which the bishop was appointed
es.c: 对主教任命方式的批评

d: pron 许多；许多人 The many means a large group of people, especially the ordinary people in society, considered as separate from a particular small group；adj 许多的 Many is also an adjective；n (Many)人名；(法)马尼

es.e: The printing press gave power to a few to change the world for the many.
es.c: 印刷机赋予了少数人为多数人改变世界的力量。

es.e: Among his many hobbies was the breeding of fine horses.
es.c: 在他的众多爱好中有饲养名马。

d: v 映射；计划；绘制地图；确定基因在染色体中的位置 to make a map of a particular area；n 地图；示意图；染色体图 a drawing of a particular area, for example a city or country, which shows its main features, such as its roads, rivers, mountains etc

es.e: He spent the next fifteen years mapping the Isle of Anglesey.
es.c: 他在后来的十五年里绘制了安格尔西岛的地图。

d: n 枫树；淡棕色 a tree which grows mainly in northern countries such as Canada. Its leaves have five points and turn red or gold in autumn.

es.e: ...a solid maple worktop.
es.c: …一张结实的枫木工作台。

d: n 马拉松赛跑；耐力的考验 a long race of about 26 miles or 42 kilometres；adj 马拉松式的；有耐力的 a marathon event continues for a long time and needs a lot of energy, patience, or determination；vi 参加马拉松赛跑

es.e: the Boston Marathon
es.c: 波士顿马拉松赛

es.e: Garcia ran the marathon in just under three hours.
es.c: 加西亚用了不到三小时就跑完了马拉松。

d: n 大理石；大理石制品；弹珠 a type of hard rock that becomes smooth when it is polished, and is used for making buildings,  statue s  etc；adj 大理石的；冷酷无情的

es.e: The columns were of white marble.
es.c: 柱子是白色的大理石。

es.e: a marble statue
es.c: 大理石雕像

d: n 三月 the third month of the year, between February and April

es.e: I flew to Milwaukee in early March.
es.c: 我3月初飞到了密尔沃基。

d: v （坚定地向某地）前进；行军，进军；游行示威；进展，进行 if soldiers or other people march somewhere, they walk there quickly with firm regular steps；n 行进，前进；行军；游行示威；进行曲 an organized event in which many people walk together to express their ideas

es.e: An estimated 5,000 people marched through the city to demonstrate against the factory closures.
es.c: 大约有五千人在市里游行示威，抗议关闭工厂。

d: n 标志；马克；符号；痕迹；分数 a cut, hole, or other small sign of damage；v 作记号 to write or draw on something, so that someone will notice what you have written

es.e: I can’t get these marks out of my T-shirt.
es.c: 我无法把我T恤衫上的这些污迹去掉。

d: n 市场；行情；股票市场；市面；集市；销路；商店 a particular country or area where a company sells its goods or where a particular type of goods is sold；v 在市场上出售 to make a product available in shops

es.e: Our main overseas market is Japan.
es.c: 我们的主要海外市场是日本。

d: n 结婚；婚姻生活；密切结合，合并 the relationship between two people who are married, or the state of being married

es.e: She has three daughters from a previous marriage.
es.c: 她前一次婚姻生了三个女儿。

d: adj 已婚的，有配偶的；婚姻的，夫妇的；密切结合的 having a husband or a wife；n 已婚者；v 结婚，与…结婚（marry的过去式）

es.e: Are you married or single?
es.c: 你是已婚还是单身？

es.e: They’ve been married for eight years.
es.c: 他们已经结婚八年了。

es.e: Married men earn 70 percent more than single men.
es.c: 已婚男子比单身男子多挣70%。

d: v 嫁；娶；与……结婚 if you marry someone, you become their husband or wife；n (Marry)人名；(阿拉伯)马雷；(法)马里

es.e: He married Bea in 1925.
es.c: 他在1925年娶了贝亚。

es.e: I’m going to ask her to marry me on St Valentine’s Day.
es.c: 我打算在情人节向她求婚。

es.e: She married young (= at a young age ) .
es.c: 她结婚早。

d: n 面具；口罩；掩饰 something that covers all or part of your face, to protect or to hide it；v 掩饰；戴面具；化装 to hide your feelings or the truth about a situation

es.e: a surgical face mask
es.c: 外科手术口罩

es.e: He was attacked and robbed by two people wearing masks .
es.c: 他被两个蒙面人袭击并抢劫。

d: n 块，团；群众，民众；大量，众多；质量 a large crowd；adj 群众的，民众的；大规模的，集中的 involving or intended for a very large number of people；v 聚集起来，聚集 to come together, or to make people or things come together, in a large group

es.e: The road was blocked by a solid mass of protesters.
es.c: 道路被密密麻麻的抗议者阻塞了。

d: v 控制；精通；征服 to learn a skill or a language so well that you have no difficulty with it；n 硕士；主人；大师；教师 someone who is very skilled at something；adj 主人的；主要的；熟练的 most important or main

es.e: the skills needed to master a new language
es.c: 掌握一门新语言所需的技能

es.e: I never quite mastered the art of walking in high heels.
es.c: 我一直学不会穿高跟鞋走路。

d: n 垫；垫子；衬边 a small piece of thick rough material which covers part of a floor；v 缠结；铺席于……上 to tangle or weave or become tangled or woven into a dense mass；adj 无光泽的

es.e: Wipe your feet on the mat.
es.c: 在地垫上蹭蹭你的鞋底。

d: v 使比赛；使相配；敌得过，比得上；相配；与…竞争 if one thing matches another, or if two things match, they look attractive together because they are a similar colour, pattern etc；n 比赛，竞赛；匹配；对手；火柴 an organized sports event between two teams or

es.e: We painted the cabinets green to match the rug.
es.c: 我们把柜子刷成绿色，和地毯相配。

es.e: Do you think this outfit matches?
es.c: 你认为这套衣服配吗？

es.e: a beech dining table with four chairs to match (= chairs that match it )
es.c: 配有四把椅子的山毛榉餐桌

d: adj 重要的；物质的，实质性的；肉体的 relating to the real world and physical objects, rather than religious or  spiritual  things；n 材料，原料；物资；布料 cloth used for making clothes, curtains etc

es.e: According to some, the material world is all that exists.
es.c: 有些人认为，物质世界就是存在的一切。

d: n 数学；数学运算 the science of numbers and of shapes, including  algebra  ,  geometry  , and  arithmetic

es.e: ...a professor of mathematics at Boston College.
es.c: …一位波士顿大学的数学教授。

d: n 物质；事件 the material that everything in the universe is made of, including solids, liquids, and gases；v 有关系；要紧 to be important, especially to be important to you, or to have an effect on what happens

es.e: particles of matter
es.c: 物质的微粒

d: adj 成熟的；充分考虑的；到期的；成年人的 someone, especially a child or young person, who is mature behaves in a sensible and reasonable way, as you would expect an adult to behave；v 成熟；到期 to become fully grown or developed

es.e: Laura is very mature for her age .
es.c: 相对她的年龄来说劳拉是很成熟的。

es.e: We’re mature enough to disagree on this issue but still respect each other.
es.c: 我们都很成熟，尽管我们对此事意见不同，但还是彼此尊重。

d: n [数] 极大，最大限度；最大量 the largest number or amount that is possible or is allowed；adj 最高的；最多的；最大极限的 the maximum amount, quantity, speed etc is the largest that is possible or allowed

es.e: We might have a third child, but that’s the absolute maximum .
es.c: 我们可能会要第三个孩子，但这绝对是极限了。

d: n 五月 the fifth month of the year, between April and June

es.e: Graduation ceremonies are held in early May.
es.c: 毕业典礼在5月初举行。

d: aux 可以，能够；可能，也许；祝，愿；会，能
adv 也许；可能；大概 used to say that something may happen or may be true but you are not certain；n 可能性；不确定性

es.e: Maybe it’s all just a big misunderstanding.
es.c: 也许这只是一个很大的误会。

es.e: ‘Do you think he’ll come back?’ ‘Maybe.’
es.c: “你认为他会回来吗？”“也许会吧。”

es.e: Maybe they’re right, but maybe not .
es.c: 也许他们是对的，但也许不是。

d: pron 我（宾格） used by the person speaking or writing to refer to himself or herself；n 自我；极端自私的人；自我的一部分 used by the person speaking or writing to refer to himself or herself

es.e: Stop, you’re hurting me.
es.c: 住手，你弄疼我了。

es.e: He bought me a drink.
es.c: 他给我买了一杯酒。

es.e: Give that book to me.
es.c: 把那本书给我。

d: n 一餐，一顿饭；膳食 an occasion when you eat food, for example breakfast or dinner, or the food that you eat on that occasion；vi 进餐

es.e: We must have a meal together some time.
es.c: 我们一定要找个时间一起吃顿饭。

es.e: Dinner is the main meal of the day for most people.
es.c: 晚饭是大多数人一天中的主餐。

d: adj 平均的；卑鄙的；低劣的；吝啬的 not wanting to spend money, or not wanting to use much of something；v 意味；想要；意欲 to intend to do something or intend that someone else should do something；n 平均值 the average amount, figure, or value

es.e: He’s too mean to buy a present for his wife.
es.c: 他很吝啬，给他妻子买件礼物都不肯。

d: n 意义；含义；意图 the thing or idea that a word, expression, or sign represents；adj 意味深长的；v 意味；意思是（mean的ing形式）

es.e: Life seemed to have lost its meaning since Janet’s death.
es.c: 珍妮特去世以后生活似乎失去了意义。

d: n 手段；方法；财产 a way of doing or achieving something；v 意思是；打算（mean的第三人称单数） [ 复数means ]

es.e: The only means of communication was sign language.
es.c: 唯一的交流方法是手语。

es.e: The window was our only means of escape .
es.c: 跳窗是我们唯一的逃生方法。

es.e: Do you have any means of identification ?
es.c: 你有什么身份证明文件吗？

d: adv 同时，其间 while something else is happening；n 其间，其时

es.e: Cook the sauce over a medium heat until it thickens. Meanwhile start boiling the water for the pasta.
es.c: 用中火把调味汁煮到变稠，同时烧水准备煮意大利面。

d: n 测量；措施；程度；尺寸 an action, especially an official one, that is intended to deal with a particular problem；v 测量；估量；权衡 to find the size, length, or amount of something, using standard units such as  inch es  ,metres etc

es.e: New safety measures were being demanded after last night’s horrific train crash.
es.c: 昨晚发生严重的火车相撞事故后，民众要求制定新的安全措施。

es.e: The new bridge was erected as a temporary measure to replace the one which was destroyed by floods.
es.c: 建这座新桥是为了临时代替被洪水毁坏的那座桥。

d: n 肉，肉类（食用） the flesh of animals and birds eaten as food

es.e: I gave up eating meat a few months ago.
es.c: 我几个月以前开始不吃肉了。

es.e: raw meat
es.c: 生肉

es.e: a meat pie
es.c: 肉馅饼

d: n 勋章，奖章；纪念章 a flat piece of metal, usually shaped like a coin, that is given to someone who has won a competition or who has done something brave

es.e: She won a gold medal at the last Olympics.
es.c: 她在上届奥运会上赢得一枚金牌。

es.e: The two boys were awarded medals for their bravery.
es.c: 这两个男孩因勇敢而获得勋章。

d: n 媒体；媒质（medium的复数）；血管中层；浊塞音；中脉 all the organizations, such as television, radio, and newspapers, that provide news and information for the public, or the people who do this work

es.e: The scandal was widely reported in the national media .
es.c: 这一丑闻在全国媒体上被广泛报道。

es.e: The role of the news media in forming public opinion is very important.
es.c: 新闻媒体对于社会舆论的形成具有非常重要的作用。

es.e: The 11-day trial generated intense media interest .
es.c: 11天的审讯引起了媒体的高度关注。

d: adj 医学的；药的；内科的 relating to medicine and the treatment of disease or injury；n 医生；体格检查 an examination of your body by a doctor to see if you are healthy

es.e: medical research
es.c: 医学研究

es.e: medical staff
es.c: 医务人员

es.e: a medical student
es.c: 医科学生

d: n 药；医学；内科；巫术 a substance used for treating illness, especially a liquid you drink；v 用药物治疗；给…用药

es.e: Medicines should be kept out of the reach of children.
es.c: 药应放在孩子够不到的地方。

es.e: Have you been taking your medicine ?
es.c: 你一直在服药吗？

es.e: a medicine bottle
es.c: 药瓶

d: adj 中间的，中等的；半生熟的 of middle size, level, or amount；n 方法；媒体；媒介；中间物 a way of communicating information and news to people, such as newspapers, television etc

es.e: What size shirt does he wear – small, medium or large?
es.c: 他穿多大尺码的衬衫——小号、中号还是大号？

es.e: hair of medium length
es.c: 中等长短的头发

es.e: Fry the onions over a medium heat until they are golden.
es.c: 用中火把洋葱炸到金黄色。

d: v 满足；遇见；对付 to see someone by chance and talk to them；n 集会 a sports competition between people running races, jumping over bars etc；adj 合适的；适宜的 right or suitable

es.e: You’ll never guess who I met in town.
es.c: 你绝对猜不出我在镇上碰到谁了。

es.e: I was worried I might meet Henry on the bus.
es.c: 我担心可能会在公共汽车上遇到亨利。

d: n 会议；会见；集会；汇合点 an event at which people meet to discuss and decide things；v 会面；会合（meet的ing形式）

es.e: We’re having a meeting next week to discuss the matter.
es.c: 我们下周将开会讨论此事。

d: n 瓜；甜瓜；大肚子；圆鼓鼓像瓜似的东西 a large round fruit with sweet juicy flesh

es.e: ...some juicy slices of melon.
es.c: …几片多汁的甜瓜。

d: n 成员；会员；议员 a person or country that belongs to a group or organization

es.e: The majority of union members voted in favour of a strike.
es.c: 大多数工会成员投票赞成罢工。

d: n 纪念碑，纪念馆；纪念仪式；纪念物 something, especially a stone with writing on it, that reminds people of someone who has died；adj 记忆的；纪念的，追悼的 done or made in order to remind people of someone who has died

es.e: Building a memorial to Columbus has been his lifelong dream.
es.c: 建一座哥伦布纪念碑一直是他一生的梦想。

d: v 记住，背熟；记忆 to learn words, music etc so that you know them perfectly

es.e: He studied his map, trying to memorize the way to Rose's street.
es.c: 他研究了地图，努力记住去罗丝家那条街的路。

d: n 记忆，记忆力；内存，[计] 存储器；回忆 someone’s ability to remember things, places, experiences etc

es.e: He has lots of happy memories of his stay in Japan.
es.c: 他对在日本逗留的那段时光有许多美好的回忆。

d: v 修理，修补；改善；修改 to repair a tear or hole in a piece of clothing；n 好转，改进；修补处 to be getting better after an illness or after a difficult period

es.e: My father used to mend our shoes.
es.c: 我父亲过去常为我们修补鞋子。

d: adj 精神的；脑力的；疯的 relating to the health or state of someone’s mind；n 精神病患者

es.e: The centre provides help for people suffering from mental illness .
es.c: 该中心对精神病患者提供帮助。

es.e: Stress has an effect on both your physical and mental health .
es.c: 压力对身体健康和心理健康都有影响。

d: adv 精神上，智力上；心理上

es.e: Above all be mentally prepared for the rigors of each trading day from the time you get up each morning until you go to bed at night.
es.c: 最重要的是在精神上对每个交易日的严峻场面作好准备，从每天早晨你爬起来，一直到晚上回到床上。

d: v 提到，谈到；提及，论及；说起 to talk or write about something or someone, usually quickly and without saying very much or giving details；n 提及，说起 when someone mentions something or someone in a conversation, piece of writing etc

es.e: Was my name mentioned at all?
es.c: 我的名字被提到过吗？

es.e: Some of the problems were mentioned in his report.
es.c: 其中的一些问题在他的报告里提到了。

es.e: (= it is important enough to mention ) that they only studied a very small number of cases.
es.c: 必须说明的是他们仅研究了几个个案。

d: n 菜单 a list of all the kinds of food that are available for a meal, especially in a restaurant

es.e: Could we have the menu, please?
es.c: 请把菜单给我们，好吗？

es.e: a three course set menu
es.c: 三道菜的套餐

d: adj 仁慈的；慈悲的；宽容的 being kind to people and forgiving them rather than punishing them or being cruel

es.e: God have mercy on his soul.

d: adj 愉快的；微醉的；嬉戏作乐的 used to say that you hope someone will have a happy time at Christmas；n 甜樱桃

es.e: He marched off, whistling a merry tune.
es.c: 他吹着一首欢快的曲子大步走了。

d: n 混乱；食堂，伙食团；困境；脏乱的东西 if there is a mess somewhere or a place is a mess, things there are dirty or not neatly arranged；v 弄乱，弄脏；毁坏；使就餐

es.c: 太乱了！

es.c: 对不起——这里有些乱。

es.e: When I got home, the house was a complete mess .
es.c: 我回到家时，屋子里一片狼藉。

d: n 消息；差使；启示；预言；广告词 a spoken or written piece of information that you send to another person or leave for them；v 报信，报告；[通信] 报文

es.e: He left a message saying he would probably be a little late.
es.c: 他留言说可能会晚一点来。

d: adj 凌乱的，散乱的；肮脏的，污秽的；麻烦的 dirty or untidy

es.c: 凌乱的房间

es.e: Sorry the place is so messy, I haven’t had time to clear up.
es.c: 对不起，这地方又脏又乱，我一直没时间打扫。

d: n 金属；合金 a hard, usually shiny substance such as iron, gold, or steel；v 以金属覆盖；adj 金属制的

es.c: 一个黑色的金属小盒子

es.e: They traded in gold and other precious metals (= valuable metals used especially for making jewellery ) .
es.c: 他们做黄金和其他贵金属的交易。

d: n 方法；条理；类函数 a planned way of doing something, especially one that a lot of people know about and use；adj 使用体验派表演方法的

es.c: 传统的教学法

es.c: 我想我们应该用不同的方法再试一次。

es.e: effective methods for the storage and retrieval of information
es.c: 信息存储和检索的有效方法

d: n 米；公尺；韵律 the basic unit for measuring length in the  metric system

es.e: She's running the 1,500 metres here.
es.c: 她正在这儿跑1500米。

d: adj 墨西哥的；墨西哥人的 relating to Mexico or its people；n 墨西哥人；墨西哥语 someone from Mexico

es.c: 墨西哥政府

es.c: 墨西哥边界

es.e: Mexican food
es.c: 墨西哥菜

es.c: 我们要在墨西哥证明这一点。

es.c: 美国的南面与墨西哥接壤。

es.c: 除一人外，其他死亡患者都在疾病爆发的中心地墨西哥。

d: n 微电脑；[计] 微型计算机 a small computer

es.e: The merchant sold electrical appliances, such as microcomputer, microphone, microprocessor and microwave ovens.
es.c: 商人卖一些电器，比如微型计算机，话筒，微处理器和微波炉。

es.e: Or, as in my case, turning on the old antique microcomputer to read my single-sided, single-density floppies might lead to a fire and the quick end of your weekend data retrieval project.
es.c: 或者，像我所作的那样，打开一个旧的古董微型计算机来读取我的单面单密度磁盘，而这有可能引起一场火灾，以及你的周末数据检索计划的快速完结。

d: n 显微镜 a scientific instrument that makes extremely small things look larger

es.e: The slightest movement will defocus the microscope.
es.c: 最轻微的运动都会使显微镜散焦。

es.c: 这架显微镜把实物放大了200倍。

d: n 微波 a type of  oven  that cooks food very quickly using very short electric waves instead of heat

es.c: 我来把它用微波炉热一热。

d: n 中午；正午 the middle of the day, at or around 12 o’clock；adj 正午的

es.c: 正午烈日的酷热

es.c: 在高速公路的中间车道上行驶

es.e: the middle drawer of the filing cabinet
es.c: 档案柜中间的抽屉

es.e: You can’t phone her now – it’s gone midnight (= after midnight ) !
es.c: 你现在不能打电话给她，都过午夜了！

es.e: By the time he arrived, it was well past midnight (= after midnight ) .
es.c: 他到的时候早已经是后半夜了。

es.e: He’s gone for a midnight swim.
es.c: 他深更半夜去游泳了。

d: n 力量；威力；势力 great strength and power；v 可以；或许（may的过去式）；应该 used to suggest politely what someone should do；aux 可能；也许

es.c: 挑战英国法律制度权威的两个人

es.e: He swung the axe again with all his might .
es.c: 他用尽全力再一次抡起斧头。

d: adj 温和的；轻微的；淡味的；文雅的；不含有害物质的的 fairly warm；n （英国的一种）淡味麦芽啤酒 dark beer with a slightly sweet taste

es.c: 去年冬天我们这里异常暖和。

es.e: a mild climate
es.c: 温和的气候

d: n 英里；一英里赛跑；较大的距离 a unit for measuring distance, equal to 1,760  yard s  or about 1,609 metres

es.c: 从这里到波兰边界有40英里。

es.e: an area 50 miles wide and 150 miles long
es.c: 一片50英里宽、150英里长的地区

es.e: We walked about half a mile .
es.c: 我们大约走了半英里。

d: n 牛奶；乳状物 a white liquid produced by cows or goats that is drunk by people；v 榨取；挤…的奶 to get as much money or as many advantages as you can from a situation, in a very determined and sometimes dishonest way

es.c: 一瓶奶

es.c: 你茶里要加点奶吗？

es.e: a pint of semi-skimmed milk
es.c: 一品脱半脱脂奶

d: n 百万；无数 the number；adj 百万的；无数的；num 百万 the number

es.e: £37 million of new investment
es.c: 3,700万英镑的新投资额

d: n 百万富翁；大富豪 someone who is very rich and has at least a million pounds or dollars；adj 100万以上人口的

es.c: 一位美国百万富翁

es.c: 一位富商

d: n 理智，精神；意见；智力；记忆力 used to show you are giving your opinion about something；v 介意；专心于；照料 to feel annoyed or upset about something

es.c: 这笔款项扣除一小笔服务费后将退还给你。

es.c: 移动式空调器

es.c: 她继续用拖把拖地。

d: adj 道德的；精神上的；品性端正的 relating to the principles of what is right and wrong behaviour, and with the difference between good and evil；n 道德；寓意 principles or standards of good behaviour, especially in matters of sex

es.e: It is easy to have an opinion on a moral issue like the death penalty for murder.
es.c: 对于判谋杀犯死刑这种涉及伦理道德的问题，有个观点并非难事。

es.e: If we accept that certain babies should be allowed to die, we place doctors in a moral dilemma .
es.c: 如果我们同意应该允许某些婴儿死去，那就是让医生在道德上处于两难境地了。

es.e: Man is gifted with a moral sense by which he distinguishes good from evil.
es.c: 人类天生有道德意识，能区分善与恶。

d: adv 更多；此外；更大程度地 used to say that something happens to a greater degree；adj 更多的；附加的；pron 更多的数量；n 更多 a greater amount or number

es.e: She cares a lot more for her dogs than she does for me.
es.c: 她关心她的狗远远超过关心我。

d: n 早晨；黎明；初期 the early part of the day, from when the sun rises until 12 o’clock in the middle of the day

es.e: I hated those cold winter mornings.
es.c: 我讨厌冬天里寒冷的早晨。

es.e: I’m not feeling very well this morning.
es.c: 今天早上我觉得不大舒服。

es.e: He stayed in bed late on Sunday morning.
es.c: 星期日早上他睡到很晚。

d: n 莫斯科（俄罗斯首都）

es.e: Must go... to Moscow!
es.c: 一定要去莫斯科！

d: adj 穆斯林的；伊斯兰教的；回教的；n 穆斯林；穆罕默德信徒；伊斯兰

es.e: She tells me that if the religious scholars say so, she will engage in Moslem operations: suicide attacks.
es.c: 她告诉我如果宗教学者希望他们那么做，她也将义无反顾的采取穆斯林的反抗活动—自杀攻击。

es.e: The Buddhist, the Christian, the Moslem, and the Jew may all get answers to their prayers, in spite of the enormous differences among their stated beliefs.
es.c: 佛教徒、基督教徒、伊斯兰教徒和犹太教徒，尽管他们所宣称的信仰有极大的不同，但是，他们的祈祷大概都能得到回应。

d: n 蚊子 Mosquitos are small flying insects which bite people and animals in order to suck their blood

adv 最；非常，极其；最多；几乎 having the greatest amount of a particular quality；adj 大部分的，多数的；最多的 You use the most to mean a larger amount than anyone or anything else, or the largest amount possible；n 大部分，大多数 nearly all of the peop

es.e: She’s one of the most experienced teachers in the district.
es.c: 她是该地区最有经验的教师之一。

es.e: The most important thing is to stay calm.
es.c: 最重要的是保持冷静。

es.e: A recent study showed that gardening is easily the most popular activity among the over 50s.
es.c: 最近的一项研究表明园艺绝对是50岁以上人群中最受欢迎的活动。

d: n 母亲；大娘；女修道院院长 a female parent of a child or animal；v 生下；养育；像母亲般关怀或照管 to look after and protect someone as if you were their mother, especially by being too kind and doing everything for them；adj 母亲的；出生地的

es.e: His mother and father are both doctors.
es.c: 他的父母都是医生。

es.e: the relationship between mother and child
es.c: 母亲和孩子之间的关系

es.e: Goodnight, Mother.
es.c: 晚安，妈妈。

d: n 祖国；母国 someone’s motherland is the country where they were born and to which they feel a strong emotional connection

es.e: They are willing to die for the motherland.
es.c: 他们愿为祖国牺牲生命。

d: n 动机；积极性；推动 eagerness and willingness to do something without needing to be told or forced to do it

es.e: Jack is an intelligent pupil, but he lacks motivation.
es.c: 杰克是一个很聪明的学生，但学习不够主动。

es.e: a high level of motivation
es.c: 高度积极性

d: n 发动机，马达；汽车 the part of a machine that makes it work or move, by changing power, especially electrical power, into movement；adj 汽车的；机动的 relating to cars or other vehicles with engines；v 乘汽车 to travel by car

es.e: an electric motor
es.c: 电动马达

d: n 摩托车 a small fast two-wheeled vehicle with an engine

es.e: The motorbike is supposed to make annoying noise.
es.c: 摩托车当然会发出令人感到烦恼的噪音。

es.e: Some earlier witness reports cited by police or security officials had explosives being thrown from a motorbike or the upper storey's of an adjacent hotel.
es.c: 一些更早的证词报道引用警方或安全部门的话说，爆炸物从摩托车上扔下，或是从领进旅馆的楼上扔下来。

d: n 摩托车；机动车 a fast two-wheeled vehicle with an engine；v 骑摩托车

es.e: You'd better encash your motorcycle at once.
es.c: 你最好马上卖掉摩托车换成现款。

es.e: She can ride a motorcycle， to say nothing of a bicycle.
es.c: 她摩托车都会骑， 自行车更不在话下了。

es.e: He runs behind a motorcycle for half an hour every morning.
es.c: 他每天早晨跟在摩托车后面跑半个小时。

d: n 座右铭，格言；箴言 a short sentence or phrase giving a rule on how to behave, which expresses the aims or beliefs of a person, school, or institution

es.e: ‘Be prepared’ is the motto of the Boy Scouts.
es.c: “时刻准备着”是童子军的格言。

d: n 山；山脉 a very high hill

es.e: the highest mountain in Austria
es.c: 奥地利最高的山

es.e: the Rocky Mountains
es.c: 落基山脉

es.e: a steep mountain road
es.c: 陡峭的山路

d: adj 多山的；巨大的；山一般的 a mountainous area has a lot of mountains

es.e: the mountainous coast of Wales
es.c: 威尔士多山的海岸

es.e: a mountainous region
es.c: 多山地区

d: v 哀悼；忧伤；服丧 to feel very sad and to miss someone after they have died

es.e: Hundreds of people gathered to mourn the slain president.
es.c: 成百上千人聚集在一起悼念遇刺的总统。

d: n 鼠标；老鼠；胆小羞怯的人 a small furry animal with a pointed nose and a long tail that lives in people’s houses or in fields；v 探出

es.e: The cat laid a dead mouse at my feet.
es.c: 猫把一只死老鼠放在我的脚边。

es.e: a field mouse
es.c: 田鼠

d: n 小胡子；髭；触须 hair that grows on a man’s upper lip

es.e: He’s shaved off his moustache.
es.c: 他剃去了小胡子。

d: n 口，嘴；河口 the part of your face which you put food into, or which you use for speaking；v 做作地说，装腔作势地说；喃喃地说出

es.e: He lifted his glass to his mouth.
es.c: 他把玻璃杯举到嘴边。

es.e: Liam was fast asleep with his mouth wide open.
es.c: 利亚姆大张着嘴，睡得很熟。

d: n 一口，满口 an amount of food or drink that you put into your mouth at one time

es.e: Michael told his story between mouthfuls.
es.c: 迈克尔边吃边讲他的故事。

d: n 移动；步骤；迁居；策略 when someone moves for a short time in a particular direction；v 移动；搬家，迁移；离开 to change from one place or position to another, or to make something do this

es.e: Good gymnasts rehearse their moves mentally before a competition.
es.c: 优秀的体操运动员赛前都会在心中默默地把动作过一遍。

es.e: He made no move to come any nearer.
es.c: 他没有再靠近。

es.e: Martin made a move towards the door.
es.c: 马丁朝门口挪了挪。

d: n 运动；活动；运转；乐章 a group of people who share the same ideas or beliefs and who work together to achieve a particular aim

es.e: It's part of a broader nationalist movement that's gaining strength throughout the country.
es.c: 这是一场正在全国范围内日益壮大的更为广泛的民族主义运动的一部分。

d: n 电影；电影院；电影业 a film made to be shown at the cinema or on television；adj 电影的

es.e: It was like one of those old John Wayne movies.
es.c: 这部电影有点像约翰•韦恩演的一部老片子。

d: adv 非常，很 by a great amount；adj 大量的；n 许多，大量 a large amount of something；pron 许多，大量

es.e: The day ended much as it began.
es.c: 这一天结束时还像开始时一样。

d: v 弄脏；用泥涂；n 泥；诽谤的话；无价值的东西 wet earth that has become soft and sticky

es.e: They daubed mud all over themselves.
es.c: 他们用泥涂满全身。

es.e: I dirty my trousers when I step on the mud.
es.c: 我一脚擩在烂泥里， 把裤子弄脏了。

d: adj 泥泞的；模糊的；混乱的 covered with mud or containing mud；v 使污浊；使沾上泥；把…弄糊涂 to make something dirty with mud

es.e: Take your boots off outside if they’re muddy.
es.c: 要是靴子上都是泥，你就脱在门外吧。

es.e: the muddy waters of the lake
es.c: 浑浊的湖水

d: v 乘；使增加；使繁殖；使相乘 to do a calculation in which you add a number to itself a particular number of times；adv 多样地；复合地；adj 多层的；多样的

es.e: Children will learn to multiply in the second grade.
es.c: 儿童在二年级学习乘法。

d: v 谋杀，凶杀 to kill someone deliberately and illegally；n 谋杀，凶杀 the crime of deliberately killing someone

es.e: He was convicted of murdering a policeman.
es.c: 他被判谋杀一名警察的罪名成立。

es.e: Thousands of civilians were brutally murdered during the civil war.
es.c: 成千上万的平民在内战中遭到残杀。

es.e: the murdered man
es.c: 被害男子

d: n 博物馆 a building where important  cultural  , historical, or scientific objects are kept and shown to the public

es.e: the Museum of Modern Art
es.c: 现代艺术博物馆

es.e: The museum has an extensive collection of early photographs.
es.c: 这座博物馆藏有大量早期的照片。

d: n 蘑菇，伞菌；蘑菇形物体；暴发户 one of several kinds of  fungus  with stems and round tops, some of which can be eaten；adj 蘑菇的；蘑菇形的；迅速生长的；v 迅速增加；采蘑菇；迅速生长 to grow and develop very quickly

es.e: mushroom soup
es.c: 蘑菇汤

d: n 音乐，乐曲 a series of sounds made by instruments or voices in a way that is pleasant or exciting

es.e: I often listen to classic music when I’m in the car.
es.c: 我在车上经常听古典音乐。

es.e: A new piece of music was specially written for the occasion.
es.c: 为了这个活动专门写了一首新曲子。

d: adj 音乐的；悦耳的 relating to music or consisting of music；n 音乐片 a play or film that includes singing and dancing

es.e: a musical version of the fairy tale ‘Cinderella’
es.c: 童话故事《灰姑娘》的音乐剧版

es.e: When he began his musical career, King played only for black audiences.
es.c: 金在音乐事业的开始阶段只为黑人观众演奏。

d: n 音乐家 someone who plays a musical instrument, especially very well or as a job

es.e: a talented young musician
es.c: 有天赋的年轻音乐家

d: aux 必须，一定；可以，应当；很可能；n 绝对必要的事物；未发酵葡萄汁 the newly pressed juice of grapes or other fruit ready for fermentation

es.e: Warm clothes are a must in the mountains.
es.c: 御寒衣物在山里是必不可少的。

d: n 芥末；芥菜；深黄色；强烈的兴趣 a yellow sauce with a strong taste, eaten especially with meat
n 羊肉 the meat from a sheep

es.e: ...a leg of mutton.
es.c: …一条羊腿。

d: pron 我的；int 哎呀（表示惊奇等）；喔唷 used when you are surprised,  impress ed  ,or upset；n (My)人名；(越)美；(老、柬)米

es.e: All my friends do not smoke.
es.c: 我的朋友并不全都吸烟。

es.e: Then you must be my cousin.
es.c: 那么你一定是我的远亲了。

d: pron 我自己；我亲自；我的正常的健康状况和正常情绪 used by the person speaking or writing to show that they are affected by their own action

es.e: I blame myself for what has happened.
es.c: 发生这一切都怪我自己。

es.e: I can look after myself.
es.c: 我可以照顾好自己。

es.e: I’m making myself a sandwich.
es.c: 我在给自己做三明治。

d: v 钉；使固定；揭露 to fasten something to something else with nails；n [解剖] 指甲；钉子 a thin pointed piece of metal with a flat top, which you hit into a surface with a hammer, for example to join things together or to hang something

es.e: Frank put the first plank down and nailed it in place.
es.c: 弗兰克放下第一块木板，把它钉到位。

d: n 名称，名字；姓名；名誉 what someone is called；v 命名，任命；指定；称呼；提名；叫出 to give someone or something a particular name；adj 姓名的；据以取名的

es.e: Her name is Mandy Wilson.
es.c: 她的名字是曼迪•威尔逊。

es.e: What’s your name?
es.c: 你叫什么名字？

d: adj 狭窄的，有限的；勉强的；精密的；度量小的 measuring only a small distance from one side to the other, especially in relation to the length；n 海峡；狭窄部分，隘路；v 使变狭窄 to make something narrower or to become narrower

es.e: The stairs were very narrow.
es.c: 楼梯非常狭窄。

es.e: a long, narrow band of cloud
es.c: 窄长的云带

d: n 国家；民族；国民 a country, considered especially in relation to its people and its social or economic structure

es.e: the President’s radio broadcast to the nation
es.c: 总统对全国的广播讲话

es.e: an independent nation
es.c: 独立的国家

es.e: the world’s leading industrial nations
es.c: 世界上的主要工业国

d: adj 国家的；国民的；民族的；国立的 related to a whole nation as opposed to any of its parts；n 国民 someone who is a citizen of a particular country but is living in another country

es.e: Religion matters very much at a national level.
es.c: 宗教事务在全国都非常重要。

es.e: Between 1929 and 1933 America’s national income fell by more than half.
es.c: 1929至1933年间，美国的国民收入下降过半。

es.e: There are strong indications that the Prime Minister will call national elections in May.
es.c: 有明显迹象预示首相将于5月召集全国大选。

d: n 国籍，国家；民族；部落 the state of being legally a citizen of a particular country

es.e: people of the same nationality
es.c: 同国籍的人

d: adj 全国范围的；全国性的 happening or existing in every part of the country；adv 在全国 Nationwide is also an adverb

es.e: a nationwide search for a missing British tourist
es.c: 在全国范围内对一名失踪英国游客的搜寻

es.e: nationwide television
es.c: 全国性的电视节目

es.e: The figures show unemployment falling nationwide last month.
es.c: 数字显示，上个月失业数字正全国性地下降。

d: adj 本国的；土著的；天然的；与生俱来的；天赋的 your native country, town etc is the place where you were born；n 本地人；土产；当地居民 someone who lives in a place all the time or has lived there a long time

es.e: They never saw their native land again.
es.c: 他们再也没见到故土。

es.e: He spent most of his professional life outside his native Poland.
es.c: 他大部分的职业生涯都没在祖国波兰度过。

d: adj 自然的；物质的；天生的；不做作的 existing in nature and not caused, made, or controlled by people；n 自然的事情；白痴；本位音 a musical note that has been changed from a flat to be a semitone higher, or from a sharp to be a semitone lower

es.e: the study of the natural world
es.c: 对自然界的研究

es.e: an area of spectacular natural beauty
es.c: 自然风景秀丽的地区

es.e: death from natural causes
es.c: 自然死亡

d: n 自然；性质；本性；种类 everything in the physical world that is not controlled by humans, such as wild plants and animals, earth and rocks, and the weather

es.e: We grew up in the countryside, surrounded by the beauties of nature.
es.c: 我们在乡村长大，周围是美丽的大自然。

es.e: nature conservation
es.c: 自然保护

es.e: Disease is nature’s way of keeping the population down.
es.c: 疾病是大自然控制人口的方法。

d: n 海军 the part of a country’s military forces that fights at sea

es.e: the British Navy
es.c: 英国海军

es.e: He joined the navy during the war.
es.c: 他在战争期间参加了海军。

d: adj 近的；亲近的；近似的 only a short distance away from someone or something；adv 近；接近 only a short distance from a person or thing；prep 靠近；近似于

es.e: It’s a beautiful house but it’s 20 miles away from the nearest town.
es.c: 房子很漂亮，但离最近的城镇也有20英里。

es.e: We can meet at the pub or in the restaurant, whichever’s nearer for you.
es.c: 我们可以在酒吧或餐馆见面，看哪个离你近一些。

d: adj 附近的，邻近的 not far away；adv 在附近 If something is nearby, it is only a short distance away；prep 在…附近

es.e: Lucy was staying in the nearby town of Hamilton.
es.c: 露西当时住在附近的汉密尔顿镇。

es.e: He might easily have been seen by someone who lived nearby.
es.c: 他可能很容易被住在附近的人看到。

es.e: The helicopter crashed to earth nearby.
es.c: 直升机坠毁在附近的地面上。

d: adv 差不多，几乎；密切地 almost, but not quite or not completely

es.e: It took nearly two hours to get here.
es.c: 到这里花了将近两小时。

es.e: Michelle’s nearly twenty.
es.c: 米歇尔年近二十。

es.e: Is the job nearly finished?
es.c: 这工作快干完了吗？

d: adj 灵巧的；整洁的；优雅的；齐整的；未搀水的；平滑的 tidy and carefully arranged

es.e: neat handwriting
es.c: 工整的笔迹

es.e: His clothes were always neat and clean.
es.c: 他的衣服总是很整洁。

es.e: Everything in the house was neat and tidy.
es.c: 房子里的每样物品都干净整齐。

d: adj 必要的；必需的；必然的 something that is necessary is what you need to have or need to do；n 必需品 things such as food or basic clothes that you need in order to live

es.e: The booklet provides all the necessary information about the college.
es.c: 这本小册子提供了关于那所学院的所有必需信息。

es.e: No further changes were considered necessary.
es.c: 没有必要作出进一步改变。

es.e: The doctor says it may be necessary for me to have an operation.
es.c: 医生说我可能需要做手术。

d: n 脖子；衣领；海峡 the part of your body that joins your head to your shoulders, or the same part of an animal or bird；v 搂著脖子亲吻；变狭窄 if two people are necking, they kiss for a long time in a sexual way

es.e: Mike rubbed the back of his neck.
es.c: 迈克揉了揉后颈。

es.e: You have a lot of tension in your neck muscles.
es.c: 你的颈部肌肉很紧张。

es.e: He patted his horse’s neck.
es.c: 他拍了拍马脖子。

d: n 项链 a string of jewels, beads etc or a thin gold or silver chain to wear around the neck

es.e: ...a diamond necklace and matching earrings.
es.c: …一条钻石项链和与之相配的耳环。

d: n 领带 a man’s tie

es.e: Really? I should untie the necktie right now.
es.c: 真的吗？那我还是赶紧把领带解了。

es.e: If I’m the one winning every time I deal, I end up with a Colombian necktie, know what I’m sayin’?
es.c: 如果每次发牌都是我赢的话，我会被他们哥伦比亚人用领带勒死的，你懂我意思吧？

es.e: Croatia also has a place in the history of neckwear as the origin of the necktie (cravat).
es.c: 克罗地亚同时也是一个拥有领带历史的国度，它成为领带（领结）的发源地。

d: n 需要，要求；缺乏；必要之物 a situation in which something is necessary, especially something that is not happening yet or is not yet available；v 需要 to have to have something or someone, because you cannot do something without them,

es.e: She works to provide for her family’s basic needs.
es.c: 她工作是为了维持家里的基本生计。

d: n 针；指针；刺激；针状物 a very thin, pointed steel tube at the end of a syringe, which is pushed into your skin to put a drug or medicine into your body or to take out blood；v 缝纫；做针线

es.e: She carried hypodermic needles and syringes in her bag.
es.c: 她包里带着皮下注射针和针筒。

es.e: Drug users are at risk when they share needles.
es.c: 吸毒者共用注射针很危险。

d: v 谈判，商议；转让；越过 to discuss something in order to reach an agreement, especially in business or politics

es.e: His first aim is to get the warring parties back to the negotiating table (= discussing something ).
es.c: 他的首要目标就是把交战各方拉回到谈判桌上。

d: n n邻居;同胞；仁慈的人 someone who lives next to you or near you；v 邻接；adj 邻居的；邻近的

es.e: One of the neighbors complained about the noise from the party.
es.c: 有位邻居抱怨聚会太吵。

es.e: FBI agents were interviewing all their friends and neighbors.
es.c: 联邦调查局人员正在向他们所有的朋友和邻居问话。

es.e: Our next-door neighbours (= the people who live in the house next to us ) say they’ll look after our cat for us while we’re away.
es.c: 我们隔壁的邻居说，我们不在时他们会照顾我们的猫。

d: n 邻近；周围；邻居关系；附近一带 the area around you or around a particular place, or the people who live there

es.e: Be quiet! You’ll wake up the whole neighbourhood!
es.c: 安静点！ 你会把邻居全都吵醒的！

d: conj 也不；既不 used when mentioning two things that are not true or possible；adv 两个都不；既不……也不 used to show that a negative statement is also true about another person or thing；adj 两者都不的；pron 两者都不

es.e: Neither Oleg’s mother nor his father spoke English.
es.c: 奥列格的父母都不会说英语。

es.e: The equipment is neither accurate nor safe.
es.c: 这台设备既不精确，也不安全。

d: n 侄子；外甥 the son of your brother or sister, or the son of your husband’s or wife’s brother or sister

es.e: I am planning a 25th birthday party for my nephew.
es.c: 我正在为侄子筹划他25岁的生日聚会。

d: adj 神经的；紧张不安的；强健有力的 worried or frightened about something, and unable to relax

es.e: I wish you’d stop looking at me like that. You’re making me nervous.
es.c: 我希望你不要再那样看着我了，你让我紧张。

es.e: By the time I got into the interview I was a nervous wreck (= was extremely nervous ).
es.c: 到了面试的时候，我紧张得要命。

d: n 巢，窝；安乐窝；温床 a place made or chosen by a bird to lay its eggs in and to live in；v 筑巢；嵌套 to build or use a nest

es.e: a bird’s nest
es.c: 鸟窝

es.e: In May the females build a nest and lay their eggs.
es.c: 雌鸟在5月份筑巢产蛋。

es.e: Young eagles leave the nest after only two months.
es.c: 雏鹰仅仅两个月以后就会飞离鸟巢。

d: n 网；网络；净利；实价 the system that allows millions of computer users around the world to exchange information；v 编网 to hit or kick the ball into the net in sport；adj 纯粹的；净余的 the net amount is the final amount that remains after

es.e: Bruce spends most evenings surfing the Net (= looking at information in different places on the Internet ).
es.c: 布鲁斯晚上大多在网上浏览信息。

d: n 网络；广播网；网状物 a system of lines, tubes, wires, roads etc that cross each other and are connected to each other

es.e: Hungary’s telephone network
es.c: 匈牙利的电话网

es.e: a high-speed European rail network
es.c: 欧洲的高速铁路网

d: adv 从未；决不 not at any time, or not once

es.e: He’s never been to Australia.
es.c: 他从未去过澳大利亚。

es.e: I’m never going back there again, not as long as I live.
es.c: 只要我活着，我再也不会回到那儿去。

es.e: It is never too late to give up smoking.
es.c: 戒烟不言晚。

d: adj 新的，新鲜的；更新的；初见的 recently made, built, invented, written, designed etc；adv 新近；n (New)人名；(英)纽

es.e: the city’s new hospital
es.c: 市里新建的医院

es.e: the new issue of ‘Time’ magazine
es.c: 新一期《时代周刊》

es.e: new products on the market
es.c: 市场上的新产品

d: n 新闻，消息；新闻报导 information about something that has happened recently

es.e: I hope to have some good news for you soon.
es.c: 我希望很快就能给你好消息。

d: n 报纸 a set of large folded sheets of printed paper containing news, articles, pictures, advertisements etc which is sold daily or weekly

es.e: She had read about it in the newspapers.
es.c: 关于这件事她已经在报纸上看到了。

es.e: a series of newspaper articles about life in Cuba
es.c: 刊登在报纸上的一系列关于古巴生活的文章

d: adv 然后；下次；其次 the next time；adj 下一个的；其次的；贴近的 Next is also an adjective；n 下一个 the next person or thing in a list, series etc comes after the one that you are dealing with now；prep 靠近；居于…之后

es.e: When I next saw her she completely ignored me.
es.c: 我再次见到她时，她压根儿没有理我。

es.e: I'll be 26 years old next Friday.
es.c: 我下周五就26岁了。

d: adj 精密的；美好的；细微的；和蔼的 pleasant, attractive, or enjoyable；n (Nice)人名；(英)尼斯

es.e: They’ve got a very nice house.
es.c: 他们的房子真漂亮。

es.e: Did you have a nice time?
es.c: 你们玩得开心吗？

es.e: It’s such a nice day (= good weather ), why not go for a swim?
es.c: 天气真好，为什么不去游泳呢？

d: n 外甥女，侄女 the daughter of your brother or sister, or the daughter of your wife’s or husband’s brother or sister

es.e: ...his niece, the daughter of his eldest sister.
es.c: …他的外甥女，他大姐的女儿。

d: n 夜晚，晚上；黑暗，黑夜 the dark part of each 24-hour period when the sun cannot be seen and when most people sleep；adj 夜晚的，夜间的

es.e: It was a cold moonlit night.
es.c: 那是个寒冷的月夜。

es.e: I didn’t sleep too well last night.
es.c: 我昨晚睡得不太好。

d: n 九，九个 the number 9；num 九；九个 the number 9；adj 九的，九个的

es.e: He’s only been in this job for nine months.
es.c: 他干这份工作才九个月。

es.e: We open at nine (= nine o’clock ).
es.c: 我们9点开始营业。

es.e: Kay was taught by her mother till she was nine (= nine years old ).
es.c: 凯一直由她妈妈教到九岁。

d: num 十九 the number 19

es.e: It was nineteen minutes past seven.
es.c: 当时是7点19分。

es.e: I was only nineteen (= 19 years old ).
es.c: 我当时只有19岁。

d: n 九十 the number 90；adj 九十的；九十岁的；num 九十 the number 90

es.e: America was far richer in the nineties.
es.c: 90年代的美国要富裕得多。

d: num 第九 one of nine equal parts of something；adj 第九的；九分之一的 coming after eight other things in a series；n 九分之一 one of nine equal parts of something

es.e: In that region, Chile went from ninth to first, overall, as Chilean mobile web use increased by 3200% over the past year.
es.c: 智利从这一地区的第九跃升到第一位，因为智利的移动网络用户在过去一年增长了 3200% 。

es.e: Then, in eighth or ninth grade, I studied astronomy, cosmology, and the origins of the universe.
es.c: 后来，在八、九年级的时候，我在学习天文学，宇宙学和宇宙的起源。

d: adv 不 used to give a negative reply to a question, offer, or request；adj 没有；不是；n 不；否决票 used on signs to say that something is not allowed；abbr 数字（number）；元素锘（nobelium）的符号

es.e: ‘Are you Italian?’ ‘No, I’m Spanish.’
es.c: “你是意大利人吗？”“不，我是西班牙人。”

es.e: ‘Do you want any more?’ ‘No thanks.’
es.c: “你还要再来点吗？”“不要了，谢谢。”

es.e: ‘Could you help me write this?’ ‘No, sorry, I haven’t got time at the moment.’
es.c: “你能帮我写这个吗？”“抱歉，不行，我现在没时间。”

d: adj 高尚的；贵族的；惰性的；宏伟的 morally good or generous in a way that is admired；n 贵族 a member of the highest social class with a title such as ‘Duke’ or ‘Countess’；vt 抓住；逮捕

es.e: It’s very noble of you to spend all your weekends helping the old folk.
es.c: 你心地真好，周末的时间全都用来帮助老人。

es.e: noble ideals
es.c: 崇高的理想

d: pron 无人，没有人；没有任何人 no one；n 无名小卒；小人物 If someone says that a person is a nobody, they are saying in an unkind way that the person is not at all important

es.e: I knocked on the door but nobody answered.
es.c: 我敲了敲门，但没人应门。

es.e: A man in my position has nothing to fear from a nobody like you.
es.c: 在我这样职位的一个男人没什么好怕像你这样一个无名之辈的。

d: n 点头；打盹；摆动 an act of nodding；v 点头；点头表示 to move your head up and down, especially in order to show agreement or understanding

es.e: The woman greeted us with a nod of the head.
es.c: 那个女人向我们点点头打招呼。

es.e: I showed the doorman my card and he gave a friendly nod.
es.c: 我向门卫出示了卡片，他友善地点了点头。

d: n [环境] 噪音；响声；杂音 a sound, especially one that is loud, unpleasant, or frightening；v 谣传 if news or information is noised abroad, people are talking about it

es.e: What’s that noise?
es.c: 那是什么声音？

es.e: Try not to make a noise when you go upstairs.
es.c: 上楼时尽量不要弄出声。

es.e: There was a lot of noise outside.
es.c: 外面很吵闹。

d: adv 吵闹地，喧闹地

es.e: It’s a colorful scene - laborers unload noisily, and small groups of women haggle for the pots of crabs and sardines to sell at village markets.
es.c: 在这个热闹的环境中，工人喧闹地卸着船，三五成群的妇女正在为一盆盆螃蟹和沙丁鱼讨价还价，以便在村里的鱼市出售。

d: adj 嘈杂的；喧闹的；聒噪的 someone or something that is noisy makes a lot of noise

es.e: The kids have been really noisy today.
es.c: 孩子们今天实在是吵。

es.e: a noisy engine
es.c: 噪声大的发动机

d: pron 没有人；一个也没有；没有任何东西 not any amount of something or not one of a group of people or things；adj 没有的，一点没有的；adv 决不，一点也不 not any worse, better etc than before；n (None)人名；(葡、罗)诺内；(日)野根(姓)

es.e: I wish I could offer you some cake but there’s none left.
es.c: 我真想能请你吃些蛋糕，但一点也没剩的了。

es.e: Although these were good students, none had a score above 60.
es.c: 虽然这些都是好学生，但是没有一个考到60分以上。

es.e: She waited for a reply, but none came.
es.c: 她等着答复，可是什么也没等到。

d: n 面条；笨蛋 a long thin piece of food made from a mixture of flour, water, and eggs, usually cooked in soup or boiling water

es.e: Serve the meat with rice or noodles.
es.c: 肉配米饭或面条一起上。

d: n 中午；正午；全盛期 12 o’clock in the daytime

es.e: We met at 12 noon.
es.c: 我们中午12点见了面。

d: conj 也不；也不是 used when mentioning two things that are not true or do not happen；adv 也不；也没有；n (Nor)人名；(中)挪(广东话·威妥玛)；(马来、俄)诺尔；(柬)诺

es.e: He can neither read nor write (= he cannot read or write ).
es.c: 他既不会读也不会写。

es.e: Hilary was neither shocked nor surprised by the news.
es.c: 希拉里对这个消息既没有感到震惊，也没有觉得意外。

es.e: Neither Matt nor Julie said anything.
es.c: 马特和朱莉都没有说什么。

d: adj 正常的；正规的，标准的 usual, typical, or expected；n 正常；标准；常态 the usual state, level, or amount

es.e: A normal working week is 40 hours.
es.c: 一个正常的工作周是40小时。

es.e: She was assessed in the normal way, and placed on the waiting list.
es.c: 她接受了正常的评估后被列入等候名单。

es.e: All I want is to lead a normal life.
es.c: 我想要的只是能过正常的生活。

d: n 北，北方 the direction that is at the top of a map of the world, above the Equator. It is on the left if you are facing the rising sun；adj 北方的；朝北的 in the north or facing the north；adv 在北方，向北方 towards the north

es.e: Which way is north?
es.c: 哪边是北？

d: adj 东北的；向东北的；来自东北的 The northeast edge, corner, or part of a place is the part which is toward the northeast；n 东北 the direction that is exactly between north and east；adv 向东北；来自东北 If you go northeast, you travel toward th

es.e: ...a climate like that of our northeast coast.
es.c: …同我们东北部沿海气候相似的一种气候。

es.e: "We're going northeast," Paula told them, before they started.
es.c: “我们将朝东北方向走，”葆拉在他们出发前告诉他们。

d: adj 北部的；北方的 in or from the north of a country or area；n 北部方言

es.e: a man with a northern accent
es.c: 带有北方口音的男子

es.e: Northern Europe
es.c: 北欧

d: adv 向北 towards the north

es.e: We sailed northwards.
es.c: 我们向北航行。

d: adj 西北的；向西北的；来自西北的 a northwest wind comes from the northwest；n 西北 the direction that is exactly between north and west；adv 在西北；向西北；来自西北 If you go northwest, you travel toward the northwest

es.e: the northwest suburbs of the city
es.c: 城市西北部的郊区

es.e: Take the narrow lane going northwest parallel with the railway line.
es.c: 走那条与铁路线平行的通向西北的窄路。

d: n 鼻子；嗅觉；突出的部分；探问 the part of a person’s or animal’s face used for smelling or breathing；v 嗅；用鼻子触

es.e: Someone punched him on the nose.
es.c: 有人一拳打在他的鼻子上。

d: adv 表示否定，不 used to make a word, statement, or question negative；n “非”（计算机中逻辑运算的一种）

es.e: Most of the stores do not open until 10 am.
es.c: 大多数商店要到上午10点才开始营业。

es.e: She’s not a very nice person.
es.c: 她为人不太好。

es.e: You were wrong not to inform the police.
es.c: 你没有通知警方是错误的。

d: n 笔记；音符；票据；注解；纸币；便笺；照会；调子 information that a student writes down during a lesson, from a book etc；v 注意；记录；注解 to notice or pay careful attention to something

es.e: Can I borrow your lecture notes?
es.c: 我能不能借用一下你的课堂笔记？

d: n 笔记本，笔记簿；手册 a book made of plain paper on which you can write notes

es.e: He brought out a notebook and pen from his pocket.
es.c: 他从口袋里掏出了一个笔记本和一支钢笔。

d: neg 没什么；毫不；n 无；零；不关紧要之事 zero；adv 毫不；决不；pron 无事；无物 if you have nothing to do with someone or something, or if someone or something has nothing to do with you, you are not involved or connected with it

es.e: I owe him nothing.
es.c: 我不欠他什么。

d: n 通知，布告；注意；公告 when you notice or pay attention to someone or something；v 通知；注意到；留心 if someone can’t help noticing something, they realize that it exists or is happening even though they are not deliberately trying to pay

es.e: I waved but they took no notice.
es.c: 我挥了挥手，可是他们没有注意到。

es.e: I hope you’ll take notice of what I’m going to tell you.
es.c: 我希望你留心听我下面要对你讲的话。

es.e: This problem may have escaped your notice so far (= you may not have noticed it ).
es.c: 可能你还没有注意到这个问题。

d: adj 新奇的；异常的 not like anything known before, and unusual or interesting；n 小说 a long written story in which the characters and events are usually imaginary

es.e: Protesters found a novel way of demonstrating against steeply rising oil prices.
es.c: 抗议者们找到一种新奇的示威方式来反对石油价格的飙升。

d: n 小说家 someone who writes novels

es.e: The key to success as a romantic novelist is absolute belief in your story.
es.c: 一个浪漫派小说家成功的关键在于对自己故事的绝对信念。

d: n 十一月 the 11th month of the year, between October and December

es.e: And again in November.
es.c: 在十一月又一次。

es.e: Too much snow in November.
es.c: 太多的大雪在十一月。

d: adv 现在；如今；立刻 You use now to refer to the present time, often in contrast to a time in the past or the future；adj 现在的；n 现在；目前；conj 由于；既然 because of something or as a result of something

es.e: She's a widow now.
es.c: 她现在是一个寡妇。

es.e: But we are now a much more fragmented society.
es.c: 但是我们现在是一个更加四分五裂的社会。

d: adv 现今；时下 now, compared with what happened in the past；n 当今

es.e: Nowadays people are rarely shocked by the sex they see on television.
es.c: 如今人们在电视上看见性爱镜头不太会感到吃惊了。

es.e: Most people nowadays are aware of the importance of a healthy diet.
es.c: 现在大多数人都明白健康饮食的重要性。

d: adv 无处；任何地方都不；毫无结果 not in any place or to any place；n 无处；任何地方；无名之地；adj 不存在的；毫无结果的；不知名的

es.e: Nowhere is drug abuse more of a problem than in the US.
es.c: 没有什么地方的吸毒问题比美国更严重。

d: adj 原子能的；[细胞] 细胞核的；中心的；原子核的 relating to or involving the nucleus (= central part ) of an atom, or the energy produced when the nucleus of an atom is either split or joined with the nucleus of another atom

es.e: France’s reliance on nuclear energy
es.c: 法国对核能的依赖

es.e: a nuclear power station
es.c: 核电站

es.e: a nuclear-powered submarine
es.c: 核动力潜艇

d: v 使麻木；使发愣；使失去感觉 to make someone unable to feel pain or feel things they are touching；adj 麻木的；发愣的 a part of your body that is numb is unable to feel anything, for example because you are very cold

es.e: The cold had numbed her fingers.
es.c: 她的手指冻僵了。

es.e: the numbing effect of the drug
es.c: 那种药物的麻醉效果

d: n 数；（杂志等的）期；号码；数字；算术 a word or sign that represents an amount or a quantity；v 计入；总数达到 to count something

es.e: They wrote various numbers on a large sheet of paper.
es.c: 他们在一张大纸上写下了很多不同的数字。

es.e: Add all the numbers together.
es.c: 把所有数字加起来。

d: v 看护，护理；照顾；培养；给…喂奶 to rest when you have an illness or injury so that it will get better；n 护士；奶妈，保姆 someone whose job is to look after people who are ill or injured, usually in a hospital

es.e: Shaw has been nursing an injury, and will not play on Sunday.
es.c: 肖一直在养伤，星期天将不参加比赛。

d: n 苗圃；托儿所；温床 a place where young children are taken care of during the day while their parents are at work

es.e: She puts her baby in this nursery and then goes back to work.
es.c: 她把孩子送到这家托儿所然后回去上班。

d: n 护理；看护；养育 the job or skill of looking after people who are ill, injured, or old；v 看护；养育（nurse的ing形式）

es.e: I’d love to go into nursing.
es.c: 我很乐意从事护理行业。

es.e: the nursing profession
es.c: 护理专业

es.e: psychiatric nursing
es.c: 精神病人的护理

d: n 螺母，螺帽；坚果；难对付的人，难解的问题 a dry brown fruit inside a hard shell, that grows on a tree；v 采坚果

es.e: a pine nut
es.c: 松子

es.e: roasted nuts
es.c: 烘坚果

es.e: We were sitting round the fire cracking nuts (= opening them ).
es.c: 我们围坐在火炉边夹碎坚果。

d: n 营养，营养学；营养品 the process of giving or getting the right type of food for good health and growth

es.e: Nutrition and exercise are essential to fitness and health.
es.c: 营养和运动是保持健康所必不可少的。

es.e: a nutrition expert
es.c: 营养专家

d: n 尼龙，[纺] 聚酰胺纤维；尼龙袜 a strong artificial material that is used to make plastics, clothes, rope etc

es.e: nylon fabric
es.c: 尼龙织物

es.e: The tent was made of nylon.
es.c: 那顶帐篷是尼龙做的。

d: v 服从，听从；按照……行动 to do what someone in authority tells you to do, or what a law or rule says you must do；n (Obey)人名；(英、法)奥贝

es.e: The little boy made no effort to obey.
es.c: 这小男孩不肯服从。

es.e: ‘Sit!’ he said, and the dog obeyed him instantly.
es.c: “坐下！”他说道，那只狗马上就服从了。

d: n 目标；物体；客体；宾语 a solid thing that you can hold, touch, or see but that is not alive；v 提出…作为反对的理由 to state a fact or opinion as a reason for opposing or disapproving of something
