es.e: Follow the path along the river to the bridge.
es.c: 沿着河边的小路走到那座桥。

d: n 耐性，耐心；忍耐，容忍 If you have patience, you are able to stay calm and not get annoyed, for example, when something takes a long time, or when someone is not doing what you want them to do

es.e: He doesn't have the patience to wait.
es.c: 他没有耐心等。

d: adj 有耐心的，能容忍的 able to wait calmly for a long time or to accept difficulties, people’s annoying behaviour etc without becoming angry；n 病人；患者 someone who is receiving medical treatment from a doctor or in a hospital

es.e: You’ll just have to be patient and wait till I’m off the phone.
es.c: 你只能耐心点，等我打完电话。

d: n 模式；图案；样品 the regular way in which something happens, develops, or is done；v 模仿；以图案装饰 to be designed or made in a way that is copied from something else

es.e: Weather patterns have changed in recent years.
es.c: 气候模式近年已经发生了变化。

es.e: A general pattern began to emerge .
es.c: 一个总体模式开始显现。

es.e: Their descriptions seemed to follow a set pattern (= always develop in the same way ) .
es.c: 他们的描述似乎依据固定的模式。

d: n 暂停；间歇 a short time during which someone stops speaking or doing something before starting again；v 暂停，停顿，中止；踌躇 to stop speaking or doing something for a short time before starting again

es.e: There was a pause while Alice changed the tape.
es.c: 艾丽斯换磁带的时候出现了短暂的停顿。

es.e: After a long pause , she went on.
es.c: 停了好一会儿，她才继续下去。

d: v 支付，付；偿还，补偿；给予 to give someone money for something you buy or for a service；n 工资，薪水；付款；报答 money that you are given for doing your job；adj 收费的；需付费的

es.e: How would you like to pay?
es.c: 你想怎么付款？

d: n 豌豆 a round green seed that is cooked and eaten as a vegetable, or the plant on which these seeds grow

es.e: roast chicken with peas and carrots
es.c: 烤鸡配豌豆胡萝卜

d: n 和平；平静；和睦；秩序 a situation in which there is no war or fighting

es.e: The country is at peace with its neighbours for the first time in years.
es.c: 这是多年来该国与其邻国第一次和平共处。

es.e: By the end of the century, France had made peace with Britain.
es.c: 到那个世纪末，法国和英国议和了。

es.e: a city where people of different religions have lived together in peace for centuries
es.c: 不同宗教的人们和平共处数百年的城市

d: adj 和平的，爱好和平的；平静的 a peaceful time, place, or situation is quiet and calm without any worry or excitement

es.e: We had a peaceful afternoon without the children.
es.c: 孩子们不在，我们度过了一个宁静的下午。

es.e: It’s very peaceful out here in the woods.
es.c: 这树林里真安静。

d: n 桃子；桃树；桃红色；受人喜欢的人（或物） a round juicy fruit that has a soft yellow or red skin and a large, hard seed in the centre, or the tree that this fruit grows on；adj 桃色的；用桃子制成的 pinkish-orange in colour；v 告密

es.e: Anderton scored a peach of a goal.
es.c: 安德顿射入一个好球。

d: n [园艺] 梨树；梨子 a sweet juicy fruit that has a round base and is thinner near the top, or the tree that produces this fruit

es.e: I took this apple for a pear until I tasted it.
es.c: 我误将这个苹果当作梨子，直到我尝了才知道。

d: n 农民；乡下人 a poor farmer who owns or rents a small amount of land, either in past times or in poor countries

es.e: Most villagers are peasant farmers.
es.c: 大多数村民是农民。

d: adj 徒步的；缺乏想像力的 ordinary and uninteresting and without any imagination；n 行人；步行者 someone who is walking, especially along a street or other place used by cars

es.e: a painting that is pedestrian and unimaginative
es.c: 乏味又缺乏想象力的画作

es.e: a rather pedestrian student
es.c: 一名相当平庸的学生

d: n 钢笔；作家；围栏 an instrument for writing or drawing with ink；v 写；关入栏中 to write something such as a letter, a book etc, especially using a pen

es.e: a ballpoint pen
es.c: 圆珠笔

es.e: a felt-tip pen
es.c: 毡头笔

es.e: a pen and ink drawing
es.c: 钢笔画

d: n 铅笔；笔状物 an instrument that you use for writing or drawing, consisting of a wooden stick with a thin piece of a black or coloured substance in the middle；v 用铅笔写；用眉笔涂 to write something or make a mark with a pencil

es.e: a sharp pencil
es.c: 尖尖的铅笔

es.e: a blue pencil
es.c: 蓝色铅笔

es.e: a pencil sketch
es.c: 铅笔速写

d: n （美）分；便士 a British unit of money or coin used until 1971. There were 12 pennies in one  shilling

es.e: Unleaded petrol rose more than a penny a gallon.
es.c: 无铅汽油每加仑涨了一个多便士。

d: n 退休金，抚恤金；津贴；膳宿费 an amount of money paid regularly by the government or company to someone who does not work any more, for example because they have reached the age when people stop working or because they are ill；v 发给养老

es.e: At what age can you start drawing your pension ?
es.c: 从多少岁可以开始领取养老金？

es.e: If you are self-employed, you should think about taking out a private pension .
es.c: 如果你是自由职业者，应该考虑办理私人养老金事宜。

es.e: Many people find it hard to live on a basic state pension .
es.c: 许多人发现仅凭国家基本养老金不能养活自己。

d: n 人；人类；民族；公民 used as the plural of ‘person’ to refer to men, women, and children；v 居住于；使住满人 if a country or area is peopled by people of a particular type, they live there

es.e: How many people were at the meeting?
es.c: 有多少人到会？

es.e: At least 40 people were killed.
es.c: 至少有40人遇害。

es.e: the people who live next door
es.c: 住在隔壁的那些人

d: n 胡椒；辣椒；胡椒粉 a powder that is used to add a hot taste to food；v 加胡椒粉于；使布满 to add pepper to food

es.e: salt and pepper
es.c: 盐和胡椒粉

d: prep 每；经；按照；每一 during each hour etc；n (Per)人名；(德、挪、丹、瑞典)佩尔

es.e: The park attracts four million visitors per year.
es.c: 那座公园每年吸引400万游客。

d: n 百分比，百分率；部分；百分数；adj 百分之…的 completely；adv 以百分之…地

es.e: But there are billions more people out there who are not in the top one percent, and they’re not in the top two or three either.
es.c: 但是还有十亿多的人不在其中，他们不在其中的百分之一，也不再其中的两百分之一或者三百分之一的其中。

d: n 百分比；百分率，百分数 an amount expressed as if it is part of a total which is 100

es.e: Interest rates fell by six percentage points (= 6% ) .
es.c: 利息下降了6个百分点。

es.e: The numbers are small in percentage terms (= when calculated as a percentage ) .
es.c: 按百分比来看，这些数字很小。

d: adj 完美的；最好的；精通的 not having any mistakes, faults, or damage；v 使完美；使熟练 to make something as good as you are able to；n 完成式 the form of a verb which is used when talking about a period of time up to and including the present

es.e: His English was perfect.
es.c: 他的英语很地道。

es.e: The car was in perfect condition.
es.c: 这辆车的车况极佳。

es.e: You’re very lucky to have perfect teeth.
es.c: 你能拥有一口完美的牙齿太幸运了。

d: v 执行；完成；演奏 to do something, especially something difficult or useful

es.e: Surgeons performed an emergency operation.
es.c: 外科医生做了一个急诊手术。

es.e: The official opening ceremony was performed by Princess Margaret.
es.c: 官方开幕式由玛 格丽特公主主持。

es.e: The leadership cannot be expected to perform miracles (= improve a situation in a way that seems impossible ) .
es.c: 不要指望这个领导班子能化腐朽为神奇。

d: n 性能；绩效；表演；执行；表现 when someone performs a play or a piece of music

es.e: This evening’s performance will begin at 8.00 pm.
es.c: 今晚的演出8点开始。

d: n 演出者；执行者；演奏者 an actor, musician etc who performs to entertain people

es.e: circus performers
es.c: 马戏演员

es.e: He was a better songwriter than performer.
es.c: 他更擅长写歌，而不是演唱。

d: n 香水；香味 a liquid with a strong pleasant smell that women put on their skin or clothing to make themselves smell nice；v 洒香水于…；使…带香味 to put perfume on something

es.e: She was wearing the perfume that he’d bought her.
es.c: 她擦了他买给她的香水。

d: adv 或许；（表示不确定）也许；（用于粗略的估计）或许；（表示勉强同意或其实不赞成）也许；可能 used to say that something may be true, but you are not sure；n 假定；猜想；未定之事

es.e: Perhaps she’s next door.
es.c: 她也许在隔壁。

es.e: Perhaps it will snow tomorrow.
es.c: 明天可能会下雪。

es.e: It won’t take so long next time, perhaps.
es.c: 也许下次不用那么久。

d: n 周期，期间；时期；月经；课时；（语法学）句点，句号 a particular length of time with a beginning and an end；adj 某一时代的

es.e: Tomorrow’s weather will be dry with sunny periods.
es.c: 明天天气干燥，间或晴朗。

es.e: The drug was tested over a five-week period.
es.c: 那种药品进行了为期五周的试验。

es.e: They adopted the system for a trial period (= time in which something is tested to see if it works well ) .
es.c: 那套系统他们试用了一段时间。

d: adj 永久的，永恒的；不变的 continuing to exist for a long time or for all the time in the future；n 烫发（等于permanent wave） a  perm 1

es.e: He gave up a permanent job in order to freelance.
es.c: 他放弃了固定工作，为的是当一名自由职业者。

es.e: a permanent change in your eating habits
es.c: 饮食习惯的永久改变

es.e: The blindness that the disease causes will be permanent.
es.c: 这种疾病引起的失明是永久性的。

d: n 允许，许可 If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it

es.e: He asked permission to leave the room.
es.c: 他请求离开房间的许可。

es.e: They cannot leave the country without permission.
es.c: 没有许可他们不得离开这个国家。

d: v 许可；允许 to allow something to happen, especially by an official decision, rule, or law；n 许可证，执照 an official written statement giving you the right to do something

es.e: Smoking is only permitted in the public lounge.
es.c: 只允许在公共休息室里抽烟。

es.e: He had more than the permitted level of alcohol in his blood.
es.c: 他血液中的酒精含量超出了允许的水平。

d: n 人；身体；容貌，外表；人称 a human being, especially considered as someone with their own particular character

es.e: He was a very nice person, always pleasant and friendly.
es.c: 他是个很好的人，始终彬彬有礼。

es.e: The only person who really said anything helpful was Jack.
es.c: 只有一个人真正说了些有用的话，就是杰克。

es.e: I like her as a person , but not as a boss.
es.c: 我喜欢她这个人，但作为老板我就不喜欢了。

d: adj 个人的；身体的；亲自的 belonging or relating to one particular person, rather than to other people or to people in general；n 人事消息栏；人称代名词

es.e: My personal view is that we shouldn’t offer him the job.
es.c: 我个人认为我们不该给他这份工作。

es.e: Style and colour are a matter of personal taste .
es.c: 款式和颜色是个人爱好问题。

es.e: She took full personal responsibility for all the arrangements.
es.c: 她个人对所有的安排承担全部责任。

d: adv 亲自地；当面；个别地；就自己而言 if you do something personally, you do it yourself rather than getting someone else to do it

es.e: The managing director wrote personally to thank me.
es.c: 总经理亲自写信向我表示感谢。

es.e: All important work is personally approved by him.
es.c: 所有重要的工作都由他亲自批准。

es.e: I’ll see to it personally.
es.c: 这件事我要亲自处理。

d: n 人事部门；全体人员 the department in a company that chooses people for jobs and deals with their complaints, problems etc；adj 人员的；有关人事的

es.e: A copy should then be sent to Personnel for our files.
es.c: 然后必须送一份到人事部供我们存档。

es.e: the personnel department
es.c: 人事部

d: v 说服，劝说；使某人相信；劝某人做（不做）某事 to make someone decide to do something, especially by giving them reasons why they should do it, or asking them many times to do it；adj 空闲的，有闲的

es.e: He was fairly easily persuaded .
es.c: 他很轻易就被说服了。

d: n 害虫；有害之物；讨厌的人 a small animal or insect that destroys crops or food supplies

es.e: a chemical used in pest control
es.c: 用于防治虫害的一种化学品

d: n 宠物；生气；受宠爱的人 an animal such as a cat or a dog which you keep and care for at home；v 宠爱 If you pet a person or animal, you touch them in an affectionate way；adj 宠爱的 a plan, idea, or subject that you particularly like or

es.e: They have two pets – a cat and a dog.
es.c: 他们有两只宠物，一只猫和一只狗。

es.e: We weren’t allowed to keep pets at school.
es.c: 学校里不许我们养宠物。

es.e: Rabbits make good pets .
es.c: 兔子是很好的宠物。

d: n （英）汽油 a liquid obtained from  petroleum  that is used to supply power to the engine of cars and other vehicles

es.e: unleaded petrol
es.c: 无铅汽油

es.e: petrol prices
es.c: 汽油价格

es.e: The petrol tank is leaking.
es.c: 油箱漏了。

d: n 现象；奇迹；杰出的人才 something that happens or exists in society, science, or nature, especially something that is studied because it is difficult to understand

es.e: Homelessness is not a new phenomenon .
es.c: 无家可归已不是什么新现象。

d: n 电话；耳机，听筒 a telephone；v 打电话 to speak to someone by telephone

es.e: Much of his work is done by phone .
es.c: 他的工作大部分是通过电话进行的。

es.e: Who was that on the phone ?
es.c: 谁来的电话？

es.e: I wish Amy would get off the phone .
es.c: 我真希望埃米别再打电话了。

d: n 照片 a photograph

es.e: Can you take a photo of me and Rachel?
es.c: 你能给我和雷切尔拍张照吗？

d: v 为…拍照；使深深印入 to take a photograph of someone or something；n 照片，相片 a picture obtained by using a camera and film that is sensitive to light

es.e: Kate agreed to let me photograph her.
es.c: 凯特同意让我为她拍照。

es.e: He stood by the tree to be photographed.
es.c: 他站在树旁准备让人拍照。

d: n 摄影师；照相师 someone who takes photographs, especially as a professional or as an artist

es.e: a fashion photographer
es.c: 时装摄影师

d: n 短语, 习语, 措辞, 乐句 a group of words that have a particular meaning when used together, or which someone uses on a particular occasion；v 措词, 将(乐曲)分成乐句

es.e: Who first used the phrase ‘survival of the fittest’?
es.c: “适者生存”这一说法最早是谁说的？

es.e: Shakespeare’s plays are full of well-known phrases .
es.c: 莎士比亚的戏剧中写满了众所周知的名言警句。

d: adj [物] 物理的；身体的；物质的；根据自然规律的，符合自然法则的 related to someone’s body rather than their mind or emotions；n 体格检查 a thorough examination of someone’s body by a doctor, in order to discover whether they are healthy or have any illn

es.e: She was in constant physical pain.
es.c: 她一直感到身上疼痛。

es.e: the physical and emotional needs of young adults
es.c: 青年人的身心需求

es.e: people with severe physical disabilities
es.c: 身体重度残疾的人

d: n [医] 医师；内科医师 a doctor

es.e: ...your family physician.
es.c: …你的家庭医生。

d: n 物理学家；唯物论者 a scientist who has special knowledge and training in  physics

es.e: ...a nuclear physicist.
es.c: …一位核物理学家。

d: n 物理学；物理现象 the science concerned with the study of physical objects and substances, and of natural forces such as light, heat, and movement

es.e: ...the laws of physics.
es.c: …物理学定律。

d: n 钢琴家；钢琴演奏者 someone who plays the piano

es.e: She was an accomplished pianist, a superb swimmer, and a gifted artist.
es.c: 她曾是一位很有造诣的钢琴家、一流的游泳健将和天才艺术家。

d: n 钢琴 a large musical instrument that has a long row of black and white  key s  . You play the piano by sitting in front of it and pressing the keys.

es.e: Jean accompanied her on the piano .
es.c: 琼为她钢琴伴奏。

d: v 挑选；采摘；挖 to choose a person or thing, for example because they are the best or most suitable；n 选择；鹤嘴锄；挖；掩护 if you can have your pick or take your pick of different things, you can choose which one you want

es.e: Students have to pick three courses from a list of 15.
es.c: 学生必须从15门课中选修3门。

es.e: I don’t know which colour to pick.
es.c: 我不知道要选哪个颜色。

es.e: Who’s going to pick the team for the match on Saturday?
es.c: 谁将为星期六的比赛挑选队员？

d: n 野餐 if you have a picnic, you take food and eat it outdoors, especially in the country；v 去野餐 to have a picnic

es.e: We decided to have a picnic down by the lake.
es.c: 我们决定在湖边野餐。

es.e: a picnic table
es.c: 野餐桌

es.e: There is free parking for visitors, as well as a restaurant and picnic area (= a special area with tables where people can have a picnic ) .
es.c: 除了餐厅和野餐区，我们还为游客提供免费停车位。

d: n 照片，图画；影片；景色；化身 shapes, lines etc painted or drawn on a surface, showing what someone or something looks like；v 画；想像；描写 to show someone or something in a photograph, painting, or drawing

es.e: The room had several pictures on the walls.
es.c: 那个房间墙上有几幅画。

es.e: a book with pictures in it
es.c: 带插图的书

es.e: He asked her permission to paint her picture (= paint a picture of her ) .
es.c: 他请求她允许为她画像。

d: n 馅饼；饼图；爱说话的人 fruit baked inside a  pastry  covering；vt 使杂乱

es.e: I had a steak and kidney pie with chips.
es.c: 我吃了一份牛肉腰子馅饼加薯条。

d: n 块；件；篇；硬币 an amount of something that has been separated from the main part；v 修补；接合；凑合

es.e: Cut off a piece of wood 5 cm in length.
es.c: 截下一段五厘米长的木头。

es.e: His trousers were held up with a piece of string.
es.c: 他的裤子靠一根细绳系着。

es.e: Would you like a small or a large piece?
es.c: 你想要一小块还是一大块？

d: n 猪；猪肉 a farm animal with short legs, a fat body and a curved tail. Pigs are kept for their meat, which includes  pork  ,  bacon  and  ham  .；v 生小猪；像猪一样过活

es.e: He kept pigs and poultry.
es.c: 他养过猪和家禽。

d: n 堆；大量；建筑群 a group of several things of the same type that are put on top of each other；v 累积；打桩于

es.e: He balanced the plate on the top of a pile of books.
es.c: 他把盘子在一摞书上放稳。

d: n 药丸；弹丸，子弹；口服避孕药 a small solid piece of medicine that you swallow whole；v 把…制成丸剂；使服用药丸；抢劫，掠夺（古语）

es.e: He has to take pills to control his blood pressure.
es.c: 他必须服药控制血压。

es.e: {"COLLOINEXA":["sleeping pills"]}
es.c: 安眠药

es.e: a bottle of vitamin pills
es.c: 一瓶维生素片

d: n 枕头 a cloth bag filled with soft material that you put your head on when you are sleeping；v 垫；枕于…；使…靠在 to rest your head somewhere

es.e: I’ll be asleep as soon as my head hits the pillow.
es.c: 我头一碰到枕头就会睡着。

d: n 飞行员；领航员 someone who operates the controls of an aircraft or spacecraft；adj 试点的 A pilot plan or a pilot project is one that is used to test an idea before deciding whether to introduce it on a larger scale；v 驾驶；领航；试用 to

es.e: an airline pilot
es.c: 航空公司飞行员

es.e: a fighter pilot
es.c: 战斗机驾驶员

es.e: The official report into the accident says that it was caused by pilot error (= a mistake by the pilot ) .
es.c: 那宗事故的官方报告称事故是由飞行员失误造成的。

d: n 大头针，别针，针；栓；琐碎物 a piece of metal, sometimes containing jewels, that you fasten to your clothes to wear as a decoration；v 钉住；压住；将……用针别住 to fasten something somewhere, or to join two things together, using a pin

es.e: ...the 18-inch steel pin holding his left leg together.
es.c: …将他的左腿固定起来的18英寸长的钢钉。

d: v 渴望，痛苦；憔悴 If you pine for something, you want it very much, especially when it is unlikely that you will be able to have it；n [林] 松树；凤梨，菠萝 a tall tree with long hard sharp leaves that do not fall off in winter；adj 松木的；似

es.e: I pine for the countryside.
es.c: 我渴望乡下的生活。

d: n [园艺] 菠萝；[园艺] 凤梨 a large yellow-brown tropical fruit or its sweet juicy yellow flesh；adj 凤梨科的

es.e: pineapple chunks
es.c: 菠萝块

es.e: pineapple juice
es.c: 菠萝汁

d: n 粉红色；化身，典范；石竹花；头面人物 a pale red colour；v 扎，刺，戳；使…变粉红色；使…面红耳赤 to prick lightly with a sword or rapier；adj 粉红的；比较激进的；石竹科的；脸色发红的 pale red

es.e: Her room was decorated in bright pinks and purples.
es.c: 她的房间装饰成明亮的粉红色和紫色。

es.e: She had arrived dressed in pink.
es.c: 她穿着粉色的衣服来了。

d: n 品脱；一品脱的量；一品脱牛奶或啤酒 a unit for measuring an amount of liquid, especially beer or milk. In Britain a pint is equal to 0.568 litres, and in the US it is equal to 0.473 litres.

es.e: He’s gone down the pub for a quick pint.
es.c: 他去小酒馆匆匆喝上一品脱啤酒。

d: n 先锋；拓荒者 someone who is important in the early development of something, and whose work or ideas are later developed by other people；v 开辟；倡导；提倡 to be the first person to do, invent or use something

es.e: the early pioneers of the Dakota territory
es.c: 达科他地区的早期拓荒者

d: n 管；烟斗；笛 a tube through which a liquid or gas flows；v 吹笛；尖叫 to make a musical sound, using a pipe

es.e: a water pipe
es.c: 水管

es.e: a frozen waste pipe
es.c: 冻住的污水管

es.e: copper pipes
es.c: 铜管

d: n 怜悯，同情；遗憾 used to show that you are disappointed about something and you wish things could happen differently；v 对……表示怜悯；对……感到同情 to feel sorry for someone because they are in a very bad situation

es.e: It’s a great pity Joyce wasn’t invited.
es.c: 乔伊斯没有受到邀请太遗憾了。

es.e: I like Charlie. Pity he had to marry that awful woman.
es.c: 我喜欢查利，遗憾的是他得和那个糟糕的女人结婚。

es.e: A pity we can’t find the guy who did it.
es.c: 真遗憾我们找不到那个干了这件事的家伙。

d: n 地方；住所；座位 a space or area, for example a particular point on a surface or in a room, building, town, city etc；v 放置；任命；寄予 to put something somewhere, especially with care

es.e: Make sure you keep the key in a safe place.
es.c: 一定要把钥匙放在安全的地方。

es.e: I’ve spent the day dashing about from place to place.
es.c: 我这一天尽是在东奔西跑。

es.e: The place was full of screaming children.
es.c: 那地方全是大叫大嚷的孩子们。

d: adj 平的；简单的；朴素的；清晰的 in clear and simple words, without using technical language；n 平原；无格式；朴实无华的东西 a large area of flat dry land；adv 清楚地；平易地

es.e: The document, written in plain English, tells you about your new policy.
es.c: 这份文件用简明的英语写成，解释了你们的新政策。

d: n 计划；平面图 something you have decided to do；v 计划；设计；打算 to think carefully about something you want to do, and decide how and when you will do it

es.e: His plan is to get a degree in economics and then work abroad for a year.
es.c: 他计划先取得经济学学位，然后去国外工作一年。

es.e: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
es.c: 你周末有什么打算？

es.e: There’s been a change of plan – we’re not going to Ibiza after all.
es.c: 计划有变，我们终究还是不去伊维萨岛了。

d: n 飞机；平面；程度，水平 a vehicle that flies in the air and has wings and at least one engine；v 刨；乘飞机旅行；翱翔 if you plane a piece of wood, you make it smoother or smaller, using a plane；adj 平的；平面的 completely flat and smooth

es.e: It is a big airline with a large fleet of planes.
es.c: 这是一家大航空公司，拥有庞大的机群。

es.e: It’s much quicker to go by plane .
es.c: 乘飞机去会快很多。

es.e: She slept on the plane .
es.c: 她在飞机上睡着了。

d: n 行星 A planet is a large, round object in space that moves around a star. The Earth is a planet.

es.e: The picture shows six of the nine planets in the solar system.
es.c: 这张图片展示太阳系9个行星中的6个行星。

d: n 工厂，车间；植物；设备；庄稼 a living thing that has leaves and roots and grows in earth, especially one that is smaller than a tree；v 种植；培养；栽培；安置 to put plants or seeds in the ground to grow

es.e: Don’t forget to water the plants.
es.c: 别忘记给植物浇水。

d: adj 塑料的；（外科）造型的；可塑的 made of plastic；n 塑料制品；整形；可塑体 a light strong material that is produced by a chemical process, and which can be made into different shapes when it is soft

es.e: a plastic spoon
es.c: 塑料汤匙

es.e: plastic bags
es.c: 塑料袋

d: n 碟；金属板；金属牌；感光底片 a flat piece of metal with words or numbers on it, for example on a door or a car；v 电镀；给…装甲

es.e: The brass plate on the door said ‘Dr Rackman’.
es.c: 黄铜门牌上写着“雷克曼博士”。

d: n 平台；月台，站台；坛；讲台 the raised place beside a railway track where you get on and off a train in a station

es.e: The Edinburgh train will depart from platform six.
es.c: 开往爱丁堡的火车将从六号站台发车。

d: v 游戏；扮演；演奏；播放；同…比赛 to perform a piece of music on a musical instrument；n 游戏；比赛；剧本 a story that is written to be performed by actors, especially in a theatre

es.e: He’s learning to play the piano.
es.c: 他在学习弹钢琴。

es.e: She played a Bach prelude.
es.c: 她演奏了一首巴赫的前奏曲。

es.e: Haden has played with many jazz greats.
es.c: 黑登和许多著名的爵士乐手合作过。

d: n 运动员，比赛者；游戏者，做游戏的人；演奏者，表演者；演员；播放器 someone who takes part in a game or sport

es.e: a basketball player
es.c: 篮球运动员

d: n 运动场，操场；游乐场 an area for children to play, especially at a school or in a park, that often has special equipment for climbing on, riding on etc

es.e: children shouting and running in the playground
es.c: 在操场上叫嚷奔跑的孩子们

d: n 玩伴；游伴 a friend that a child plays with

es.e: The young girl loved to play with her playmates.
es.c: 这个小女孩喜欢和她的玩伴们一起玩。

d: n 游戏室；娱乐室 a room for children to play in

es.e: The playroom is designed for recreational purpose.
es.c: 这游戏室计划用于娱乐活动。

es.e: This wardrobe is actually a secret entrance to a playroom.
es.c: 这个衣柜实际上是一个游戏室的秘密入口。

es.e: In the weeks that followed, that stool became my favorite item in the playroom.
es.c: 此后的几星期里，那个凳子成了娱乐室里我特别喜欢的东西。

d: adj 令人愉快的，舒适的；讨人喜欢的，和蔼可亲的 enjoyable or attractive and making you feel happy；n (Pleasant)人名；(英)普莱曾特

es.e: It had been a pleasant evening.
es.c: 那是个愉快的夜晚。

es.e: the pleasant climate of Southern California
es.c: 南加利福尼亚的宜人气候

es.e: The restaurant was large and pleasant.
es.c: 那家餐厅宽敞舒适。

d: v 使喜欢；使高兴，使满意 to make someone happy or satisfied；int 请（礼貌用语） used to be polite when asking someone to do something

es.e: a business that wants to please its customers
es.c: 希望让顾客满意的一家公司

es.e: She did everything she could to please him.
es.c: 她千方百计讨好他。

es.e: Most children are eager to please .
es.c: 大多数孩子都渴望取悦别人。

d: adj 高兴的；喜欢的；乐意做某事 happy or satisfied；v 满意；愿意（please的过去分词形式）

es.e: Your Dad will be so pleased.
es.c: 你爸爸会非常高兴的。

es.e: She seemed pleased by the compliment.
es.c: 她受了赞扬，显得很高兴。

d: n 快乐；希望；娱乐；令人高兴的事 the feeling of happiness, enjoyment, or satisfaction that you get from an experience；vt 使高兴；使满意；vi 高兴；寻欢作乐

es.e: the simple pleasures of life
es.c: 生活中的简单乐趣

d: n 丰富，大量；充足 a situation in which there is a lot of food and goods available for people；adj 足够的，很多的；adv 足够 used to emphasize that something is more than big enough, fast enough etc

es.e: a land of plenty
es.c: 一片富饶的土地

d: n 情节；图；阴谋 a secret plan by a group of people to do something harmful or illegal；v 密谋；绘图；划分；标绘 to make a secret plan to harm a person or organization, especially a political leader or government

es.e: The court heard how she and her lover hatched a plot (= planned a plot ) to kill her husband.
es.c: 法庭听取了她和情人密谋杀害她丈夫的案情。

es.e: The plot to overthrow the military government was foiled (= prevented from being successful ) .
es.c: 推翻军政府的秘密计划被挫败了。

es.e: an assassination plot
es.c: 一宗暗杀阴谋

d: n 插头；塞子；栓 a round flat piece of rubber used for stopping the water flowing out of a bath or  sink；v 塞住；用插头将与电源接通 to fill or block a small hole

es.e: the bath plug
es.c: 浴缸塞子

d: n 正号，加号；好处；附加额 a  plus sign；adj 正的；附加的 more than zero – used especially when talking about temperatures；prep 加，加上 used to show that one number or amount is added to another

es.e: Daytime temperatures barely reached plus 5˚.
es.c: 白天的气温仅零上5度。

d: abbr （拉）下午（Post Meridiem，等于afternoon）；调相（Phase Modulation）

n 口袋；钱；容器 a type of small bag in or on a coat, trousers etc that you can put money, keys etc in；v 隐藏；忍受；将…放入衣袋 If someone pockets something, they put it in their pocket, for example, because they want to steal it or hide

es.e: Luke came in with his hands in his pockets.
es.c: 卢克走了进来，双手插在口袋里。

es.e: The policeman told me to turn out my pockets (= take everything out of them ) .
es.c: 警察让我把口袋里的东西都掏出来。

es.e: Anthony snatched his letters and pocketed them.
es.c: 安东尼抓过他的信，放进了衣袋中。

d: n 诗 a piece of writing that expresses emotions, experiences, and ideas, especially in short lines using words that  rhyme (= end with the same sound )

es.e: ...a book of love poems.
es.c: …一本爱情诗集。

d: n 诗人 someone who writes poems

es.e: He was a painter and poet.
es.c: 他是一位画家兼诗人。

d: n 要点；得分；标点；[机] 尖端 a single fact, idea, or opinion that is part of an argument or discussion；v 指向；弄尖；加标点于 to show something to someone by holding up one of your fingers or a thin object towards it

es.e: That’s a very interesting point.
es.c: 那个观点很有趣。

es.e: She made some extremely good points.
es.c: 她提出了一些很不错的观点。

es.e: There are three important points we must bear in mind.
es.c: 有三个要点我们必须记住。

d: v 污染；使中毒，放毒于；败坏；阻碍 to give someone poison, especially by adding it to their food or drink, in order to harm or kill them；n 毒药，毒物；酒；有毒害的事物；[助剂] 抑制剂 a substance that can cause death or serious illness if you eat it, drink

es.e: She was accused in 1974 of poisoning her second husband, Charles.
es.c: 1974 年她被控毒死了她的第二任丈夫查尔斯。

es.e: He killed several people by poisoning their tea.
es.c: 他在茶里下毒杀死了几个人。

d: adj 有毒的；恶毒的；讨厌的 containing poison or producing poison

es.e: Some mushrooms are extremely poisonous.
es.c: 一些蘑菇有剧毒。

es.e: poisonous gases such as hydrogen sulfide
es.c: 硫化氢等有毒气体

es.e: poisonous substances
es.c: 有毒物质

d: n 杆；极点；电极 a long stick or post usually made of wood or metal, often set upright in the ground to support something；v 用竿支撑 to push a boat along in the water using a pole

es.e: a telephone pole
es.c: 电话线杆

d: n 警察，警方；治安 the people who work for an official organization whose job is to catch criminals and make sure that people obey the law；v 监督；管辖；维持治安；为…配备警察 to keep control over a particular area in order to make sure that law

es.e: Police surrounded the courthouse.
es.c: 警察围在法院大楼四周。

d: n 警察，警员；[分化] 淀帚（橡皮头玻璃搅棒） A policeman is a man who is a member of the police force
n 政策，方针；保险单 a way of doing something that has been officially agreed and chosen by a political party, a business, or another organization

es.e: an insurance policy
es.c: 保险单

d: n 磨光，擦亮；擦亮剂；优雅，精良 an act of polishing a surface to make it smooth and shiny；v 擦亮，变光滑 to make something smooth, bright, and shiny by rubbing it；adj 波兰的

es.e: An occasional polish will keep wall tiles looking good.
es.c: 偶尔擦拭一下能使墙砖保持美观。

d: adj 有礼貌的，客气的；文雅的；上流的；优雅的 behaving or speaking in a way that is correct for the social situation you are in, and showing that you are careful to consider other people’s needs and feelings

es.e: She’s always very polite.
es.c: 她总是很有礼貌。

es.e: polite, well-behaved children
es.c: 懂礼貌、守规矩的孩子

es.e: a clear but polite request
es.c: 明确但客气的请求

d: adj 政治的；党派的 Political means relating to the way power is achieved and used in a country or society

es.e: All other political parties there have been completely banned.
es.c: 那里的其他所有政党都已经完全被取缔了。

es.e: The government is facing another political crisis.
es.c: 该政府正面临着另一场政治危机。

d: n 政治家，政客 someone who works in politics, especially an elected member of the government

es.e: politicians who are trying to get the minority vote
es.c: 努力争取少数族群选票的政治家

es.e: a British Labour politician
es.c: 英国工党政治家

d: n 政治，政治学；政治活动；政纲 ideas and activities relating to gaining and using power in a country, city etc

es.e: a good understanding of politics in China
es.c: 对中国政治很好的了解

es.e: modern American politics
es.c: 现代美国政治

es.e: Politics have always interested Anita.
es.c: 阿妮塔一直对政治感兴趣。

d: v 污染；玷污；败坏 to make air, water, soil etc dangerously dirty and not suitable for people to use

es.e: beaches polluted by raw sewage
es.c: 受未经处理的污水污染的海滩

es.e: The factory pollutes the air and water.
es.c: 那家工厂污染了空气和水。

d: n 污染 the process of making air, water, soil etc dangerously dirty and not suitable for people to use, or the state of being dangerously dirty

es.e: California’s tough anti-pollution laws
es.c: 加利福尼亚州严厉的反污染法

d: vt 筑成池塘；vi 筑成池塘；n 池塘 a small area of fresh water that is smaller than a lake, that is either natural or artificially made

es.e: The path descends to  the pond.
es.c: 小路下斜通到池塘。

es.e: This pond often catches in winter.
es.c: 这个池塘在冬天常常结冰。

es.e: Wild flowers and grasses rimmed the little pond.
es.c: 各种野花和野草环绕着这个小池塘。

d: n 联营；撞球；水塘；共同资金 a small area of still water in a hollow place；v 联营，合伙经营

es.e: pools of water with tiny fish in them
es.c: 有小鱼的一个个水池

es.e: Mosquitoes breed in stagnant pools of water.
es.c: 蚊子在死水塘中繁殖。

d: adj 贫穷的；可怜的；贫乏的；卑鄙的 used to show sympathy for someone because they are so unlucky, unhappy etc；n (Poor)人名；(英、伊朗)普尔

es.e: Poor kid, he’s had a rough day.
es.c: 可怜的孩子，今天他真倒霉。

es.e: You poor thing , you’ve had a hard time of it, haven’t you?
es.c: 可怜的东西，你过得很苦，是不是？

d: abbr 卖点广告（Point of Purchase）
n 爆米花，爆玉米花 a kind of corn that swells and bursts open when heated, and is usually eaten warm with salt or sugar as a  snack
adj 流行的，通俗的；受欢迎的；大众的；普及的 liked by a lot of people

es.e: Hilary was popular at school.
es.c: 希拉里在学校里很受欢迎。

es.e: a popular holiday resort
es.c: 人们喜欢的度假胜地

es.e: Coffee is probably the most popular drink in the world.
es.c: 咖啡很可能是世界上最受欢迎的饮料。

d: n 人口；[生物] 种群，[生物] 群体；全体居民 the number of people living in a particular area, country etc

es.e: Nearly 70 percent of the population still live in the countryside.
es.c: 人口中差不多有70%仍住在乡村。

d: n 猪肉 the meat from pigs；vt 与女子性交

es.e: pork chops
es.c: 猪排

d: n 粥，糊；麦片粥  oats  that are cooked with milk or water and served hot for breakfast；vt 服刑
n 港口，口岸；（计算机的）端口；左舷；舱门 a place where ships can be loaded and unloaded；v 转向左舷 to turn or be turned towards the port

es.e: Britain’s largest port
es.c: 英国最大的港口城市

d: adj 手提的，便携式的；轻便的 able to be carried or moved easily；n 手提式打字机

es.e: a portable radio
es.c: 便携式收音机

d: n 门房；服务员；行李搬运工；守门人 someone whose job is to carry people’s bags at railway stations, airports etc

es.e: Our taxi pulled up at Old Delhi station and a porter sprinted to the door.
es.c: 我们的出租车停在老德里车站，一个搬运工疾步跑向车门。

d: n 位置，方位；职位，工作；姿态；站位 the way someone is standing, sitting, or lying；v 安置；把……放在适当位置 to carefully put something in a particular position

es.e: Lie in a comfortable position .
es.c: 以一个舒服的姿势躺下。

es.e: Frankie shifted his position so that his knees would not become cramped.
es.c: 弗朗基换了个姿势，这样他的膝盖就不会老蜷着动弹不得。

d: v 控制；使掌握；持有；迷住；拥有，具备 to have a particular quality or ability

es.e: Different workers possess different skills.
es.c: 不同的工人拥有不同技能。

es.e: He no longer possessed the power to frighten her.
es.c: 他再也吓不倒她了。

d: n 拥有；财产；领地；自制；着迷 if something is in your possession, you own it, or you have obtained it from somewhere

es.e: That information is not in our possession.
es.c: 那则信息不归我们所有。

es.e: How did the painting come into your possession (= how did you get it ) ?
es.c: 这幅画是怎么到你手上的？

es.e: The finance company now has possession of the house.
es.c: 这家金融公司目前拥有这所房子。

d: n 可能性；可能发生的事物 if there is a possibility that something is true or that something will happen, it might be true or it might happen

es.e: There’s always a possibility that he might go back to Seattle.
es.c: 他也许会回到西雅图去，这种可能性一直存在。

es.e: the possibility of an enemy attack
es.c: 敌人进攻的可能性

es.e: There was no possibility of changing the voting procedure.
es.c: 改变投票程序是不可能的。

d: adj 可能的；合理的；合适的 if something is possible, it can be done or achieved；n 可能性；合适的人；可能的事物 someone or something that might be suitable or acceptable for a particular purpose

es.e: Is it possible toget tickets for the game?
es.c: 有没有可能弄到比赛的门票？

es.e: It might be possible for the documents to be sent over.
es.c: 这些文件也许可以发送过去。

es.e: Computer technology makes it possible for many people to work from home.
es.c: 计算机技术让很多人可以在家里工作。

d: adv 可能地；也许；大概 used when saying that something may be true or likely, although you are not completely certain

es.e: This last task is possibly the most difficult.
es.c: 这最后一项任务也许是最难的。

es.e: It will take three weeks, possibly longer.
es.c: 要花三个星期，也许更久。

es.e: ‘Will you be here tomorrow?’ ‘Possibly.’
es.c: “你明天到这儿来吗？”“也许吧。”

d: n 岗位；邮件；标杆 letters, packages etc that are sent and delivered；v 张贴；公布；邮递；布置 to put up a public notice about something on a wall or notice board

es.e: Was there any post for me today?
es.c: 今天有我的邮件吗？

es.e: Emma was opening her post .
es.c: 埃玛正在拆邮件。

d: n 邮资，邮费 the money charged for sending a letter, package etc by post

es.e: How much is the postage for a postcard?
es.c: 寄一张明信片的邮资是多少？

d: n 邮箱 a box in a public place, into which you put letters that you want to send

es.e: I was so certain that it had happened, that I wrote a letter to my parents that same night and put it in the postbox at the corner of the street.
es.c: 我如此地肯定这件事的发生，当晚我写信给我的父母，把信投进了街角的邮箱。

es.e: He feels the floor of the post office move beneath him, and he tries to turn his eyes from her, to ground his gaze in something solid: postbox, ceiling tile, window.
es.c: 他感到邮局的地板在脚下移动，他试图把视线从她身上挪开，让他的注视停留在某种结实可靠的东西上：邮箱、天花板上的瓷砖、窗户。

d: n 明信片 a card that can be sent in the post without an envelope, especially one with a picture on it

es.e: Don’t forget to send us a postcard!
es.c: 别忘了给我们寄张明信片！

d: n （英）邮政编码；邮区号 a group of numbers and letters that you write at the end of an address on an envelope, package etc. The postcode shows the exact area where someone lives and helps the post office deliver the post more quic

es.e: Type your street address and postcode.
es.c: 键入你的街道地址和邮政编码。

d: n 海报，广告；招贴 a large printed notice, picture, or photograph, used to advertise something or as a decoration

es.e: A team of volunteers were putting up posters .
es.c: 一队志愿者正在张贴海报。

es.e: a poster campaign for the election
es.c: 选举的海报宣传

d: n 邮递员；邮差 someone whose job is to collect and deliver letters

es.e: That postman is in charge of this route.
es.c: 那个邮递员负责这条投递线路。

es.e: The old man often stands here to watch out for the postman.
es.c: 老人常常站在这儿等邮递员。

es.e: At the door he met an intelligent postman coming out with letters for the morning delivery.
es.c: 他在邮政总局门口碰见一个伶俐的邮差，拿着信从邮局走出来，去送早班信。

d: v 使…延期；把…放在次要地位；把…放在后面

es.e: The match had to be postponed until next week.
es.c: 比赛不得不推迟到下周举行。

d: n 壶；盆；罐 a container for a plant, usually made of plastic or baked clay；v 把…装罐；射击；节略 If you pot a young plant, or part of a plant, you put it into a container filled with soil, so it can grow there

es.e: herbs growing in pots
es.c: 长在花盆里的草本植物

es.e: Pot the cuttings individually.
es.c: 将这些剪枝一个个的装盆。

d: n [作物] 土豆，[作物] 马铃薯 a round white vegetable with a brown, red, or pale yellow skin, that grows under the ground

es.e: Marie stood at the sink, peeling potatoes (= cutting off the skin ) .
es.c: 玛丽站在洗涤槽边削土豆皮。

d: n 潜能；可能性；[电] 电势 the possibility that something will develop in a particular way, or have a particular effect；adj 潜在的；可能的；势的 likely to develop into a particular type of person or thing in the future

es.e: The boy has great potential.
es.c: 这个男孩有很大的潜力。

d: n 英镑；重击，重击声；兽栏；拘留所 the standard unit of money in Britain, which is divided into 100 pence；v 捣烂；敲打；监禁，拘留 If you pound something, you crush it into a paste or a powder or into very small pieces

es.e: They spent over a thousand pounds.
es.c: 他们花了一千多英镑。

es.e: a multi-million pound business
es.c: 一笔几百万英镑的生意

es.e: a five pound note
es.c: 五英镑的纸币

d: n 倾泻；流出；骤雨；v 灌，注；倒；倾泻；倾吐 to make a liquid or other substance flow out of or into a container by holding it at an angle

es.e: She poured coffee for everyone.
es.c: 她为每个人都倒了咖啡。

d: n 粉；粉末；[化工][军] 火药；尘土 a dry substance in the form of very small grains；v 使成粉末；撒粉；搽粉于

es.e: curry powder
es.c: 咖喱粉

es.e: talcum powder
es.c: 滑石[爽身]粉

es.e: Grind the sugar into a powder .
es.c: 把糖碾成粉末。

d: n 力量，能力；电力，功率；政权，势力；[数] 幂 the ability or right to control people or events；v 激励；供以动力；使…有力量 to supply power to a vehicle or machine；adj 借影响有权势人物以操纵权力的 clothes which you wear at work to make you look important or confident

es.e: They seized power in a military coup.
es.c: 他们在一场军事政变中夺取了政权。

d: adj 强大的；强有力的 a powerful person, organization, group etc is able to control and influence events and other people’s actions；adv 很；非常

es.e: He was one of the most powerful men in Bohemia.
es.c: 他是波希米亚最有权势的人物之一。

es.e: a very influential and powerful family
es.c: 很有权势的家庭

es.e: rich and powerful nations
es.c: 富强的国家

d: adj 实际的；实用性的 relating to real situations and events rather than ideas, emotions etc

es.e: Candidates should have training and practical experience in basic electronics.
es.c: 应征者应该具备基础电子学方面的培训和实践经验。

es.e: the practical problems of old age
es.c: 老年的实际问题

es.e: They provide financial and practical help for disabled students.
es.c: 他们为残障学生提供经济上的援助以及实际的帮助。

d: n 实践；练习；惯例 when you do a particular thing, often regularly, in order to improve your skill at it；v 练习；实习；实行

es.e: It takes hours of practice to learn to play the guitar.
es.c: 学习弹吉他需要长时间的练习。

es.e: With a little more practice you should be able to pass your test.
es.c: 稍微再练一练，你应该能通过考试了。

es.e: We have choir practice on Tuesday evening.
es.c: 星期二晚上我们要练习合唱。

d: n 大草原；牧场 a wide open area of fairly flat land in North America which is covered in grass or wheat

es.e: About 160 species of rare birds live in the swamps and prairie there.
es.c: 大约有160种珍稀鸟类栖息在这里的沼泽地和大草原上。

es.e: To assemble a prairie takes time -- even if you have all the pieces.
es.c: 整合一个大草原需要时间——哪怕你手中已掌握了所有分块。

d: n 赞扬；称赞；荣耀；崇拜 words that you say or write in order to praise someone or something；v 赞美，歌颂；表扬 to say that you admire and approve of someone or something, especially publicly

es.e: It’s important to give children plenty of praise and encouragement.
es.c: 对小孩子多加表扬和鼓励是很重要的。

es.e: Her teacher was full of praise for her work.
es.c: 老师对她的作业赞不绝口。

es.e: His first novel received high praise .
es.c: 他的第一部小说受到了高度赞扬。

d: v 祈祷；恳求；央求 to speak to God in order to ask for help or give thanks；n (Pray)人名；(匈)普劳伊；(英)普雷

es.e: They went to the mosque to pray.
es.c: 他们去清真寺祷告。

d: n 祈祷，祷告；恳求；祈祷文 words that you say when praying to God or gods

es.e: Our thoughts and prayers are with you at this difficult time.
es.c: 在这艰难时期我们时刻思念你，为你祈祷。

es.e: The children said their prayers and got into bed.
es.c: 孩子们做完祷告后上床睡觉了。

es.e: God has answered your prayer .
es.c: 上帝应许了你的祷告。

d: adj 宝贵的；珍贵的；矫揉造作的 something that is precious is valuable and important and should not be wasted or used without care；n (Precious)人名；(英)普雷舍斯，普雷舍丝(女名)

es.e: planes delivering precious supplies of medicine and food
es.c: 运送药品、食品等宝贵物资的飞机

es.e: our planet’s precious resources
es.c: 我们星球上的宝贵资源

d: adj 精确的；明确的；严格的 precise information, details etc are exact, clear, and correct

es.e: precise sales figures
es.c: 准确的销售数据

es.e: It was difficult to get precise information.
es.c: 很难得到确切的消息。

es.e: ‘She’s a lot older than you, isn’t she?’ ‘Fifteen years, to be precise .’
es.c: “她比你大很多，是不是？”“准确地说，大了15岁。”

d: v 预报，预言；预知 to say that something will happen, before it happens

es.e: Sales were five percent lower than predicted.
es.c: 销售额比预期低5%。

es.e: As Liz had predicted , the rumours were soon forgotten.
es.c: 正如利兹所预料的，流言很快就被淡忘了。

d: v 更喜欢；宁愿；提出；提升 to like someone or something more than someone or something else, so that you would choose it if you could

es.e: This type of owl prefers a desert habitat.
es.c: 这种猫头鹰更喜欢沙漠的生活环境。

es.e: She prefers her coffee black.
es.c: 她更喜欢喝黑咖啡。

es.e: the government’s preferred option
es.c: 政府倾向的选择

d: n 偏爱，倾向；优先权 if you have a preference for something, you like it more than another thing and will choose it if you can

es.e: Do you have a colour preference ?
es.c: 你有什么颜色上的偏好吗？

es.e: Parents may be able to express a preference as to the school their child will attend.
es.c: 家长也许可以表明愿意让孩子就读哪所学校。

es.e: The amount of sugar you add will depend on personal preference .
es.c: 加多少糖取决于个人的喜好。

d: adj 怀孕的；富有意义的 if a woman or female animal is pregnant, she has an unborn baby growing inside her body

es.e: care for pregnant women
es.c: 孕妇保健

es.e: I knew right away that I was pregnant.
es.c: 我立即明白我怀孕了。

es.e: I thought I was too old to get pregnant .
es.c: 我觉得自己年龄太大，已经不能怀孕了。

d: n 偏见；侵害 an un-reasonable dislike and distrust of people who are different from you in some way, especially because of their race, sex, religion etc – used to show disapproval；v 损害；使有偏见 to influence someone so that they h

es.e: Women still face prejudice in the workplace.
es.c: 女性在职场中仍然面临歧视。

es.e: It takes a long time to overcome these kinds of prejudices.
es.c: 战胜这些偏见需要假以时日。

d: adj 第一的；最初的 best or most important；n 总理，首相 a  prime minister  – used in news reports

es.e: one of Dublin’s premier hotels
es.c: 都柏林最好的酒店之一

d: n 预备；准备 the process of preparing something or preparing for something

es.e: This dish is good for dinner parties because much of the preparation can be done ahead of time.
es.c: 这道菜适合宴会，因为很多准备工作可以事先做好。

es.e: Plans for the new school are now in preparation .
es.c: 新学校的设计图正在绘制中。

es.e: a course in food service and food preparation
es.c: 餐饮服务和备菜课程

d: v 准备；使适合；装备；起草 to make plans or arrangements for something that will happen in the future

es.e: The prosecution wanted more time to prepare their case.
es.c: 原告想要有更多的时间来准备诉讼。

d: n 药方；指示；惯例 a piece of paper on which a doctor writes what medicine a sick person should have, so that they can get it from a  pharmacist；adj 凭处方方可购买的

es.e: We are trying to cut the price of prescription drugs .
es.c: 我们正努力降低处方药的价格。

es.e: a repeat prescription
es.c: 重复处方

d: v 提出；介绍；呈现；赠送 to give something to someone, for example at a formal or official occasion；adj 现在的；出席的 in a particular place；n 现在；礼物；瞄准 something you give someone on a special occasion or to thank them for something

es.e: She was presented with an award .
es.c: 她被授予一个奖项。

d: n 展示；描述，陈述；介绍；赠送 an event at which you describe or explain a new product or idea

es.e: We will begin a series of presentations to help the public fully understand our system.
es.c: 我们将进行一系列的说明，帮助公众充分了解我们的制度。

d: v 保存；保护；维持；腌；禁猎 to save something or someone from being harmed or destroyed；n 保护区；禁猎地；加工成的食品

es.e: We must encourage the planting of new trees and preserve our existing woodlands.
es.c: 我们必须鼓励栽种新树木，同时也要保护现有的林地。

d: n 总统；董事长；校长；主席 the official leader of a country that does not have a king or queen

es.e: President Bush
es.c: 布什总统

d: v 压；按；逼迫；紧抱 to push something firmly against a surface；n 压；按；新闻；出版社；[印刷] 印刷机 to be criticized in the newspapers or on radio or television

es.e: Manville kept his back pressed flat against the wall.
es.c: 曼维尔后背紧紧地贴在墙上。

es.e: She pressed the gas pedal and the car leapt forwards.
es.c: 她踩下油门，汽车向前冲了出去。

es.e: He pressed a card into her hand before leaving.
es.c: 离开之前他往她手里塞了一张卡片。

d: n 压力；压迫，[物] 压强 an attempt to persuade someone by using influence, arguments, or threats；v 迫使；密封；使……增压

es.e: They are putting pressure on people to vote yes.
es.c: 他们正在向民众施加压力，要求他们投赞成票。

es.e: You must never give in to pressure .
es.c: 你绝不能屈从压力。

d: v 假装，伪装，佯装 to behave as if something is true when in fact you know it is not, in order to deceive people or for fun；adj 假装的 imaginary or not real - used especially by children

es.e: Let’s pretend we’re on the moon.
es.c: 我们假装自己是在月球上吧。

es.e: He’s not asleep – he’s just pretending.
es.c: 他并没睡着，不过是装睡而已。

es.e: To pretend ignorance of the situation would be irresponsible.
es.c: 装作不知情是不负责任的做法。

d: adj 漂亮的；可爱的；优美的 a woman or child who is pretty has a nice attractive face；adv 相当地；颇 fairly or more than a little；n 有吸引力的事物（尤指饰品）；漂亮的人

es.e: a pretty little girl
es.c: 漂亮的小姑娘

es.e: Maria looks much prettier with her hair cut short.
es.c: 玛丽亚把头发剪短好看多了。

d: v 预防，防止；阻止 to stop something from happening, or stop someone from doing something

es.e: The rules are intended to prevent accidents.
es.c: 这些规定旨在预防事故。

es.e: We were prevented from entering the site.
es.c: 我们被阻止进入现场。

es.e: Wrap small ornaments in paper to prevent them being damaged.
es.c: 把小饰品用纸包上以免损坏。

d: n 预览；试映；事先查看 an occasion when you can see a film, play, painting etc before it is shown to the public；v 预览；预演；事先查看 to see or describe something before it is shown to the public

es.e: the press preview of the show (= when people who write for newspapers, television etc could see it )
es.c: 该节目的媒体试映

d: n 价格；价值；代价 the amount of money you have to pay for something；v 给……定价；问……的价格 to decide the price of something that is for sale

es.e: They may pay a high price for their few years of glory.
es.c: 为了短短几年的辉煌，他们也许要付出高昂的代价。

d: n 自豪；骄傲；自尊心 a feeling that you are proud of something that you or someone connected with you has achieved；v 使得意，以…自豪 to be especially proud of something that you do well, or of a good quality that you have

es.e: He wore his medals with pride.
es.c: 他自豪地戴着奖章。

es.e: The people have a sense of pride in their community.
es.c: 人们对自己的社区有一种自豪感。

es.e: His heart swelled with pride when his daughter came in.
es.c: 女儿进来时他的内心充满了自豪感。

d: adj 主要的；初级的；基本的 most important；n 原色；最主要者

es.e: Our primary concern is to provide the refugees with food and health care.
es.c: 我们的头等大事是向难民提供食品和医疗。

es.e: Many of the villagers rely on fishing as their primary source of income.
es.c: 很多村民以打鱼作为他们的主要收入来源。

es.e: Personal safety is of primary importance .
es.c: 人身安全至关重要。

d: adj 原始的，远古的；简单的，粗糙的 belonging to a simple way of life that existed in the past and does not have modern industries and machines；n 原始人 an artist who paints simple pictures like those of a child

es.e: a primitive society
es.c: 原始社会

es.e: a primitive nomadic tribe
es.c: 原始的游牧部落

es.e: the tools used by primitive man
es.c: 原始人所用的工具

d: n 原理，原则；主义，道义；本质，本义；根源，源泉 the basic idea that a plan or system is based on

es.e: The general principle is that education should be available to all children up to the age of 16.
es.c: 总的原则是，16 岁以下儿童都应该能接受教育。

es.e: He called for a return to first principles (= the most important ideas ) of road safety for children.
es.c: 他呼吁回归儿童道路安全的根本原则。

es.e: Similar principles apply in the case of older children (= the principles are the same as others that have been mentioned ) .
es.c: 类似的原则也适用于年纪大些的儿童。

d: n 印刷业；印花布；印刷字体；印章；印记 writing that has been printed, for example in books or newspapers；v 印刷；打印；刊载；用印刷体写；在…印花样 to produce many printed copies of a book, newspaper etc

es.e: There was no print at all on the backs of the tickets.
es.c: 门票背面没有印任何文字。

es.e: the pleasure of seeing my name in print
es.c: 在出版物中看到我名字时的那份喜悦

es.e: Very little of his poetry actually got into print (= was printed ) .
es.c: 他的诗作鲜有付梓。

d: n [计] 打印机；印刷工；印花工 a machine which is connected to a computer and can make a printed record of computer information

es.e: a laser printer
es.c: 激光打印机

es.e: a colour printer
es.c: 彩色打印机

d: n 印刷；印刷术 the act or process of making a book, magazine etc using a machine that puts ink onto paper

es.e: the invention of printing
es.c: 印刷术的发明

es.e: the printing industry
es.c: 印刷业

es.e: a printing error
es.c: 印刷错误

d: n 监狱；监禁；拘留所 a building where people are kept as a punishment for a crime, or while they are waiting to go to court for their  trial；vt 监禁，关押

es.e: He visits his dad in prison every week.
es.c: 他每周都去探望狱中的父亲。

es.e: Ricky has been out of prison for three years now.
es.c: 里基现已出狱三年。

es.e: They’ll probably put him in prison for a long time.
es.c: 他们很可能会让他在监狱里待很长时间。

d: n 囚犯，犯人；俘虏；刑事被告 someone who is kept in a prison as a legal punishment for a crime or while they are waiting for their  trial

es.e: Relationships between the staff and the prisoners are good.
es.c: 狱警和犯人相处良好。

es.e: Prisoners here only serve short sentences.
es.c: 这里的犯人只是短期服刑。

es.e: The organization is arguing for the release of political prisoners (= people in prison because of their political opinions ) .
es.c: 该组织正在争取释放政治犯。

d: adj 私人的；私有的；私下的 for use by one person or group, not for everyone；n 列兵；二等兵 a soldier of the lowest rank

es.e: Morris has a private jet.
es.c: 莫里斯拥有一架私人喷气式飞机。

es.e: He made some notes for his private use.
es.c: 他记了些笔记供自己所用。

es.e: They objected to any form of private property .
es.c: 他们反对任何形式的私有财产。

d: n 特权；优待 a special advantage that is given only to one person or group of people；v 给与…特权；特免 to treat some people or things better than others

es.e: He had no special privileges and was treated just like every other prisoner.
es.c: 他不享受特权，待遇和任何其他犯人一样。

d: n 奖品；奖赏；战利品 something that is given to someone who is successful in a competition, race, game of chance etc；v 珍视；捕获；估价 to think that someone or something is very important or valuable；adj 获奖的 good enough to win a prize o

es.e: In this month’s competition you could win a prize worth £3,000.
es.c: 在本月的竞赛中您可以赢得价值3,000英镑的奖品。

es.e: The first prize has gone to Dr John Gentle.
es.c: 获得一等奖的是约翰·金特尔博士。

es.e: The prizes are awarded (= given ) every year to students who have shown original thinking in their work.
es.c: 这些奖项每年颁发给在学习中表现出创造性思维的学生。

d: adj 很可能的；可信的 likely to exist, happen, or be true；n 很可能的事；大有希望的候选者 someone who is likely to be chosen for a team, to win a race etc

es.e: The probable cause of the fire was faulty wiring.
es.c: 起火的原因很可能是电路故障。

es.e: Success is highly probable .
es.c: 成功的希望相当大。

d: n 难题；引起麻烦的人 a situation that causes difficulties；adj 成问题的；难处理的

es.e: She was older than me, but that wasn’t really a problem.
es.c: 她比我年长，不过那不算什么问题。

d: n 程序，手续；步骤 a way of doing something, especially the correct or usual way

es.e: On board, we were given the usual talk on safety procedures (= what to do if an accident happens, or to prevent an accident ) .
es.c: 在飞机上，我们听了例行的飞行安全讲解。

d: v 处理；加工 to make food, materials, or goods ready to be used or sold, for example by preserving or improving them in some way；n 过程，进行；方法，步骤；作用；程序；推移 a series of actions that are done in order to achieve a particular result

es.e: Goats’ cheese may be processed in many ways.
es.c: 山羊奶干酪可以有多种加工方法。

es.e: Two million workers are employed processing goods for electronic firms.
es.c: 200 万名工人受雇为电子公司加工产品。

d: v 生产；引起；创作；生育，繁殖 to cause a particular result or effect；n 农产品，产品 food or other things that have been grown or produced on a farm to be sold

es.e: New drugs are producing remarkable results .
es.c: 新药正在产生显著的效果。

es.e: a rise in sea level produced by climatic change
es.c: 由气候变化引起的海平面升高

es.e: As a policy, it did not produce the desired effect .
es.c: 作为一项政策，它并未产生预期的效果。

d: n 产品；结果；[数] 乘积；作品 something that is grown or made in a factory in large quantities, usually in order to be sold

es.e: The London factory assembles the finished product .
es.c: 伦敦工厂组装成品。

es.e: He works in marketing and product development.
es.c: 他从事营销和产品开发。

d: n 成果；产品；生产；作品 the process of making or growing things to be sold, especially in large quantities

es.e: the new Shakespeare production at the Arts Theatre
es.c: 艺术剧院新排演的莎士比亚戏剧

d: n 职业，专业；声明，宣布，表白 a job that needs a high level of education and training

es.e: people who work in the professions
es.c: 从事专业性工作的人

es.e: nurses, social workers, and other people in the caring professions
es.c: 护士、社工和其他从事护理行业的人

d: n 利润；利益 money that you gain by selling things or doing business, after your costs have been paid；v 获利；有益 to be useful or helpful to someone

es.e: The shop’s daily profit is usually around $500.
es.c: 这家商店每天的利润一般在500美元左右。

es.e: She sold the business and bought a farm with the profits.
es.c: 她卖了公司，用所得利润买下了一座农场。

es.e: They sold their house at a healthy profit .
es.c: 他们卖掉房子，赚了一大笔钱。

d: n 计划，规划；节目；程序 a series of actions which are designed to achieve something important；v 编程序；制作节目

es.e: the US space program
es.c: 美国太空计划

d: n 进步，发展；前进 the process of getting better at doing something, or getting closer to finishing or achieving something；v 前进，进步；进行 to improve, develop, or achieve things so that you are then at a more advanced stage

es.e: We made good progress despite the snow.
es.c: 尽管下雪，我们的行程还是很顺利。

d: v 阻止，禁止 to say that an action is illegal or not allowed

es.e: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the factory.
es.c: 厂区严禁吸烟。

d: v 设计；计划；表达；投射 to make the picture of a film, photograph etc appear in a larger form on a screen or flat surface；n 工程；计划；事业 a carefully planned piece of work to get information about something, to build something, to impr

es.e: the projected closure of the hospital
es.c: 计划关闭这所医院

d: n 许诺，允诺；希望 A promise is a statement that you make to a person in which you say that you will definitely do something or give them something；v 允诺，许诺；给人以…的指望或希望 If you promise that you will do something, you say to someone

es.e: If you make a promise, you should keep it.
es.c: 如果你许下一个诺言，你就应该遵守它。

es.e: The post office has promised to resume first class mail delivery to the area on Friday.
es.c: 邮局已承诺在星期五恢复该地区第一类邮件的递送。

es.e: He had promised that the rich and privileged would no longer get preferential treatment.
es.c: 他已承诺富人和特权阶层将不会再得到优待。

d: v 促进；提升；推销；发扬 If people promote something, they help or encourage it to happen, increase, or spread

es.e: You don't have to sacrifice environmental protection to promote economic growth.
es.c: 你们没有必要牺牲环保来促进经济增长。

d: v 发音；宣判；断言 to give a judgment or opinion

es.e: The scheme was pronounced a failure.
es.c: 该方案宣告失败。

d: n 发音；读法 the way in which a language or a particular word is pronounced

es.e: She gave the word its French pronunciation.
es.c: 她给出了这个单词的法语发音。

d: adj 适当的；本身的；特有的；正派的 right, suitable, or correct；adv 完全地 completely；n (Proper)人名；(英、德)普罗珀

es.e: Everything was in its proper place (= where it should be ) .
es.c: 每样东西都放在恰当的位置。

es.e: the proper way to clean your teeth
es.c: 正确的刷牙方法

es.e: The proper name for Matthew’s condition is hyperkinetic syndrome.
es.c: 马修的病的恰当名称是多动症。

d: adv 适当地；正确地；恰当地 correctly, or in a way that is considered right

es.e: The brakes don’t seem to be working properly.
es.c: 刹车似乎不正常。

es.e: Then he’s not doing his job properly.
es.c: 那么他没把分内事做好。

es.e: Parents should teach their children to behave properly in public.
es.c: 家长应该教导子女在公共场合要有规有矩。

d: v 保护，防卫；警戒 to keep someone or something safe from harm, damage, or illness

es.e: Are we doing enough to protect the environment?
es.c: 我们在保护环境方面做得够吗？

d: n 保护；防卫；护照 when someone or something is protected

es.e: protection money
es.c: 保护费

d: adj 自豪的；得意的；自负的 feeling pleased about something that you have done or something that you own, or about someone or something you are involved with or related to；n (Proud)人名；(英)普劳德

es.e: Seth was the proud owner of a new sports car.
es.c: 赛思因为有了新跑车而扬扬得意。

d: v 证明；检验；显示 to show that something is true by providing facts, information etc

es.e: You’re wrong, and I can prove it.
es.c: 你错了，我可以证明。

es.e: To prove his point (= show that he was right ) , he mentioned several other experiments which had produced similar results.
es.c: 为了证明自己的观点，他提到了另外几个结果相似的实验。

d: v 提供；规定；准备；装备 to give something to someone or make it available to them, because they need it or want it

es.e: Tea and biscuits will be provided.
es.c: 有茶水和饼干供应。

d: n 省；领域；职权 one of the large areas into which some countries are divided, and which usually has its own local government

es.e: a Chinese province
es.c: 中国的一个省

d: n 酒馆；客栈 a building in Britain where alcohol can be bought and drunk, and where meals are often served

es.e: Do you fancy going to the pub?
es.c: 你想去酒吧吗？

es.e: a pub lunch
es.c: 酒吧午餐

es.e: the pub landlord
es.c: 酒吧老板

d: adj 公众的；政府的；公用的；公立的 relating to all the ordinary people in a country, who are not members of the government or do not have important jobs；n 公众；社会；公共场所 ordinary people who do not work for the government or have any specia

es.e: We have to show that publishing this story is in the public interest (= helpful or useful to ordinary people ) .
es.c: 我们必须证明刊登这篇报道有利于公众。

es.e: full public access to information
es.c: 公众对信息的充分知情权

es.e: Public opinion is gradually shifting in favor of the imprisoned men.
es.c: 舆论渐渐倾向于同情入狱的男子。

d: adv 公然地；以公众名义 in a way that is intended for anyone to know, see, or hear

es.e: She and her family agreed never to discuss the matter publicly.
es.c: 她和家人一致同意，绝不公开讨论那件事。

d: v 出版；发表；公布 to arrange for a book, magazine etc to be written, printed, and sold

es.e: The first edition was published in 1765.
es.c: 第一版于1765年出版。

es.e: They are publishing the dictionary on CD-ROM.
es.c: 那部词典他们将以光盘版的形式推出。

d: v 拉；拔；拖 to use your hands to make something or someone move towards you or in the direction that your hands are moving；n 拉，拉绳；拉力，牵引力；拖 an act of using force to move something towards you or in the same direction that you

es.e: Mom! Davey’s pulling my hair!
es.c: 妈妈! 戴维拽我的头发！

es.e: His breathing was shallow and his pulse was weak .
es.c: 他呼吸很浅，脉搏微弱。

es.e: She felt his neck. There was no pulse.
es.c: 她摸了摸他的颈部，没有脉搏。

es.e: Her pulse raced (= beat very quickly ) with excitement.
es.c: 她激动得脉搏急速跳动。

d: v 打气；用抽水机抽… To pump a liquid or gas in a particular direction means to force it to flow in that direction using a pump；n 泵，抽水机；打气筒 a machine for forcing liquid or gas into or out of something

es.e: It's not enough to get rid of raw sewage by pumping it out to sea.
es.c: 仅用水泵将未经处理的污水排入海中是不够的。

es.e: The money raised will be used to dig bore holes to pump water into the dried-up lake.
es.c: 筹到的钱款将用来挖井眼，再将水抽入干涸的湖中。

d: adj 准时的，守时的；精确的 arriving, happening, or being done at exactly the time that has been arranged

es.e: She’s always very punctual for appointments.
es.c: 她一向准时赴约。

es.e: the punctual payment of invoices
es.c: 准时结清费用清单

es.c: 寂静间或被笑声打破。

d: n 标点；标点符号 the marks used to divide a piece of writing into sentences, phrases etc

es.c: 他以很差的语法和标点符号使用而出名。

d: v 惩罚；严厉对待；贪婪地吃喝 to make someone suffer because they have done something wrong or broken the law

es.c: 要惩罚孩子，不应该用打的方式。

es.e: He promised to punish severely any officials found guilty of electoral fraud.
es.c: 他承诺要严惩任何在选举中有欺诈行为的官员。

es.e: They deserve to be punished for putting passengers at risk.
es.c: 他们置乘客于危险之中，理应受到惩罚。

es.c: …一个发起运动反对体罚儿童的组织。

d: n 学生；[解剖] 瞳孔；未成年人 someone who is being taught, especially a child

es.c: 大约20名小学生在这里学习音乐。

es.c: 教职员工和学生

es.c: 一名优秀的小学生

es.c: 她付钱买好东西离开了。

es.c: 我附上小票作为购物凭证。

es.e: She made two purchases from my stall.
es.c: 她从我的货摊上买了两样东西。

d: adj 纯的；纯粹的；纯洁的；清白的；纯理论的 a pure substance or material is not mixed with anything；n (Pure)人名；(俄)普雷

es.c: 纯金制成的戒指

es.e: Our beef patties are 100% pure .
es.c: 我们的牛肉饼是100%的纯牛肉。

es.c: 他气得脸色发紫。

es.c: 尼克开始的时候头脑中并没有明确的目标。

es.c: 我锁上门，然后把钥匙丢进手提包里。

es.c: 它一动不动，因此她加力去推。

es.e: I promised to push him on the swings for as long as he wanted.
es.c: 我答应他想在秋千上荡多久我就推多久。

es.e: shoppers pushing their grocery carts
es.c: 推着购物车的购物者

d: v 放；表达；移动；安置；赋予 to move something to a particular place or position, especially using your hands；n 掷；笨蛋；投击；怪人；adj 固定不动的

es.e: He put the coffee on the table.
es.c: 他把咖啡放在桌上。

es.e: Where did you put the programmes?
es.c: 你把节目单放在哪里了？

d: v 使…困惑；使…为难；苦思而得出 to confuse someone or make them feel slightly anxious because they do not understand something；n 谜；难题；迷惑 something that is difficult to understand or explain

es.e: a question that continues to puzzle scientists
es.c: 一直困扰科学家的问题

es.c: 他对自己的话引起的反应感到困惑不解。

es.c: 令我不解的是，他的书为什么如此受欢迎。

es.e: different levels of the management pyramid
es.c: 金字塔式管理体系中的不同层次

es.c: 里士满气得发抖。

d: n 资格；条件；限制；赋予资格 if you have a qualification, you have passed an examination or course to show you have a particular level of skill or knowledge in a subject

es.c: 他离校时没有拿到任何文凭。

es.c: 很多地的土质很差。

es.c: 只使用上等的材料。

es.c: 这学期你的作业在完成数量和质量上都有提高。

es.c: 我希望你们两个别再吵了。

es.c: 大概是一又四分之一页。

es.c: 把蛋糕切成四等份。

es.c: 方块Q，方块王后

es.c: 我能问你个问题吗？

es.c: 我恐怕无法回答那个问题。

d: n 问卷；调查表 a written set of questions which you give to a large number of people in order to collect information

es.c: 教师们将被要求填写一份调查问卷。

es.c: 你得排队。

es.c: 她的指甲都咬到肉里了。

es.c: 我们得安静点，免得吵醒宝宝。

es.c: 这车真好，发动机声音很小。

es.e: I’ll be as quiet as a mouse (= very quiet ).
es.c: 我会像老鼠一样悄无声息的。

es.e: ...an old patchwork quilt.
es.c: …一条旧的拼布被子。

d: v 离开；放弃；停止；使…解除 to leave a job, school etc, especially without finishing it completely；n 离开；[计] 退出；adj 摆脱了…的；已经了结的

es.c: 他和一个同事争吵后就辞职了。

es.c: 我十六岁辍学。

es.e: She has decided to quit show business.
es.c: 她已决定退出娱乐圈。
