es.c: 当时我对此感到相当痛苦。

es.e: Well, actually it requires quite a bit of work and research.
es.c: 呃，实际上这需要相当多的工作和研究。

d: n 考查；恶作剧；课堂测验 a short test that a teacher gives to a class；v 挖苦；张望；对…进行测验

es.e: a biology quiz
es.c: 生物测验

d: n 兔子，野兔 a small animal with long ears and soft fur, that lives in a hole in the ground；v 让…见鬼去吧

es.e: The rabbit disappeared in the bushes.
es.c: 那只兔子消失在树丛中。

es.e: At this time, a robust rabbit said: "No, or eat me !
es.c: 这时，一只健壮的兔子又说：“不，还是先吃我吧！

d: n 属，种；种族，人种；家庭，门第 one of the main groups that humans can be divided into according to the colour of their skin and other physical features；v 使参加比赛；和…竞赛；使急走，使全速行进 to compete against someone or something in a race

es.e: The school welcomes children of all races .
es.c: 该校欢迎各种族的学生就读。

es.e: a person of mixed race
es.c: 混血儿

es.e: The law forbids discrimination on the grounds of race or religion.
es.c: 法律禁止以种族或宗教信仰为由歧视他人。

d: adj 种族的；人种的 relating to the relationships between different races of people who now live in the same country or area

es.e: a victim of racial discrimination
es.c: 种族歧视的受害者

es.e: This part of the community needs to be protected from racial prejudice .
es.c: 需保护社区里的这一部分人，使其免受种族偏见的伤害。

es.e: evidence of racial harassment
es.c: 种族骚扰的证据

d: n 辐射；发光；放射物 a form of energy that comes especially from nuclear reactions, which in large amounts is very harmful to living things

es.e: An accident at the power station could result in large amounts of radiation being released.
es.c: 发电站事故会造成大量核辐射泄漏。

es.e: a lethal dose of radiation
es.c: 致命剂量的辐射

d: n 收音机；无线电广播设备 a piece of electronic equipment which you use to listen to programmes that are broadcast, such as music and news；v 用无线电进行通信 to send a message using a radio

es.e: The last 12 months have been difficult ones for local radio.
es.c: 最近的12个月对地方广播电台来说是艰难的。

d: adj [核] 放射性的；有辐射的 a radioactive substance is dangerous because it contains  radiation (= a form of energy that can harm living things )

es.e: the problem of how to dispose of radioactive waste
es.c: 如何处理放射性废物的问题

es.e: a consignment of highly radioactive plutonium
es.c: 发送的一批高放射性钚

d: n [化学] 镭（88号元素符号Ra） a white metal that is  radioactive  and is used in the treatment of diseases such as  cancer  . It is a chemical  element  : symbol Ra

es.e: Madame Curie discovered radium.
es.c: 居里夫人发现了镭。

es.e: The  radiation  radius of the  radioactive  radium  radiator in the  stadium is  variable.
es.c: 放射性的镭暖气装置的辐射半径在体育场是易变的。

es.e: Madame Curie was the physicist with expertise in chemistry that, in 1898, discovered the radioactive substances of radium and polonium in Paris, France.
es.c: 居里夫人是一位具有化学专门知识的物理学家。 1898年，她在法国巴黎发现了放射性物质的镭和钋。

d: n 破布；碎屑 A rag is a piece of old cloth which you can use to clean or wipe things；v 戏弄；责骂 to laugh at someone or play tricks on them

es.e: He was wiping his hands on an oily rag.
es.c: 他正用一块油腻腻的抹布擦手。

d: n 铁轨；扶手；横杆；围栏 one of the two long metal tracks fastened to the ground that trains move along；v 抱怨；责骂 to complain angrily about something, especially something that you think is very unfair

es.e: Several passengers were leaning against the ship’s rail.
es.c: 几名乘客斜靠在轮船的栏杆上。

d: n （英）铁路；轨道；铁道部门 a system of tracks along which trains run, or a system of trains；vi 乘火车旅行

es.e: a railway company
es.c: 铁路公司

d: n 雨；下雨；雨天；雨季 water that falls in small drops from clouds in the sky；v 下雨；降雨 if it rains, drops of water fall from clouds in the sky

es.e: a night of wind and rain
es.c: 风雨交加的夜晚

es.e: There will be heavy rain in most parts of the country.
es.c: 全国大部分地区将有大雨。

d: n 彩虹；五彩缤纷的排列；幻想 a large curve of different colours that can appear in the sky when there is both sun and rain；adj 五彩缤纷的；彩虹状的；vt 使呈彩虹状；如彩虹般装饰；vi 呈彩虹状

es.e: ...silk and satin in every shade of the rainbow.
es.c: …如彩虹般五颜六色的丝绸与锦缎。

d: n （美）雨衣 a coat that you wear to protect yourself from rain

es.e: He dipped in his raincoat pocket.
es.c: 他把手深深地伸进雨衣口袋里。

es.e: The dark clouds remembered me to take my raincoat along.
es.c: 乌云提醒我带上雨衣。

es.e: If I had taken my raincoat with me this morning, I would not be wet now.
es.c: (从句指过去,主句指现在)。如果我今天早上带了雨衣，现在就不会被淋湿了。

d: n 降雨；降雨量 the amount of rain that falls on an area in a particular period of time

es.e: We’ve had a long period of low rainfall.
es.c: 我们已有很长一段时间雨量偏低。

es.e: The city has received only half its average rainfall of four inches.
es.c: 该市目前的降雨只有往常四英寸平均雨量的一半。

d: adj 下雨的；多雨的 a rainy period of time is one when it rains a lot；n (Rainy)人名；(英)雷尼

es.e: a cold rainy day in October
es.c: 十月里一个寒冷的雨天

es.e: I hate rainy weather .
es.c: 我讨厌雨天。

es.e: the rainy season
es.c: 雨季

d: v 提高；筹集；养育；升起 to move or lift something to a higher position, place, or level；n 高地；上升；加薪 an increase in the money you earn

es.e: Can you raise the lamp so I can see?
es.c: 你能把灯举高点好让我看清吗？

es.e: William raised his hat and smiled at her.
es.c: 威廉抬一抬帽子，朝她笑了笑。

es.e: Raise your hand if you know the right answer.
es.c: 知道正确答案的话，请举手。

d: adj [数] 随机的；任意的；胡乱的 happening or chosen without any definite plan, aim, or pattern；n 随意；adv 胡乱地

es.e: The company has introduced random drug testing of its employees.
es.c: 公司已实行对雇员的随机毒品测试。

es.e: A few random shots were fired.
es.c: 胡乱放了几枪。

es.e: We looked at a random sample of 120 families.
es.c: 我们研究了随机抽样的120个家庭。

d: n 范围；幅度；排；山脉 the limits within which amounts, quantities, ages etc vary；v （在内）变动；平行，列为一行；延伸；漫游；射程达到 to move around in an area without aiming for a particular place

es.e: a temperature range of 72-85˚
es.c: 72 度到85度之间的温度范围

es.e: Even the cheapest property was out of our price range (= too expensive for us ) .
es.c: 即使是最便宜的房子也超出了我们能承受的价格范围。

d: n 排；等级；军衔；队列 the position or level that someone holds in an organization, especially in the police or the army, navy etc；adj 讨厌的；恶臭的；繁茂的 if something is rank, it has a very strong unpleasant smell；v 排列；把…分等 to arrange ob

es.e: He was sentenced to prison and stripped of his rank (= had his rank taken from him ) .
es.c: 他被判入狱，并且被剥夺了军衔。

d: adj 迅速的，急促的；飞快的；险峻的 happening or done very quickly and in a very short time；n 急流；高速交通工具，高速交通网

es.e: The patient made a rapid recovery.
es.c: 病人迅速康复。

es.e: a period of rapid decline
es.c: 迅速衰退期

es.e: He fired three times in rapid succession (= one after another ) .
es.c: 他接连开了三枪。

d: adj 稀有的；稀薄的；半熟的 not seen or found very often, or not happening very often；adv 非常；极其；vi 用后腿站起；渴望

es.e: This species of plant is becoming increasingly rare.
es.c: 这种植物越来越罕见。

es.e: I only saw Helen on the rare occasions when I went into her shop.
es.c: 我只有偶尔去海伦店里时才会见到她。

es.e: It is very rare for her to miss a day at school.
es.c: 她很少有哪一天不上学的。

d: n 鼠；卑鄙小人，叛徒 an animal that looks like a large mouse with a long tail；v 捕鼠；背叛，告密 if someone rats on you, they tell someone in authority about something wrong that you have done

es.e: But you promised to help us, you rat!
es.c: 可你答应过要帮我们的，你这小人！

d: n 比率，率；速度；价格；等级 the number of times something happens, or the number of examples of something within a certain period；v 认为；估价；责骂 if you rate someone or something, you think they are very good

es.e: Immediately his heart rate (= the number of beats per minute ) increased.
es.c: 他的心率立即加快了。

d: adv 宁可，宁愿；相当 You use rather to indicate that something is true to a fairly great extent, especially when you are talking about something unpleasant or undesirable；int 当然啦（回答问题时用）；n (Rather)人名；(英)拉瑟

es.e: I grew up in rather unusual circumstances.
es.c: 我在相当不寻常的环境中长大。

es.e: I'm afraid it's a rather long story.
es.c: 我恐怕这是个相当长的故事。

d: adj 生的；未加工的；阴冷的；刺痛的；擦掉皮的；无经验的；（在艺术等方面）不成熟的 not cooked；n 擦伤处；vt 擦伤

es.e: raw meat
es.c: 生肉

es.e: grated raw carrots
es.c: 磨碎的生胡萝卜

es.e: Cabbage can be eaten raw.
es.c: 洋白菜可以生吃。

d: v 剃，用剃刀刮；n 剃刀 a tool with a sharp blade, used to remove hair from your skin

es.e: BATHROOMS: A man has five items in his bathroom: a toothbrush, shaving cream, razor, a bar of soap, and a towel from the Holiday Inn.
es.c: 一个男人在他的盥洗室里有五件东西：一把牙刷，剃须膏，剃刀，一盒肥皂和从假日旅馆顺来的一条毛巾。

d: v 达到；延伸；伸出手；传开 if someone or something reaches a particular point in their development or in a process or competition, they get to that point；n 范围；延伸；河段；横风行驶 the limit of someone’s power or ability to do something

es.e: Chelsea could reach the final of the European Cup.
es.c: 切尔西队会进入欧洲杯决赛。

d: v 反应；影响；反抗；起反作用 to behave in a particular way or show a particular emotion because of something that has happened or been said

es.e: He reacted angrily to the suggestion that he had lied.
es.c: 说他撒谎，他非常生气。

es.e: She reacted very badly (= was very upset ) when her parents split up.
es.c: 父母离婚的时候，她非常难过。

es.e: You have to react quickly to circumstances.
es.c: 你必须对形势迅速作出反应。

d: v 阅读；读懂，理解 to look at written words and understand what they mean；n 阅读；读物 if you have a read, you spend time reading；adj 有学问的

es.e: I can’t read your writing.
es.c: 我看不懂你写的东西。

es.e: She picked up the letter and read it.
es.c: 她拿起信读了起来。

es.e: Read the instructions carefully before you start.
es.c: 开始前要仔细阅读说明。

d: n 阅读，朗读；读物；读数 the activity or skill of understanding written words；adj 阅读的；v 阅读（read的ing形式）

es.e: She loves reading.
es.c: 她喜欢看书。

es.e: Reading is taught using a combination of several methods.
es.c: 综合运用多种方法进行阅读教学。

d: adj 准备好；现成的；迅速的；情愿的；快要…的 if you are ready, you are prepared for what you are going to do；n 现款；预备好的状态 money that you can use immediately；adv 迅速地；预先；v 使准备好 to make something or someone ready for something

es.e: Come on. Aren’t you ready yet?
es.c: 快点，你还没准备好吗？

es.e: When the doorbell rang he was ready and waiting .
es.c: 门铃响的时候，他已经准备好在等着了。

es.e: Why does it take you so long to get ready to go out?
es.c: 你外出怎么要准备那么长时间？

d: adj 实际的；真实的；实在的 something that is real exists and is important；adv 真正地；确实地；n 现实；实数

es.e: There is a real danger that the disease might spread.
es.c: 这种疾病确实有蔓延的危险。

es.e: We need to tackle the real problems of unemployment and poverty.
es.c: 我们需要解决失业和贫穷这两个实际问题。

es.e: There is no real reason to worry.
es.c: 没有什么真正的理由需要担心。

d: n 现实；实际；真实 what actually happens or is true, not what is imagined or thought

es.e: the distinction between fantasy and reality
es.c: 幻想和现实之间的区别

es.e: TV is used as an escape from reality .
es.c: 电视成了逃避现实的一种方式。

es.e: I think the government has lost touch with reality (= no longer understands what is real or true ) .
es.c: 我认为政府已经脱离了现实。

d: v 实现；认识到；了解；将某物卖得，把(证券等)变成现钱；变卖 to know and understand something, or suddenly begin to understand it

es.e: It took us a while to realize the extent of the tragedy.
es.c: 我们过了一段时间才意识到这场悲剧有多严重。

es.e: It was only later that I realized my mistake.
es.c: 我到后来才认识到自己的错误。

d: n 理由；理性；动机 why something happens, or why someone does something；v 推论；劝说 to form a particular judgment about a situation after carefully considering the facts

es.e: She has reason to feel guilty.
es.c: 她有理由感到内疚。

d: adj 合理的，公道的；通情达理的 fair and sensible

es.e: a reasonable request
es.c: 合情合理的要求

es.e: Be reasonable — you can’t expect her to do all the work on her own!
es.c: 要讲道理，你不能指望她一个人干所有的工作！

es.e: I thought it was a perfectly reasonable (= completely reasonable ) question.
es.c: 我认为这个问题问得很有道理。

d: v 重建；改造，重新组装；复原 to build something again, after it has been damaged or destroyed

es.e: The church was completely rebuilt in the last century.
es.c: 这座教堂在上个世纪全面重建。

d: n 收到；收据；收入 a piece of paper that you are given which shows that you have paid for something；v 收到

es.e: Keep your receipt in case you want to bring it back.
es.c: 保留收据以备退货之需。

es.e: Can you give me a receipt?
es.c: 你能给我一个收条吗？

d: v 收到；接待；接纳 to be given something

es.e: All the children will receive a small gift.
es.c: 每个孩子都会收到一份小礼物。

es.e: Lee received 324 votes (= 324 people voted for him ) .
es.c: 李得到324票。

d: n 接收器；接受者；收信机；收款员，接待者 A receiver is the part of a radio or television that picks up signals and converts them into sound or pictures

es.e: Auto-tuning VHF receivers are now common in cars.
es.c: 自动调谐的超高频信号接收器现普遍使用在小汽车上。

d: adj 最近的；近代的 having happened or started only a short time ago

es.e: Irving’s most recent book
es.c: 欧文最新的书

es.e: recent research into the causes of cancer
es.c: 近来对致癌原因的研究

es.e: the recent past
es.c: 不久前

d: n 接待；接收；招待会；感受；反应 a particular type of welcome for someone, or a particular type of reaction to their ideas, work etc

es.e: She was unsure of her reception after everything that had happened.
es.c: 发生了这些事后，她对自己是否还受欢迎没把握。

es.e: The plans received a mixed reception from unions (= some people liked them, others did not ) .
es.c: 各工会对这些计划反响不一。

d: n 接待员；传达员 someone whose job is to welcome and deal with people arriving in a hotel or office building, visiting a doctor etc

es.e: You tell the receptionist that you are expecting a call from this client and to put them through.
es.c: 你告诉传达员你正在等待一个来自这个客户的电话，并允许将他们接进来。

d: n 食谱；[临床] 处方；秘诀；烹饪法 a set of instructions for cooking a particular type of food

es.e: a recipe book
es.c: 一本烹饪书

d: v 背诵；叙述；列举 to say a poem, piece of literature etc that you have learned, for people to listen to

es.e: She recited a poem that she had learnt at school.
es.c: 她背诵了一首学校里学的诗。

d: v 认出；承认，认可；识别
v 推荐，介绍；劝告；使受欢迎；托付 to advise someone to do something, especially because you have special knowledge of a situation or subject

es.e: Doctors strongly recommend that fathers should be present at their baby’s birth.
es.c: 医生极力建议孩子出生时父亲应该在场。

es.e: Sleeping tablets are not recommended in this case.
es.c: 这种情况下不建议使用安眠药。

es.e: It is dangerous to exceed the recommended dose .
es.c: 超过建议剂量很危险。

d: v 记录，记载；标明；将录音 to write information down or store it in a computer or on film so that it can be looked at in the future；n 档案，履历；唱片；最高纪录 information about something that is written down or stored on computer, film etc so

es.e: Her husband made her record every penny she spent.
es.c: 她丈夫要她把花的每分钱都记下来。

es.e: The coroner recorded a verdict of accidental death.
es.c: 验尸官作出了意外死亡的结论。

es.e: Profits were at record levels.
es.c: 利润水平是创纪录的。

d: n 录音机；记录器；记录员；八孔直笛 a piece of electrical equipment that records music, films etc

es.e: Rodney put the recorder on the desk top and pushed the play button.
es.c: 罗德尼把录音机放在桌面上，按下了播放键。

d: v 恢复；弥补；重新获得 to get better after an illness, accident, shock etc；n 还原至预备姿势

es.e: After a few days of fever, she began to recover.
es.c: 发烧几天之后，她开始恢复。

d: n 娱乐；消遣；休养 an activity that you do for pleasure or amusement

es.e: His only recreations are drinking beer and watching football.
es.c: 他唯一的消遣就是喝啤酒和看足球比赛。

es.e: the provision of recreation facilities
es.c: 提供娱乐设施

d: n 矩形；长方形 a shape that has four straight sides, two of which are usually longer than the other two, and four 90˚ angles at the corners

es.e: Suppose the width of a rectangle is x metres.
es.c: 设长方形的宽是 x 米。

d: v 使再循环；使…重新利用 to use something such as an idea, writing etc again instead of developing something new；n 再生；再循环；重复利用

es.e: The fashion world just keeps recycling old ideas.
es.c: 时装界就是不停地翻新旧观念。

d: n 红色，红颜料；赤字 the colour of blood；adj 红色的；红肿的，充血的 having the colour of blood

es.e: I like the way the artist uses red in this painting.
es.c: 我喜欢画家在这幅作品中对红色的运用。

es.e: the reds and yellows of the trees
es.c: 红黄斑斓，层林尽染

es.e: The corrections were marked in red (= in red ink ) .
es.c: 修改处用红笔标出。

d: v 使改方向；重新寄送 to send something in a different direction；adj 再直接的；n 再直接询问

es.e: The flight was redirected to Cleveland.
es.c: 航班改道飞向克利夫兰。

d: v 减少；降低；使处于；把…分解 to make something smaller or less in size, amount, or price

es.e: The governor announced a new plan to reduce crime.
es.c: 州长宣布了一项降低犯罪率的新计划。

es.e: The helmet law should reduce injuries in motorcycle accidents.
es.c: 头盔法的实施应该能减少摩托车事故的受伤率。

es.e: Small businesses will need to reduce costs in order to survive.
es.c: 小企业要想生存必须削减成本。

d: v 参考；涉及；提到；查阅 If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them

es.e: In his speech, he referred to a recent trip to Canada.
es.c: 在他的讲话中，他提到了最近的加拿大之行。

d: n 裁判员；调解人；介绍人 someone who makes sure that the rules of a sport such as football,  basketball  , or  boxing  , are followed；v 仲裁；担任裁判 to be the referee of a game

es.e: His headmaster agreed to act as his referee.
es.c: 他的校长同意做他的推荐人。

d: n 参考，参照；涉及，提及；参考书目；介绍信；证明书 part of something you say or write in which you mention a person or thing；v 引用

es.e: The official at the American embassy asked me for two references.
es.c: 美国大使馆的官员要我提供两名证明人。

d: v 反映；反射，照出；表达；显示;反省 if a person or a thing is reflected in a mirror, glass, or water, you can see an image of the person or thing on the surface of the mirror, glass, or water

es.e: The drop in consumer spending reflects concern about the economy.
es.c: 消费支出的下降反映出人们对经济的担忧。

d: n 改革，改良；改正 a change or changes made to a system or organization in order to improve it；v 改革，革新；重新组成 to improve a system, law, organization etc by making a lot of changes to it, so that it operates in a fairer or more eff

es.e: Reforms were made to revive the economy.
es.c: 为复苏经济而进行了改革。

d: v 更新；使……恢复；使……清新；消除……的疲劳 if you refresh your computer screen while you are connected to the Internet, you make the screen show any new information that has arrived since you first began looking at it

es.e: A shower will refresh you.
es.c: 洗个淋浴你就凉快了。

d: n 点心；[食品] 茶点；小吃 Refreshments are drinks and small amounts of food that are provided, for example, during a meeting or a trip

es.e: Lunch and refreshments will be provided.
es.c: 将提供午餐和茶点。

d: n 冰箱，冷藏库 a large piece of electrical kitchen equipment, shaped like a cupboard, used for keeping food and drink cool
n 拒绝；优先取舍权；推却；取舍权 when you say firmly that you will not do, give, or accept something

es.e: Her country suffered through her refusal to accept change.
es.c: 她的国家因为她拒绝接受变革而受了害。

d: n 垃圾；废物 waste material that has been thrown away；v 拒绝；不愿；抵制 to say firmly that you will not do something that someone has asked you to do

es.e: a refuse dump
es.c: 垃圾场

es.e: refuse collection
es.c: 垃圾收集

d: n 注意；尊重；问候；凝视 good wishes - used when sending your good wishes to someone or when ending a short letter or message；v 注重，考虑；看待；尊敬；把…看作；与…有关 to think about someone or something in a particular way

es.e: My husband sends his regards .
es.c: 我丈夫向你问好。

es.e: Hope to see you soon. Regards, Chris
es.c: 希望很快见到你。 祝安，克里斯

d: adj 不管的；不顾的；不注意的；adv 不顾后果地；不管怎样，无论如何；不惜费用地 without being affected or influenced by something

es.e: Despite her recent surgery she has been carrying on regardless.
es.c: 尽管她最近动了手术，她却一直在不顾一切地继续工作。

d: n 致意，问候；v 视为，注意（regard的第三人称单数）

es.e: Please give him my regards.
es.c: 请转达我对他的问候。

es.e: Should you happen to see him, please give him my regards.
es.c: 如果你碰巧见到他，请代我向他致意。

d: v 登记；注册；记录；挂号邮寄；把…挂号；正式提出 to put someone’s or something’s name on an official list；n 登记；注册；记录；寄存器；登记簿 an official list of names of people, companies etc, or a book that has this list

es.e: The tanker is registered in Rotterdam.
es.c: 这艘油轮是在鹿特丹登记的。

d: n 遗憾；抱歉；悲叹 sadness that you feel about something, especially because you wish it had not happened；v 后悔；惋惜；哀悼 to feel sorry about something you have done and wish you had not done it

es.e: It is with great regret that I must decline your offer.
es.c: 很遗憾，我不得不谢绝你的好意。

d: adj 定期的；有规律的；合格的；整齐的；普通的 happening every hour, every week, every month etc, usually with the same amount of time in between；n 常客；正式队员；中坚分子 someone who often goes to the same bar, restaurant etc or who takes part in an ac

es.e: The company holds regular meetings with employees.
es.c: 公司定期召集雇员开会。

es.e: His breathing was slow and regular.
es.c: 他的呼吸缓慢而均匀。

es.e: Trains will run at regular intervals from 11 am to 4 pm.
es.c: 火车从上午11点到下午4点每隔一定时间开行。

d: n 管理；规则；校准 an official rule or order；adj 规定的；平常的 used or worn because of official rules

es.e: There seem to be so many rules and regulations these days.
es.c: 如今好像条条框框很多。

es.e: regulations governing the safety of toys
es.c: 监控玩具安全的条例

es.e: All companies must comply with the regulations .
es.c: 所有公司都必须遵守规定。

d: v 拒绝；排斥；抵制；丢弃 to refuse to accept, believe in, or agree with something；n 被弃之物或人；次品 a product that has been rejected because there is something wrong with it

es.e: Sarah rejected her brother’s offer of help.
es.c: 萨拉拒绝了她弟弟的帮助。

es.e: Dexter flatly rejected (= completely rejected ) calls for his resignation.
es.c: 德克斯特断然拒绝让他辞职的要求。

es.e: His proposal was rejected outright (= completely rejected ) .
es.c: 他的建议被彻底否决了。

d: v 叙述；使…有联系 if two things relate, they are connected in some way

es.e: I don’t understand how the two ideas relate.
es.c: 我不明白这两个观点有什么联系。

d: n 关系；叙述；故事；亲属关系 a connection between two or more things

es.e: The price the meat is sold for bears no relation to (= is not connected to ) the price the farmer receives.
es.c: 肉的售价和农民拿到的价格无关。

d: n 关系；关联 the way in which two people or two groups feel about each other and behave towards each other

es.e: He’s never had a sexual relationship before.
es.c: 他以前从未与人有过性关系。

d: adj 相对的；有关系的；成比例的 having a particular quality when compared with something else；n 亲戚；相关物；[语] 关系词；亲缘植物 a member of your family

es.e: The relative merits of both approaches have to be considered.
es.c: 两种方法的相对优点都得考虑在内。

es.e: her opponent’s relative lack of experience
es.c: 她的对手相对来说缺少经验

es.e: You may think you’re poor, but it’s all relative (= you are not poor compared to some people ) .
es.c: 你可能认为自己很穷，但一切都是相对的。

d: v 放松，休息；松懈，松弛；变从容；休养 to rest or do something that is enjoyable, especially after you have been working

es.e: I just want to sit down and relax.
es.c: 我只想坐下来休息一下。

es.e: What Robyn needed was a drink to relax her.
es.c: 萝宾需要的是喝一杯放松放松。

es.e: A hot bath should help to relax you.
es.c: 洗个热水澡可以帮助你放松下来。

d: v 转播；接替 if radio or television signals are relayed, they are received and sent, especially so that they can be heard on the radio or seen on television；n [电] 继电器；接替，接替人员；驿马

es.e: The broadcasts were relayed by satellite.
es.c: 这些电视节目通过卫星进行转播。

d: adj 相关的；切题的；中肯的；有重大关系的；有意义的，目的明确的 directly relating to the subject or problem being discussed or considered

es.e: Relevant documents were presented in court.
es.c: 法庭上出示了相关的文件。

es.e: We received all the relevant information.
es.c: 我们收到了所有相关信息。

d: adj 可靠的；可信赖的 someone or something that is reliable can be trusted or depended on；n 可靠的人

es.e: a birth control method that is cheap and reliable
es.c: 既便宜又可靠的避孕方法

es.e: Miller was a quiet and reliable man.
es.c: 米勒是个话不多且可靠的人。

d: n 救济；减轻，解除；安慰；浮雕 when something reduces someone’s pain or unhappy feelings

es.e: Marijuana can provide pain relief for some cancer patients.
es.c: 大麻可以为一些癌症患者减轻疼痛。

d: n 宗教；宗教信仰 a belief in one or more gods

es.e: The U.S. Constitution promises freedom of religion.
es.c: 美国宪法保证宗教信仰自由。

es.e: a course on philosophy and religion
es.c: 关于哲学和宗教的课程

d: adj 宗教的；虔诚的；严谨的；修道的 relating to religion in general or to a particular religion；n 修道士；尼姑

es.e: I don’t share her religious beliefs .
es.c: 她的宗教信仰和我的不同。

es.e: a religious school
es.c: 宗教学校

es.e: the dates of major religious observances such as Easter or Christmas
es.c: 复活节和圣诞节等重要宗教节日的日期

d: v 依靠；信赖 If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly

es.e: They relied heavily on the advice of their professional advisers.
es.c: 他们非常依赖专业顾问的建议。

d: v 保持；依然；留下；剩余；逗留；残存 to continue to be in the same state or condition；n 遗迹；剩余物，残骸 Theremainsof something are the parts of it that are left after most of it has been taken away or destroyed

es.e: Please remain seated until all the lights are on.
es.c: 请留在座位上，直到灯全都亮起。

es.e: We remained friends.
es.c: 我们依然是朋友。

es.e: The boy remained silent .
es.c: 男孩依然默不作声。

d: n 注意；言辞 something that you say when you express an opinion or say what you have noticed；v 评论；觉察 to say something, especially about something you have just noticed

es.e: Unfortunately, a local journalist overheard the remark.
es.c: 不巧一名当地记者无意中听到了这些话。

d: v 记得；牢记；纪念；代…问好 to have a picture or idea in your mind of people, events, places etc from the past

es.e: Do you remember Rosa Davies?
es.c: 你记得罗莎·戴维斯吗？

es.e: I can’t remember her exact words.
es.c: 我记不得她的原话了。

es.e: I remember it well ; I’d never seen my mother so angry.
es.c: 这件事我记得很清楚；我从未见过母亲这么生气。

d: v 提醒；使想起 to make someone remember something that they must do

es.e: Yes, I’ll be there. Thanks for reminding me.
es.c: 是的，我会去那里的。 谢谢提醒。

es.e: He made a few notes to remind himself of what he wanted to say.
es.c: 他记了几条，提醒自己要说些什么。

d: adj 遥远的；偏僻的；疏远的 far from towns or other places where people live；n 远程

es.e: a remote border town
es.c: 一个偏远的边境小镇

es.e: a fire in a remote mountain area
es.c: 偏远山区的火灾

d: v 移动，迁移；开除；调动 to force someone out of an important position or dismiss them from a job；n 移动；距离；搬家 a distance or amount by which two things are separated

es.e: Remove the old wallpaper and fill any holes in the walls.
es.c: 撕下旧墙纸，把墙上的洞都填平。

d: n 租金 the money that someone pays regularly to use a room, house etc that belongs to someone else；v 出租；租用；租借 to regularly pay money to live in a house or room that belongs to someone else, or to use something that belongs

es.e: I pay the rent at the beginning of every month.
es.c: 我每逢月初交付房租。

d: v 修理；修复 to fix something that is damaged, broken, split, or not working properly；n 修理，修补；修补部位 something that you do to fix a thing that is damaged, broken, or not working

es.e: Dad was up the ladder, repairing the roof.
es.c: 爸爸在梯子上修补屋顶。

es.e: Where can I get my shoes repaired ?
es.c: 哪儿能修补鞋子？

d: n 修理；[会计] 修理费；备件；修理工作（repair的复数形式） A repair is something that you do to mend a machine, building, piece of clothing, or other thing that has been damaged or is not working properly；v 修理；恢复（repair的三单形式）；弥补；纠正 If you repai

es.e: Many women know how to make repairs on their cars.
es.c: 很多女性知道如何修理汽车。

es.e: Goldsmith has repaired the roof to ensure the house is windproof.
es.c: 戈德史密斯已经修理了房顶以确保房子可以抵御狂风。

d: v 重复；复制；背诵 to do something again；n 重复；副本 the sign that tells a performer to play a piece of music again, or the music that is played again

es.e: Repeat the exercises twice a day.
es.c: 这套操每天做两次。

es.e: We must not repeat the mistakes of the past.
es.c: 我们不能再犯以前的错误。

es.e: The team are hoping to repeat their success (= achieve the same good result ) of last season.
es.c: 球队希望再续上一赛季的佳绩。

d: v 取代，代替；替换，更换；归还，偿还；把…放回原处 to start doing something instead of another person, or start being used instead of another thing

es.e: I’m replacing Sue on the team.
es.c: 我将接替队里的休。

es.e: Lectures have replaced the old tutorial system.
es.c: 课堂授课取代了旧式的导师制。

d: v 回答；[法] 答辩；回击 to answer someone by saying or writing something；n 回答；[法] 答辩 something that is said, written, or done as a way of replying

es.e: I asked Clive where he was going, but he didn’t reply.
es.c: 我问克莱夫到哪儿去，但他没有回答。

es.e: Sorry it took me so long to reply.
es.c: 抱歉，我过了这么久才回复。

es.e: ‘Did you see Simon today?’ ‘Of course,’ Nathalie replied with a smile.
es.c: “你今天见到西蒙了吗？”“当然啦。”纳萨莉笑着答道。

d: n 报告；报道；成绩单 a written or spoken description of a situation or event, giving people the information they need；v 报告；报导；使报到 to give people information about recent events, especially in newspapers and on television and radi

es.e: According to recent news reports , two of the victims are Americans.
es.c: 根据近期的新闻报道，受害者中有两名是美国人。

d: n 记者 someone whose job is to write about news events for a newspaper, or to tell people about them on television or on the radio

es.e: a news reporter
es.c: 新闻记者

d: v 代表；表现；描绘；回忆；再赠送 to officially speak or take action for another person or group of people

es.e: Mr Kobayashi was chosen to represent the company at the conference.
es.c: 小林先生被选中代表公司出席会议。

d: adj 典型的，有代表性的；代议制的 typical of a particular group or thing；n 代表；典型；众议员 someone who has been chosen to speak, vote, or make decisions for someone else

es.e: The pollsters asked a representative sample of New York residents for their opinions.
es.c: 民意调查员向一些有代表性的纽约居民征询了意见。

d: n 共和国；共和政体 a country governed by elected representatives of the people, and led by a president, not a king or queen

es.e: the former Federal Republic of Germany
es.c: 前德意志联邦共和国

es.e: Nine republics took part in the referendum.
es.c: 有九个共和国参加了全民公决。

d: n 名声，名誉；声望 the opinion that people have about someone or something because of what has happened in the past

es.e: Alice Munro has a reputation for being a very depressing writer.
es.c: 艾丽斯•门罗有文风抑郁的名声。

d: n 请求；需要 a polite or formal demand for something；v 要求，请求 to ask for something in a polite or formal way

es.e: France had agreed to his request for political asylum.
es.c: 法国已经同意了他政治避难的请求。

d: v 需要；要求；命令 to need something

es.e: Campbell’s broken leg will probably require surgery.
es.c: 坎贝尔的一条腿骨折，可能需要手术。

es.e: What’s required is a complete reorganization of the system.
es.c: 需要做的是彻底整顿整个系统。

es.e: Most house plants require regular watering.
es.c: 大多数室内盆栽植物需要定期浇水。

d: n 要求；必要条件；必需品 something that someone needs or asks for

es.e: The refugees’ main requirements are food and shelter.
es.c: 难民的主要需求是食物和住所。

d: v 营救；援救 to save someone or something from a situation of danger or harm；n 营救；援救；解救 when someone or something is rescued from danger

es.e: Survivors of the crash were rescued by helicopter.
es.c: 空难的生还者被直升机救了出来。

d: n 研究；调查 serious study of a subject, in order to discover new facts or test new ideas；v 研究；调查 to study a subject in detail, especially in order to discover new facts or test new ideas

es.e: Gould was helped in his researches by local naturalists.
es.c: 古尔德在研究过程中得到了当地博物学家的帮助。

d: v 类似，像 to look like or be similar to someone or something

es.e: It’s amazing how closely Brian and Steve resemble each other.
es.c: 布赖恩和史蒂夫真是惊人地相像。

es.e: He grew up to resemble his father.
es.c: 他长大了，很像他父亲。

d: n 预约，预订；保留 an arrangement which you make so that a place in a hotel, restaurant, plane etc is kept for you at a particular time in the future

es.e: a dinner reservation
es.c: 预订晚餐

es.e: Customers are advised to make seat reservations well in advance.
es.c: 建议顾客提前订座。

d: n 储备，储存；自然保护区；预备队；缄默；[金融] 储备金 a supply of something kept to be used if it is needed；v 储备；保留；预约 to arrange for a place in a hotel, restaurant, plane etc to be kept for you to use at a particular time in the future

es.e: $10 million in cash reserves
es.c: 1,000万美元的现金储备

es.e: oil reserves
es.c: 石油储备

d: v 辞职；放弃；委托；使听从 to officially announce that you have decided to leave your job or an organization；n 辞去职务

es.e: Josh resigned himself to the long walk home.
es.c: 乔希只好走很长的路回家。

d: v 抵抗，抗拒；忍耐 to try to prevent a change from happening, or prevent yourself from being forced to do something；n [助剂] 抗蚀剂；防染剂

es.e: He resisted pressure to resign.
es.c: 他顶住压力，没辞职。

d: n 尊敬，尊重；方面；敬意 a feeling of admiring someone or what they do, especially because of their personal qualities, knowledge, or skills；v 尊敬，尊重；遵守 to admire someone because they have high standards and good qualities such as f

es.e: The boys showed a complete lack of respect for authority.
es.c: 这些男孩子根本无视权威。

d: v 回答；作出反应；承担责任 to do something as a reaction to something that has been said or done；n 应答；唱和

es.e: They are likely to respond positively to the president's request for aid.
es.c: 他们有可能积极地回应该总统的援助请求。

d: n 责任，职责；义务 a duty to be in charge of someone or something, so that you make decisions and can be blamed if something bad happens

es.e: Kelly’s promotion means more money and more responsibility.
es.c: 凯利获得提升，这意味着钱多了，责任也更大了。

d: v 使休息，使轻松；把…寄托于 to stop working or doing an activity for a time and sit down or lie down to relax；n 休息，静止；休息时间；剩余部分；支架 a period of time when you are not doing anything tiring and you can relax or sleep

es.e: If you’re tired, we’ll stop and rest for a while.
es.c: 如果你累了，我们就停下来歇一会儿。

d: n 餐馆；[经] 饭店 a place where you can buy and eat a meal

es.e: He took her out for a five-course dinner in a fancy restaurant.
es.c: 他带她到一家豪华餐厅吃了一顿有五道菜的晚餐。

es.e: The company runs a chain of restaurants.
es.c: 公司经营连锁饭店。

es.e: A new restaurant has just opened across the road.
es.c: 马路对面刚开了一家新饭馆。

d: v 限制；约束；限定 to limit or control the size, amount, or range of something

es.e: The new law restricts the sale of hand guns.
es.c: 新法规限制手枪的销售。

es.e: You may need to restrict access to certain files (= limit the number of people who can read them ) .
es.c: 某些档案可能需要限制查阅。

es.e: The agreement will restrict competition.
es.c: 这个协议将限制竞争。

d: n 限制；约束；束缚 a rule or law that limits or controls what people can do

es.e: a 50 mph speed restriction
es.c: 每小时50英里的限速

d: n 结果；成绩；答案；比赛结果 something that happens or exists because of something that happened before；v 结果；导致；产生 if something results from something else, it is caused by it

es.e: High unemployment is a direct result of the recession.
es.c: 高失业率是经济衰退的直接后果。

es.e: Growing plants from seed can produce disappointing results .
es.c: 将种子培育成植株，有时会产生令人失望的结果。

es.e: With a little effort you should achieve the desired result .
es.c: 只要稍作努力，你就可以取得预期的效果。

d: v 复述；再讲；重述 to tell a story again, often in a different way or in a different language

es.e: Lucilla often asks her sisters to retell the story.
es.c: 陆希拉经常叫她的姐姐们重讲那个故事。

d: v 退休；撤退；退却 when a  jury  in a law court retires, they go away to consider whether someone is guilty or not；n 退休；退隐；退兵信号
