es.c: 去海滨的旅行

d: n 时期；季节；赛季 one of the main periods into which a year is divided, each of which has a particular type of weather. The seasons are spring, summer, autumn, and winter；v 给…调味；使适应 to add salt, pepper etc to food you are cooki

es.e: the effect on plants as the seasons start to change
es.c: 换季对植物的影响

d: n 座位；所在地；职位 a place where you can sit, especially one in a vehicle or one from which you watch a performance, sports event etc；v 使…坐下；可容纳…的；使就职 If you seat yourself somewhere, you sit down

es.e: I was in the back seat and Jo was driving.
es.c: 我在后座，乔开车。

es.e: a 10,000-seat stadium
es.c: 万人体育场

es.e: People were shifting in their seats, looking uncomfortable.
es.c: 人们在座位上动来动去，看上去不大自在。

d: n 海藻，海草 a plant that grows in the sea

es.e: So the next time you see a chunk of seaweed ... notice the beauty of it, yes.
es.c: 所以下次你碰见一大片海藻时，要毫不犹豫的欣赏它的美。

es.e: The crabs come closer to shore at this time of year, Child said, where they feed on the seaweed.
es.c: 这些螃蟹每年这个时间，要来到这里海岸的边上，恰尔特说，它们以吃海藻为生。

es.e: In many places, like Japan, people get iodine from seafood, seaweed, vegetables grown in iodine-rich soil or animals that eat grass grown in that soil.
es.c: 像日本等许多地方，人们通过食用海鲜、海藻得到碘，还可以从生长在高碘土壤里的蔬菜或食草动物那里得到碘。

d: n 秒；第二名；瞬间；二等品 a unit for measuring time. There are 60 seconds in a minute.；v 支持；adj 第二的；次要的；附加的 the second person, thing, event etc is the one that comes after the first；num 第二

es.e: Hold your breath for six seconds.
es.c: 请你屏气6秒钟。

es.e: The operation takes only 30 seconds.
es.c: 这个操作仅需要30秒钟。

es.e: Ultrasonic waves travel at around 300 metres per second .
es.c: 超声波的传播速度约为每秒300米。

d: adj 二手的；旧的；间接获得的；做旧货生意的 Secondhand things are not new and have been owned by someone else；adv 间接地；间接听来；以旧货 Secondhand is also an adverb

es.e: They could afford a secondhand car, she thought.
es.c: 他们能买得起一辆二手车，她想。

es.e: I only heard about it secondhand.
es.c: 我只间接听说了这件事。

d: n 秘密；秘诀；机密 something that is kept hidden or that is known about by only a few people；adj 秘密的；机密的 known about by only a few people and kept hidden from others

es.e: I can’t tell you. It’s a secret .
es.c: 我不能告诉你，这是个秘密。

es.e: It was no secret that the two men hated each other.
es.c: 这两个男人相互仇视，这算不得什么秘密。

es.e: Don’t worry. Your secret is safe with me (= I won’t tell anyone about it ) .
es.c: 别担心，我会替你保守秘密。

d: n 秘书；书记；部长；大臣 someone who works in an office  typing  letters, keeping records, answering telephone calls, arranging meetings etc

es.e: My secretary will fax you all the details.
es.c: 我的秘书会把所有的细节发传真给你。

d: n 截面；部分；部门；地区；章节 one of the parts that something such as an object or place is divided into；v 被切割成片；被分成部分 If something is sectioned, it is divided into sections

es.e: The plane’s tail section was found in a cornfield.
es.c: 飞机的尾部在玉米田里找到了。

es.e: the smoking section (= where you can smoke )
es.c: 吸烟区

es.e: It holds vegetables in place while they are being peeled or sectioned.
es.c: 它在蔬菜被去皮或切分时将他们固定。

d: adj 安全的；无虑的；有把握的；稳当的 safe from and protected against damage or attack；v 保护；弄到；招致；缚住 to make something safe from being attacked, harmed, or lost

es.e: Companies can offer secure credit card transactions over the Internet.
es.c: 公司可以提供安全的网上信用卡交易。

d: n 安全；保证；证券；抵押品 things that are done to keep a person, building, or country safe from danger or crime；adj 安全的；保安的；保密的

es.e: The trial was held under tight security .
es.c: 这场审讯是在戒备森严的情况下进行的。

es.e: lax security at airline check-in desks
es.c: 登机手续柜台松懈的安全措施

es.e: terrorist activity that is a threat to national security
es.c: 威胁国家安全的恐怖活动

d: v 看见；理解；领会 to notice or examine someone or something, using your eyes；n (See)人名；(英)西伊；(柬)塞；(德)泽

es.e: The moment we saw the house, we knew we wanted to buy it.
es.c: 我们一看到这房子就知道我们要买。

es.e: He crouched down so he couldn’t be seen.
es.c: 他蹲下来好让别人看不见他。

es.e: Can I see your ticket, please?
es.c: 我能看看你的票吗？

d: n 种子；根据；精液；萌芽；子孙；原由 a player or team in a competition that is given a particular position, according to how likely they are to win；v 播种；结实；成熟；去…籽 to remove seeds from fruit or vegetables

es.e: He’s been top seed for the past two years.
es.c: 他在过去两年中一直是头号种子选手。

d: v 寻求；寻找；探索；搜索 to try to achieve or get something

es.e: Do you think the President will seek re-election ?
es.c: 你认为总统会谋求连任吗？

d: v 似乎；像是；装作 if something seems to be true, there are qualities or facts that make people think it is true；n (Seem)人名；(英)西姆

es.e: Ann didn’t seem very sure.
es.c: 安看来并不十分肯定。

es.e: It seems a foolish decision now.
es.c: 现在看来这是一个愚蠢的决定。

es.e: It seems like you’re catching a cold, Taylor.
es.c: 你好像感冒了，泰勒。

d: v 抓住；夺取；理解；逮捕 to take hold of something suddenly and violently

es.e: Suddenly he seized my hand.
es.c: 他突然抓住我的手。

d: adv 很少，不常 very rarely or almost never

es.e: Karen had seldom seen him so angry.
es.c: 卡伦很少见他这么生气过。

d: v 挑选；选拔 to choose something or someone by thinking carefully about which is the best, most suitable etc；adj 精选的；挑选出来的；极好的 a select group of people or things is a small special group that has been chosen carefully；n 被挑选者；

es.e: a group of students selected at random
es.c: 随机挑选出来的一组学生

d: n 自己，自我；本质；私心 the type of person you are, your character, your typical behaviour etc；adj 同一的；vt 使自花授精；使近亲繁殖；vi 自花授精

es.e: a child’s developing sense of self
es.c: 儿童逐渐形成的自我意识

d: adj 自私的；利己主义的 caring only about yourself and not about other people – used to show disapproval

es.e: How can you be so selfish?
es.c: 你怎能这样自私？

es.e: selfish behaviour
es.c: 自私的行为

d: v 销售；推销；出卖；欺骗 to give something to someone in exchange for money；n 销售；失望；推销术

es.e: If you offer him another hundred, I think he’ll sell.
es.c: 如果你再加一百元钱，我想他会卖的。

es.e: He regrets selling all his old records.
es.c: 他后悔把所有的老唱片都卖掉了。

d: n 半圆，半圆形 half a circle

es.e: They sit cross-legged in a semicircle and share stories.
es.c: 他们盘着腿围成半圆坐在一起讲故事。

d: v 发送，寄；派遣；使进入；发射 to arrange for something to go or be taken to another place, especially by post；n 上升运动

es.e: Lyn sent some pictures of the wedding.
es.c: 琳恩寄了几张婚礼照片。

d: adj 高级的；年长的；地位较高的；年资较深的，资格较老的 having a higher position, level, or rank；n 上司；较年长者；毕业班学生 a student in their last year of  high school  or university

es.e: the senior Democrat on the House committee
es.c: 众议院委员会中的资深民主党人

es.e: White men hold most of the jobs in senior management .
es.c: 白人占据高级管理层的大部分职位。

es.e: the senior partner in a law firm
es.c: 律师事务所里的资深合伙人

d: n 感觉，功能；观念；道理；理智 a feeling about something；v 感觉到；检测 if you sense something, you feel that it exists or is true, without being told or having proof

es.e: Cats have a very acute sense of hearing (= very good, so that they can hear even the smallest sound ) .
es.c: 猫的听觉非常敏锐。

d: adj 敏感的；感觉的；[仪] 灵敏的；感光的；易受伤害的；易受影响的 easily upset or offended by events or things that people say；n 敏感的人；有灵异能力的人

es.e: a very sensitive child
es.c: 一个很敏感的小孩

d: n [语][计] 句子，命题；宣判，判决 a group of words that usually contains a subject and a verb, and expresses a complete idea. Sentences written in English begin with a capital letter and usually end with a  full stop  or a  question

es.e: His voice dropped at the end of the sentence.
es.c: 到句子结尾处，他压低了嗓音。

d: v 使分离；使分开；使分居 to divide or split into different parts, or to make something do this；adj 单独的；分开的；不同的；各自的； different；n 分开；抽印本

es.e: This will keep your dressing from separating.
es.c: 这样可以防止调味汁分层。

es.e: First, separate the eggs (= divide the white part from the yellow part ) .
es.c: 第一步，把蛋清和蛋黄分开。

d: adv 分别地；分离地；个别地 If people or things are dealt with separately or do something separately, they are dealt with or do something at different times or places, rather than together

es.e: Cook each vegetable separately until just tender.
es.c: 把每样蔬菜单独烹煮，直到煮软就行了。

d: n 分离，分开；间隔，距离；[法] 分居；缺口 when something separates or is separate

es.e: the separation of church and state
es.c: 政教分离

d: n 九月 the ninth month of the year, between August and October

es.e: Her son, Jerome, was born in September.
es.c: 她的儿子杰罗姆出生于9月。

d: adj 严肃的，严重的；认真的；庄重的；危急的 a serious situation, problem, accident etc is extremely bad or dangerous

es.e: the serious problem of unemployment
es.c: 严重的失业问题

es.e: Luckily, the damage was not serious.
es.c: 还好，损坏不算严重。

es.e: Serious crimes have increased dramatically.
es.c: 重大犯罪案件大幅度增加了。

d: n 仆人，佣人；公务员；雇工 someone, especially in the past, who was paid to clean someone’s house, cook for them, answer the door etc, and who often lived in the house

es.e: Many young girls became domestic servants .
es.c: 许多年轻姑娘成了家仆。

d: n 服务，服侍；服役；仪式 the official system for providing something, especially something that everyone in a country needs to have, or the official organization that provides it；adj 服务性的；耐用的；服现役的；v 维修，检修；保养 if someone services a m

es.e: the health service
es.c: 医疗保健服务

es.e: the postal service
es.c: 邮政服务

es.e: the police service
es.c: 警察部门

d: n 会议；（法庭的）开庭；（议会等的）开会；学期；讲习会 a formal meeting or group of meetings, especially of a law court or parliament

es.e: Board members met in closed session (= with nobody else present ) .
es.c: 委员会成员举行了闭门会议。

d: n [数] 集合；一套；布景；[机] 装置 a group of similar things that belong together or are related in some way；v 树立；点燃；点缀；；adj 固定的；规定的；固执的 a set amount, time etc is fixed and is never changed

es.e: a chess set
es.c: 一副国际象棋

d: v 解决；定居；沉淀；下陷 to end an argument or solve a disagreement；n 有背长椅 a seat, for two or more people, usually made of wood with a high back and arms, and sometimes having a storage space in the boxlike seat

es.e: We hope the factions will be able to settle their differences (= agree to stop arguing ) by peaceful means.
es.c: 我们希望各派系能以和平方式解决分歧。

es.e: Forensic tests should settle the question of whether Bates was actually present at the scene of the crime.
es.c: 法医检验应该能够解决贝茨是否在犯罪现场的问题。

es.e: They might be willing to settle out of court (= come to an agreement without going to a court of law ) .
es.c: 他们或许会愿意庭外和解。

d: n 解决，处理；[会计] 结算；沉降；殖民 an official agreement or decision that ends an argument, a court case, or a fight, or the action of making an agreement

es.e: Union leaders and company bosses will meet tomorrow in an attempt to reach a settlement .
es.c: 工会领导人和公司老板将于明天举行会议以期达成协议。

es.e: His lawyers are understood to be negotiating a settlement .
es.c: 据说他的律师正在商谈一个协议。

es.e: Hopes grew that a workable peace settlement might emerge.
es.c: 达成一项可行的和平协定的希望越来越大。

d: n 移居者；殖民者 someone who goes to live in a country or area where not many people like them have lived before, and that is a long way from any towns or cities

es.e: early settlers in Australia
es.c: 澳大利亚的早期移民

d: num 七个，七 the number 7；n 七个，七 the number 7；adj 七的；七个的

es.e: The women visited cities in seven states.
es.c: 这些女性访问了七个州的城市。

es.e: We close the store at seven (= seven o’clock ) .
es.c: 我们商店七点关门。

es.e: ‘How old’s Sam?’ ‘He’s seven (= seven years old ) .’
es.c: “萨姆多大了？”“他七岁。”

d: n 十七，十七个 the number 17；adj 十七岁的；十七的，十七个的；num 十七 the number 17

es.e: a group of seventeen American military officers
es.c: 由17名美国军官组成的团体

es.e: I left home when I was seventeen (= 17 years old ) .
es.c: 我17岁时离开家。

d: n 第七；七分之一 one of seven equal parts of something；adj 第七的；七分之一的 coming after six other things in a series；adv 居第七位地

es.e: Both will meet in your seventh house of partnerships, so to unlock your good fortune, you need to collaborate with a partner.
es.c: 它们将在你表合作关系的第七宫会面，如果你有一个合作伙伴的话，它们将合作释放出你的好运气。

d: n 七十；七十个；七十岁；七十年代 the number 70；adj 七十的；七十个的；七十岁的；num 七十 the number 70

es.e: We lost touch during the seventies.
es.c: 我们在70年代失去了联系。

d: adj 几个的；各自的 different and separate；pron 几个；数个

es.e: They shook hands and went their several ways (= went in different directions ) .
es.c: 他们握了握手便各自走了。

d: adj 严峻的；严厉的；剧烈的；苛刻的 severe problems, injuries, illnesses etc are very bad or very serious

es.e: His injuries were quite severe.
es.c: 他的伤势很严重。

es.e: She’s suffering from severe depression.
es.c: 她患有严重的抑郁症。

es.e: The US faces severe economic problems.
es.c: 美国面临严重的经济问题。

d: v 缝合，缝上；缝纫 to use a needle and thread to make or repair clothes or to fasten something such as a button to them

es.e: I learned to sew at school.
es.c: 我在学校学会了缝纫。

d: n 性；性别；性行为；色情 the physical activity that two people do together in order to produce babies, or for pleasure；v 引起…的性欲；区别…的性别 to find out whether an animal is male or female

es.e: All you see on TV is sex and violence these days.
es.c: 如今在电视上看到的尽是性和暴力。

es.e: They had sex in the back seat of his car.
es.c: 他们在他的汽车后座上做了爱。

es.e: She no longer wanted to have sex with him.
es.c: 她再也不想和他做爱了。

d: adj 破旧的；卑鄙的；吝啬的；低劣的 shabby clothes, places, or objects are untidy and in bad condition because they have been used for a long time

es.e: Hugh’s jacket was old and shabby.
es.c: 休的夹克衫又旧又破。

es.e: a shabby little restaurant
es.c: 一家肮脏的小餐馆

d: n 树荫；阴影；阴凉处；遮阳物；（照片等的）明暗度；少量、些微；细微的差别 slight darkness or shelter from the direct light of the sun made by something blocking it；v 使阴暗；使渐变；为…遮阳；使阴郁；掩盖 to protect something from direct light

es.e: a plant that needs a lot of shade
es.c: 喜阴植物

d: n 阴影；影子；幽灵；庇护；隐蔽处 the dark shape that someone or something makes on a surface when they are between that surface and the light；v 遮蔽；使朦胧；尾随；预示 to follow someone closely in order to watch what they are doing；adj 影子内阁的 the

es.e: the long dark shadow of an old oak tree
es.c: 一棵老橡树长长的影子

d: v 动摇；摇动；震动；握手 to move suddenly from side to side or up and down, usually with a lot of force, or to make something or someone do this；n 摇动；哆嗦 if you give something a shake, you move it up and down or from side to side

es.e: She shook him to wake him up.
es.c: 她摇摇他，想把他叫醒。

es.e: Shake the bottle before you open it.
es.c: 打开瓶子之前先摇一摇。

es.e: The whole house started to shake.
es.c: 整幢房子摇晃起来。

d: aux 应；会；将；必须
adj 浅的；肤浅的 measuring only a short distance from the top to the bottom；n [地理] 浅滩；v 使变浅

es.e: a shallow river
es.c: 浅河

es.e: The lake is quite shallow.
es.c: 这湖很浅。

es.e: the shallow end of the pool
es.c: 游泳池的浅水区

d: n 羞耻，羞愧；憾事，带来耻辱的人 the feeling you have when you feel guilty and embarrassed because you, or someone who is close to you, have done something wrong；v 使丢脸，使羞愧 to make someone feel ashamed

es.e: He felt a deep sense of shame.
es.c: 他深深地感到羞愧。

es.e: Maria blushed with shame.
es.c: 玛丽亚羞得脸都红了。

es.e: (= it made her feel ashamed ) , she gained back all the weight she’d lost.
es.c: 让她感到惭愧的是，她减掉的体重全又长回来了。

d: n 上海（中国东部港市）

es.e: He once lived in Shanghai.
es.c: 他曾经在上海住过。

es.e: He chauffeurs for a company in Shanghai.
es.c: 他为上海一家公司开汽车。

es.e: We should not wind down our business in Shanghai.
es.c: 我们不该逐渐结束在上海的生意。

d: n 形状；模型；身材；具体化 the form that something has, for example round, square,  triangular  etc；v 形成；塑造，使成形；使符合 to influence something such as a belief, opinion etc and make it develop in a particular way

es.e: What shape is the table?
es.c: 那张桌子是什么形状的？

es.e: You can recognize a tree by the shape of its leaves.
es.c: 可以根据树叶的形状辨认出是什么树。

es.e: His battered old hat had completely lost its shape.
es.c: 他那顶破旧的帽子已经完全变形了。

d: v 分享，分担；分配 to let someone have or use something that belongs to you；n 份额；股份 one of the equal parts into which the  ownership  of a company is divided

es.e: As a kid he’d never share his toys.
es.c: 他小时候从不肯与人分享他的玩具。

d: n 鲨鱼；骗子 a large sea fish with several rows of very sharp teeth that is considered to be dangerous to humans；v 诈骗

es.e: Sharks were circling around our boat.
es.c: 鲨鱼在我们的小船周围游弋。

d: adj 急剧的；锋利的；强烈的；敏捷的；刺耳的 having a very thin edge or point that can cut things easily；adv 急剧地；锐利地；突然地 Sharp is also an adverb；n 尖头；骗子；内行；vt 磨快；把音调升高

es.e: Make sure you use a good sharp knife.
es.c: 你一定要用锋利的好刀。

es.e: Its teeth are razor sharp (= very sharp ) .
es.c: 它的牙齿非常锋利。

es.e: Do not cross the bridge but turn sharp left to go down on to the towpath.
es.c: 不要过桥，而是向左急转下到纤道上去。

d: v 削尖；磨快；使敏捷；加重

es.e: Anne sharpened her pencil and got out her homework.
es.c: 安妮把铅笔削尖，然后拿出家庭作业来。

d: n 卷笔刀；[机] 磨具；研磨者 A sharpener is a tool or machine used for sharpening pencils or knives

es.e: ...a pencil sharpener.
es.c: …一个卷笔刀。

d: v 剃须，剃毛 to cut off hair very close to the skin, especially from the face, using a  razor；n 刮脸，剃胡子；修面；<口>侥幸逃过，幸免；剃刀，刮刀 if a man has a shave, he cuts off the hair on his face close to his skin using a  razor

es.e: He hadn’t shaved for days.
es.c: 他已经好几天没刮脸了。

es.e: Brian had cut himself shaving .
es.c: 布赖恩刮胡子时割破了脸。

d: n 理发师；电动剃刀 a small piece of electrical equipment used for shaving

es.e: He uses an electric shaver.
es.c: 他使用电动剃须刀。

d: pron 她（主格）；它（用来指雌性动物或国家、船舶、地球、月亮等） used to refer to a woman, girl, or female animal that has already been mentioned or is already known about；n 女人；雌性动物 used to refer to a woman, girl, or female animal that has already be

es.e: You could always ask Beth – she’s got plenty of money.
es.c: 你总是可以去问贝丝——她有很多钱。

es.e: I saw you talking to that girl. Who is she?
es.c: 我看见你和那个女孩子说话。 她是谁？

es.e: What did she say when you told her?
es.c: 你告诉她时她怎么说？

d: n 羊，绵羊；胆小鬼 a farm animal that is kept for its wool and its meat

es.e: Sheep were grazing on the hillside.
es.c: 羊群在山坡上吃草。

es.e: a sheep farmer
es.c: 养羊的农民

d: n 薄片，纸张；薄板；床单 a large piece of thin cloth that you put on a bed to lie on or lie under；v 覆盖；盖上被单；使成大片；adj 片状的

es.e: I’ll go and find you some clean sheets and blankets.
es.c: 我去给你们找些干净的床单和毯子。

es.e: white cotton sheets
es.c: 白色的棉布床单

d: n 架子；搁板；搁板状物；暗礁 a long flat narrow board attached to a wall or in a frame or cupboard, used for putting things on

es.e: shelves of books
es.c: 一层层书架的书

es.e: supermarket shelves
es.c: 超级市场的货架

es.e: the amount of shelf space available
es.c: 可用的货架空间

d: n 庇护；避难所；遮盖物 protection from danger or from wind, rain, hot sun etc；v 保护；使掩蔽 If a place or thing is sheltered by something, it is protected by that thing from wind and rain

es.e: The men took shelter in a bombed-out farmhouse.
es.c: 那些男人躲在一间被炸毁的农舍里。

es.e: All around me, people were running for shelter .
es.c: 我周围的人都在奔跑着寻找地方躲避。

es.e: ...a wooden house, sheltered by a low pointed roof.
es.c: …一座由低矮的尖屋顶遮蔽的木房子。

d: v 发出光；反射光，闪耀；出类拔萃，表现突出；露出；照耀；显露；出众 to produce bright light；n 光亮，光泽；好天气；擦亮；晴天；擦皮鞋；鬼把戏或诡计 the brightness that something has when light shines on it

es.e: The sun was shining .
es.c: 阳光照耀。

es.e: The moon shone brightly in the sky.
es.c: 皓月当空。

d: v 运送，乘船；以船运送 to send goods somewhere by ship, plane, truck etc；n 船；舰；太空船 a large boat used for carrying people or goods across the sea

es.e: We'll ship your order to the address we print on your cheques.
es.c: 我们将把你预订的货物送到我们印在你单据上的地址。

d: n 衬衫；汗衫，内衣 a piece of clothing that covers the upper part of your body and your arms, usually has a collar, and is fastened at the front by buttons

es.e: I have to wear a shirt and tie to work.
es.c: 我上班要穿衬衫打领带。

es.e: a check shirt
es.c: 格子衬衫

d: n 休克；震惊；震动；打击；禾束堆 if something that happens is a shock, you did not expect it, and it makes you feel very surprised, and usually upset；v 使休克；使震惊；使震动；使受电击；把…堆成禾束堆 to make someone feel very surprised and upset, and unable

es.e: She was shaking with shock and humiliation.
es.c: 她又是震惊，又是羞辱，身体直发抖。

d: n 鞋；蹄铁；外胎 something that you wear to cover your feet, made of leather or some other strong material；v 给……穿上鞋；穿……鞋

es.e: I sat down and took off my shoes and socks.
es.c: 我坐下来脱掉鞋子和袜子。

es.e: What size shoes do you take?
es.c: 你穿几号的鞋子？

d: v 射击，射中；拍摄；发芽；使爆炸；给…注射 to deliberately kill or injure someone using a gun；n 射击；摄影；狩猎；急流 an occasion when someone takes photographs or makes a film

es.e: Police shot one suspect when he pulled a gun on them.
es.c: 警方在一名嫌疑人拔枪指着他们时击毙了他。

es.e: Smith killed his wife, and then shot himself.
es.c: 史密斯杀死妻子，然后开枪自杀。

es.e: A woman was shot dead in an attempted robbery.
es.c: 一名女子在一桩未遂抢劫案中中枪身亡。

d: n 射击；打猎；摄影；射门 the sport of shooting animals and birds with guns；v 射击（shoot的ing形式）

es.e: the grouse shooting season
es.c: 松鸡狩猎季节

es.e: The shooting party set off shortly before dawn.
es.c: 拂晓前不久这群打猎者就出发了。

d: n 商店；店铺 a building or part of a building where you can buy things, food, or services；v 购物 to go to one or more shops to buy things

es.e: a barber’s shop
es.c: 理发店

es.e: a fish-and-chip shop
es.c: 炸鱼薯条店

es.e: the local shops
es.c: 当地的商店

d: n 店主，老板 someone who owns or is in charge of a small shop

es.e: The girl had only worked for the shopkeeper for three days when she packed him in.
es.c: 这姑娘替那店主只干了三天， 就辞职不干了。

es.e: In Jermyn Street in London, a shopkeeper anxiously asked who the next president would be.
es.c: 在伦敦的杰明街，一个店主焦急地问道，谁将是（美国）下一任总统。

es.e: I was an unknown foreigner, and could have easily evaded payment with impunity, yet no London shopkeeper ever mistrusted me.
es.c: 我是一个没人知道的异乡人，本可以大胆地轻易逃避付款，但是从来没有一个伦敦的店主不信任我。

d: n 购物，买东西 the activity of going to shops and buying things；v 购物（shop的ing形式）

es.e: Late-night shopping is becoming very popular.
es.c: 深夜购物越来越普遍了。

es.e: I went on a shopping spree (= went shopping and bought a lot of things ) at the weekend and spent far too much money.
es.c: 我周末大买特买了一番，花了好多钱。

es.e: I’ve got to do some last-minute shopping.
es.c: 我得去作最后一刻的大采购。

d: v 支撑，使稳住；用支柱撑住 to prop or make safe with or as if with a shore；n 海滨；支柱 the land along the edge of a large area of water such as an ocean or lake

es.e: We could see a boat about a mile from shore.
es.c: 我们看见离岸边大约一英里的地方有一艘船。

es.e: Only a few survivors reached the shore.
es.c: 仅有几个生还者到达岸边。

es.e: She began to swim to shore.
es.c: 她开始朝岸边游去。

d: adj 短的；不足的；矮的，低的 happening or continuing for only a little time or for less time than usual；n 短；缺乏；短路；短裤 a short film shown in the cinema；adv 不足；突然；唐突地 to almost do something but then decide not to do it

es.e: a short meeting
es.c: 一个短会

es.e: Morris gave a short laugh.
es.c: 莫里斯笑了一声。

es.e: a short course on business English
es.c: 商业英语短期课程

d: n 缺点；短处 a fault or weakness that makes someone or something less successful or effective than they should be

es.e: Peter was painfully aware of his own shortcomings.
es.c: 彼得痛苦地认识到了自己的短处。

d: adv 立刻；简短地；唐突地 soon

es.e: Ms Jones will be back shortly.
es.c: 琼斯女士很快就会回来。

d: n 短裤 trousers reaching the top of the thigh or partway to the knee, worn by both sexes for sport, relaxing in summer, etc

es.e: I like your shorts, Jake.
es.c: 杰克， 我喜欢你的短裤。

es.e: Where are my shorts?
es.c: 我的短裤在哪里？

es.e: Now I have a cool pair of shorts for riding.
es.c: 现在我就有了一条骑车时的酷酷短裤啦！

d: n 发射；炮弹；射手；镜头 the view of something in a film or television programme that is produced by having the camera in a particular position；adj 用尽的；破旧的；杂色的，闪光的 in bad condition because of being used too much or treated badly；v

es.e: In the opening shot, we see Travolta’s feet walking down the sidewalk.
es.c: 在开场的镜头中，我们看到特拉沃尔塔的脚在人行道上行走。

d: aux 应该；就；可能；将要
n 肩，肩膀；肩部 one of the two parts of the body at each side of the neck where the arm is connected；v 肩负，承担 to accept a difficult or unpleasant responsibility, duty etc

es.e: She tapped the driver on the shoulder.
es.c: 她拍拍司机的肩。

es.e: He put his arm around her shoulders.
es.c: 他用手臂搂住她的肩。

es.e: His shoulders were broad and powerful.
es.c: 他的肩膀宽阔强壮。

d: v 呼喊；喊叫；大声说 to say something very loudly；n 呼喊；呼叫 a loud call expressing anger, pain, excitement etc

es.e: There’s no need to shout! I can hear you!
es.c: 用不着大声喊叫！我听得见！

es.e: ‘Watch out!’she shouted, as the car started to move.
es.c: “小心！”汽车开动时，她大声喊道。

d: v 显示；说明；演出；展出 to explain to someone how to do something, by doing it yourself or using actions to help them learn；n 显示；表演；炫耀 a performance for the public, especially one that includes singing, dancing, or jokes

es.e: The man grinned, showing bad teeth.
es.c: 那男人咧着嘴笑，露出一口坏牙。

d: n 淋浴；（倾泻般出现的）一阵，一大批；阵雨 a piece of equipment that you stand under to wash your whole body；v 大量地给予；把……弄湿 to give someone a lot of things

es.e: Why does the phone always ring when I’m in the shower?
es.c: 为什么电话铃总是在我洗澡的时候响？

es.e: I’d like to use the shower if that’s all right.
es.c: 如果可以的话，我想用一下这里的淋浴。

es.e: The bathroom has a separate shower cubicle (= a shower in a separate part of the room ) .
es.c: 卫生间里有一个独立的淋浴间。

d: v 关闭；停业；幽禁 to close something, or to become closed；n 关闭；adj 关闭的；围绕的 not open

es.e: Shut the window, Ellen!
es.c: 埃伦，把窗关上！

es.e: I heard his bedroom door shut.
es.c: 我听到他的卧室门关上了。

es.e: She lay down on her bed and shut her eyes .
es.c: 她在床上躺下，闭上眼睛。

d: n 航天飞机；穿梭；梭子；穿梭班机、公共汽车等 a  space shuttle；v 使穿梭般来回移动；短程穿梭般运送 to travel frequently between two places

es.e: He took the Washington - New York shuttle.
es.c: 他乘坐华盛顿－纽约的往返班机。

d: adj 害羞的；畏缩的，胆怯的 nervous and embarrassed about meeting and speaking to other people, especially people you do not know；v 投；畏缩；惊退；厌恶 if a horse shies, it makes a sudden movement away from something because it is frightened

es.e: He was a quiet shy man.
es.c: 他是个话不多、害羞的男人。

es.e: a shy smile
es.c: 羞怯的微笑

es.e: As a teenager, I was painfully shy (= extremely shy ) .
es.c: 我十几岁时害羞得很。

d: adj 厌恶的；病态的；不舒服；渴望的；恶心的 ；生病的 suffering from a disease or illness；n 病人 people who are ill；v 使狗去咬；呕吐；追击

es.e: His mother’s very sick.
es.c: 他母亲病得很重。

es.e: Maria can’t come in today because she’s sick.
es.c: 玛丽亚因为生病今天不能来了。

es.e: a sick child
es.c: 生病的孩子

d: n 疾病；呕吐；弊病 the state of being ill

es.e: an insurance policy against long-term sickness and injury
es.c: 保长期患病和受伤的保险单

es.e: working days lost due to sickness
es.c: 因病损失的工作日

d: n 方面；侧面；旁边 one of the two areas that are on the left or the right of an imaginary line, or on the left or the right of a border, wall, river etc；v 支持；赞助；偏袒 to support or argue against a person or group in a quarrel, figh

es.e: Fuel is cheaper on the French side of the border.
es.c: 燃料在边境那边的法国要便宜些。

es.e: A man stood watching me from the other side of the road.
es.c: 有个男人站在马路的对面看着我。

es.e: His friends and family were all on the other side of the world.
es.c: 他的朋友和家人都在地球的另一边。

d: n 人行道；小巷；adv 斜地里；adj 旁边的；向侧面的（等于sideways）

es.e: The key design concept of the space is that the suspended rooms are connected with suspended bridges and sideway aisles.
es.c: 这个空间设计的关键概念是这些悬挂着的房间是用悬挂着的桥和边侧的走廊连接起来的。

d: adv 向侧面地；向一旁 to or towards one side；adj 向侧面的；一旁的 Sideways is also an adjective

es.e: A strong gust of wind blew the car sideways into the ditch.
es.c: 一阵狂风把汽车横着掀进了沟里。

es.e: Alfred shot him a sideways glance.
es.c: 艾尔弗雷德斜着眼看了他一下。

d: v 叹息，叹气 to breathe in and out making a long sound, especially because you are bored, disappointed, tired etc；n 叹息，叹气 an act or sound of sighing

es.e: ‘Well, there’s nothing we can do about it now,’ she sighed.
es.c: “唉，我们现在对此无能为力。”她叹口气说。

d: n 视力；景象；眼界；见解 the physical ability to see；v 看见；瞄准 to see something from a long distance away, or see something you have been looking for；adj 见票即付的；即席的

es.e: Anne’s sight is very good for someone of her age.
es.c: 安妮的视力对于她这个年龄的人来说算是非常好的。

es.e: He began to lose his sight six years ago.
es.c: 六年前他开始视力衰退。

es.e: an emergency operation to save his sight
es.c: 挽救他视力的紧急手术

d: n 观光；游览 when you visit famous or interesting places, especially as tourists；adj 观光的；游览的；v 观光（sightsee的ing形式）；游览

es.e: She swam and sunbathed, went sightseeing and relaxed.
es.c: 她游泳，晒日光浴，观光，放松。

d: n 迹象；符号；记号；手势；指示牌 a piece of paper, metal, or wood with words or a picture that gives people information, warnings, or instructions；v 签署；签名 to write your  signature  on something to show that you wrote it, agree with it,

es.e: a sign on the door
es.c: 门上的标牌

es.e: {"COLLOINEXA":["road signs"]}
es.c: 路标

es.e: a no smoking sign
es.c: 禁止吸烟的告示牌

d: n 信号；暗号；导火线 a sound or action that you make in order to give information to someone or tell them to do something；v 标志；用信号通知；表示 to make something clear by what you say or do – used in news reports；adj 显著的；作为信号的

es.e: At a prearranged signal the lights went out.
es.c: 预定的信号一发出，灯就全灭了。

d: n 署名；签名；信号 your name written in the way you usually write it, for example at the end of a letter, or on a cheque etc, to show that you have written it

es.e: Her signature is totally illegible (= cannot be read ) .
es.c: 她的签字完全无法辨认。

es.e: The school collected 4,000 signatures for the petition.
es.c: 学校为这份请愿书收集到了四千个签名。

es.e: The Ukrainians put their signatures to the Lisbon Protocol.
es.c: 乌克兰签署了《里斯本协议》。

d: n 意义；重要性；意思 The significance of something is the importance that it has, usually because it will have an effect on a situation or shows something about a situation

es.e: Ideas about the social significance of religion have changed over time.
es.c: 有关宗教的社会意义的观念已随时间的流逝发生了改变。

d: n 沉默；寂静；缄默；不谈；无声状态 complete absence of sound or noise；v 使沉默；使安静；压制；消除噪音 to make someone stop talking, or stop something making a noise；int 安静！；别作声！ complete absence of sound or noise

es.e: There was a brief silence before anyone answered.
es.c: 沉默了片刻才有人回答。

d: adj 沉默的；寂静的；无记载的 without any sound, or not making any sound；n 无声电影

es.e: The large house was silent and lonely.
es.c: 这幢大房子寂静荒凉。

es.e: At last the guns fell silent .
es.c: 枪声终于沉寂了下来。

es.e: Julie offered up a silent prayer that she would pass her exam.
es.c: 朱莉默默地祈祷，希望能通过这次考试。

d: n 丝绸；蚕丝；丝织物 a thin smooth soft cloth made from very thin thread which is produced by a silkworm；adj 丝的；丝绸的；丝制的；vi （玉米）处于长须的阶段中

es.e: pure silk stockings
es.c: 生丝面料的漂亮连衣裙

d: adj 愚蠢的；不明事理的；没头脑的 not sensible, or showing bad judgment；n 傻瓜 used to tell someone that you think they are not behaving sensibly

es.e: Stop asking silly questions.
es.c: 别再问傻问题了。

es.e: You made a lot of silly mistakes .
es.c: 你犯了许多愚蠢的错误。

es.e: I left my keys at home, which was a pretty silly thing to do .
es.c: 我干了件傻事，把钥匙落在家里了。

d: adj 相似的 almost the same；n 类似物

es.e: We have similar tastes in music.
es.c: 我们对音乐的品位相近。

es.e: Both approaches seem to achieve similar results.
es.c: 两种方法都得出了相似的结果。

es.e: A number of his friends had been affected in a similar way .
es.c: 他的一些朋友也受到了类似的影响。

d: adj 简单的；单纯的；天真的 not difficult or complicated to do or understand；n 笨蛋；愚蠢的行为；出身低微者

es.e: a simple but effective solution to the problem
es.c: 对这个问题简单而有效的解决办法

es.e: There is no simple answer to this question.
es.c: 这个问题没有简单的答案。

es.e: I’m sure there’s a perfectly simple explanation.
es.c: 我相信一定有一个很简单的解释。

d: v 简化；使单纯；使简易 to make something easier or less complicated

es.e: an attempt to simplify the tax system
es.c: 简化税制的尝试

es.e: The law needs to be simplified.
es.c: 这部法律需要简化。

es.e: a simplified version of the game
es.c: 这个游戏的简化版

d: adv 简单地；仅仅；简直；朴素地；坦白地 used to emphasize what you are saying

es.e: This work is simply not good enough.
es.c: 这工作做得实在不够好。

es.e: He simply won’t accept the committee’s decision.
es.c: 他根本不接受委员会的决定。

es.e: That would be simply wonderful!
es.c: 那简直太棒了！

d: conj 因为；由于；既然；自…以来；自…以后；prep 自…以来；自…以后 from a particular time or event in the past until the present, or in that period of time；adv 后来 When you are talking about an event or situation in the past, you use since to indica

es.e: We’ve been waiting here since two o’clock.
es.c: 我们从两点钟开始就在这里等了。

es.e: I haven’t played rugby since I left university.
es.c: 我大学毕业后就没打过橄榄球。

es.e: She left London ten years ago, and I haven’t seen her since.
es.c: 她十年前离开伦敦，此后我再没有见过她。

d: adv 真诚地；由衷地，诚恳地 if you feel or believe something sincerely, you really feel or believe it and are not just pretending

es.e: I sincerely hope I’ll see her again.
es.c: 我衷心希望再见到她。

es.e: We are sincerely grateful for your help.
es.c: 我们由衷地感谢你的帮助。

d: v 唱歌；歌颂；鸣叫；呼号 to produce a musical sound with your voice；n 演唱；鸣声；呼啸声

es.e: She can sing beautifully.
es.c: 她唱歌很好听。

es.e: Most children enjoy singing.
es.c: 大多数孩子都喜欢唱歌。

es.e: We had a great time singing some of the old songs .
es.c: 我们唱了一些老歌，非常开心。

d: n 歌手，歌唱家 someone who sings

es.e: the lead singer (= main singer ) of Slade
es.c: 施莱德乐队的主唱

es.e: Tina Turner’s backing singers
es.c: 蒂纳·特纳的伴唱歌手

d: adj 单一的；单身的；单程的 only one；n 一个；单打；单程票 a game, especially in tennis, in which one person plays on their own against another person；v 选出

es.e: A single tree gave shade from the sun.
es.c: 唯有一棵树遮阴。

es.e: They won the game by a single point.
es.c: 他们仅以一分的优势赢得比赛。

es.e: the highest price ever paid for a single work of art
es.c: 为单件艺术品所支付的最高价格

d: v 下沉；消沉；渗透 to go down below the surface of water, mud etc；n 水槽；洗涤槽；污水坑 a large open container that you fill with water and use for washing yourself, washing dishes etc

es.e: Their motorboat struck a rock and began to sink.
es.c: 他们的摩托艇触了礁，开始下沉。

es.e: The kids watched as the coin sank to the bottom of the pool.
es.c: 孩子们看着那枚硬币沉到池底。

es.e: The heavy guns sank up to their barrels in the mud.
es.c: 这些沉重的大炮深陷在泥里，只露出炮管。

d: n 先生；（用于姓名前）爵士；阁下；（中小学生对男教师的称呼）先生；老师 used when speaking to a man in order to be polite or show respect

es.e: ‘Report back to me in an hour, sergeant.’ ‘Yes, sir.’
es.c: “一小时后向我报告，中士。”“是，长官。”

es.e: Can I help you, sir?
es.c: 我能为您效劳吗，先生？

es.e: Sir! You dropped your wallet.
es.c: 先生！ 您的钱包掉了。

d: n 姐妹；（称志同道合者）姐妹；修女；护士 a girl or woman who has the same parents as you；adj 姐妹般的；同类型的 You can use sister to describe something that is of the same type or is connected in some way to another thing you have mentioned. For e

es.e: Janet and Abby are sisters.
es.c: 珍妮特和阿比是两姐妹。

es.e: He has two sisters and a brother.
es.c: 他有两个姊妹和一个弟弟。

es.e: She’s my twin sister .
es.c: 她是我的孪生妹妹。

d: v 坐；位于 to be in a particular position or condition；n (Sit)人名；(东南亚国家华语)硕；(罗)西特

es.e: The parliament building sits in a large square.
es.c: 议会大楼位于一个大广场上。

es.e: He’s got a computer sitting on his desk, but he doesn’t use it.
es.c: 他有一台电脑放在书桌上，但他不用。

es.e: My climbing boots were sitting unused in a cupboard.
es.c: 我的登山靴在橱柜里，一直没有穿。

d: n 情况；形势；处境；位置 a combination of all the things that are happening and all the conditions that exist at a particular time in a particular place

es.e: I explained the situation to everyone.
es.c: 我向大家介绍了一下情况。

d: num 六，六个 the number 6；n 六，六个 the number 6

es.e: six months ago
es.c: 六个月前

es.e: She arrived just after six (= six o’clock ) .
es.c: 她六点刚过就到了。

es.e: He learnt to play the violin when he was six (= six years old ) .
es.c: 他六岁学拉小提琴。

d: adj 十六的，十六个的；num 十六 the number

es.e: But it contained one very interesting piece of data: in 2008, for the first time in sixteen years, the finance and insurance industry shrank.
es.c: 但是，这份报告里有一项非常耐人寻味的数据：在2008年，金融保险业出现近十六年来的首次萎缩。

d: num 第十六；十六分之一 one of 16 equal parts of something；adj 第十六的；十六分之一的

es.e: But in the course of history, we settled beginning in the sixteenth and seventeenth century, down into just two patterns: what we call the major pattern and the minor pattern.
es.c: 但在历史的发展过程中,在十六到十七世纪期间,人们最终确定了下列两种模式,我们称之为大调模式和小调模式

d: n 月的第六日，（与the连用的）第六个；六分之一 one of six equal parts of something；adj （与 the 连用）第六的，第六个的；六分之一的 coming after five other things in a series

es.e: About one sixth of the children admitted to taking drugs.
es.c: 大约六分之一的儿童承认吸毒。

d: num 六十；六十个 the number

es.e: sixty years ago
es.c: 六十年前

d: n 大小；尺寸 how big or small something is；adj 一定尺寸的；v 依大小排列 to sort according to size

es.e: He’s a small boy, about John’s size.
es.c: 他是个小男孩，个子和约翰差不多。

es.e: Jensens’ house is about the same size as ours.
es.c: 詹森的房子和我们的差不多大。

es.e: He’s quite a big dog, but he’s still not full size yet.
es.c: 这条狗体型很大，但还没有长足。

d: v 滑冰；滑过 to move on skates；n 溜冰；冰鞋 one of a pair of boots with metal blades on the bottom, for moving quickly on ice

es.e: The children skated on the frozen pond.
es.c: 孩子们在结冰的池塘上滑冰。

d: n 溜冰板 a short board with two small wheels at each end, which you can stand on and ride for fun or as a sport；v 用滑板滑行

es.e: He has long hair.He has a black skateboard.Who is he?
es.c: 他有长头发.他有一黑色溜冰板.他是谁？

d: n 滑雪橇 one of a pair of long thin narrow pieces of wood or plastic that you fasten to your boots and use for moving on snow or on water；v 滑雪 to move on skis for sport or in order to travel on snow or water；adj 滑雪（用）的 You

es.e: ski slopes
es.c: 滑雪坡

es.e: a ski resort (= where people can go skiing )
es.c: 滑雪度假胜地

es.e: ...the Swiss ski resort of Klosters.
es.c: …瑞士的克洛斯特斯滑雪胜地。

d: n 技能，技巧；本领，技术 an ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practised it

es.e: Reading and writing are two different skills.
es.c: 阅读和写作是两种不同的技能。

es.e: Many jobs today require computer skills.
es.c: 如今的许多工作都需要计算机技能。

d: adj 熟练的；有技能的；需要技能的 someone who is skilled has the training and experience that is needed to do something well

es.e: Skilled craftsmen, such as carpenters, are in great demand.
es.c: 对木工之类的熟练工匠需求量很大。

es.e: The company is fortunate to have such highly skilled workers.
es.c: 公司有这样一些技能熟练的工人真是幸运。

d: adj 熟练的；巧妙的

es.e: I like making things by hand because my mother is very skillful, and I liked staying with her when I was young.
es.c: 我喜欢亲手作一些东西，这是因为我母亲的手非常巧，而且我小的时候喜欢同她在一起。

es.e: They understand that development is a difficult social activity that can be conquered not by a silver bullet, but rather by dedicated, skillful practitioners who know and leverage proven techniques.
es.c: 开发是一项有难度的社会活动，不仅不能够通过银弹来征服，而是由理解并实施可靠技术的那些专注且熟练的人们来解决。

d: adv 巧妙地；精巧地
n 皮肤；外皮 the natural outer layer of a person’s or animal’s body；v 剥皮 to remove the skin from an animal, fruit, or vegetable

es.e: She had thick black hair and smooth dark skin.
es.c: 她一头浓密的黑发，皮肤黝黑光滑。

es.e: The skin on his hands was dry and rough.
es.c: 他手上的皮肤干燥粗糙。

d: v 跳跃；跳绳；遗漏；跳读 to go from one subject to another in no fixed order；n 跳跃；跳读 a skipping movement

es.e: They saw the man with a little girl skipping along behind him.
es.c: 他们看到那个男人身后跟着一个蹦蹦跳跳的小女孩。

d: n 裙子 a piece of outer clothing worn by women and girls, which hangs down from the waist like the bottom part of a dress；v 绕过，回避；位于…边缘 to avoid talking about an important subject, especially because it is difficult or emb

es.e: She wore a white blouse and a plain black skirt.
es.c: 她穿着白衬衣和纯黑的裙子。

d: n 天空；顶点 the space above the earth where clouds and the sun and stars appear；v 把…投向空中；把…挂得过高

es.e: The sky grew dark, and a cold rain began to fall.
es.c: 天色转暗，开始下起冰冷的雨来。

es.e: A shooting star sped across the sky.
es.c: 一颗流星划过天空。

d: n 摩天楼，超高层大楼；特别高的东西 a very tall modern city building

es.e: The skyscraper towers into the clouds.
es.c: 那幢摩天大楼高耸入云。

d: n 奴隶；从动装置 someone who is owned by another person and works for them for no money；v 苦干；拼命工作 to work very hard with little time to rest

es.e: a slave to fashion
es.c: 时尚的奴隶

d: n 奴役；奴隶制度；奴隶身份 the system of having slaves

es.e: attempts to abolish slavery
es.c: 废除奴隶制的努力

d: v 睡，睡觉 to rest your mind and body, usually at night when you are lying in bed with your eyes closed；n 睡眠 the natural state of resting your mind and body, usually at night

es.e: I usually sleep on my back.
es.c: 我一般仰卧着睡觉。

es.e: Did you sleep well?
es.c: 你睡得好吗？

es.e: He’s lucky because at least he has somewhere to sleep.
es.c: 他算是幸运的，至少还有个睡觉的地方。

d: adj 欲睡的；困乏的；不活跃的 tired and ready to sleep

es.e: The warmth from the fire made her feel sleepy.
es.c: 暖洋洋的炉火使她昏昏欲睡。

d: n [机] 套筒，[机] 套管；袖子，[服装] 袖套 the part of a piece of clothing that covers all or part of your arm；vt 给……装袖子；给……装套筒

es.e: a dress with long sleeves
es.c: 长袖连衣裙

d: n 薄片；部分；菜刀，火铲 a thin flat piece of food cut from a larger piece；v 切下；把…分成部分；将…切成薄片 to cut meat, bread, vegetables etc into thin flat pieces

es.e: pizza slices
es.c: 比萨块

es.e: Cut the tomatoes into slices .
es.c: 把番茄切成片。

d: n 滑动；幻灯片；滑梯；雪崩 a large structure with steps leading to the top of a long sloping surface which children can slide down；v 滑动；滑落；不知不觉陷入 to move smoothly over a surface while continuing to touch it, or to make something mov

es.e: a slide show
es.c: 幻灯片放映

d: adj 轻微的，少量的；脆弱的；细长的；不重要的 small in degree；v 轻视，忽略；怠慢 to offend someone by treating them rudely or without respect；n 怠慢；轻蔑

es.e: a slight improvement
es.c: 些许的改进

es.e: a slight increase
es.c: 少许的增加

es.e: a slight change of plan
es.c: 计划的略微变动

d: adj 苗条的；修长的；微小的；差的 someone who is slim is attractively thin；v 使…体重减轻；使…苗条 to make yourself thinner by eating less, taking a lot of exercise etc；n (Slim)人名；(阿拉伯)萨利姆；(英、西)斯利姆

es.e: a slim young woman
es.c: 身材苗条的年轻女子

es.e: a slim waist
es.c: 纤腰

d: v 滑动；滑倒；犯错；失足；减退 to slide a short distance accidentally, and fall or lose your balance slightly；n 滑，滑倒；片，纸片；错误；下跌；事故 a small mistake；adj 滑动的；有活结的；活络的；abbr 串行线路接口协议，是旧式的协议（Serial Line Interface Protocol）

es.e: Wright slipped but managed to keep hold of the ball.
es.c: 赖特滑了一下，但球还抓在手里。

d: adj 慢的；减速的；迟钝的 not moving, being done, or happening quickly；v 变慢；变萧条；adv 慢慢地；迟缓地 In informal English, slower is used to mean "at a slower speed" and slowest is used to mean "at the slowest speed." In nonstandard English,

es.e: The car was travelling at a very slow speed.
es.c: 汽车正以非常慢的速度行驶。

es.e: a slow walker
es.c: 慢慢走着的人

es.e: The economy faces a year of slower growth.
es.c: 经济将面临增长更缓慢的一年。

d: adj 少的，小的；微弱的；几乎没有的；不重要的；幼小的 not large in size or amount；adv 小小地；卑鄙地；n 小件物品；矮小的人

es.e: a small piece of paper
es.c: 一小片纸

es.e: a small car
es.c: 一辆小汽车

es.e: a small town
es.c: 小镇

d: adj 聪明的；巧妙的；敏捷的；厉害的；潇洒的；剧烈的；时髦的 intelligent or sensible；n (Smart)人名；(法)斯马尔；(英、德)斯马特

es.e: The smart kids get good grades and go off to college.
es.c: 聪明的孩子成绩好，可以去上大学。

es.e: I was smart enough to wait for a week.
es.c: 我很明智，等了一个星期。

es.e: His decision to become a director was a smart move (= sensible thing to do ) .
es.c: 他决定要做导演，这是明智之举。

d: v 嗅，闻；有…气味 to notice or recognize a particular smell；n 气味，嗅觉；臭味 the quality that people and animals recognize by using their nose

es.e: I can smell burning.
es.c: 我闻到烧焦的气味。

es.e: Can you smell something?
es.c: 你闻到什么气味了吗？

d: adj 有臭味的，发臭的 having a strong unpleasant smell

es.e: smelly feet
es.c: 臭脚

d: v 微笑 to make your mouth curve upwards, in order to be friendly or because you are happy or amused；n 微笑；笑容；喜色 an expression in which your mouth curves upwards, when you are being friendly or are happy or amused

es.e: her smiling face
es.c: 她的笑脸

d: n 烟雾 dirty air that looks like a mixture of smoke and  fog  , caused by smoke from cars and factories in cities

es.e: Cars cause pollution, both smog and acid rain.
es.c: 汽车引起污染，既有烟雾又有酸雨。

d: n 烟；抽烟；无常的事物 white, grey or black gas that is produced by something burning；v 冒烟，吸烟；抽烟；弥漫 to suck or breathe in smoke from a cigarette, pipe etc or to do this regularly as a habit

es.e: cigarette smoke
es.c: 香烟的烟雾

es.e: Smoke from burning fields drifted across nearby roads.
es.c: 地里燃烧产生的烟雾飘到了附近的公路上。

es.e: the pall of smoke (= thick cloud of smoke ) that hung over the city
es.c: 笼罩在城市上空的浓烟

d: n 吸烟者；薰制工 someone who smokes cigarettes,  cigar s  etc

es.e: My grandad was a heavy smoker (= someone who smokes a lot ) .
es.c: 我爷爷烟瘾很大。

es.e: He had a smoker’s cough (= a cough caused by smoking cigarettes regularly ) .
es.c: 他因为经常吸烟而得了咳嗽病。

d: n 抽烟；冒气 the activity of breathing in tobacco smoke from a cigarette, pipe etc；adv 冒着烟；adj 准许吸烟的 A smoking area is intended for people who want to smoke；v 吸烟；冒烟（smoke的现在分词）

es.e: The sign says ‘No Smoking’.
es.c: 告示牌上写着“禁止吸烟”。

es.e: a no smoking area
es.c: 禁烟区

es.e: the risks of passive smoking
es.c: 吸二手烟的风险

d: adj 顺利的；光滑的；平稳的 a smooth surface has no rough parts, lumps, or holes, especially in a way that is pleasant and attractive to touch；v 使光滑；消除（障碍等）；使优雅；缓和 to make a rough surface flat and even；n 平滑部分；一块平地；adv 光滑地；平稳地；流畅地 If

es.e: Her skin felt smooth and cool.
es.c: 她的皮肤摸上去又滑又凉。

es.e: a smooth pebble
es.c: 光滑的卵石

es.e: The stone steps had been worn smooth .
es.c: 石阶被磨得光溜溜的了。

d: n 小吃，快餐；一份，部分 a small amount of food that is eaten between main meals or instead of a meal；v 吃快餐，吃点心 to eat small amounts of food between main meals or instead of a meal

es.e: I grabbed a quick snack.
es.c: 我赶紧吃了点零食。

es.e: Drinks and light snacks are served at the bar.
es.c: 酒吧里供应饮料和小吃。

es.e: snack foods like crisps and peanuts
es.c: 炸薯片和花生之类的小吃

d: n 蛇；阴险的人 an animal with a long thin body and no legs, that often has a poisonous bite；v 迂回前进 if a river, road, train, or line snakes somewhere, it moves in long twisting curves

es.e: A snake slithered across our path.
es.c: 一条蛇蜿蜒爬过我们的小路。

d: n 抢夺；抓举；小量 when someone quickly takes or steals something；v 夺得；抽空做；及时救助

es.e: reports of a bag snatch
es.c: 抢夺手提包的报道

d: n 运动鞋；卑鄙者；鬼鬼祟祟做事的人 a type of light soft shoe with a rubber  sole (= bottom )  , used for sports

es.e: a pair of white sneakers
es.c: 一双白色的运动鞋

d: v 打喷嚏 if you sneeze, air suddenly comes from your nose, making a noise, for example when you have a cold；n 喷嚏 the act or sound of sneezing

es.e: She started coughing and sneezing.
es.c: 她开始咳嗽、打喷嚏。

es.e: The dust was making him sneeze .
es.c: 灰尘使他打起了喷嚏。

d: v 嗅；嗤之以鼻 to breathe air in through your nose in order to smell something；n 吸，闻；嗤之以鼻；气味；以鼻吸气；吸气声 Sniff is also a noun

es.e: He opened the milk and sniffed it.
es.c: 他打开牛奶闻了闻。

es.e: At last the sobs ceased, to be replaced by sniffs.
es.c: 最后呜咽声终于停止了，取而代之的是抽鼻子的声音。

d: n 雪，积雪；下雪 soft white pieces of frozen water that fall from the sky in cold weather and cover the ground；v 降雪 if it snows, snow falls from the sky

es.e: Snow was falling heavily as we entered the village.
es.c: 我们进村的时候雪下得正大。

es.e: I could see footprints in the snow.
es.c: 我看到雪地里有脚印。

es.e: The town was buried under three feet of snow.
es.c: 小镇被三英尺厚的积雪覆盖着。

d: n 雪球 a ball of snow that children make and throw at each other；v 掷雪球；滚雪球般增大 if a plan, problem, business etc snow-balls, it grows bigger at a faster and faster rate

es.e: We had a massive snowball fight .
es.c: 我们打了一场大雪仗。

d: n 雪人 a simple figure of a person made of snow, made especially by children

es.e: The children were balling up snow to make a snowman.
es.c: 孩子们正在把雪堆成球状，做一个雪人。

es.e: "He gave me a hug and a kiss and asked me where my snowman was," she said.
es.c: 黛比说：“他给了我一个拥抱和亲吻。 还问我的雪人在哪里。”

es.e: If you are wrong,the snowman with the correct answer will chill your heart.
es.c: 如果你是错误的，有正确答案的雪人将会使你的心脏变冷。

d: adj 下雪的，多雪的；被雪覆盖的；洁白无瑕的 with a lot of snow

es.e: the snowy fields
es.c: 被雪覆盖的田野

es.e: one snowy January day
es.c: 1月里大雪纷飞的一天

d: adv 如此，这么；确是如此 used to refer back to an idea, action, quality, situation etc that has just been mentioned；conj 所以；因此 used to say that someone does something because of the reason just stated；pron 这样；n (So)人名；(柬)索

es.e: The troops will not advance until ordered to do so .
es.c: 在接到命令之前，部队不会前进。

es.e: Did Luke sell them? And, if so , what happened to the money?
es.c: 卢克把它们卖了吗？如果是这样的话，那钱到哪里去了？

es.e: ‘Has he lost a fortune?’ ‘ So they say .’
es.c: “他输掉了一大笔钱吗？”“他们是这么说的。”

d: n 肥皂 the substance that you use to wash your body；v 将肥皂涂在……上；对……拍马屁（俚语） to rub soap on or over someone or something

es.e: Wash thoroughly with soap and water .
es.c: 用肥皂和水彻底洗一洗。

es.e: a bar of soap
es.c: 一块肥皂

d: v 啜泣，呜咽；（风等）发出呜咽声 to cry noisily while breathing in short sudden bursts；n 啜泣，呜咽 A sob is one of the noises that you make when you are crying

es.e: He began sobbing uncontrollably .
es.c: 他不由自主地抽噎起来。

es.e: Her sobs grew louder.
es.c: 她的呜咽声变得更大了。

d: n 英式足球，足球 a sport played by two teams of 11 players, who try to kick a round ball into their opponents’  goal

es.e: It must be one of those soccer scarfs from England.
es.c: 那一定是某个英国足球队的围巾。

d: adj 社会的，社交的；群居的 relating to human society and its organization, or the quality of people’s lives；n 联谊会；联欢会 a party for the members of a group, club, or church

es.e: social issues, such as unemployment and education
es.c: 失业和教育之类的社会问题

es.e: the country’s serious social problems
es.c: 该国严重的社会问题

es.e: a challenge to the social order
es.c: 对社会秩序的一个挑战

d: n 社会主义 an economic and political system in which large industries are owned by the government, and taxes are used to take some wealth away from richer citizens and give it to poorer citizens

es.e: They declared for socialism.
es.c: 他们表示拥护社会主义。

es.e: We should rally under the banner of socialism.
es.c: 我们应当在社会主义的旗帜下团结起来。

es.e: From the Left: Yes! Yes, exactly what socialism is.
es.c: 从左边的回答：是的，这就是社会主义。

d: n 社会主义者；社会党党员 someone who believes in socialism, or who is a member of a political party that supports socialism；adj 社会主义的 based on socialism or relating to a political party that supports socialism

es.e: Esperanto has always been popular among socialists.
es.c: 世界语在社会主义者中一直很受欢迎。

d: n 社会；交往；社团；社交界 people in general, considered in relation to the laws, organizations etc that make it possible for them to live together

es.e: technology and its effects on modern society
es.c: 科技及其对现代社会的影响

es.e: Children are the most vulnerable members of society .
es.c: 儿童是最脆弱的社会成员。

d: n 短袜；一击 a piece of clothing made of soft material that you wear on your foot inside your shoe；v 重击；给……穿袜 If you sock someone or something, you hit them hard；adv 正着地；不偏不倚地；adj 非常成功的

es.e: a pair of socks
es.c: 一双短袜

es.e: white ankle socks
es.c: 白色的齐踝短袜

es.e: Once, after a boy made a comment, she socked him.
es.c: 有一次，一个男孩子发表了一点意见，她就挥拳猛击他。

d: n 插座；窝，穴；牙槽 a place in a wall where you can connect electrical equipment to the supply of electricity；vt 给…配插座

es.e: a headphone socket
es.c: 耳机插口

d: n 沙发；长椅 a comfortable seat with raised arms and a back, that is wide enough for two or three people to sit on

es.e: He sprang up from the sofa.
es.c: 他从沙发上猛然跳了起来。

es.e: She spread a sheet on the sofa for me.
es.c: 她为我在沙发上铺了一条单子。

es.e: There's enough space to have a sofa there.
es.c: 那里还有足够的地方放下一个沙发。

d: adj 软的，柔软的；温柔的，温和的；软弱的；笨的 having a surface that is smooth and pleasant to touch；adv 柔软地；温和地；n 柔性；柔软的东西；柔软部分

es.e: a baby’s soft skin
es.c: 婴儿细嫩的皮肤

es.e: The fur was soft to the touch.
es.c: 这皮毛摸起来很柔滑。

d: n 垒球；垒球运动 a game similar to baseball but played on a smaller field with a slightly larger and softer ball
n 软件 the sets of programs that tell a computer how to do a particular job

es.e: She loaded the new software .
es.c: 她给电脑装上新的软件。

es.e: a software company
es.c: 软件公司

d: n 土地；土壤；国家；粪便；务农；温床 the top layer of the earth in which plants grow；v 弄脏；污辱 to make something dirty, especially with waste from your body

es.e: Roses grow well in a clay soil.
es.c: 蔷薇适宜在黏质土中生长。

d: adj 太阳的；日光的；利用太阳光的；与太阳相关的 relating to the sun；n 日光浴室

es.e: a solar eclipse
es.c: 日食

d: n 军人；[昆] 兵蚁；懒汉；一片烤面包 a member of the army of a country, especially someone who is not an officer；v 当兵；磨洋工；坚持干；假称害病

es.e: A British soldier was wounded in the fighting.
es.c: 战斗中，有一名英国士兵受了伤。

es.e: an enemy soldier
es.c: 敌兵

d: adj 固体的；可靠的；立体的；结实的；一致的 hard or firm, with a fixed shape, and not a liquid or gas；n 固体；立方体 a firm object or substance that has a fixed shape, not a gas or liquid

es.e: The lake was frozen solid .
es.c: 湖水冻得结结实实。

es.e: It was good to be back on solid ground again.
es.c: 又能踏上坚实的土地感觉真好。

es.e: Is the baby eating solid food (= bread, meat etc ) yet?
es.c: 宝宝吃固体食物了吗？

d: adj 一些；某个；大约；相当多的；pron 一些；若干；其中的一部分；（数量不确切时用）有些人 a number of people or things or an amount of something, when the exact number or amount is not stated；adv 非常；相当；<美>稍微 a fairly large number or amount of something

es.e: I’ve just made a pot of coffee. Would you like some?
es.c: 我刚煮了一壶咖啡，你想喝点吗？

es.e: ‘Do you know where the screws are?’ ‘There are some in the garage.’
es.c: “你知道螺丝钉在哪儿吗？”“车库里有一些。”

d: n 大人物；重要人物 used to mean a person, when you do not know, or do not say who the person is；pron 有人；某人 used to mean a person, when you do not know, or do not say who the person is

es.e: There’s somebody waiting to see you.
es.c: 有人等着要见你。

es.e: Somebody’s car alarm kept me awake all night.
es.c: 不知谁的汽车警报器吵得我整晚都无法入睡。

es.e: ‘Who can we get to babysit?’ ‘I’ll call Suzie or somebody .’
es.c: “我们能请谁来看小孩呢？”“我会叫苏齐或别的什么人。”

d: pron 有人，某人 used to mean a person, when you do not know or do not say who the person is

es.e: What would you do if someone tried to rob you in the street?
es.c: 要是有人在街上抢劫你，你会怎么办？

es.e: Will someone please explain what’s going on?
es.c: 谁能说说是怎么回事？

es.e: Have Brooks or someone fax this to New York right away.
es.c: 叫布鲁克斯或谁立刻把这个发传真到纽约。

d: pron 某事；某物 used to mean a particular thing when you do not know its name or do not know exactly what it is；n 重要的人；值得重视的事；adv 非常；有点；大约；adj 大约；有点象

es.e: There’s something in my eye.
es.c: 我眼睛里有什么东西。

es.e: Sarah said something about coming over later.
es.c: 萨拉说她等一会儿过来什么的。

es.e: I don’t know what he does exactly, but I know it has something to do with computers (= is related to them in some way ) .
es.c: 我不知道他具体是干什么的，只知道和电脑有关。

d: adv 有时，间或 on some occasions but not always

es.e: I sometimes have to work late.
es.c: 我有时得工作到很晚。

es.e: Sometimes, Grandma would tell us stories about her childhood in Italy.
es.c: 有时候，祖母会跟我们讲讲她儿时在意大利的经历。

es.e: ‘Do you ever wish you were back in Japan?’ ‘Sometimes. Not very often.’
es.c: “你有没有想过希望回到日本？”“有时候吧，但不经常这么想。”

d: adv 在某处；到某处 in or to a place, but you do not say or know exactly where；n 某个地方

es.e: My wallet must be around here somewhere.
es.c: 我的钱包肯定是在这里的什么地方。

es.e: We could meet for dinner at Giorgio’s or somewhere (= or a similar place ) .
es.c: 我们可以在乔治家或别的什么地方一起吃饭。

d: n 儿子；孩子（对年轻人的称呼）；男性后裔 someone’s male child

es.e: Her son Sean was born in 1983.
es.c: 她的儿子肖恩出生于 1983 年。

es.e: They have three sons and a daughter.
es.c: 他们有三个儿子和一个女儿。

es.e: In those days, the property went to the oldest son.
es.c: 那时候，财产由长子继承。

d: n 歌曲；歌唱；诗歌；鸣声 the musical sounds made by birds and some other animals such as  whales

es.e: the song of the lark
es.c: 云雀的鸣唱

d: adv 快；不久，一会儿；立刻；宁愿 in a short time from now, or a short time after something else happens

es.e: It will be dark soon.
es.c: 天很快就要黑了。

es.e: David arrived sooner than I expected.
es.c: 戴维到得比我预料的快。

es.e: ‘Who?’ ‘You’ll find out soon enough (= fairly soon ) .’
es.c: “谁？”“你很快就会知道的。”

d: n 悲伤；懊悔；伤心事 a feeling of great sadness, usually because someone has died or because something terrible has happened to you；v 懊悔；遗憾；感到悲伤 to feel or express sorrow

es.e: the family’s joys and sorrows
es.c: 这家人的喜与悲

d: adj 遗憾的；对不起的，抱歉的 feeling ashamed or unhappy about something bad you have done；int 对不起，抱歉（表示委婉的拒绝等）

es.e: She was very sorry about all the trouble she'd caused.
es.c: 她对自己造成的麻烦感到很内疚。

d: n 种类；方式；品质 a group or class of people, things etc that have similar qualities or features；v 分类；协调；交往 to put things in a particular order or arrange them in groups according to size, type etc

es.e: Most of the victims developed psychological problems of one sort or another (= of various different types ) .
es.c: 大多数受害者都出现了这样那样的心理问题。

es.e: They do burgers, pizzas, that sort of thing .
es.c: 他们供应汉堡包、比萨饼什么的。

d: n 灵魂；心灵；精神；鬼魂 the part of a person that is not physical, and that contains their character, thoughts, and feelings. Many people believe that a person’s soul continues to exist after they have died.；adj 美国黑人文化的

es.e: the immortality of the soul
es.c: 灵魂的不灭

es.e: It was as if those grey eyes could see into the very depths of her soul .
es.c: 仿佛那双灰眼睛能看到她的灵魂深处。

es.e: the souls of the dead
es.c: 亡灵

d: v 听（诊）；测量，测…深；使发声；试探；宣告 to publicly give a warning or tell people to be careful；n 声音，语音；噪音；海峡；吵闹；听力范围；[医] 探条 something that you hear, or what can be heard；adj 健全的，健康的；合理的；可靠的；有效彻底的 sensible and likely to produce the righ

es.e: Several earlier studies had sounded similar warnings .
es.c: 早先的几次研究也提出过类似的警告。

es.e: Now it is an American economist who is sounding the alarm .
es.c: 现在是一位美国的经济学家在提出警告。

d: n 汤，羹；马力 cooked liquid food, often containing small pieces of meat, fish, or vegetables；v 加速；增加马力

es.e: homemade tomato soup
es.c: 自制的番茄汤

d: adj 酸的；发酵的；刺耳的；酸臭的；讨厌的 having a sharp acid taste, like the taste of a  lemon  or a fruit that is not ready to be eaten；v 发酵；变酸；厌烦 if milk sours, or if something sours it, it begins to have an unpleasant sharp taste；n 酸味；

es.e: Rachel sampled the wine. It was sour.
es.c: 雷切尔尝了尝葡萄酒，是酸的。

es.e: sour cherries
es.c: 酸樱桃

d: n 南方，南边；南部 the direction that is at the bottom of a map of the world, below the Equator. It is on the right if you are facing the rising sun.；adv 在南方，向南方 towards the south；adj 南的，南方的 in the south, or facing the south

es.e: Which way is south?
es.c: 哪面是南？

d: adj 南的；南方的 in or from the south of a country or area；n 南方人

es.e: a southern accent
es.c: 南部口音

es.e: Southern Italy
es.c: 意大利南部

d: n 西南方 the direction that is exactly between south and west；adj 西南的 a southwest wind comes from the southwest；adv 往西南；来自西南 If you go southwest, you travel toward the southwest

es.e: ...some 500 kilometres to the southwest of Johannesburg.
es.c: …约翰内斯堡西南约五百公里。

es.e: We took a plane southwest across the Anatolian plateau to Cappadocia.
es.c: 我们乘飞机朝西南方,越过安纳托利亚高原,飞往卡帕多细亚。

d: n 纪念品；旅游纪念品；回忆 A souvenir is something which you buy or keep to remind you of a holiday, place, or event

es.e: ...a souvenir of the summer of 1992.
es.c: …一个1992年夏天的纪念品。

d: v 播种；散布；使密布 to plant or scatter seeds on a piece of ground；n 母猪 a fully grown female pig

es.e: Sow the seeds in late March.
es.c: 三月底播种。

d: n 空间；太空；距离 the amount of an area, room, container etc that is empty or available to be used；v 留间隔

es.e: How much space is there on each disk?
es.c: 每张磁盘有多大容量？

es.e: The hedge takes up too much space .
es.c: 这树篱占了太多的地方。

d: n [航] 宇宙飞船 a vehicle for carrying people through space

es.e: ...an alien spaceship.
es.c: …一艘外星人的宇宙飞船。

d: n 铁锹，铲子 a tool for digging that has a long handle and a broad metal blade that you push into the ground；v 铲；把……弄实抹平

es.e: ...a garden spade.
es.c: …一把花园里使用的锹。

d: n 意大利式细面条 a type of  pasta  in very long thin pieces, that is cooked in boiling water

es.e: As the sun sets over Tokyo, another case is about to reach its climax on a bridge across a spaghetti of railway lines.
es.c: 当太阳在在东京落下时，在一座横跨意大利面条似的铁路线的桥上，另一事件正要到达它的巅峰。

es.e: Standing in the next room, in the middle of what looked like piles of concrete spaghetti, I began to feel overpowered.
es.c: 站在下一个房间里，在这一大堆看起来就像水泥做的意大利细面条中间，我真有点受不了了。

es.e: Comments: This prank was one of the first to ever to be pulled on television, and although it seems a little bit out there today, at the time spaghetti was considered a delicacy in the U. K.
es.c: 点评： 瑞士面条大丰收是第一个上电视的恶作剧，尽管该主意在今天看来仍然有点不足为道，但当时恶作剧中的主角“面条”成为了英国饭桌上的精美食物。

d: n 西班牙

es.e: They are touring in Spain.
es.c: 他们正在西班牙旅游。

es.e: She chose Spain, but personally I'd prefer to go to France.
es.c: 她选择了西班牙，而我个人倒更愿意去法国。

es.e: This island was ceded to Spain more than one hundred years ago.
es.c: 这个岛屿在一百多年以前就割让给西班牙了。

d: adj 西班牙的；西班牙人的；西班牙语的 relating to Spain, its people, or its language；n 西班牙语；西班牙人 the language used in Spain and parts of Latin America

es.e: ...a Spanish sherry.
es.c: ...一瓶西班牙雪利酒。

d: v 节约，吝惜；饶恕；分出，分让 If you spare time or another resource for a particular purpose, you make it available for that purpose；adj 多余的；瘦的；少量的 not being used or not needed at the present time；n 剩余；备用零件 an additional thing, for e

es.e: She said that she could only spare 35 minutes for our meeting.
es.c: 她说她只能抽出35分钟给我们的会议。

d: n 麻雀；矮小的人 a small brown bird, very common in many parts of the world

es.e: The myrtle, dove, sparrow, and swan are sacred to her.
es.c: 桃金娘，鸽子，麻雀和天鹅是她的圣物。

es.e: Appearing in great danger, the tiny sparrow tumbled on to the lawn, but softy Flint appeared to have taken pity on him.
es.c: 跌落在草地上的小麻雀看起来处于非常危险的境地，但是温柔的“弗林特”似乎非常同情他。

d: v 说话；演讲；表明；陈述 to use your voice to produce words

es.e: I was so shocked I couldn’t speak.
es.c: 我震惊得说不出话来。

es.e: He spoke very softly (= quietly ) .
es.c: 他说话声音非常轻柔。

d: n 演讲者；扬声器；说话者；说某种语言的人 someone who makes a formal speech to a group of people

es.e: The keynote speaker (= main or most important speaker ) was Robert Venturi, the architect.
es.c: 主要发言人是建筑师罗伯特·文图里。

d: n 矛，枪 a pole with a sharp pointed blade at one end, used as a weapon in the past；v 用矛刺 to push or throw a spear into something, especially in order to kill it

es.e: I fended off his sword thrust with my spear.
es.c: 他一刀砍来， 我拿枪架住。

es.e: He transfixed the enemy's heart with a spear.
es.c: 他用长矛刺穿了敌人的心脏。

es.e: Yes,of course. My shield is the strongest.It can stop any spear in the world.
es.c: 当然是了。我的盾是最结实的，它能抵挡住世界上任何矛。

d: n 特使，特派人员；特刊；特色菜；专车；特价商品 a lower price than usual for a particular product for a short period of time；adj 特别的；专门的，专用的 not ordinary or usual, but different in some way and often better or more important

es.e: a lunch special for $4.99
es.c: 4.99 美元的特惠午餐

d: n 专家；专门医师 someone who knows a lot about a particular subject, or is very skilled at it；adj 专家的；专业的

es.e: a heart specialist
es.c: 心脏专科医生

d: n 演讲；讲话；[语] 语音；演说 a talk, especially a formal one about a particular subject, given to a group of people

es.e: He has to make a lot of after-dinner speeches .
es.c: 他经常要发表席后演说。

es.e: Collins gave the keynote speech (= most important speech ) .
es.c: 科林斯作了主题发言。

d: v 超速，加速；加速，迅速前行；兴隆 to be driving faster than the legal limit；n 速度，速率；迅速，快速；昌盛，繁荣 the rate at which something moves or travels

es.e: I got caught speeding on the A40 yesterday.
es.c: 昨天我在 A40 号干线公路上超速行驶被逮到。

d: v 拼，拼写；意味着；招致；拼成；迷住；轮值 to form a word by writing or naming the letters in order；n 符咒；一段时间；魅力 a piece of magic that someone does, or the special words or ceremonies used in doing it

es.e: How do you spell ‘juice’?
es.c: juice 怎么拼？

es.e: Pupils should know how to spell commonly used words.
es.c: 小学生应该知道常用词的拼法。

d: n 拼写；拼字；拼法 the act of spelling words correctly, or the ability to do this；v 拼写；意味着（spell的ing形式）；迷住

es.e: Her spelling has improved.
es.c: 她的拼写进步了。

es.e: an essay full of spelling mistakes
es.c: 一篇满是拼写错误的文章

d: v 度过，消磨（时光）；花费；浪费；用尽 to use your money to pay for goods or services；n 预算

es.e: I can’t afford to spend any more money this week.
es.c: 这星期我没有能力花更多的钱了。

es.e: The repairs cost a lot, but it’s money well spent (= a sensible way of spending money ) .
es.c: 修理费很高，但这是该花的钱。

d: v 旋转；纺纱；吐丝；晕眩 to turn around and around very quickly, or to make something do this；n 旋转；疾驰 an act of turning around quickly

es.e: The plane’s propellers were spinning.
es.c: 飞机的螺旋桨在快速旋转。

d: n 精神；心灵；情绪；志气；烈酒 the qualities that make someone live the way they do, and make them different from other people；v 鼓励；鼓舞；诱拐

es.e: His spirits were so low (= he was so sad ) that he refused to answer his phone.
es.c: 他情绪非常低落，连电话也不愿接。

es.c: 奇怪的噪声

es.e: Does Geoff’s behaviour seem strange to you?
es.c: 你觉得杰夫的行为反常吗？

es.e: She felt there was something strange about Dexter’s voice.
es.c: 她觉得德克斯特的声音有点奇怪。

d: n 陌生人；外地人；局外人 someone that you do not know

es.e: Children must not talk to strangers.
es.c: 小孩子千万不要同陌生人说话。

d: n 稻草；吸管；一文不值的东西 a thin tube of paper or plastic for sucking up liquid from a bottle or a cup；adj 稻草的；无价值的 having little value or substance

es.e: She sipped her lemonade through a straw.
es.c: 她用吸管吸着柠檬水。

d: n 草莓；草莓色 a soft red juicy fruit with small seeds on its surface, or the plant that grows this fruit

es.e: ...strawberries and cream.
es.c: …奶油草莓。

d: n 溪流；流动；潮流；光线 a flow of water, air, smoke etc, or the direction in which it is flowing；v 流；涌进；飘扬 to flow quickly and in great amounts

es.e: A stream of cold air rushed through the open door.
es.c: 一股冷气穿过敞开的门直冲进来。

d: n 街道 a public road in a city or town that has houses, shops etc on one or both sides；adj 街道的

es.e: We moved to Center Street when I was young.
es.c: 在我小时候，我们搬到了中心大街。

es.e: She lives just a few streets away.
es.c: 她的住处就在几条街外。

es.e: I walked on further down the street .
es.c: 我继续沿着马路走。

d: n 力量；力气；兵力；长处 the physical power and energy that makes someone strong

es.e: I’m trying to build up my strength .
es.c: 我在努力增强体力。

es.e: Jo hit him with all her strength .
es.c: 乔用尽全力打他。

es.e: He never ceased to be amazed by her physical strength .
es.c: 他一直对她的体力感到惊诧。

d: v 加强；巩固 to become stronger or make something stronger

es.e: Our friendship has steadily strengthened over the years.
es.c: 我们的友谊逐年加深。

es.e: Steve’s opposition only strengthened her resolve to go ahead.
es.c: 史蒂夫的反对反而坚定了她继续下去的决心。

es.e: The company plans to strengthen its hand (= make itself more powerful ) in Europe by opening an office in Spain.
es.c: 该公司计划在西班牙设立办事处，以此增强在欧洲的实力。

d: n 压力；强调；紧张；重要性；重读 continuous feelings of worry about your work or personal life, that prevent you from relaxing；v 强调；使紧张；加压力于；用重音读 to emphasize a statement, fact, or idea

es.e: Your headaches are due to stress.
es.c: 你的头痛是压力造成的。

es.e: Janet’s been under a lot of stress since her mother’s illness.
es.c: 珍妮特自从母亲生病以来承受了很大的压力。

es.e: all the stresses of public life
es.c: 公众生活的所有压力

d: adj 严格的；绝对的；精确的；详细的 expecting people to obey rules or to do what you say

es.e: a strict teacher
es.c: 严格的老师

d: v 打，打击；罢工；敲，敲击；抓；打动；穿透 to hit or fall against the surface of something；n 罢工；打击；殴打 a period of time when a group of workers deliberately stop working because of a disagreement about pay, working conditions etc

es.e: She fell heavily, striking her head against the side of the boat.
es.c: 她重重地摔倒，头撞在船舷上。

es.e: A snowball struck him on the back of the head.
es.c: 一个雪球打中他的后脑勺。

es.e: Several cars were struck by falling trees.
es.c: 几辆车被倒下的树砸中。

d: n 线，弦，细绳；一串，一行 a strong thread made of several threads twisted together, used for tying or fastening things

es.e: Her key hung on a string around her neck.
es.c: 她的钥匙穿了根绳子挂在脖子上。

es.e: a ball of string
es.c: 一团细绳

es.e: I need a piece of string to tie this package.
es.c: 我需要一根绳子来捆这个包裹。

d: adj 坚强的；强壮的；牢固的；擅长的 having a lot of physical power so that you can lift heavy things, do hard physical work etc；adv 强劲地；猛烈地；n (Strong)人名；(英)斯特朗

es.e: He was a big strong man.
es.c: 他高大健壮。

es.e: Jack was tall and strong.
es.c: 杰克又高又壮。

es.e: I’m not strong enough to fight him.
es.c: 和他打我还不够强壮。

d: v 奋斗，努力；挣扎 to try extremely hard to achieve something, even though it is very difficult；n 努力，奋斗；竞争 a long hard fight to get freedom, political rights etc

es.e: The team has been struggling all season.
es.c: 整个赛季球队都打得很艰难。

d: adj 顽固的；顽强的；难处理的 determined not to change your mind, even when people think you are being unreasonable

es.e: Why are you so stubborn?
es.c: 你怎么这么固执？

es.e: I’ve got a very stubborn streak (= a tendency to be stubborn ) .
es.c: 我的个性很固执。

es.e: Paul can be as stubborn as a mule (= very stubborn ) .
es.c: 保尔有时倔得像头驴。

d: n 学生；学者 someone who is studying at a university, school etc

es.e: Warren's eldest son is an art student.
es.c: 沃伦的长子是一名学艺术的学生。

d: n 工作室；[广播][电视] 演播室；画室；电影制片厂 a film company or the buildings it owns and uses to make its films

es.e: Depardieu is making a film with one of the big Hollywood studios.
es.c: 德帕迪约正在为好莱坞的一家大制片公司拍摄一部电影。

d: n 学习，研究；课题；书房；学问 a piece of work that is done to find out more about a particular subject or problem, and usually includes a written report；v 学习；考虑；攻读；细察 to learn about a subject at school, university etc

es.e: Recent studies show that women still get paid a lot less than men.
es.c: 最近的调查表明，女性的薪水仍比男性的要低很多。

es.e: The study was carried out between January and May 2008.
es.c: 这项研究是在 2008 年1月到5月间进行的。

d: adj 愚蠢的；麻木的；乏味的 showing a lack of good sense or good judgment；n 傻瓜，笨蛋 an insulting way of talking to someone who you think is being stupid

es.e: stupid mistakes
es.c: 愚蠢的错误

es.e: That was a stupid thing to say.
es.c: 那样说可真傻。

es.e: I can’t believe Kate was stupid enough to get involved in this.
es.c: 我简直不能相信凯特这么傻，会介入这件事情。

d: n 风格；时尚；类型；字体 a particular way of doing, designing, or producing something, especially one that is typical of a particular place, period of time, or group of people；v 设计；称呼；使合潮流 to design clothing, furniture, or the shap

es.e: an attempt to use Japanese management style in a European business
es.c: 将日本的管理方式用于欧洲企业的尝试

d: n 主题；科目；[语] 主语；国民 the thing you are talking about or considering in a conversation, discussion, book, film etc；adj 服从的；易患…的；受制于…的 To be subject to something means to be affected by it or to be likely to be affected by it

es.e: Paul has strong opinions on most subjects.
es.c: 保罗在大多数问题上观点激烈。

es.e: The subjects covered in this chapter are exercise and nutrition.
es.c: 本章涵盖的主题是运动和营养。

es.e: Prices may be subject to alteration.
es.c: 价格可能会受变更影响。

d: adj 主观的；个人的；自觉的 a state-ment, report, attitude etc that is subjective is influenced by personal opinion and can therefore be unfair

es.e: As a critic, he is far too subjective.
es.c: 作为评论家，他过于主观。

es.e: a highly subjective point of view
es.c: 相当主观的看法

d: v 使服从；主张；呈递 to give a plan, piece of writing etc to someone in authority for them to consider or approve

es.e: In desperation, Mrs. Jones submitted to an operation on her right knee to relieve the pain.
es.c: 绝望中，琼斯夫人不得已接受了一次她右膝的手术以减轻疼痛。

d: v 订阅；捐款；认购；赞成；签署 to pay money, usually once a year, to have copies of a newspaper or magazine sent to you, or to have some other service

es.e: My main reason for subscribing to New Scientist is to keep abreast of advances in science.
es.c: 我订阅《新科学家》的主要原因是要跟上科学的进步。

d: n 代用品；代替者 someone who does someone else’s job for a limited period of time, especially in a sports team or school；v 替代 to use something new or diffe-rent instead of something else

es.e: Germany brought on a substitute at half time.
es.c: 德国队在比赛半场时换上一名替补队员。

es.e: substitute goalkeeper
es.c: 替补守门员

d: n [数] 减法；减少；差集 the process of taking a number or amount from a larger number or amount
v 成功；继承；继任；兴旺 to do what you tried or wanted to do

es.e: She wanted to be the first woman to climb Mount Qomolangma, and she almost succeeded.
es.c: 她本想成为第一位登上珠穆朗玛峰的女性，而且差一点就成功了。

d: n 成功，成就；胜利；大获成功的人或事物 when you achieve what you want or intend

es.e: The experiment was a big success.
es.c: 实验非常成功。

d: adj 成功的；一帆风顺的 achieving what you wanted, or having the effect or result you intended

es.e: The operation was successful.
es.c: 手术成功了。

es.e: a highly successful (= very successful ) meeting
es.c: 十分成功的会议

d: adj 这样的，如此的；n (Such)人名；(英)萨奇；(德)祖赫 used to show that you think that something is not good enough or that there is not enough of it

es.e: How dared they do such a thing?
es.c: 他们怎么敢做出这样的事?

es.e: He would not succumb to such an item.
es.c: 他不会对这样的条款做出让步的。

d: v 吸吮；吸取 to take air, liquid etc into your mouth by making your lips form a small hole and using the muscles of your mouth to pull it in；n 吮吸 an act of sucking

es.e: They waited in silence and sucked their sweets.
es.c: 他们静静地等着，吮着糖果。

d: adj 突然的，意外的；快速的 happening, coming, or done quickly or when you do not expect it；n 突然发生的事

es.e: a sudden change in the weather
es.c: 天气的突然变化

es.e: Life is cruel, she thought, with a sudden rush of anger.
es.c: 生活真残酷，她想，心头突然涌上一股怒气。

es.e: a sudden movement
es.c: 突然的一动

d: v 遭受；忍受；经历 to experience physical or mental pain；n (Suffer)人名；(意)苏费尔

es.e: At least he died suddenly and didn’t suffer.
es.c: 至少他死得突然，没有遭罪。

es.e: She’s suffering a lot of pain.
es.c: 她遭受着巨大的痛苦。

d: n 受难；苦楚 serious physical or mental pain；adj 受苦的；患病的；v 受苦；蒙受（suffer的ing形式）

es.e: the suffering of the refugees after the war
es.c: 战后难民所遭受的苦难

es.e: the pain and suffering caused by road accidents
es.c: 交通事故造成的痛苦

d: n 糖；食糖；甜言蜜语 a sweet white or brown substance that is obtained from plants and used to make food and drinks sweet；v 加糖于；粉饰 to add sugar or cover something with sugar

es.e: Do you take sugar in your coffee?
es.c: 你的咖啡加糖吗？

d: v 提议，建议；启发；使人想起；显示；暗示 to tell someone your ideas about what they should do, where they should go etc

es.e: The zoo asked its visitors to suggest a name for the new baby panda.
es.c: 动物园请游客提建议，给刚出生的大熊猫起一个名字。

es.e: It has been suggested that the manager will resign if any more players are sold.
es.c: 有人提议，如果再有球员被出售，球队主教练就辞职。

d: n 建议；示意；微量，细微的迹象 an idea, plan, or possibility that someone mentions, or the act of mentioning it

es.e: Any suggestions would be welcome.
es.c: 任何建议都欢迎。

d: v 适合；使适应 to be acceptable, suitable, or  convenient  for a particular person or in a particular situation；n 诉讼；恳求；套装，西装；一套外衣 a set of clothes made of the same material, usually including a jacket with trousers or a skirt

es.e: Whatever your reason for borrowing, we have the loan that suits your needs .
es.c: 不管您因何贷款，我们都会有满足您需要的贷款。

es.e: There’s a range of restaurants to suit all tastes .
es.c: 有各种各样的餐馆可以满足所有口味。

es.e: There are countryside walks to suit everyone .
es.c: 有适合每个人的乡村步行路径。

d: adj 适当的；相配的 having the right qualities for a particular person, purpose, or situation

es.e: We are hoping to find a suitable school.
es.c: 我们希望能找到一所合适的学校。

d: n [轻] 手提箱；衣箱 a large case with a handle, used for carrying clothes and possessions when you travel

es.e: It did not take Andrew long to pack a suitcase.
es.c: 安德鲁没有用多长时间就整理好了手提箱。

d: n （一套）家具；套房；组曲；（一批）随员，随从 a set of rooms, especially expensive ones in a hotel

es.e: a honeymoon suite
es.c: 蜜月套房

es.e: a suite of rooms for palace guests
es.c: 王室贵宾套房

d: adj 简易的；扼要的 a summary report, statement etc gives the main facts in a report etc without any of the details or explanations；n 概要，摘要，总结 a short statement that gives the main information about something, without giving all

es.e: a summary execution
es.c: 立即处决

d: n 太阳 the large bright object in the sky that gives us light and heat, and around which the Earth moves；v 使晒 to sit or lie outside when the sun is shining

es.e: The sky was blue and the sun was shining.
es.c: 天空蔚蓝，阳光明媚。

d: adj 晒黑的；有晒斑的；日炙的；v 晒黑（sunburn的过去式和过去分词）

es.e: Ground zero is The Thatch, the village pub joined, via its beer garden, to the even rowdier Billy Budds, rammed to the rafters with sunburnt revellers living the dream.
es.c: Thatch酒吧，这家乡村酒馆通过自己的啤酒花园，加入到了吵闹的比利巴德的行列，晒得黝黑、活在梦中的狂欢者的喧哗声充满着整个酒吧。

d: n 星期日；礼拜日 the day between Saturday and Monday

es.e: What are you doing Sunday?
es.c: 你星期天做什么？

d: n 太阳镜；凸透镜（sunglass的复数） dark glasses that you wear to protect your eyes when the sun is very bright

es.e: She slipped on a pair of sunglasses.
es.c: 她轻快地戴上了一副太阳镜。

d: n 日光 natural light that comes from the sun

es.e: The water sparkled in the bright sunlight.
es.c: 水面在灿烂的阳光下闪闪发亮。

es.e: (= came in large amounts ) through the windows.
es.c: 阳光从窗户流泻进来。

es.e: a shaft of sunlight
es.c: 一束阳光

d: adj 阳光充足的，和煦的；快活的；性情开朗的 having a lot of light from the sun

es.e: a warm sunny day
es.c: 温暖晴朗的一天

es.e: a sunny morning
es.c: 艳阳高照的上午

es.e: a nice sunny room
es.c: 阳光充足的房间

d: n 日出；黎明 the time when the sun first appears in the morning

es.e: a picture of sunrise over Mount Fuji
es.c: 富士山日出的照片

d: n 日落，傍晚 the time of day when the sun disappears and night begins

es.e: a glorious sunset
es.c: 壮丽的日落景象

d: n 阳光；愉快；晴天；快活 the light and heat that come from the sun when there is no cloud

es.e: We had three days of spring sunshine.
es.c: 我们享受了三天的春日阳光。

d: adj 特级的；极好的 extremely good；n 特级品，特大号；临时雇员

es.e: an old car in super condition
es.c: 一辆状况极好的旧车

es.e: That sounds super.
es.c: 那听起来棒极了。

es.e: What a super idea!
es.c: 这个主意太妙了！

d: adj 极好的；华丽的；宏伟的 extremely good；n (Superb)人名；(罗)苏佩尔布

es.e: The food was superb.
es.c: 食物好吃极了。

es.e: superb weather
es.c: 极好的天气

d: adj 上级的；优秀的，出众的；高傲的 thinking that you are better than other people – used to show disapproval；n 上级，长官；优胜者，高手；长者 someone who has a higher rank or position than you, especially in a job

es.e: She had that superior tone of voice.
es.c: 她带着那种傲慢的语气。

d: n 超人，能力非凡的 a man of unusually great ability or strength

es.e: Collor nurtured the idea that he was a superman, who single-handedly could resolve Brazil's crisis.
es.c: 考乐抱有一个想法，即他是可以一手解决巴西危机的超人。

d: n 超级市场；自助售货商店 a very large shop that sells food, drinks, and things that people need regularly in their homes

es.e: Most of us do our food shopping in the supermarket.
es.c: 我们大多数人在这家超市采购食品。

d: n 晚餐，晚饭；夜宵 the meal that you have in the early evening

es.e: Why don’t you come over for supper on Friday?
es.c: 周五为什么不过来吃晚饭呢？

es.e: We had supper in a small Italian place.
es.c: 我们在一家意大利小餐馆吃了晚饭。

es.e: Have you eaten supper ?
es.c: 你吃过晚饭了吗？

d: n 供给，补给；供应品 an amount of something that is available to be used；v 供给，提供；补充 to provide people with something that they need or want, especially regularly over a long period of time

es.e: The nation’s fuel supplies will not last forever.
es.c: 这个国家的燃料供应不会无穷无尽。

es.e: To protect the food supply , the government ordered the slaughter of affected cattle.
es.c: 为保护食品供应，政府下令宰杀被感染的牛。

d: v 支持，支撑，支援；扶持，帮助；赡养，供养 to say that you agree with an idea, group, or person, and usually to help them because you want them to succeed；n 支持，维持；支援，供养；支持者，支撑物 approval, encouragement, and perhaps help for a person, idea, p

es.e: The bill was supported by a large majority in the Senate.
es.c: 这项法案得到参议院绝大多数人的支持。

es.e: We strongly support the peace process.
es.c: 我们大力拥护和平进程。

d: v 假设；认为；让（虚拟语气）；推想 to think that something is probably true, based on what you know；conj 假使…结果会怎样

es.e: There were many more deaths than was first supposed.
es.c: 死亡人数远远超过最初的预料。

es.e: (= it is unlikely that ) he’s lying.
es.c: 没有理由认为他在说谎。

d: adj 最高的；至高的；最重要的 having the highest position of power, importance, or influence；n 至高；霸权

es.e: the Supreme Allied Commander in Europe
es.c: 欧洲盟军最高指挥官

es.e: a country where the car reigns supreme
es.c: 汽车占绝对优势地位的国家

d: adj 确信的；可靠的；必定的 confident that you know something or that something is true or correct；adv 当然；的确 used to say ‘yes’ to someone；n (Sure)人名；(英)休尔

es.e: ‘That’s Sarah’s cousin.’ ‘Are you sure?’
es.c: “那是萨拉的表妹。”“你肯定吗？”

es.e: ‘What time does the show start?’ ‘I’m not sure.’
es.c: “表演什么时候开始？”“我说不准。”

es.e: My mother, I felt sure , had not met him before.
es.c: 我敢肯定我妈妈以前从未见过他。

d: n 表面；表层；外观 the top layer of an area of water or land；adj 表面的，肤浅的 relating to the part of the army, navy etc that travels by land or on the sea, rather than by air or under the sea；v 浮出水面 if someone or something surfaces,

es.e: Nearly 10% of the Earth’s surface is covered by ice.
es.c: 地球表面将近 10% 被冰层覆盖。

es.e: Gas bubbles in any liquid tend to rise to the surface .
es.c: 在任何液体中气泡往往都会浮到表面。

d: n 外科医生 a doctor who does operations in a hospital

es.e: ...a heart surgeon.
es.c: …一位心脏外科医生。

d: n 剩余；[贸易] 顺差；盈余；过剩 an amount of something that is more than what is needed or used；adj 剩余的；过剩的 more than what is needed or used

es.e: Any surplus can be trimmed away.
es.c: 多出来的部分可以修剪掉。

d: n 惊奇，诧异；突然袭击 the feeling you have when something unexpected or unusual happens；v 使惊奇；奇袭 to make someone feel surprised；adj 令人惊讶的

es.e: The man had a look of surprise on his face.
es.c: 那人脸上一副惊讶的表情。

d: v 围绕；包围 to be all around someone or something on every side；n 围绕物；adj 环绕立体声的

es.e: He glared at the people who surrounded the tent.
es.c: 他怒视着围住帐篷的那些人。
