d: n 惯例，传统；传说 a belief, custom, or way of doing something that has existed for a long time, or these beliefs, customs etc in general

es.e: the traditions of South East Asia
es.c: 东南亚的传统

es.e: the tradition that the eldest son inherits the property
es.c: 长子继承家产的传统

es.e: By tradition, it’s the bride’s parents who pay for the wedding.
es.c: 根据传统习俗，婚礼的费用由新娘的父母承担。

d: adj 传统的；惯例的 being part of the traditions of a country or group of people

es.e: traditional Italian cooking
es.c: 传统的意大利烹饪

es.e: a traditional Irish folk song
es.c: 传统的爱尔兰民歌

es.e: a traditional method of brewing beer
es.c: 传统的啤酒酿造方法

d: n 交通；运输；贸易；[通信] 通信量 the vehicles moving along a road or street；v 用…作交换；在…通行

es.e: There wasn’t much traffic on the roads.
es.c: 路上车辆不多。

es.e: The sound of the traffic kept me awake.
es.c: 车辆来往的嘈杂声令我无法入睡。

d: n 火车；行列；长队；裙裾 a set of several carriages that are connected to each other and pulled along a railway line by an engine；v 培养；训练；瞄准 to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills

es.e: We went all the way to Inverness by train.
es.c: 我们一路坐火车到因弗内斯。

d: n 助理教练；训练员；驯马师；飞行练习器；运动鞋 someone who trains people or animals for sport or work

es.e: a racehorse trainer
es.c: 赛马训练师

d: n 训练；培养；瞄准；整枝 the process of teaching or being taught the skills for a particular job or activity；v 训练；教养（train的ing形式）

es.e: Police drivers have to undergo intensive training .
es.c: 警察驾驶员都得接受强化训练。

es.e: a rigorous training session
es.c: 一节严格的训练课

es.e: On-the-job training will be supplemented by classroom lectures.
es.c: 除了在职培训，还将有课堂授课作为补充。

d: n 电车轨道；煤车 a vehicle for passengers, which travels along metal tracks in the street；v 用煤车运载

es.e: You can get to the beach easily from the centre of town by tram.
es.c: 你可以很容易地在市中心坐有轨电车到达海滩。

d: v 改变，使…变形；转换 to completely change the appearance, form, or character of something or someone, especially in a way that improves it

es.e: Increased population has transformed the landscape.
es.c: 人口的增加使景观发生了变化。

d: v 翻译；转化；解释；转变为；调动 to change written or spoken words into another language

es.e: Poetry doesn’t usually translate well.
es.c: 诗歌通常都译不好。

d: n 翻译；译文；转化；调任 when you translate something, or something that has been translated

es.e: She read the letter and gave us a rough translation (= she did not translate everything exactly ) .
es.c: 她看了信，给我们大概翻译了一下。

es.e: I’ve only read ‘Madame Bovary’ in translation (= not in its original language ) .
es.c: 我只读过《包法利夫人》的翻译本。

es.e: Much of the book’s humour has been lost in translation (= is no longer effective when translated ) .
es.c: 本书的许多幽默元素已在翻译过程中丢失。

d: n 译者；翻译器 someone who changes writing into a different language

es.e: The author discovered that the translator had foisted several passages into his book.
es.c: 作者发现翻译者偷偷在他的原著中插入了几段文章。

d: adj 透明的；显然的；坦率的；易懂的 if something is transparent, you can see through it

es.e: a transparent plastic container
es.c: 透明的塑料容器

d: n 运输；运输机；狂喜；流放犯 a system or method for carrying passengers or goods from one place to another；v 运输；流放；使狂喜 to take goods, people etc from one place to another in a vehicle

es.e: commuters who travel on public transport
es.c: 乘坐公共交通车辆上下班的人

es.e: It’s easier to get to the college if you have your own transport (= a car, bicycle etc ) .
es.c: 如果你有自己的交通工具，去学院就会更方便。

d: v 诱捕；使…受限制；使…陷入困境 to catch someone by forcing them into a place from which they cannot escape；n 陷阱；圈套；[建] 存水湾 a piece of equipment for catching animals

es.e: The police trapped the terrorists at a roadblock.
es.c: 警察在设有路障的地方堵住了恐怖分子。

d: n 旅行者；旅客；旅行推销员（等于traveller）
n 财富，财产；财宝；珍品 a group of valuable things such as gold, silver, jewels etc；v 珍爱；珍藏 to keep and care for something that is very special, important, or valuable to you

es.e: The Book of Kells is Trinity College’s greatest treasure.
es.c: 《凯尔经》是三一学院的镇院之宝。

d: v 治疗；对待；探讨；视为 to behave towards someone or something in a particular way；n 请客；款待 something special that you give someone or do for them because you know they will enjoy it

es.e: It was difficult to treat patients because of a shortage of medicine.
es.c: 由于缺少药物，很难给病人治病。

d: n 治疗，疗法；处理；对待 something that is done to cure someone who is injured or ill

es.e: Just lately, Kyra has been giving me the silent treatment (= refusing to speak to me because she is angry with me ) .
es.c: 就在最近，凯拉一直对我不理不睬。

d: n 树；木料；树状物 a very tall plant that has branches and leaves, and lives for many years；v 把赶上树

es.e: As a kid, I loved to climb trees.
es.c: 小时候，我喜欢爬树。

es.e: the trunk of an old oak tree (= the main central part, from which the branches grow )
es.c: 一棵老橡树的树干

d: v 发抖；战栗；焦虑；摇晃 to shake slightly in a way that you cannot control, especially because you are upset or frightened；n 颤抖；战栗；摇晃 Tremble is also a noun

es.e: His lip started to tremble and then he started to cry.
es.c: 他的嘴唇开始颤抖，接着就哭了起来。

es.e: I will never forget the look on the patient's face, the tremble in his hand.
es.c: 我将永远不会忘记那病人脸上的表情和他颤抖的手。

d: n 趋势，倾向；走向 a general tendency in the way a situation is changing or developing；v 趋向，伸向

es.e: The current trend is towards more part-time employment.
es.c: 当前的趋势是雇用更多的兼职人员。

es.e: the general trend towards the centralization of political power
es.c: 政治权力集中化的普遍趋势

es.e: A disturbing trend is that victims of violence are getting younger.
es.c: 一个令人担心的趋势是，暴力行为的受害者越来越年轻。

d: n 试验；审讯；努力；磨炼 a process of testing to find out whether something works effectively and is safe；adj 试验的；审讯的

es.e: a new drug that is undergoing clinical trials
es.c: 正在接受临床试验的一种新药

d: n 三角（形）；三角关系；三角形之物；三人一组 a flat shape with three straight sides and three angles

es.e: a triangle of land
es.c: 一块三角地

d: n 诡计；恶作剧；窍门；花招；骗局；欺诈 something you do in order to deceive someone；v 欺骗；哄骗；装饰；打扮 to deceive someone in order to get something from them or to make them do something；adj 特技的；欺诈的；有决窍的 when a photograph or picture has been c

es.e: Pretending he doesn’t remember is an old trick of his.
es.c: 假装不记得是他的老花招了。

es.e: He didn’t really lose his wallet - that’s just a trick.
es.c: 他并没有真的丢了钱包——这只是一个骗局。

d: v 绊倒；远足；犯错误；轻快地走 to hit something with your foot by accident so that you fall or almost fall；n 旅行；绊倒；差错 a visit to a place that involves a journey, for pleasure or a particular purpose

es.e: He tripped and fell .
es.c: 他绊了一下，摔倒了。

d: n 军队；组；群；多数 soldiers in an organized group；v 群集；成群而行；结队 if a group of people troop somewhere, they walk there together in a way that shows they are tired or bored

es.e: Both countries agreed to withdraw their troops .
es.c: 两国都同意撤军。

es.e: troops stationed in Hawaii
es.c: 夏威夷的驻军

d: n 麻烦；烦恼；故障；动乱 problems or difficulties；v 麻烦；使烦恼；折磨 to say something or ask someone to do something which may use or waste their time or upset them

es.e: Recent stock market losses point to trouble ahead.
es.c: 最近股市的下跌预示着未来将有麻烦。

d: adj 麻烦的；讨厌的；使人苦恼的 causing problems, in an annoying way

es.e: a troublesome child
es.c: 烦人的孩子

es.e: troublesome itching
es.c: 难受的痒

d: n 裤子，长裤 a piece of clothing that covers the lower half of your body, with a separate part fitting over each leg

es.e: His trousers were slightly too short.
es.c: 他的裤子有点短。

es.e: I need a new pair of trousers for work.
es.c: 我需要一条上班穿的新裤子。

d: n 卡车；交易；手推车 a large road vehicle used to carry goods；v 驾驶卡车；以物易物；adj （美）运货汽车的

es.e: a truck driver
es.c: 卡车司机

d: adj 真实的；正确的 If something is true, it is based on facts rather than being invented or imagined, and is accurate and reliable；adv 真实地；准确地；n 真实；准确；v 装准

es.e: Everything I had heard about him was true.
es.c: 我所听到的关于他的一切都是真的。

es.e: He said it was true that a collision had happened.
es.c: 他说碰撞真的发生了一次。

d: adv 真实地，不假；真诚地 used to emphasize that the way you are describing something is really true；n (Truly)人名；(英)特鲁利

es.e: His work is truly original.
es.c: 他的作品确实十分独特。

es.e: Fawcett was a truly remarkable man.
es.c: 福西特是一位真正不同凡响的人。

es.e: a truly great work of medieval literature
es.c: 一部真正伟大的中世纪文学作品

d: n 树干；躯干；象鼻；汽车车尾的行李箱 the thick central woody stem of a tree；vt 把…放入旅行箱内；adj 干线的；躯干的；箱子的

es.e: He left his bicycle leaning against a tree trunk .
es.c: 他把他的自行车斜靠在树干上。

d: n 信任，信赖；责任；托拉斯 a strong belief in the honesty, goodness etc of someone or something；v 信任，信赖；盼望；赊卖给 to believe that someone is honest or will not do anything bad or wrong

es.e: At first there was a lack of trust between them.
es.c: 起初，他们之间缺乏信任。

es.e: an agreement made on the basis of mutual trust
es.c: 在相互信任的基础上达成的一项协议

es.e: You betrayed your father’s trust (= did something bad even though he trusted you ) .
es.c: 你辜负了你父亲对你的信任。

d: n 真理；事实；诚实；实质 the true facts about something, rather than what is untrue, imagined, or guessed

es.e: How do we know you’re telling us the truth?
es.c: 我们怎么知道你告诉我们的是真话？

d: v 试图，努力；试验；审判；考验 to take action in order to do something that you may not be able to do；n 尝试；努力；试验 an attempt to do something

es.e: Let’s have a rest and then we’ll try again.
es.c: 我们休息一下，然后再试。

es.e: I tried everything to lose weight with no success.
es.c: 我试了各种方法减肥，但都没有成功。

es.e: I tried and tried (= kept making an effort ) and eventually I was offered a job.
es.c: 我一次次地尝试，终于有人给了我一份工作。

d: n 管；电子管；隧道；电视机 a round pipe made of metal, glass, rubber etc, especially for liquids or gases to go through；v 使成管状；把…装管；用管输送

es.e: a tube of toothpaste
es.c: 一管牙膏

d: n 星期二 the day between Monday and Wednesday

es.e: I’ll see you Tuesday.
es.c: 星期二见。

d: n 曲调；和谐；心情 a series of musical notes that are played or sung and are nice to listen to；v 调整；使一致；为…调音 to make a musical instrument play at the right  pitch

es.e: That’s a nice tune.
es.c: 那曲调很美。

es.e: She sang some old classics and a few new tunes.
es.c: 她唱了几首经典老歌和一些新曲。

d: n 火鸡；笨蛋；失败之作 a bird that looks like a large chicken and is often eaten at Christmas and at Thanksgiving

es.e: roast turkey
es.c: 烤火鸡

d: v 转动，使旋转；转弯；翻过来；兑换 to move your body so that you are looking in a different direction；n 转弯；变化；(损害或有益于别人的)行为，举动，举止 a sudden or unexpected change that makes a situation develop in a different way

es.e: Ricky turned and walked away.
es.c: 里基转身走了。

es.e: She turned her head in surprise.
es.c: 她惊讶地转过头来。

es.e: Brigitte glared at him, turned on her heel (= turned away suddenly because of anger ) , and stomped out of the room.
es.c: 布丽吉特瞪了他一眼，猛地一转身，噔噔噔地走出了房间。

d: n 转向；旋转；回转；转弯处 If you take a particular turning, you go along a road which leads away from the side of another road；v 旋转（turn的ing形式）

es.e: He must have taken a wrong turning in the dark.
es.c: 他准是在黑暗中拐错弯了。

d: v 辅导；约束；n 导师；家庭教师；助教 someone who gives private lessons to one student or a small group, and is paid directly by them

es.e: He was privately tutored.
es.c: 他是由家庭教师教的。

d: abbr 电视（television）

es.e: Drag up a chair and watch the TV.
es.c: 拖一把椅子坐到前面来看电视。

es.e: He threw his homework aside and watched TV.
es.c: 他把家庭作业抛到一边去看电视了。

es.e: He never switched off his TV, which always stayed on.
es.c: 他从来不关电视机，他的电视机始终开着。

d: adj 第十二的，第十二个的；十二分之一的；n 第十二；月的第十二日

es.e: He poled his twelfth home run in the sixth inning.
es.c: 在第六回合他打出了他的第十二次本垒打。

d: n 十二；十二个 the number 12；num 十二；十二个 the number 12；adj 十二的；十二个的

es.e: He received a twelve-month jail sentence.
es.c: 他获刑12个月。

es.e: Come at twelve (= 12 o’clock ) .
es.c: 12点来。

es.e: Their son Dylan is twelve (= 12 years old ) .
es.c: 他们的儿子迪伦12岁。

d: n 二十分之一；adj 第二十的；二十分之一的；num 第二十

es.e: One twentieth of the total output was exported.
es.c: 产量中有二十分之一出口。

d: n 二十；二十年代 the number 20；num 二十 the number 20；adj 二十的

es.e: a small village twenty miles from Nairobi
es.c: 距内罗毕20英里的一个小村庄

es.e: I’m nearly twenty (= 20 years old ) .
es.c: 我快20岁了。

d: adv 两次；两倍 two times

es.e: He was questioned by police twice yesterday.
es.c: 他昨天被警察审问了两次。

es.e: None of our dinner menus are exactly the same twice over .
es.c: 我们的晚餐菜单从没有完全重样的。

d: v 使成对；n 双胞胎中一人 one of two children born at the same time to the same mother；adj 双胞胎的 used to describe one of two children who are twins

es.e: The twins are now eight months old.
es.c: 这对双胞胎现在已经八个月大了。

d: v 捻；拧；扭伤；编织；使苦恼 to bend or turn something, such as wire, hair, or cloth, into a particular shape；n 扭曲；拧；扭伤 a twisting action or movement

es.e: Her hands began to twist the handles of the bag she carried.
es.c: 她的双手开始拧她拎着的那个包的拎柄。

d: n 两个 in groups of two people or things；adj 两个的；num 二 the number 2

es.e: I’d like you to line up in twos, please.
es.c: 请你们两个一组排好队。

d: n 类型，品种；模范；样式 one member of a group of people or things that have similar features or qualities；v 打字；测定（血等）类型 to write something using a computer or a  typewriter

es.e: Jo’s not really the sporty type.
es.c: 乔可不是那种喜欢运动的人。

d: n 打字机 a machine with keys that you press in order to print letters of the alphabet onto paper

es.e: She tapped out a letter on the typewriter.
es.c: 她用打字机打出了一封信。

es.e: He tapped out an article on the typewriter.
es.c: 他用打字机打出了一篇文章。

es.e: The secretary transcribed those letters on the typewriter.
es.c: 秘书用打字机打出了那些信。

d: n [气象] 台风 a very violent tropical storm

es.e: The typhoon had spent its fury.
es.c: 台风的势头已经减弱了。

es.e: The football match have to stand over next week for the typhoon storm.
es.c: 由于台风风暴，这场足球赛延期到下个星期举行。

d: adj 典型的；特有的；象征性的 having the usual features or qualities of a particular group or thing

es.e: typical British weather
es.c: 典型的英国天气

es.e: This advertisement is a typical example of their marketing strategy.
es.c: 这则广告是他们营销策略的一个典型例子。

d: n 打字员，打字者 a secretary whose main job is to  type  letters

es.e: I’m a slow typist.
es.c: 我打字很慢。

d: vt 装轮胎于；n [橡胶] 轮胎；轮箍 a thick rubber ring that fits around the wheel of a car, bicycle etc

es.e: He saw a dagger sticking in his car's tyre.
es.c: 他看到一把匕首插在他汽车的轮胎上。

d: adj 丑陋的；邪恶的；令人厌恶的 extremely unattractive and unpleasant to look at

es.e: a very ugly man
es.c: 非常丑陋的男子

es.e: the ugliest building in town
es.c: 城里最难看的建筑

es.e: Nick’s dog is as ugly as sin (= very ugly ).
es.c: 尼克的狗难看得要命。

d: abbr 联合王国（United Kingdom）；n 英国

es.e: But we have the same problem in UK.
es.c: 而在我们英国，也有同样的问题。

es.e: What does that mean for those at the very bottom in the UK?
es.c: 对那些在英国处于社会底层的人来说这意味着什么呢？

d: n 雨伞；保护伞；庇护；伞形结构 an object that you use to protect yourself against rain or hot sun. It consists of a circular folding frame covered in cloth.

es.e: It started to rain, so Tricia stopped to put up her umbrella.
es.c: 开始下雨了，所以特里西娅停下来撑起雨伞。

es.e: I spent the day on the beach, lying under a beach umbrella, reading.
es.c: 那天我就在海滩上度过，躺在海滩遮阳伞下面看书。

d: abbr 联合国（United Nations）；硝酸铀铣（Uranyl Nitrate）
adj 不会的，不能的；[劳经] 无能力的；不能胜任的 not able to do something

es.e: The military may feel unable to hand over power to a civilian president next year.
es.c: 军方可能觉得无法在明年把政权移交给一位民选总统。

d: adj 难以忍受的；承受不住的 too unpleasant, painful, or annoying to deal with

es.e: The pain was almost unbearable.
es.c: 那疼痛几乎难以忍受。

es.e: He was making life unbearable for his parents.
es.c: 他把父母的生活弄得不堪忍受。

d: adj 无常的；含糊的；靠不住的；迟疑不决的 feeling doubt about something

es.e: My whole future now seemed uncertain.
es.c: 现在我的前途似乎是个未知数。

d: n 叔叔；伯父；伯伯；舅父；姨丈；姑父 the brother of your mother or father, or the husband of your aunt

es.e: I went to stay with my uncle and aunt for a few days.
es.c: 我去和叔叔婶婶住了几天。

es.e: Uncle Philip
es.c: 菲利普叔叔

es.e: I was very excited about becoming an uncle(= your sister or your brother’s wife has a child ).
es.c: 要做舅舅了，我很激动。

d: adj 不舒服的；不安的 not feeling physically comfortable, or not making you feel comfortable

es.e: This sofa is so uncomfortable.
es.c: 这张沙发太不舒服了。

d: adj 无条件的；绝对的；无限制的 not limited by or depending on any conditions

es.e: the unconditional release of all political prisoners
es.c: 所有政治犯的无条件释放

es.e: unconditional surrender
es.c: 无条件投降

d: adj 无意识的；失去知觉的；不省人事的；未发觉的 unable to see, move, feel etc in the normal way because you are not conscious

es.e: She was found alive but unconscious.
es.c: 她被找到时还活着，但已不省人事。

d: prep 低于，少于；在之下 less than a particular number, amount, age, or price；adv 在下面；在下方 Under is also an adverb；adj 下面的；从属的

es.e: These toys are not suitable for children under five.
es.c: 这些玩具不适合五岁以下的儿童玩。

es.e: Most of the events listed cost under £60.
es.c: 所列活动项目的花费大多低于 60 英镑。

es.e: I spend just under four hours a day seeing customers.
es.c: 我一天接待客户所花的时间将近四小时。

d: adv 在地下；秘密地 under the earth’s surface；adj 地下的；秘密的；先锋派的 below the surface of the earth；n 地下；地铁；地道；地下组织；秘密活动；先锋派团体 a railway system under the ground

es.e: This animal spends most of its life underground.
es.c: 这种动物一生中的大部分时间都待在地下。

es.e: nuclear waste buried deep underground
es.c: 深埋在地下的核废物

d: v 强调；在…下面划线；预告 to draw a line under a word to show that it is important；n 下划线；下期节目预告

es.e: This tragic incident underlines the need for immediate action.
es.c: 这一悲剧事件突显了立即采取行动的必要性。

d: v 理解；懂；获悉；推断；省略 to know the meaning of what someone is telling you, or the language that they speak

es.e: She doesn’t understand English.
es.c: 她不懂英语。

es.e: I’m sorry, I don’t understand. Can yon explain that again?
es.c: 对不起，我不明白。你能再解释一遍吗？

es.e: The woman had a strong accent, and I couldn’t understand what she was saying.
es.c: 那女人口音很重，我听不懂她在说些什么。

d: n 谅解，理解；理解力；协议 an unofficial or informal agreement；adj 了解的；聪明的；有理解力的 If you are understanding toward someone, you are kind and forgiving；v 理解；明白（understand的ing形式）

es.e: We had an understanding that Jean-Claude should never be mentioned.
es.c: 我们有一个共识，永远不提让－克洛德。

es.e: Her boss, who was very understanding, gave her time off.
es.c: 她的老板很体谅她，给她放了假。

d: v 承担，保证；从事；同意；试图 to accept that you are responsible for a piece of work, and start to do it

es.e: He undertook to pay the money back in six months.
es.c: 他保证在六个月之内还钱。

d: n 内衣物 clothes that you wear next to your body under your other clothes

es.e: You just need to take a change of underwear.
es.c: 你只需带一套换洗的内衣。

d: adj 专心的；专一的；未分开的；完整的 complete；v 未分开（undivide的过去式和过去分词）

es.e: I’ll give the matter my undivided attention.
es.c: 我会全力关注此事。

d: v 取消；解开；破坏；扰乱 to open something that is tied, fastened or wrapped

es.e: The screws can be undone by hand.
es.c: 这些螺丝可以用手拧开。

es.e: I undid the package carefully.
es.c: 我小心地打开包裹。

d: n 失业；失业率；失业人数 the number of people in a particular country or area who cannot get a job

es.e: a town where there is high unemployment
es.c: 高失业率城镇

d: adj 不公平的，不公正的 not right or fair, especially because not everyone has an equal opportunity

es.e: an unfair advantage
es.c: 不公平的优势

es.e: laws aimed at preventing unfair competition
es.c: 旨在防止不公平竞争的法令

es.e: Many employers have recognized that age discrimination is unfair.
es.c: 许多雇主已经认识到年龄歧视是不公平的。

d: adj 不适宜的；不合格的；不健康的 not in a good physical condition；v 使不合格；使不相宜；使不胜任

es.e: She never gets any exercise – she must be really unfit.
es.c: 她从不锻炼——身体一定很不好。

d: v 打开；呈现 if a story unfolds, or if someone unfolds it, it is told

es.e: As the story unfolds, we learn more about Max’s childhood.
es.c: 随着故事的展开，我们对马克斯的童年有了更多的了解。

d: adj 不幸的；令人遗憾的；不成功的 someone who is unfortunate has something bad happen to them

es.e: When we entered the room, the teacher was yelling at some unfortunate student.
es.c: 我们进教室的时候，老师正在对着一个倒霉的学生吼叫。

d: adv 不幸地 used when you are mentioning a fact that you wish was not true

es.e: Unfortunately, you were out when we called.
es.c: 很遗憾，我们来的时候你出去了。

d: adj 不快乐的；不幸福的；不适当的 not happy

es.e: If you’re so unhappy, why don’t you change jobs?
es.c: 你要是那么不开心，为什么不换个工作呢？

es.e: Leslie had an unhappy childhood.
es.c: 莱斯利的童年很不幸。

es.e: an unhappy marriage
es.c: 不幸的婚姻

d: adj 不健康的；危险的；有害身心健康的 likely to make you ill

es.e: unhealthy living conditions
es.c: 不利于健康的生活环境

d: adj 统一的；一致的；相同的；均衡的；始终如一的 being the same in all its parts or among all its members；n 制服 a particular type of clothing worn by all the members of a group or organization such as the police, the army etc；v 使穿制服；使成一样

es.e: Grade A eggs must be of uniform size.
es.c: A 级鸡蛋必须大小相同。

d: adj 不重要的；琐碎的 not important

es.e: unimportant details
es.c: 无关紧要的细枝末节

d: n 联盟，协会；工会；联合 an organization formed by workers to protect their rights

es.e: Are you planning to join the union?
es.c: 你打算加入工会吗？

es.e: {"COLLOINEXA":["union members"]}
es.c: 工会会员

d: adj 独特的，稀罕的；[数] 唯一的，独一无二的 being the only one of its kind；n 独一无二的人或物

es.e: Each person’s fingerprints are unique.
es.c: 每个人的指纹都是独一无二的。

d: n 单位，单元；装置；[军] 部队；部件 an amount of something used as a standard of measurement

es.e: The man is in the hospital’s intensive care unit.
es.c: 那名男子在医院的重症监护室。

d: v 使…混合；使…联合；使…团结 if different people or organizations unite, or if something unites them, they join together in order to achieve something

es.e: Our goal is to unite the opposition parties and defeat the President.
es.c: 我们的目标是联合各反对党挫败总统。

d: adj 普遍的；通用的；宇宙的；全世界的；全体的 involving everyone in the world or in a particular group；n 一般概念；普通性

es.e: free universal healthcare
es.c: 免费的全民保健制度

es.e: These stories have universal appeal.
es.c: 这些故事人人都喜欢。

es.e: a topic of universal interest
es.c: 人们普遍感兴趣的一个话题

d: n 宇宙；世界；领域 all space, including all the stars and planets

es.e: Einstein's equations showed the universe to be expanding.
es.c: 爱因斯坦的方程式表明宇宙正在扩大。

d: n 大学；综合性大学；大学校舍 an educational institution at the highest level, where you study for a degree
adj 未知的；陌生的，默默无闻的 not known about；n 未知数；未知的事物，默默无闻的人 things that you do not know or understand

es.e: The murderer’s identity remains unknown.
es.c: 杀人凶手身份仍然不明。

es.e: For some unknown reason, Mark quit his job and moved to Greece.
es.c: 不知何故，马克辞掉工作移居希腊了。

es.e: a voyage through unknown territory
es.c: 穿越未知海域的航行

d: conj 除非，如果不 used to say that something will happen or be true if something else does not happen or is not true；prep 除…之外

es.e: Unless some extra money is found, the theatre will close.
es.c: 要是不能找到更多资金，剧院将要关闭。

es.e: I think you should complain – unless, of course, you are happy with the way things are.
es.c: 我觉得你应该发发牢骚——当然，除非你对现状很满意。

es.e: He won’t go to sleep unless you tell him a story.
es.c: 要是你不给他讲故事他就不睡觉。

d: adj 不同的，不相似的 not alike；prep 和…不同，不像 completely different from a particular person or thing

es.e: Tammy was unlike any other woman I have ever known.
es.c: 塔米和我认识的其他女人都不一样。

d: adj [法] 未婚的；单身的；独身的 not married；v 离婚（unmarry的过去分词）

es.e: unmarried mothers
es.c: 未婚母亲

d: adj 讨厌的；使人不愉快的 not pleasant or enjoyable

es.e: an unpleasant experience
es.c: 不愉快的经历

es.e: an extremely unpleasant smell
es.c: 极其难闻的味道

es.e: an unpleasant surprise
es.c: 令人不快的意外

d: n 不安；动荡的局面；不安的状态

es.e: There is growing unrest throughout the country.
es.c: 全国各地日益动荡不安。

d: adj 不安全的；危险的；不安稳的 dangerous or likely to cause harm

es.e: The building is unsafe.
es.c: 那栋大楼不安全。

es.e: water that’s unsafe to drink
es.c: 不能安全饮用的水

d: adj 不成功的；失败的 not having a successful result or not achieving what you wanted to achieve

es.e: an unsuccessful attempt to climb Qomolangma
es.c: 攀登珠穆朗玛峰的失败尝试

d: conj 在…以前；直到…时；prep 在…以前；到…为止 if something happens until a particular time, it continues and then stops at that time

es.e: The ticket is valid until March.
es.c: 这张票的有效期一直到 3 月份。

es.e: He waited until she had finished speaking.
es.c: 他一直等到她讲完。

es.e: Until recently, Anna worked as a teacher in Japan.
es.c: 直到最近，安娜一直在日本当老师。

d: adj 不真实的；不合标准的；不忠实的；不正当的 not based on facts that are correct

es.e: allegations that are totally untrue
es.c: 完全不能成立的指控

es.e: It’s untrue to say that the situation has not changed.
es.c: 说情况没有改变，这是没有根据的。

d: adj 不寻常的；与众不同的；不平常的 different from what is usual or normal

es.e: an unusual feature
es.c: 不寻常的特点

es.e: unusual circumstances
es.c: 异常状况

es.e: It’s unusual for Dave to be late.
es.c: 戴夫迟到是很少见的。

d: adj 不愿意的；不情愿的；勉强的 not wanting to do something and refusing to do it

es.e: an unwilling helper
es.c: 勉强来帮忙的人

d: adv 起来；上涨；向上 towards a higher place or position；prep 在…之上；向…的较高处；adj 涨的；起床的；向上的 If you are up, you are not in bed；n 上升；繁荣

es.e: We walked slowly up the hill.
es.c: 我们慢慢地爬上山。

es.e: She picked her jacket up off the floor.
es.c: 她从地板上捡起外套。

es.e: paths leading up into the mountains
es.c: 通往山里的小径

d: adj 上面的，上部的；较高的 in a higher position than something else；n (Upper)人名；(英)厄珀

es.e: the upper lip
es.c: 上唇

d: v 使心烦；颠覆；扰乱 to make someone feel unhappy or worried；adj 心烦的；混乱的；弄翻的 unhappy and worried because something unpleasant or disappointing has happened；n 混乱；翻倒；颠覆 Upset is also a noun

es.e: Don’t do anything that would upset him.
es.c: 别做惹他生气的事情。

es.e: Markets are very sensitive to any upsets in the Japanese economic machine.
es.c: 市场对日本经济机器里的任何混乱都是非常敏感的。

d: adv 在楼上，向楼上；上楼；往楼上 towards or on an upper floor in a building；adj 楼上的 An upstairs room or object is situated on a floor of a building that is higher than the ground floor；n 楼上 one or all of the upper floors in a building

es.e: I went upstairs and had a shower.
es.c: 我上楼冲了个澡。

es.e: She’s upstairs in bed feeling ill.
es.c: 她身体不舒服，在楼上躺着。

es.e: Marsani moved into the upstairs apartment.
es.c: 玛萨妮搬进了楼上的公寓。

d: adj 向上的；上升的 increasing to a higher level；adv 向上 If someone moves or looks upward, they move or look up towards a higher place

es.e: upward pressure on bank interest rates
es.c: 针对银行利率的越来越大的压力

es.e: They climbed upward along the steep cliffs surrounding the village.
es.c: 他们沿着环绕村庄的陡峭悬崖向上爬。

es.e: 'There,' said Jack, pointing upwards.
es.c: “那儿，”杰克往上指着说。

d: adj 城市的；住在都市的 relating to towns and cities；n (Urban)人名；(西)乌尔万；(斯洛伐)乌尔班；(德、俄、罗、匈、塞、波、捷、瑞典、意)乌尔班；(英)厄本；(法)于尔邦

es.e: unemployment in urban areas
es.c: 城市地区的失业状况

es.e: the deprived sections of the urban population
es.c: 城市人口中的贫困群体

d: v 力劝，催促；驱策，推进 formal to make someone or something move by shouting, pushing them etc；n 强烈的欲望，迫切要求；推动力 a strong wish or need

es.e: The charity urged quick action.
es.c: 慈善机构敦促迅速采取行动。

d: adj 紧急的；急迫的 very important and needing to be dealt with immediately

es.e: He was in urgent need of medical attention.
es.c: 他急需治疗。

es.e: The report called for urgent action to reduce lead in petrol.
es.c: 报告呼吁迅速采取行动，减少汽油中的铅含量。

es.e: an urgent message
es.c: 一封急报

d: n 使用；用途；发挥 the action or fact of using something；v 利用；耗费 to take an amount of something from a supply of food, gas, money etc

es.e: an exit for use in emergencies
es.c: 紧急出口

d: adj 习惯的；二手的，使用过的；v 用（use的过去式）；（used to）过去常做

es.e: I do the dishes every day, so I’m used to it.
es.c: 我每天洗盘子，所以习惯了。

d: adj 有用的，有益的；有帮助的 helping you to do or get what you want

es.e: useful information
es.c: 有用的信息

es.e: A little Japanese can be really useful.
es.c: 懂一点日语非常有用。

es.e: Can you come and make yourself useful(= help people to do something )?
es.c: 你能不能过来帮点忙？

d: adj 无用的；无效的

es.e: The editor killed a few useless lines.
es.c: 编辑删掉了几行无用的文字。

es.e: Please cancel the words which are useless.
es.c: 请把无用的词划掉。

es.e: They wrote his suggestion off as a useless idea.
es.c: 他们把他的建议看做是无用的想法。

d: n 用户 someone or something that uses a product, service etc

es.e: road users
es.c: 道路使用者

es.e: a computer user
es.c: 电脑用户

es.e: library users
es.c: 图书馆的读者

d: adj 通常的，惯例的；平常的 happening, done, or existing most of the time or in most situations

es.e: Make a cheese sauce in the usual way.
es.c: 按通常的做法做奶酪酱。

es.e: I’ll meet you at the usual time.
es.c: 我在老时间和你碰头。

es.e: She ate twice as much as usual.
es.c: 她吃了平时食量两倍的东西。

d: adv 通常，经常 used to talk about what happens on most occasions or in most situations

es.e: Women usually live longer than men.
es.c: 女人通常比男人长寿。

es.e: Usually I wear black, grey, or brown.
es.c: 通常我都穿黑色、灰色或者棕色的衣服。

es.e: The drive usually takes 15 or 20 minutes.
es.c: 这段车程通常需要 15 或 20 分钟。

d: adj 空虚的；空的；空缺的；空闲的；茫然的 a vacant seat, building, room or piece of land is empty and available for someone to use；n (Vacant)人名；(法)瓦康

es.e: Only a few apartments were still vacant.
es.c: 只有几套公寓仍然空着。

es.e: There was only a vacant lot (= empty unused area of land in a city ) where her house used to be.
es.c: 她以前房子所在的地方只剩下一块空地了。

d: n 假期；（房屋）搬出 a holiday, or time spent not working；v 休假，度假 to go somewhere for a holiday

es.e: We’re planning a vacation in Europe.
es.c: 我们正计划去欧洲度假。

es.e: We’re planning to go on vacation soon.
es.c: 我们在计划近期去度假。

d: adj 模糊的；含糊的；不明确的；暧昧的 unclear because someone does not give enough detailed information or does not say exactly what they mean；n (Vague)人名；(法)瓦格；(英)韦格

es.e: The governor gave only a vague outline of his tax plan.
es.c: 州长只是含糊地大致说了一下他的税务计划。

d: adj 徒劳的；自负的；无结果的；无用的 someone who is vain is too proud of their good looks, abilities, or position – used to show disapproval

es.e: Men can be just as vain as women.
es.c: 男人有时会和女人一样虚荣。

d: adj 有效的；有根据的；合法的；正当的 a valid ticket, document, or agreement is legally or officially acceptable

es.e: a valid credit card
es.c: 有效信用卡

es.e: Your return ticket is valid for three months.
es.c: 你的往返票有效期为三个月。

d: n 山谷；流域；溪谷 an area of lower land between two lines of hills or mountains, usually with a river flowing through it

es.e: the San Fernando Valley
es.c: 圣费尔南多山谷

d: adj 有价值的；贵重的；可估价的 worth a lot of money；n 贵重物品

es.e: a valuable painting
es.c: 一幅名贵的画

es.e: Their most valuable belongings were locked in a safe in the bedroom.
es.c: 他们最值钱的财物锁在卧室保险箱里。

d: n 值；价值；价格；重要性；确切涵义 the amount of money that something is worth；v 评价；重视；估价 to think that someone or something is important

es.e: the nutritional value of cereal
es.c: 谷类食物的营养价值

d: n 香子兰，香草 a substance used to give a special taste to ice cream, cakes etc, made from the beans of a tropical plant；adj 香草味的 having the taste of vanilla

es.e: I added a dollop of vanilla ice cream to the pie.
es.c: 我在馅饼中加了一块香草冰淇淋。

d: n 多样；种类；杂耍；变化，多样化 the differences within a group, set of actions etc that make it interesting

es.e: I really like the variety the store has to offer.
es.c: 我很喜欢这家商店商品的丰富多样。

d: adj 各种各样的；多方面的 if there are various things, there are several different types of that thing

es.e: The jacket is available in various colours.
es.c: 这种夹克有好多种颜色可选。

es.e: There are various ways to answer your question.
es.c: 有多种方法可以回答你的问题。

es.e: He decided to leave school for various reasons.
es.c: 出于种种原因，他决定辍学。

d: n 瓶；花瓶 a container used to put flowers in or for decoration

es.e: ...a vase of red roses.
es.c: …一个插着红玫瑰的花瓶。

d: adj 广阔的；巨大的；大量的；巨额的 extremely large；n 浩瀚；广阔无垠的空间

es.e: The refugees come across the border in vast numbers.
es.c: 大量难民涌过边境。

es.e: In the past five years, there has been a vast improvement in graduation rates.
es.c: 过去的五年内，毕业率大幅度提高。

d: n 小牛（等于vealer）；小牛肉 the meat of a calf(= a young cow )

es.e: ...a veal cutlet.
es.c: …一块小牛排。

d: n 蔬菜；植物；植物人 a plant that is eaten raw or cooked, such as a cabbage, a carrot, or peas；adj 蔬菜的；植物的 relating to plants in general, rather than animals or things that are not living

es.e: fresh fruit and vegetables
es.c: 新鲜果蔬

es.e: organic methods of growing vegetables
es.c: 蔬菜的有机种植方法

es.e: vegetable soup
es.c: 蔬菜汤

d: n [车辆] 车辆；工具；交通工具；运载工具；传播媒介；媒介物 a machine with an engine that is used to take people or things from one place to another, such as a car, bus, or truck

es.e: a description of the stolen vehicle
es.c: 对被盗车辆的描述

es.e: Have you locked your vehicle?
es.c: 你锁车了吗？

d: n 版本；译文；倒转术 a copy of something that has been changed so that it is slightly different

es.e: the human version of mad cow disease
es.c: 疯牛病的人类变体

d: adj 垂直的，直立的；[解剖] 头顶的，顶点的 pointing up in a line that forms an angle of 90˚ with a flat surface；n 垂直线，垂直面 the direction of something that is vertical

es.e: a vertical line
es.c: 垂直线

es.e: the vertical axis of a graph
es.c: 图的纵轴

es.e: vertical window blinds
es.c: 垂直百叶窗

d: adj 恰好是，正是；甚至；十足的；特有的 used to emphasize that you are talking exactly about one particular thing or person；adv 非常，很；完全 used to emphasize an adjective, adverb, or phrase；n (Very)人名；(英)维里

es.e: He died in this very room.
es.c: 他就是在这个房间里去世的。

es.e: I’ll start at the very beginning.
es.c: 我要从头开始。

es.e: Those were his very words.
es.c: 那就是他的原话。

d: n 背心；汗衫 a piece of underwear without sleeves that you wear on the top half of your body；v 授予；使穿衣

es.e: a bulletproof vest
es.c: 防弹背心

d: prep 渠道，通过；经由 travelling through a place on the way to another place

es.e: We flew to Athens via Paris.
es.c: 我们经由巴黎飞往雅典。

d: n 恶习；缺点；[机] 老虎钳；卖淫 a bad habit；prep 代替；vt 钳住 to grip (something) with or as if with a vice；adj 副的；代替的 serving in the place of or as a deputy for

es.e: Smoking is my only vice.
es.c: 吸烟是我唯一的恶习。

d: n 受害人；牺牲品；牺牲者 someone who has been attacked, robbed, or murdered

es.e: The victim received head injuries from which she died a week later.
es.c: 受害人头部受伤，一周后死亡。

es.e: a credit card fraud ring that stole millions of dollars from unsuspecting victims
es.c: 从毫无戒心的受害者手中盗取数百万美元的信用卡诈骗团伙

d: n 胜利；成功；克服 a situation in which you win a battle, game, election, or dispute

es.e: Union leaders are heading for victory in their battle over workplace rights.
es.c: 工会领袖们在争取工作场所权利的斗争中正迈向胜利。

d: n [电子] 视频；录像，录像机；电视 a copy of a film or television programme, or a series of events, recorded on videotape；adj 视频的；录像的；电视的 relating to or used in the process of recording and showing pictures on television；v 录制 to record

es.e: Let’s stay at home and watch a video.
es.c: 我们待在家里看录像吧。

es.e: Rewind the video right to the beginning.
es.c: 把录像倒退到开头部分。

es.e: The school will be making a video of the play.
es.c: 学校将把这出戏拍摄成录像。

d: n 电视电话 a type of telephone that allows you to see the person you are talking to on a screen

es.e: Perhaps as soon as 2007, these assistants will hover over an astronaut's shoulder, serving as an all-in-one PDA, videophone, and air monitor.
es.c: 最快到2007年，这类助理型机器人就会出现在宇航员的箭头，它能用做PDA、可视电话并监测空气。

d: n 观察；视野；意见；风景 what you think or believe about something；v 观察；考虑；查看 to watch a television programme, film etc

es.e: In my view, the country needs a change of government.
es.c: 依我看，这个国家需要换个政府。

d: n 观察者；观看者；观众；[仪] 指示器 someone who watches television

es.e: The new series has gone down well with viewers.
es.c: 这个新的电视系列片很受观众欢迎。

d: n 村庄；村民；（动物的）群落 a very small town in the countryside

es.e: a little fishing village
es.c: 一座小渔村

d: n 乡村居民，村民 someone who lives in a village

es.e: Soon the villagers couldn't afford to buy food for themselves.
es.c: 很快村民们就买不起吃的东西了。

d: n 醋 a sour-tasting liquid made from malt or wine that is used to improve the taste of food or to preserve it

es.e: The  sugared  vinegar is  refined from the sugarcane and  pine.
es.c: 加糖的醋是从甘蔗和松木中精炼出来的.

es.e: To make the red-wine vinaigrette, whisk together the oil, vinegar and mustard in a medium bowl until well combined.
es.c: 制作红酒醋油沙司，将油、醋和芥末放在一个中等大小的碗里一起搅拌，直到混合均匀。

es.e: In cooking, vinegar can be used alone or to add flavor without calories to our food, but what will it do if we use it on our hair?
es.c: 在烹饪中，醋可以单独食用，也可以用作食物调味料不附加任何卡路里，但如果我们把它涂抹到头发上呢？

d: v 违反；侵犯，妨碍；亵渎 to disobey or do something against an official agreement, law, principle etc

es.e: 34 protesters were arrested for violating criminal law.
es.c: 34名抗议者因违反刑法而被逮捕。

es.e: regimes that violate human rights
es.c: 侵犯人权的政权

d: n 暴力；侵犯；激烈；歪曲 behaviour that is intended to hurt other people physically

es.e: There is too much sex and violence on TV these days.
es.c: 如今电视上性爱和暴力场面太多。

d: adj 暴力的；猛烈的 involving actions that are intended to injure or kill people, by hitting them, shooting them etc

es.e: the increase in violent crime
es.c: 暴力犯罪的增多

es.e: violent clashes between the police and demonstrators
es.c: 警方与示威者之间发生的暴力冲突

es.e: 31 people have been injured in violent incidents throughout the day.
es.c: 今天一天有31人在暴力事件中受伤。

d: n 小提琴；小提琴手 a small wooden musical instrument that you hold under your chin and play by pulling a bow(= special stick ) across the strings
n 小提琴演奏者，小提琴家 someone who plays the violin

es.e: Rose's father was a talented violinist.
es.c: 罗斯的父亲是一位天才的小提琴手。

d: n 美德；优点；贞操；功效 moral goodness of character and behaviour

es.e: Women have often been used as symbols of virtue.
es.c: 女性常被用作美德的象征。

d: n [病毒] 病毒；恶毒；毒害 a very small living thing that causes infectious illnesses

es.e: children infected with the Aids virus
es.c: 感染艾滋病病毒的儿童

es.e: a virus infection
es.c: 病毒感染

d: n 签证 an official mark put on your passport that gives you permission to temporarily enter or leave a foreign country；v 签发签证

es.e: I was still in New York, trying to get a visa to visit Russia.
es.c: 我仍在纽约，正在办理去俄罗斯的签证。

d: n 访问；参观；逗留 an occasion when someone goes to spend time in a place or goes to see a person；v 访问；参观；视察 to go and spend time in a place or with someone, especially for pleasure or interest

es.e: We’re just here on a short visit.
es.c: 我们只在这儿作短暂逗留。

es.e: Why don’t you come for a visit this summer?
es.c: 你们何不今年夏天来这里做客呢？

es.e: I decided to pay him a visit at his office.
es.c: 我决定去他的办公室拜访他。

d: n 访问者，参观者；视察者；候鸟 someone who comes to visit a place or a person

es.e: Times Square attracts more than 30 million visitors annually.
es.c: 时代广场每年吸引三千多万游客。

d: adj 视觉的，视力的；栩栩如生的 relating to seeing

es.e: Artists translate their ideas into visual images.
es.c: 画家把自己的思想转换成视觉画面。

es.e: The tall tower adds to the visual impact of the building.
es.c: 高高的塔楼增强了这幢大楼的视觉效果。

d: adj 至关重要的；生死攸关的；有活力的 full of energy in a way that is exciting and attractive；n (Vital)人名；(法、德、意、俄、葡)维塔尔；(西)比塔尔

es.e: Rodgers and Hart’s music sounds as fresh and vital as the day it was written.
es.c: 罗杰斯与哈特的音乐现在听来还有刚写成时的那份清新和活力。

d: adj 生动的；鲜明的；鲜艳的 vivid memories, dreams, descriptions etc are so clear that they seem real

es.e: I’ve got vivid memories of that summer.
es.c: 我对那年夏天记忆犹新。

es.e: He had a vivid picture of her in his mind.
es.c: 他的脑海中清晰地留着她的形象。

d: n 词汇；词表；词汇量 all the words that someone knows or uses

es.e: Teachers were impressed by his vocabulary.
es.c: 他的词汇量给老师们留下了深刻的印象。

d: n 声音；嗓音；发言权；愿望 the sounds that you make when you speak, or the ability to make these sounds；v 表达；吐露 to tell people your opinions or feelings about a particular subject

es.e: He recognized her voice instantly.
es.c: 他立刻听出了她的声音。

es.e: I could hear angry voices.
es.c: 我听到了愤怒的声音。

d: n 火山 a mountain with a large hole at the top, through which lava(= very hot liquid rock ) is sometimes forced out

es.e: Pompeii was destroyed when the volcano erupted in 79 AD.
es.c: 庞贝城于公元79年在火山爆发中毁灭。

d: n 排球 a game in which two teams use their hands to hit a ball over a high net

es.e: I like playing beach volleyball.
es.c: 我喜欢打沙滩排球。

es.e: Every sunday, they played volleyball in the park.
es.c: 每个周日他们在公园打排球。

es.e: Balloon, baseball, basketball, football and volleyball all dance  ballet on the  volcano.
es.c: 气球、棒球、篮球、足球和排球都在火山上跳芭蕾舞。

d: adj 自愿的；志愿的；自发的；故意的 done willingly and without being forced；n 志愿者；自愿行动

es.e: Workers are being encouraged to take voluntary redundancy.
es.c: 工人被鼓励主动离职。

d: n 志愿者；志愿兵 someone who does a job willingly without being paid；adj 志愿的；v 自愿 to offer to do something without expecting any reward, often something that other people do not want to do

es.e: Most of the relief work was done by volunteers.
es.c: 大部分救援工作都由志愿人员完成。

d: n 投票，选举；选票；得票数 an act of voting in an elec­tion or meeting, or the choice that you make when you vote；v 提议，使投票；投票决定；公认 to show which person or party you want, or whether you support a plan, by marking a piece of paper, r

es.e: A vote for us is not a wasted vote.
es.c: 投我们的票是不会白投的。

es.e: The proposal was rejected by 19 votes to 7.
es.c: 那项提议以19票对7票被否决。

es.e: policies designed to win votes in the South
es.c: 旨在赢取南方选票的各项政策

d: n 航行；航程；旅行记 a long journey in a ship or spacecraft；v 航行；航海 to travel to a place, especially by ship

es.e: The voyage from England to India used to take six months.
es.c: 过去从英格兰到印度要航行六个月。

es.e: the Titanic’s maiden voyage
es.c: “泰坦尼克”号的首航

es.e: I don’t want to make the voyage single-handed.
es.c: 我不想独自航行。

d: v 摇摆；摇动；饶舌 if a dog wags its tail, or if its tail wags, the dog moves its tail many times from one side to the other；n 摇摆；爱说笑打趣的人 someone who says or does something clever and amusing

es.e: ‘You naughty girl!’ Mom said, wagging her finger at me.
es.c: “你这个调皮的丫头！”妈妈对我摇了摇手指说道。

d: v 进行；发动；从事 to be involved in a war against someone, or a fight against something；n 工资；代价；报偿 money you earn that is paid according to the number of hours, days, or weeks that you work

es.e: The government, along with the three factions that had been waging a civil war, signed a peace agreement.
es.c: 政府和发动了内战的3方一起签订了1份和平协议。

d: n 腰，腰部 the narrow part in the middle of the human body

es.e: The skirt was too big around the waist.
es.c: 那条裙子腰围太大。

d: v 等候；推迟；延缓 to stay somewhere or not do something until something else happens, someone arrives etc；n 等待；等候 a period of time in which you wait for something to happen, someone to arrive etc

es.e: Hurry up! Everyone’s waiting.
es.c: 快点！大家在等着呢。

es.e: Would you mind waiting outside?
es.c: 你在外面等好吗？

es.e: We’ve been waiting ages.
es.c: 我们已经等了很长时间了。

d: n 服务员，侍者 a man who serves food and drink at the tables in a restaurant
n 女服务员；女侍者 a woman who serves food and drink at the tables in a restaurant；v 做女服务生
v 醒来；唤醒；警觉 to stop sleeping, or to make someone stop sleeping；n 尾迹；守夜；守丧 the time before or after a funeral when friends and relatives meet to remember the dead person

es.e: When she woke, the sun was streaming through the windows.
es.c: 她醒来时，阳光泻入窗内。

es.e: Try not to wake the baby.
es.c: 尽量不要吵醒宝宝。

d: n 步行，走；散步 a journey that you make by walking, especially for exercise or enjoyment；v 散步；走过 When you walk, you move forward by putting one foot in front of the other in a regular way

es.e: It’s a long walk. Maybe we should get the bus.
es.c: 走着去很远，或许我们应该乘公共汽车。

es.e: Rosanna and Forbes walked in silence.
es.c: 罗莎娜与福布斯默默地走着。

es.e: We walked into the foyer.
es.c: 我们走进前厅。

d: n 随身听（商标名称） A Walkman is a small cassette player with headphones which people carry around so that they can listen to music, for example, while they are travelling

es.e: I like music, and I like this walkman, too.
es.c: 我喜欢音乐，我也喜欢这个随身听。

d: n 墙壁，围墙；似墙之物 an upright flat structure made of stone or brick, that divides one area from another or surrounds an area；v 用墙围住，围以墙；adj 墙壁的

es.e: the Great Wall of China
es.c: 中国的长城

es.e: We climbed over the wall into the orchard.
es.c: 我们翻墙进了果园。

d: n 钱包，皮夹 a small flat case, often made of leather, that you carry in your pocket, for holding paper money, bank cards etc

es.e: He took a credit card out of his wallet.
es.c: 他从钱包里拿出一张信用卡。

d: n 胡桃；胡桃木 a nut that you can eat, shaped like a human brain；adj 胡桃科植物的

es.e: coffee and walnut cake
es.c: 咖啡核桃蛋糕

d: v 徘徊；漫步；迷路；离题 to walk slowly across or around an area, usually without a clear direction or purpose；n (Wander)人名；(英)万德(女子教名)

es.e: She wandered aimlessly about the house.
es.c: 她漫无目的地在房子里走来走去。

es.e: Ana wandered off to get a drink.
es.c: 安娜溜达着去弄了一杯喝的。

es.e: He was found wandering the streets of New York.
es.c: 有人看到他在纽约街头游荡。

d: v 需要；希望；应该；缺少 to have a desire for something；n 需要；缺乏；贫困；必需品 used to say that you do not have or cannot find what you need in a particular situation

es.e: I really want a drink.
es.c: 我很想喝一杯。

es.e: What do you want for your birthday?
es.c: 你生日想要什么礼物？

es.e: She’d always wanted to go to Thailand.
es.c: 她一直想去泰国。

d: n 战争，斗争；军事，战术；冲突，对抗，竞争 when there is fighting between two or more countries or between opposing groups within a country, involving large numbers of soldiers and weapons；v 打仗，作战；对抗

es.e: the Vietnam War
es.c: 越南战争

es.e: He served as a pilot during the war.
es.c: 他在战时担任飞行员。

d: n 病房；保卫；监视 a large room in a hospital where people who need medical treatment stay；v 避开；保卫；守护

es.e: the other patients in the ward
es.c: 病房里的其他病人

d: n 仓库；货栈；大商店 a large building for storing large quantities of goods；v 储入仓库；以他人名义购进（股票）
adj 温暖的；热情的 slightly hot, especially in a pleasant way；v 同情；激动；变温暖 to make someone or something warm or warmer, or to become warm or warmer；n 取暖；加热

es.e: The house was lovely and warm.
es.c: 那房子漂亮温暖。

es.e: I hope we get some warm weather soon.
es.c: 我希望天气很快就会回暖。

es.e: I’ve put your dinner in the oven to keep it warm.
es.c: 我把你的饭菜放进了烤箱里保温。

d: n 温暖；热情；激动 the heat something produces, or when you feel warm

es.e: She went further into the room, drawn by the warmth of the fire.
es.c: 她被火的温暖吸引着，走进了房间。

d: n 警告；预兆；预告 something, especially a statement, that tells you that something bad, dangerous, or annoying might happen so that you can be ready or avoid it；adj 警告的；引以为戒的 a warning action or thing tells you that something b

es.e: a warning that grey squirrels are threatening the existence of red squirrels
es.c: 关于灰松鼠正威胁到红松鼠生存的警告

d: n 洗涤；洗的衣服；化妆水；冲积物 an act of cleaning something using soap and water；v 洗涤；洗刷；冲走；拍打 to clean something using water and a type of soap

es.e: Those jeans need a good wash (= a thorough wash ).
es.c: 那条牛仔裤要好好洗一洗了。

es.e: I’ll just have a quick wash before we go out.
es.c: 我很快洗个澡，然后我们就出门。

d: n 洗手间；盥洗室；厕所 a room in a public building where you can wash and use the toilet

es.e: The landlord pays cleaners who come daily, and there is a dingy shared washroom where residents can clean their belongings.
es.c: 房东雇了清洁工每天来打扫，还有一个昏暗的公用盥洗室，供住户们洗自己的东西。

d: n 浪费；废物；荒地；损耗；地面风化物 when something such as money or skills are not used in a way that is effective, useful, or sensible；v 浪费；消耗；使荒芜 to use more money, time, energy etc than is useful or sensible；adj 废弃的；多余的；荒芜的 waste mat

es.e: excessive waste in state spending
es.c: 政府支出方面的过度浪费

d: v 观察；注视；看守；警戒 to look at someone or something for a period of time, paying attention to what is happening；n 手表；监视；守护；值班人 a small clock that you wear on your wrist or keep in your pocket

es.e: Do you mind if I watch?
es.c: 你介意我看着吗？

es.e: We sat and watched the sunset.
es.c: 我们坐下来看日落。

es.e: Ruth could not bear to watch her parents arguing.
es.c: 露丝看不得父母争吵。

d: n 水；海水；雨水；海域，大片的水 the clear liquid without colour, smell, or taste that falls as rain and that is used for drinking, washing etc；v 使湿；供以水；给…浇水 if you water plants or the ground they are growing in, you pour water on them

es.e: There’s water all over the bathroom floor.
es.c: 浴室地面上都是水。

es.e: Does anyone want a drink of water?
es.c: 有谁想喝杯水吗？

es.e: a glass of sparkling mineral water
es.c: 一杯有气矿泉水

d: n 西瓜 a large round fruit with hard green skin, red flesh, and black seeds

es.e: Oh, what a big watermelon!
es.c: 喔唷， 这么大的西瓜!

es.e: A watermelon is red inside and green outside.
es.c: 西瓜内红外绿。

es.e: This kind of watermelon is remarkable for its size.
es.c: 这种西瓜个头儿大。

d: v 波动；起伏；挥手示意；摇动；呈波形 to raise your arm and move your hand from side to side in order to make someone notice you；n 波动；波浪；高潮；挥手示意；卷曲 a line of raised water that moves across the surface of the sea

es.e: Enid waved at us and we waved back.
es.c: 伊妮德向我们挥手，我们也向她挥手。

d: n 蜡；蜡状物 a solid substance made of fat or oil and used to make candles, polish etc；v 给…上蜡 to rub a layer of wax into a floor, surface etc to protect it or make it shine；adj 蜡制的；似蜡的

es.e: wax crayons
es.c: 蜡笔

d: n 方法；道路；方向；行业；习惯 a method that you use to do or achieve something；adv 大大地；远远地 very far；adj 途中的

es.e: There are several different ways we can tackle this problem.
es.c: 我们可以用几种不同的方法处理这个问题。

es.e: There’s no way of knowing if the treatment will work.
es.c: 没有办法知道这种治疗方法是否有效。

d: n 路旁 the side of a road；adj 路旁的

es.e: How is it that the successful motivate themselves to keep at it when others fall by the wayside?
es.c: 当其他人跌倒在路旁时，他们是如何激发自己坚持下去的？

es.e: To instance only one point: till then I had cared very little about plants and flowers, but now I found myself eagerly interested in every blossom, in every growth of the wayside.
es.c: 只要举个例子就看得出来了：在这之前，我很少留意于草木花卉，可是现在我发现自己对路边每朵绽开的鲜花、每根生长的小草都兴趣十足。

es.e: She beheld the minister advancing along the path, entirely alone, and leaning on a staff which he had cut by the wayside.
es.c: 她看到牧师正沿着小径走来，他只身一人，只是手中接着一根从路边砍下的手杖。

d: pron 我们（主格）；笔者，本人（作者或演讲人使用）；朕，寡人 used by the person speaking or writing to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people；n (We)人名；(缅)韦

es.e: ‘Did you go into the supermarket?’ ‘No, we didn’t.’
es.c: “你们进超级市场了吗？”“我们没有进去。”

es.e: Shall we stop for a coffee?
es.c: 我们停下来喝杯咖啡好吗？

es.e: So we all travelled down to Brighton together.
es.c: 所以我们一起都去了布赖顿。

d: adj [经] 疲软的；虚弱的；无力的；不牢固的 not physically strong

es.e: The illness left her feeling weak.
es.c: 疾病使她感到身体虚弱。

es.e: Poor light produces weak plants.
es.c: 光照不足，植物就生长不好。

es.e: The animal was weak from loss of blood.
es.c: 那只动物因失血而虚弱无力。

d: n 弱点；软弱；嗜好 a fault in someone’s character or in a system, organization, design etc

es.e: The legislation has a fundamental weakness.
es.c: 这项立法有一个根本性缺陷。

es.e: The plan has strengths and weaknesses.
es.c: 这个计划既有优点又有缺点。

d: n 财富；大量；富有 a large amount of money, property etc that a person or country owns

es.e: The country’s wealth comes from its oil.
es.c: 这个国家的财富来自石油。

es.e: the distribution of wealth
es.c: 财富的分配

es.e: The purpose of industry is to create wealth.
es.c: 工业的目的就是创造财富。

d: adj 富有的；充分的；丰裕的 having a lot of money, possessions etc；n 富人 The wealthy are people who are wealthy

es.e: the wealthy nations of the world
es.c: 世界上的富国

es.e: The best education should not be available only to the wealthy.
es.c: 不应该只有富人才能得到最好的教育。

d: n 衣物；磨损；耐久性 damage caused by continuous use over a long period；v 穿着；用旧；耗损；面露 to have a particular expression on your face

es.e: Replace your trainers when they start to show signs of wear.
es.c: 运动鞋开始出现磨损迹象就要更换。

es.e: Check the equipment for wear and tear.
es.c: 检查设备有没有损耗。

d: n 天气；气象；气候；处境 the temperature and other conditions such as sun, rain, and wind；v 经受住；使风化；侵蚀；使受风吹雨打 if rock, wood, or someone’s face is weathered by the wind, sun, rain etc, or if it weathers, it changes colour or shape o

es.e: What’s the weather like today?
es.c: 今天天气如何？

es.e: The weather turned bitterly cold.
es.c: 天气变得很冷了。

d: n 气象员；天气预报员 a man on television or radio who tells you what the weather will be like

es.e: In just 50 weeks Dan tried everything from being a lobster catcher, a jazz conductor, a TV weatherman and even a Las Vegas wedding planner.
es.c: 于是在50个礼拜之内，从捕龙虾、爵士乐指挥，电视天气预报，甚至拉斯维加斯的婚庆服务，他都一一尝试。

es.e: The weatherman says we’ll have a cold spell before the end of this week.
es.c: 天气预报员说,在这个周末之前,会有一阵子的冷天气。

d: n 网；卷筒纸；蹼；织物；圈套 the system on the Internet that allows you to find and use information that is held on computers all over the world；v 用网缠住；使中圈套
n 网站（全球资讯网的主机站） a place on the Internet where you can find information about something, especially a particular organization

es.e: For more information on weight loss and healthy eating, visit our website.
es.c: 有关减肥和健康饮食的更多信息，请访问我们的网站。

d: n 婚礼，婚宴；结婚；结合 a marriage ceremony, especially one with a religious service；v 与…结婚（wed的ing形式）

es.e: She’s busy planning her daughter’s wedding.
es.c: 她正忙着筹备女儿的婚礼。

es.e: When is the wedding?
es.c: 婚礼是什么时候？

d: n 星期三 the day between Tuesday and Thursday

es.e: Come and have supper with us on Wednesday, if you're free.
es.c: 星期三过来和我们一起吃晚饭，如果有空的话。

d: v 除草；铲除 to remove unwanted plants from a garden or other place；n 杂草，野草；菸草 a wild plant growing where it is not wanted that prevents crops or garden flowers from growing properly

es.e: Caspar was weeding the garden.
es.c: 卡斯帕正在给花园除草。

d: n 周，星期 a period of seven days and nights, usually measured in Britain from Monday to Sunday and in the US from Sunday to Saturday

es.e: I can’t see you this week.
es.c: 我这星期不能见你。

d: n 平日，普通日；工作日 any day of the week except Saturday and Sunday

es.e: If you want to avoid the crowds, it's best to come on a weekday.
es.c: 如果你想避开人流，最好在工作日来。

d: n 周末，周末休假；周末聚会 Saturday and Sunday, especially considered as time when you do not work；adj 周末的，周末用的；v 度周末 to spend the weekend somewhere

es.e: Are you doing anything nice this weekend?
es.c: 这个周末你有什么好的安排？

es.e: Tony has been unwell over the weekend (= during the weekend ).
es.c: 托尼这个周末身体不舒服。

es.e: We’re going to Paris for a long weekend (= Saturday and Sunday, and also Friday or Monday, or both ).
es.c: 我们要到巴黎去度一个长周末。

d: adj 每周的；周刊的；一周一次的 happening or done every week；n 周刊 a magazine that appears once a week；adv 每周一次；逐周 Weekly is also an adverb

es.e: a weekly current affairs programme
es.c: 一周一档的时事节目

es.e: twice-weekly flights
es.c: 每周两次的航班

es.e: The group meets weekly.
es.c: 小组每周见面一次。

d: v 哭泣；流泪；哀悼；滴落；渗出液体 to cry, especially because you feel very sad；n 哭泣；眼泪；滴下

es.e: James broke down and wept.
es.c: 詹姆斯控制不住感情，哭了起来。

es.e: He wept bitterly (= cried a lot ) when it was time for us to leave.
es.c: 我们要分别的时候他痛哭了一场。

d: v 权衡；考虑；称…重量 to have a particular weight；n 权衡；称重量

es.e: The young birds weigh only a few grams.
es.c: 雏鸟重量只有几克。

es.e: Do you know how much it weighs?
es.c: 你知道它的重量吗？

es.e: (= how much ) do you weigh?
es.c: 你的体重是多少？

d: n 重量，重力；负担；砝码；重要性 how heavy something is when you measure it；v 加重量于，使变重 If you weight something, you make it heavier by adding something to it, for example, in order to stop it from moving easily

es.e: The average weight of a baby at birth is just over seven pounds.
es.c: 婴儿的平均出生体重是七磅多一点。

es.e: It can be sewn into curtain hems to weight the curtain and so allow it to hang better.
es.c: 可以把它缝在窗帘的摺边里以增加窗帘的重量，使之更有下垂感。

d: adj 受欢迎的 if someone is welcome in a place, other people are glad that they are there；n 欢迎 the way in which you greet someone when they arrive at a place；v 欢迎 to say hello in a friendly way to someone who has just arrived

es.e: I had the feeling I wasn’t really welcome.
es.c: 我感觉到我其实不受欢迎。

es.e: I didn’t feel welcome in the club.
es.c: 我觉得我在俱乐部里不受欢迎。

es.e: Mary made us very welcome.
es.c: 玛丽让我们感觉很受欢迎。

d: n 福利；幸福；福利事业；安宁 someone’s welfare is their health and happiness；adj 福利的；接受社会救济的 Welfare services are provided to help with people's living conditions and financial problems

es.e: Our only concern is the children’s welfare.
es.c: 我们唯一关心的是孩子们的幸福。

es.e: Child welfare services are well established and comprehensive.
es.c: 儿童福利机构发展成熟、体系完善。

d: adv 很好地；充分地；满意地；适当地 in a successful or satisfactory way；adj 良好的；健康的；适宜的 healthy；n 井；源泉；v 涌出

es.e: Did you sleep well?
es.c: 你睡得好吗？

es.e: James reads quite well for his age.
es.c: 就詹姆斯的年龄来说，他的阅读能力算不错了。

es.e: All the team played very well today.
es.c: 今天所有队员都打得很不错。

d: n 西；西方；西部 the direction towards which the sun goes down, and which is on the left if you are facing north；adj 西方的；朝西的 in the west or facing the west；adv 在西方；向西方；自西方 towards the west

es.e: There’s a slight chance of some sunshine in the west.
es.c: 西部地区见晴的可能性不大。

d: adj 西方的，西部的；有西方特征的 in or from the west of a country or area；n 西方人；西部片，西部小说 a film about life in the 19th century in the American West, especially the lives of cowboys

es.e: the western end of the bay
es.c: 海湾的西端

es.e: Western Australia
es.c: 西澳大利亚

d: n 西方人，欧美人；美国西部的人 A westerner is a person who was born in or lives in the United States, Canada, or Western, Northern, or Southern Europe

es.e: It's the first time a Westerner has been convicted for a drug-related offence in recent years in China.
es.c: 这是近年来第一次有西方人在中国被判犯有与毒品有关的罪行。

d: adv 向西 Westward or westwards means toward the west；adj 向西的 Westward is also an adjective

es.e: He sailed westward from Palos de la Frontera.
es.c: 他从帕洛斯·德拉·弗龙特拉港出发向西航行。

es.e: ...the one-hour westward flight over the Andes to Lima.
es.c: …越过安第斯山脉到利马一小时的向西飞行。

d: adj [气象][物] 潮湿的；有雨的 covered in or full of water or another liquid；n 雨天；湿气 the rain；v 弄湿 to make something wet

es.e: I’ve washed your shirt but it’s still wet.
es.c: 我把你的衬衫洗过了，不过现在还是湿的。

es.e: wet grass
es.c: 湿草地

es.e: The man in the boat was wet through (= completely wet ).
es.c: 船上的那人浑身湿透。

d: v 猛揍；使惨败；n 鲸；巨大的东西 a very large animal that lives in the sea and looks like a fish, but is actually a mammal
pron 什么；多么；多少 used to ask for information or for someone’s opinion；adj 什么；多么；何等；adv 到什么程度，在哪一方面；int 什么；多么

es.e: What are you doing?
es.c: 你在做什么？

es.e: What subjects did you enjoy most?
es.c: 你最喜欢什么学科？

es.e: What colour is the new carpet?
es.c: 新地毯是什么颜色的？

d: adj 不管什么样的；pron 无论什么；诸如此类；conj 无论什么
n 小麦；小麦色 the grain that bread is made from, or the plant that it grows on

es.e: a field of wheat
es.c: 小麦地

d: n 车轮；方向盘；转动 one of the round things under a car, bus, bicycle etc that turns when it moves；v 转动；使变换方向；给…装轮子 to push something that has wheels somewhere

es.e: Shall I take the wheel (= drive instead of someone else )?
es.c: 我来开车好吗？

d: conj 考虑到；既然；当…时；在…时；如果；adv 什么时候，何时；（用于时间的表达方式之后）在那时；其时；当时 at what time；pron 那时；什么时侯；n 时间，时候；日期；场合

es.e: When are we leaving?
es.c: 我们什么时候走？

es.e: When did you first meet Dr Darnall?
es.c: 你是什么时候认识达纳尔博士的？

es.e: When will the work be finished?
es.c: 这项工作什么时候完成？

d: conj 每当；无论何时；adv 不论何时；随便什么时候 at any time

es.e: They were always there by you， whenever you needed them.
es.c: 无论何时你需要他们，他们总是在你身边。

d: adv 在哪里 in or to which place；pron 哪里；conj 在…的地方；n 地点

es.e: Where are you going?
es.c: 你要到哪儿去？

es.e: Where do they live?
es.c: 他们住在哪里？

es.e: Do you know where my glasses are?
es.c: 你知道我的眼镜在哪儿吗？

d: adv 无论什么地方；究竟在哪里 to or at any place, position, or situation；conj 无论在哪里；无论什么情况下

es.e: Children will play wherever they happen to be.
es.c: 小孩子走到哪里玩到哪里。

es.e: Sit wherever you like.
es.c: 随便坐吧。

d: conj 是否；不论 used when talking about a choice you have to make or about something that is not certain；pron 两个中的哪一个

es.e: Maurice asked me whether I needed any help.
es.c: 莫里斯问我是否需要帮助。

es.e: There were times when I wondered whether or not we would get there.
es.c: 有时候我也想知道我们能不能做得到。

es.e: I didn’t know whether to believe him or not.
es.c: 我不知道该不该相信他。

d: pron 哪/那一个；哪/那一些；adj 哪一个；哪一些
pron 任何一个；无论哪个；adj 无论哪个；无论哪些
conj 虽然；然而；当……的时候 during the time that something is happening；n 一会儿；一段时间；v 消磨；轻松地度过 to spend time in a pleasant and lazy way

es.e: They arrived while we were having dinner.
es.c: 他们来时我们正在吃饭。

es.e: While she was asleep, thieves broke in and stole her handbag.
es.c: 她睡着的时候，小偷闯进来偷走了她的手提包。

es.e: She met Andy while working on a production of Carmen.
es.c: 排练《卡门》时，她认识了安迪。

d: n 私语；谣传；飒飒的声音 a piece of news or information that has not been officially announced and may or may not be true；v 耳语；密谈；飒飒地响 to speak or say something very quietly, using your breath rather than your voice

es.e: You don’t have to whisper, no one can hear us.
es.c: 你不必轻声轻语，没人听得到我们说话。

es.e: ‘I’ve missed you,’ he whispered in her ear.
es.c: “我想你了。”他在她耳边低语道。

d: n 口哨；汽笛；呼啸声 a small object that produces a high whistling sound when you blow into it；v 吹口哨；鸣汽笛 to make a high or musical sound by blowing air out through your lips

es.e: The lifeguard blew his whistle.
es.c: 救生员吹响哨子。

d: adj 白色的；白种的；纯洁的 having the colour of milk, salt, or snow；n 白色；洁白；白种人 the colour of milk, salt, and snow

es.e: a white dress
es.c: 白色连衣裙

d: pron 谁；什么人 used to ask or talk about which person is involved, or what the name of a person is

es.e: Who locked the door?
es.c: 谁锁的门？

es.e: Who do you work for?
es.c: 你为谁工作？

es.e: Who’s that guy with your wife?
es.c: 和你妻子在一起的那个人是谁？

d: adj 完整的；纯粹的 all of something；n 整体；全部 something that consists of a number of parts, but is considered as a single unit

es.e: You have your whole life ahead of you!
es.c: 你有一辈子要过呢！

es.e: His whole attitude bugs me.
es.c: 他的整个态度都让我讨厌。

es.e: We ate the whole cake in about ten minutes.
es.c: 大约十分钟的时间，我们就把整个蛋糕都给吃完了。

d: pron 谁（who的宾格）

es.e: From whom shall I get comfort?
es.c: 我从谁那儿能得到安慰呢?

es.e: The dispute at the moment revolved about the question of whom to send.
es.c: 当时的争论是围绕着派谁去好这一问题而进行的。

d: pron 谁的（疑问代词）

es.e: The word “dentist”denotes a doctor whose work is the care of teeth.
es.c: “牙科医生”一词意谓其工作是医治牙齿的医生。

d: int 哎呀！什么？ used when you are surprised or have suddenly realized something；adv 为什么 used to ask or talk about the reason for something

es.e: Why, look who’s here!
es.c: 哎呀，看看这是谁！

es.e: And I thought to myself, why, I can do that.
es.c: 我就对自己说，嗨，我能行的。

d: adj 广泛的；宽的，广阔的；张大的；远离目标的 including or involving a large variety of different people, things, or situations；adv 广泛地；广阔地；充分地 opening or spreading as much as possible；n 大千世界

es.e: a man with a wide experience of foreign affairs
es.c: 外交事务经验丰富的人

es.e: Our aim is to bring classical music to a wider audience.
es.c: 我们的目的是把古典音乐带给更多的听众。

d: adj 普遍的，广泛的；分布广的 existing or happening in many places or situations, or among many people

es.e: the widespread use of chemicals in agriculture
es.c: 化学品在农业中的广泛使用

d: n 妻子，已婚妇女；夫人 the woman that a man is married to

es.e: Have you met my wife?
es.c: 你见过我的妻子吗？

es.e: a refuge for battered wives
es.c: 受虐待妻子庇护所

es.e: his second wife
es.c: 他的第二任妻子

d: adj 野生的；野蛮的；狂热的；荒凉的 living in a natural state, not changed or controlled by people；n 荒野 in natural and free conditions, not kept or controlled by people；adv 疯狂地；胡乱地 if plants run wild, they grow a lot in an uncontrolled

es.e: {"COLLOINEXA":["wild animals"]}
es.c: 野生动物

es.e: a field full of wild flowers
es.c: 遍地野花的田野

es.e: animals both wild and domesticated
es.c: 野生动物和家养动物

d: n 野生动植物 animals and plants growing in natural conditions；adj 野生动植物的

es.e: measures to protect the area’s wildlife
es.c: 保护该地区野生生物的措施

es.e: the destruction of wildlife habitats
es.c: 野生动植物生存环境的破坏

d: n 意志；决心；情感；遗嘱；意图；心愿 determination to do something that you have decided to do, even if this is difficult；v 决心要；遗赠；用意志力使 used to show that someone is willing or ready to do something；aux 将；愿意；必须

es.e: Children sometimes have strong wills.
es.c: 小孩子有时有很强的意志力。

d: adj 乐意的；自愿的；心甘情愿的 prepared to do something, or having no reason to not want to do it；v 决心；用意志力驱使；将（财产等）遗赠某人（will的现在分词）；n (Willing)人名；(德、芬、瑞典)维林；(英)威林

es.e: I soon had an army of willing helpers.
es.c: 我很快就拥有了一批热心的帮手。

d: adv 欣然地；愿意地，乐意地
n 乐意；心甘情愿；自动自发
v 赢得；在…中获胜；劝诱 to be the best or most successful in a competition, game, election etc；n 赢；胜利 a success or victory, especially in sport

es.e: Who’s winning (= who is most successful at this point in the game )?
es.c: 现在谁领先？

d: n 风；呼吸；气味；卷绕 moving air, especially when it moves strongly or quickly in a current；v 缠绕；上发条；使弯曲；吹号角；绕住或缠住某人 to turn or twist something several times around something else

es.e: The wind blew from the northeast.
es.c: 风从东北方向吹来。

es.e: Planes were unable to take off because of high winds.
es.c: 飞机因大风无法起飞。

d: n 防风夹克，同windcheater A Windbreaker is a jacket that resists the wind and fits closely at the waist and wrists
n 窗；窗口；窗户 a space or an area of glass in the wall of a building or vehicle that lets in light

es.e: Television provides us with a useful window on the world.
es.c: 电视为我们提供了了解世界的有用渠道。

d: adj 多风的，有风的；腹胀的；吹牛的 if it is windy, there is a lot of wind

es.e: It’s too windy for a picnic.
es.c: 风太大，不适合野餐。

es.e: a cold, windy day
es.c: 一个寒冷的大风天

es.e: a windy hillside
es.c: 当风的山坡

d: n 酒，葡萄酒；紫红色 an alcoholic drink made from grapes, or a type of this drink；v 喝酒 to entertain someone well with a meal, wine etc

es.e: a glass of wine
es.c: 一杯葡萄酒

d: n 翼；翅膀；飞翔；派别；侧厅，耳房，厢房 one of the large flat parts that stick out from the side of a plane and help to keep it in the air；v 使飞；飞过；空运；增加…速度；装以翼 to fly somewhere

es.e: The bird flapped its wings furiously.
es.c: 那只鸟使劲地拍打着翅膀。

d: n 胜利者 a person or animal that has won something

es.e: Five lucky winners will each receive a signed copy of the album.
es.c: 五位幸运的获胜者每人将得到一张签名专辑。

es.e: As a jockey he rode 10 winners.
es.c: 作为骑师他曾十度驾驭获胜赛马。

d: n 冬季；年岁；萧条期 the season after autumn and before spring, when the weather is coldest；v 过冬 to spend the winter somewhere；adj 冬天的；越冬的

es.e: Soon it will be winter.
es.c: 很快要到冬天了。

d: v 擦；消除；涂上 to remove liquid, dirt, or marks by wiping；n 擦拭；用力打 a wiping movement with a cloth

es.e: I'll just wipe the table.
es.c: 我只擦擦桌子。

d: n 电线；金属丝；电报 thin metal in the form of a thread, or a piece of this；v 拍电报；给…装电线 to send money electronically

es.e: copper wire
es.c: 铜丝

es.e: a wire fence
es.c: 铁丝网

d: n 智慧，才智；明智；学识；至理名言 good sense and judgment, based especially on your experience of life

es.e: a man of great wisdom
es.c: 一个有大智慧的男人

es.e: You can always expect a few words of wisdom from Dave.
es.c: 戴夫总能冒出几句至理名言。

d: adj 明智的；聪明的；博学的 wise decisions and actions are sensible and based on good judgment；v 使知道；教导；n (Wise)人名；(英)怀斯

es.e: a wise precaution
es.c: 明智的预防措施

es.e: I don’t think that would be a very wise move (= not be a sensible thing to do ).
es.c: 我认为那样做不是很明智。

d: n 希望；祝福；心愿 a desire to do something, to have something, or to have something happen；v 祝愿；渴望；向…致问候语 to want something to be true although you know it is either impossible or unlikely

es.e: Close your eyes and make a wish.
es.c: 闭上眼睛许个愿。

d: prep 用；随着；支持；和…在一起 used to say that two or more people or things are together in the same place；n (With)人名；(德、芬、丹、瑞典)维特

es.e: I saw Bob in town with his girlfriend.
es.c: 我看到鲍勃与他的女朋友一起在镇上。

es.e: Put this bag with the others.
es.c: 把这个包和其他的包放在一起。

es.e: I always wear these shoes with this dress.
es.c: 这双鞋子我总是和这条裙子一起穿。

d: v 撤退；收回；撤消；拉开 to stop taking part in an activity, belonging to an organization etc, or to make someone do this

es.e: calls for Britain to withdraw from the European Union
es.c: 要求英国退出欧盟的呼声

d: prep 在…之内 before a certain period of time has passed；adv 在内部 Within is also an adverb；n 里面

es.e: We should have the test results back within 24 hours.
es.c: 我们24小时之内应该可以拿到化验结果。

es.e: He fell sick and died within a matter of weeks.
es.c: 他病倒了，不出几星期就死了。

es.e: Within an hour of our arrival Caroline was starting to complain.
es.c: 我们到达还没有一小时，卡罗琳就开始抱怨了。

d: prep 没有；超过；在…外面 not having something, especially something that is basic or necessary；adv 户外；在外面；没有或不显示某事物；n 外部；外面

es.e: After the storm we were without electricity for five days.
es.c: 暴风雨之后我们断电了五天。

es.e: a house without a garden
es.c: 不带花园的房子

es.e: We passed two ruined abbeys, one with a tower and one without.
es.c: 我们路过两座破落的寺院，一座有塔楼，另一座没有。

d: n 证人；目击者；证据 someone who sees a crime or an accident and can describe what happened；v 目击；证明；为…作证 to see something happen, especially a crime or accident

es.e: Police have appealed for witnesses to come forward.
es.c: 警方呼吁目击者站出来。

es.e: an eye witness (= someone who sees an event ) to the robbery
es.c: 抢劫案的一名目击者

d: n 狼；色狼；残忍贪婪之人 a wild animal that looks like a large dog and lives and hunts in groups；v 大吃；狼吞虎咽地吃 to eat something very quickly, swallowing it in big pieces

es.e: a pack of wolves
es.c: 一群狼

d: n 妇女；女性；成年女子 an adult female person

es.e: I was talking to a woman I met on the flight.
es.c: 我正和一个在飞机上认识的女子交谈。

es.e: married women
es.c: 已婚妇女

es.e: a popular women’s magazine
es.c: 一本受欢迎的女性杂志

d: n 惊奇；奇迹；惊愕 used to say that something is very surprising；v 怀疑；想知道；惊讶 to think about something that you are not sure about and try to guess what is true, what will happen etc；adj 奇妙的；非凡的 If you refer, for example, to a yo

es.e: It’s a wonder no one got hurt.
es.c: 竟然没有人受伤，真是奇迹。

es.e: Mickelson was hailed as the wonder boy of American golf.
es.c: 米克尔森被称颂为美国高尔夫球界的神奇男孩。

d: adj 极好的，精彩的，绝妙的；奇妙的；美妙；胜；神妙 making you admire someone or something very much

es.e: It’s wonderful what doctors can do nowadays.
es.c: 如今医生的本领着实令人称奇。

d: v 追求；招致；向…求爱；恳求 to try to persuade a woman to love you and marry you
n 木材；木制品；树林 the material that trees are made of；vi 收集木材；vt 植林于；给…添加木柴

es.e: Put some more wood on the fire.
es.c: 往火上再添些木柴。

es.e: a polished wood floor
es.c: 擦得锃亮的木地板

es.e: Her house was made of wood .
es.c: 她家的房子是木头盖的。

d: adj 木制的；僵硬的，呆板的 made of wood

es.e: a wooden bench
es.c: 木制长椅

d: adj 羊毛制的 made of wool；n 毛织品

es.e: a woollen scarf
es.c: 羊毛围巾

d: n [语] 单词；话语；消息；诺言；命令 a single group of letters that are used together with a particular meaning；v 用言辞表达 to use words that are carefully chosen in order to express something

es.e: Write an essay of about five hundred words.
es.c: 写一篇约500字的文章。

es.e: What does that word mean?
es.c: 那个单词是什么意思？

es.e: ‘Vater’ is the German word for (= that means ) ‘father’.
es.c: vater在德语中是“父亲”的意思。

d: n 工作；[物] 功；产品；操作；职业；行为；事业；工厂；著作；文学、音乐或艺术作品 a job or activity that you do regularly, especially in order to earn money；v 使工作；操作；经营；使缓慢前进 to do the activities and duties that are part of your job

es.e: There isn’t a lot of work at this time of the year.
es.c: 每年这个时候工作机会都不多。

es.e: He’s been out of work (= without a job ) for two years.
es.c: 他失业有两年了。

es.e: More people are in work (= have a job ) than ten years ago.
es.c: 现在有工作的人比十年前多。

d: n 工作日 the amount of time that you spend working in a day；adj 日常的，工作日的；平凡的

es.e: a 10-hour workday
es.c: 十小时工作日

d: n 工人；劳动者；职蚁 the members of the  working class

es.e: the workers’ revolution
es.c: 工人阶级革命

d: n 劳动力；工人总数，职工总数 all the people who work in a particular industry or company, or are available to work in a particular country or area

es.e: Women now represent almost 50% of the workforce.
es.c: 如今女性几乎占全部劳动人口的 50%。

es.e: The company is cutting its workforce.
es.c: 这家公司正在裁员。

d: n 同事；工友 someone you work with

es.e: More than 80% of unfaithful people have affairs with someone who’d started out as “just a friend, ” very often a workmate.
es.c: 超过80%的有过偷情史的人都是从跟一些人以“仅仅是朋友”开始的，并且多数是同事。

es.e: The link between a positive workmate relationship and the risk of mortality was most notable among those aged between 38 and 43.
es.c: 与同事建立积极关系和死亡风险之间的联系在38到43岁人群当中最为显著。

es.e: The report found more than a fifth of employees have recently confided in a colleague, while a similar number said they would turn to a workmate first.
es.c: 研究报告指出，超过五分之一的员工最近曾向一位同事倾吐秘密，另外有同样数量的人说他们会最先向同事倾诉。

d: n 工作场所；车间 the room, building etc where you work

es.e: ...the difficulties facing women in the workplace.
es.c: …妇女在工作场所中面临的困难。

d: n 作品；工厂；工程结构
n 世界；领域；世俗；全人类；物质生活 the  planet  we live on, and all the people, cities, and countries on it

es.e: Tuberculosis is still common in some parts of the world .
es.c: 结核病在世界上某些地区仍很常见。

es.e: At that time China was the most powerful country in the world .
es.c: 当时中国是世界上最强大的国家。

es.e: The Taj Mahal attracts visitors from around the world .
es.c: 泰姬陵吸引了来自世界各地的游客。

d: adj 全世界的 everywhere in the world；adv 在世界各地 If something exists or happens worldwide, it exists or happens throughout the world

es.e: We have offices in over 56 countries worldwide.
es.c: 我们在全世界超过56个国家设有办事处。

es.e: cars with a worldwide reputation for reliability
es.c: 以性能可靠享誉世界的汽车

es.e: His books have sold more than 20 million copies worldwide.
es.c: 他的书在全世界卖出了两千多万本。

d: n 虫，蠕虫；蜗杆；螺纹；小人物 a long thin creature with no bones and no legs that lives in soil；v 使蠕动；给除虫；使缓慢前进

es.e: ...a new computer worm that disables security software.
es.c: …一种使安全软件失灵的新型计算机蠕虫病毒。

d: adj 疲倦的；用旧的 a worn object is old and damaged, especially because it has been used a lot；v 穿；磨损（wear的过去分词）；佩戴；n (Worn)人名；(柬)翁；(英、葡)沃恩

es.e: a worn patch on the carpet
es.c: 地毯上一小块磨破的地方

es.e: well worn stone steps
es.c: 残破的石阶

d: adj 担心的 unhappy because you keep thinking about a problem, or about something bad that might happen

es.e: She gave me a worried look.
es.c: 她担心地看了我一眼。

es.e: His parents must be worried sick (= extremely worried ) .
es.c: 他的父母肯定担心死了。

d: n 担心；烦恼；撕咬 the feeling of being anxious about something；v 担心；发愁；折磨 to be anxious or unhappy about someone or something, so that you think about them a lot

es.e: He’s been a constant source of worry .
es.c: 他总是让人担心。

d: adj 更坏的；更差的；更恶劣的（bad的比较级）；（病情）更重的（ill的比较级） more unpleasant, bad, or severe；adv 更糟；更坏；更恶劣地；更坏地 in a more severe or serious way than before；n 更坏的事；更恶劣的事 something worse

es.e: The traffic is much worse after five o’clock.
es.c: 5点以后交通拥堵严重得多。

es.e: The weather was a lot worse this year.
es.c: 今年天气糟糕得多。

es.e: Conditions will get worse as the winter continues.
es.c: 随着冬天持续下去，情况会更糟。

d: adj 最差的，最坏的；最不利的；效能最低的 worse than anything or anyone else；n 最坏；最坏的时候 the person or thing that is worse than all others；adv 最坏地；最不利地 most badly

es.e: This is the worst recession for fifty years.
es.c: 这是50年来最严重的一次经济衰退。

es.e: My worst fear was that we would run out of food.
es.c: 我最大的担忧是我们会把食物吃光。

es.e: What is the worst possible thing that can happen?
es.c: 最糟可能会发生什么事？

d: adj 值…的；n 价值；财产 an amount of something worth ten pounds, $500 etc

es.e: You should not deprecate your own worth.
es.c: 你不应该贬低你自己的价值。

d: adj 无价值的；不值钱的；卑微的 something that is worthless has no value, importance, or use

es.e: The house was full of worthless junk.
es.c: 这房子里堆满了没有用的东西。

es.e: The information was worthless to me.
es.c: 这些资料对我毫无用处。

d: adj 值得做的，值得花时间的 if something is worthwhile, it is important or useful, or you gain something from it

es.e: He wanted to do a worthwhile job.
es.c: 他想做有意义的工作。

es.e: We decided to give the money to a worthwhile cause (= one that helps people ) .
es.c: 我们决定把这笔钱投入到慈善事业中。

d: adj 值得的；有价值的；配得上的，相称的；可尊敬的；应…的 deserving respect from people；n 杰出人物；知名人士 someone who is important and should be respected

es.e: Leeds United were worthy winners of the competition.
es.c: 利兹联队是比赛当之无愧的获胜者。

es.e: a worthy opponent
es.c: 值得钦佩的对手

d: aux 将，将要；愿意；v will的过去式 used to ask someone politely to do something

es.e: Would you shut the window, please?
es.c: 请把窗户关上，好吗？

es.e: Would you mind waiting outside?
es.c: 您在外面等好吗？

es.e: Would someone please tell me what is going on?
es.c: 请问谁能告诉我发生什么事了？

d: n 创伤，伤口 an injury to your body that is made by a weapon such as a knife or a bullet；v 使受伤

es.e: A nurse cleaned and bandaged the wound.
es.c: 护士把伤口清洗包扎好。

es.e: It took several months for his wounds to heal .
es.c: 他的伤口几个月后才愈合。

es.e: The doctor said it was only a flesh wound (= one that does not cut the skin very deeply ) .
es.c: 医生说那只是皮肉伤。

d: adj 受伤的 injured by a weapon such as a gun or knife；n 受伤者，伤员；v 使受伤（wound的过去分词）

es.e: a wounded soldier
es.c: 受伤的士兵

d: n 摔跤；搏斗；斗争；v 摔跤；斗争；斟酌 to fight someone by holding them and pulling or pushing them

es.e: They run races; they wrestle; and sometimes they have mock fights together.
es.c: 蚂蚁参加各种赛跑，摔跤，有时还在一起模拟战斗。

d: n 皱纹 wrinkles are lines on your face and skin that you get when you are old；v 起皱 if you wrinkle a part of your face, or if it wrinkles, small lines appear on it

es.e: Her face was a mass of wrinkles.
es.c: 她的脸上布满皱纹。

d: n 手腕；腕关节 the part of your body where your hand joins your arm；vt 用腕力移动

es.e: He broke his wrist climbing rocks for a cigarette ad.
es.c: 他为了一个香烟广告攀岩折断了手腕。

d: v 写，写字；写作，作曲；写信 to put words in a letter to someone

es.e: I wrote her several letters , but she didn’t reply.
es.c: 我给她写了几封信，可是她没有回复。

d: n 书写；作品；著作；[法] 笔迹 words that have been written or printed；v 书写（write的ing形式）

es.e: What does the writing on the back say?
es.c: 背面的文字说什么？

es.e: a T-shirt with Japanese writing on it
es.c: 一件印有日语的T恤衫

d: adv 错误地；邪恶地，不正当地 not in the correct way；n 坏事；不公正 behaviour that is not morally right；adj 错误的；失常的；不适当的 not correct, and not based on true facts；v 委屈；无理地对待；诽谤 Wrong is also an adverb

es.e: You’ve spelt my name wrong.
es.c: 你把我的名字拼错了。

es.e: What? Have I done it wrong ?
es.c: 什么？我做得不对吗？

es.e: I asked him to sort those files, but he’s done it all wrong (= in completely the wrong way ) .
es.c: 我让他整理这些文件，可是他弄得根本不对。

d: n 院子；码（英制中丈量长度单位，1码=3英尺）；庭院；帆桁 a unit for measuring length, equal to three feet or 0.91 metres；vt 把…关进或围在畜栏里

es.e: a hundred yards away
es.c: 100码外

es.e: an area of 9,000 square yards
es.c: 面积为9,000平方码的一片区域

d: n 哈欠；裂口 Yawn is also a noun；v 打哈欠；裂开 to open your mouth wide and breathe in deeply because you are tired or bored

es.e: Rosanna stifled a huge yawn.
es.c: 罗莎娜忍住了一个大哈欠。

d: n 年；年度；历年；年纪；一年的期间；某年级的学生 a period of about 365 days or 12 months, measured from any particular time

es.e: I arrived here two years ago.
es.c: 我两年前来到这里。

es.e: We’ve known each other for over a year.
es.c: 我们相识一年多了。

es.e: It’s almost a year since Sue died.
es.c: 休去世快一年了。

d: v 大叫，叫喊 to shout or say something very loudly, especially because you are frightened, angry, or excited；n 喊声，叫声 a loud shout

es.e: ‘Help me!’ she yelled hysterically.
es.c: “救救我！”她歇斯底里地大叫。

es.e: I yelled out, ‘Here I am!’
es.c: 我大声喊道:“我在这儿！”

es.e: The crowd are on their feet yelling.
es.c: 观众站着高声呐喊。

d: adj 黄色的；黄皮肤的 having the colour of butter or the middle part of an egg；n 黄色；黄种人；黄色颜料 the colour of butter or the middle part of an egg；v 使变黄或发黄 to become yellow or make something become yellow

es.e: yellow flowers
es.c: 黄花

d: adv 是, 是的 used as an answer to say that you want something or want to do something；n 是（表示肯定）

es.e: ‘Would you like a sandwich?’ ‘Yes, please.’
es.c: “你想来个三明治吗？”“好的，谢谢。”

es.e: ‘Would you like to come with us?’ ‘Yes, I’d love to.’
es.c: “你想和我们一起去吗？”“好的，我很乐意。”

d: n 昨天；往昔 the day before today；adv 昨天 on or during the day before today

es.e: yesterday’s meeting
es.c: 昨天的会议

es.e: They arrived the day before yesterday.
es.c: 他们前天到的。

d: adv 还；但是；已经 used to emphasize how much time will pass before something happens, or how long a situation will continue；conj 但是；然而 used to introduce a fact, situation, or quality that is surprising after what you have just

es.e: ‘When’s your holiday?’ ‘Oh, not for ages yet.’
es.c: “你什么时候去休假？”“噢，不知何年何月呢。”

es.e: It could be months yet before they know their fate.
es.c: 可能要好几个月他们才能知道自己的命运。

d: n 酸奶（等于yoghourt）；酸乳酪 a thick liquid food that tastes slightly sour and is made from milk, or an amount of this food

es.e: a pot of strawberry yogurt
es.c: 一罐草莓酸奶

d: pron 你；你们 used to refer to a person or group of people when speaking or writing to them；n (You)人名；(柬)尤；(东南亚国家华语)猷

es.e: Hi, Kelly. How are you?
es.c: 嗨，凯利，你好吗？

es.e: You must all listen carefully.
es.c: 你们大家都必须仔细听着。

es.e: I have some news for you.
es.c: 我有一些消息要告诉你们。

d: adj 年轻的；初期的；没有经验的 a young person, plant, or animal has not lived for very long；n 年轻人；（动物的）崽，仔 young people

es.e: a young child
es.c: 幼儿

es.e: He’s younger than me.
es.c: 他比我小。

es.e: You’re too young to get married.
es.c: 你还太小，不能结婚。

d: pron 你的，你们的

es.e: You should keep in with your colleagues.
es.c: 你应当与你的同事友好相处。

es.e: You should not deprecate your own worth.
es.c: 你不应该贬低你自己的价值。

d: pron 你（们）的东西；你的责任[义务]；你的家属；来信，尊函 used when speaking or writing to one or more people to refer to something that belongs to them or is connected with them；adj 你（们）的（东西）；信末署名前用语

es.e: This is our room, and yours is just across the hall.
es.c: 这是我们的房间，你们的在走廊那边。

es.e: A lot of people have money problems, but yours are more serious than most people’s.
es.c: 许多人有财务问题，不过你的问题比大多数人的要严重。

es.e: A cash prize of £10,000 or a new car – the choice is yours.
es.c: 一万英镑的奖金或一辆新车——随你选择。

d: pron 你自己 used when talking to someone to show that they are affected by their own action

es.e: Look at yourself in the mirror.
es.c: 照照镜子吧。

es.e: Come and warm yourselves by the fire.
es.c: 到火边来暖暖身子。

es.e: Have you hurt yourself?
es.c: 你伤到自己了吗？

d: pron 你们自己；你们本人（yourself的复数）

es.e: Believe in yourselves.
es.c: 相信你们自己。

es.e: I need not press the urgency of the matter on you, as I konw you are fully aware of it yourselves.
es.c: 我无需向你们强调此事的急迫性，因为我知道，你们自己对此完全了解。

es.e: But what is ultimately most important here is that you are asking the question —not just of me but of yourselves.
es.c: 但是我在这儿说的最重要的是：你们在问那些问题——不仅是问我，而是在问你们自己。

d: n 青年；青春；年轻；青少年时期 the period of time when someone is young, especially the period when someone is a teenager

es.e: a gang of youths
es.c: 一伙少年

d: adj 好吃的；美味的；愉快的 tasting very good；n 美味的东西；令人喜爱的东西

es.e: This cake is really yummy.
es.c: 这蛋糕真好吃。

es.e: ‘Treacle tart! Yummy!’ said Simon.
es.c: “糖蜜馅饼！ 好吃！”西蒙说。

d: n [脊椎] 斑马 an animal that looks like a horse but has black and white lines all over its body；adj 有斑纹的

es.e: The neck of the zebra was nipped by a lion.
es.c: 狮子咬断了那头斑马的脖子。

es.e: But what if your horse suddenly grows zebra stripes?
es.c: 可是如果那匹马突然长出了斑马的条纹呢？

es.e: Sixty acres of woods and ponds are home to camels, zebra, bison, water buffalo, ostrich and antelope.
es.c: 六十英亩的森林和池塘是骆驼，斑马，野牛，水牛，鸵鸟和羚羊的家园。

d: n 零点，零度 the number 0；num 零 the number 0

es.e: Make x greater than or equal to zero.
es.c: 设x大于或等于零。

d: n 拉链；活力，精力；尖啸声，撕裂声；一种程序压缩的档案文件格式 two lines of small metal or plastic pieces that slide together to fasten a piece of clothing；v 拉开或拉上；以尖啸声行进 to fasten something using a zip

es.e: The zip on my skirt had broken.
es.c: 我裙子上的拉链坏了。

d: n 拉链 two lines of small metal or plastic pieces that slide together to fasten a piece of clothing；v 拉上拉链

es.e: ...the metal zipper on his jacket.
es.c: …他的夹克上的金属拉锁。

d: n 地带；地区；联防 a large area that is different from other areas around it in some way；v 分成区

es.e: San Francisco and Tokyo are both located in earthquake zones.
es.c: 旧金山和东京都位于地震带。

es.e: The government has set up a special economic zone to promote private enterprise.
es.c: 政府设立了一个经济特区来推动私营企业的发展。

d: n 动物园 a place, usually in a city, where animals of many kinds are kept so that people can go to look at them

es.e: The road to the zoo turns off here.
es.c: 通向动物园的路由这儿拐弯。

es.e: The parrots in the zoo are popping all the time.
es.c: 动物园里的鹦鹉一直在生小鹦鹉。

es.e: Lionesses bearing cubs in the zoo is nothing new now.
es.c: 狮子在动物园繁殖早已屡见不鲜了。

d: n 急速上升；嗡嗡声；[摄] 变焦摄影 a sound made by a vehicle that is travelling fast；v 急速上升；摄像机移动
